source_text: and behold, a woman who was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment. for she said within herself, if i may but touch his garment, i shall be whole.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, ca dhèu ina kako la'e madhutu si. bhèni ne lèke papèd'a bhèni, dhu loe boe ciki sa d'ai canguru dua tèu kèna. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke kodho yesus di, tatu èi papèd'a ja'a ne èle. nèti èèna ka, na ara padètu la'e, hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus.

source_text: but jesus turned himself about, and when he saw her, he said, daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. and the woman was made whole from that hour.
target_text: yesus dhu ne'a, hèia na kabib'a, ladhe sa ina ne. ka na lii, peka na, ina, ee! pa'èra la d'ara èu. te, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèti èèna ka èu èle nèti papèd'a. hèia bhèni ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and when jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
target_text: èle ka, yesus si lasi taruu asa èmu nèti kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna. d'ai era nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara, hèia na ladhe nèdhi dhèu dhu tema karihu musiik mamadhe, dènge dhèu ae dhu tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: he said to them, give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. and they derided him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ae eele ka tangi, aa lami ka èmu miu! te ana ne madhe boe, dhoka na bhèj'i di. te ngaa dhèu se mari dènge pakapengo hèb'a mi yesus.

source_text: but when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu se aa'i-aa'i lasi asa li'u. ka yesus maso asa d'ara kama ana bhèni ne. na kèpe ai ana ne, hèia ana ne mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: and the fame of this went abroad into all that land.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne, ka dhèu mulai palolo lème ètu kabarai ra, lula-nèti ngaa dhu yesus tao ne.

source_text: and when jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, thou son of david, have mercy on us.
target_text: èle, hèia yesus kako taruu. ètu talora j'ara, abhu dhèu bèdhu dhèu dua dhu madhutu ne. dua ra rodhe, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ji'i la!

source_text: and when he had come into the house, the blind men came to him: and jesus saith to them, believe ye that i am able to do this? they said to him, yes, lord.
target_text: ropa yesus maso asa d'ara èmu cue, dhèu bèdhu se lasi paraga dènge ne. ka yesus karèi dua ra, peka na, miu se lèka tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne dènge koasa ho puri-pa'èle miu, sèna ka bisa ladhe mèdhi, do? hèia dua ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama karèi ia ka, te ji'i dhu lèka mema-mema le.

source_text: then he touched their eyes, saying, according to your faith, be it to you.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii dhaa dua ra, hèia yesus g'ag'e musi madha ra, ka na peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i ka madhutu parcaya miu.

source_text: and their eyes were opened; and jesus strictly charged them, saying, see that no man know it.
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, hèia dua ra ladhe rèdhi dènge ka. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, peka na, baku miu peka dènge ca dhèu sa, ngaa dhu j'aj'i le!

source_text: but they, when they had departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se taha rare boe d'ara ra. ka ra kako palème kabarai èèna, lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tatao yesus mi rèngu dua ra.

source_text: as thy went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a demon.
target_text: ropa dhèu bèdhu se lasi, dhèu rèti dhèu leo hari èci asa yesus. dhèu ne bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and when the demon was cast out, the dumb spoke: and the multitudes marveled, saying, it was never so seen in israel.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, hèia yesus paredha nidhu kalua nèti dhèu lii aad'o ne. nidhu èèna kalua, ka dhèu ne padhai lii dènge ka. hèia dhèu ae ètu era èèna malaa, ka ra peka na, ira ii! èdhi dhèu yahudi paraga tèdhi mèka madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne!

source_text: but the pharisees said, he casteth out demons, through the prince of the demons.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu parisi ka'uu, peka na, dhèu aae nidhu ka dhu hia ne koasa, sèna ka na bisa babège eela nidhu.

source_text: and jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness, and every disease among the people.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae, sèna ka aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèra. na aj'a dhèu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa j'ara tasamia rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: but when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae se, hèia na taha nare boe d'ara, lula dhèu se re'a heka tao sèmi ngaa sa. te rèngu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe dhèu madhenga.

source_text: then saith he to his disciples, the harvest truly is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae se, nuka sèmi nganga'a ae-ae ètu d'ara oka-tedhe. masi ka nganga'a ae titu kèna, te ngaa dhèu sab'a d'ai boe ho puu-g'ètu, sèna ka tèke asa d'ara gud'a.

source_text: pray ye therefore the lord of the harvest, that he will send forth laborers into his harvest.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i manèngi ku mi lamatua oka, sèna ka na tabha hari dhèu sab'a, ho lasi puu-g'ètu isi oka se.

source_text: and when he had called to him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness, and all manner of disease.
target_text: èle ka, yesus paroa ana madhutu na, sèna ka mai pakaboko. hèia na hia si koasa ho babège eele nidhu aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: now the names of the twelve apostles are these; the first, simon, who is called peter, and andrew his brother; james the son of zebedee, and john his brother;
target_text: ana madhutu na dhu na pua sèra, dhèu canguru dua, nuka: partama, ngara na simon dhu dhèu tema paroa ne, ‘petrus', dènge ari na, anderias, yakobis, dènge ari na, yohanis dua ra ana sabadeus,

source_text: philip, and bartholomew; thomas, and matthew the publican; james the son of alpheus, and lebbeus, whose surname was thaddeus;
target_text: pelipus, bertolomeos, tomas, mateos dhèu roro doi bea, yakobis dhu leo nuka ana alpius, tadius,

source_text: simon the canaanite, and judas iscariot, who also betrayed him.
target_text: simon nèti partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: these twelve jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, go not into the way of the gentiles, and enter ye not into any city of the samaritans. but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of israel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, aa paredha si, peka na, ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra, lula ae nèti rèngu dhu madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dènge mola. rèngu cakaraa kahib'i-kalèbho dhu sala j'ara. nèti èèna ka, baku lami asa dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dhèu samaria.

source_text: and as ye go, proclaim, saying, the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
target_text: lami peka dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra, na, ‘ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o kèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. '

source_text: heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons: freely ye have received, freely give.
target_text: aa lami puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, pa'èle dhèu kusta, aa babège eele nidhu. ama lamatua hia le miu ae-ae, te ngaa na manèngi hari boe ca ana maa sa. de lami ka ho pala pa'ae-ae mi dhèu leo, te ngaa mage mi manèngi hari ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses;
target_text: pakèd'i dènge ai hua. baku mèti doi,

source_text: nor bag for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor a staff: for the workman is worthy of his food.
target_text: gee j'ara, mèdha silu, salapa, do tatea. te dhèu hud'i hia ku dhèu sab'a, ngaa dhu pantas ho ra bisa mamuri.

source_text: and into whatever city or town ye shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy, and there abide till ye go thence.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota do rae èci, na, miu hud'i tenge ku dhèu dhu neo sèmi rare miu. hèia miu pea ètu èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: and when ye come into a house, salute it.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu, peka la dènge rèngu, ‘saloom! lamatua hia miu mèngi-nale. '

source_text: and if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara èmu ne, sèmi rare miu dènge be'a, na, miu manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia si berkat. te ngaa ladhe ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, na, lamatua hia boe rèngu berkat.

source_text: and whoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart from that house, or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, mi kalua nèti èmu èèna, do kota èèna, hèia miu caro eele ahu nèti haga miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ladhe ro'o boe nanene, pe rèngu d'ui rare pala ra.

source_text: verily, i say to you, it shall be more tolerable for the land of sodom and gomorrah, in the day of judgment, than for that city.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu ètu rai-haha ne'e, tatu na pabia mi dhèu sodom dènge gomora dhu uru èèna bhelu titu kèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! èèna na, nèngu huku bia risi hari mi dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu!

source_text: behold, i send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! te ja'a pua miu ne, èci èèna ka ja'a patabuli kahib'i-kalèbho asa talora aae busa hui. nèti èèna ka, ngangee miu hud'i sèmi mege dhu d'èlu-mèu. aa d'ara mi hud'i mola ku nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu ne'a boe tenge lii langu.

source_text: but beware of men: for they will deliver you to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues.
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu paj'èra miu, sama sèmi busa hui kadhi pamadhe kahib'i-kalèbho. èèna na, rèngu nuni rèti miu asa era parisa lii langu agama. aa dhèu hake paparu miu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and ye will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the gentiles.
target_text: pe rèngu ère rèti miu asa madha gubernur dènge dhèu aae, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o sèra, ho peka-padhai dènge ra lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua tadèngi kahèi kolongara ja'a ne.

source_text: but when they deliver you up, be not anxious how or what ye shall speak, for it shall be given to you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu nuni rèti miu sèmi èèna, mage miu madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a peka tasamia? ' do, ‘ja'a neo dhaa peka sèmi ngaa? ' baku j'aj'i mi ngangee, te ladhe d'ai lod'o na, ama mi ètu sorga ka dhu peka dènge miu, nèti j'ara mia ka dhu miu hud'i peka-padhai.

source_text: for it is not ye that speak, but the spirit of your father which speaketh in you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ngaa dhu miu padhai, mai boe nèti d'ara miu unu mi, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu aj'a-nori ètu d'ara miu, sèna ka miu padhai sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: and the brother will deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children will rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
target_text: sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu ca dhèu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu mesa na, ka dhu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. aa ladhe ana ka dhu parcaya, èèna na ama na ka dhu pamadhe ne. ladhe ina-ama ka dhu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a ana-ana ra ka dhu pamadhe si.

source_text: and ye will be hated by all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
target_text: sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha taruu, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri.

source_text: but when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily i say to you, ye shall not have gone over the cities of israel till the son of man shall have come.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu ètu d'ara kota cue, rai lami asa kota leo! lèke kèna! ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa miu palème aa'i mèka kota-kota ètu isra'el, te ngaa ja'a dhu lèpa hari mai le èèna.

source_text: the disciple is not above his teacher, nor the servant above his lord.
target_text: biasa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu mese risi nèti ana sakola na sèra. aa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu lamatua risi nèti ènu na sèra.

source_text: it is enough for the disciple that he should be as his teacher, and the servant as his lord: if they have called the master of the house beelzebub, how much more will they call them of his household?
target_text: ladhe ana sakola mèu sama sèmi mese na, nèngu pangee na d'ai le. aa ladhe ènu d'èlu-mèu sama sèmi lamatua na, nèngu ngee na d'ai le. de sanèd'e paie! ladhe dhèu paroa lamatua èmu, peka na, ‘èu ne, baalsebul, dhèu aae nidhu! ' tatu isi èmu na abhu kolongara dhu karehe risi hari.

source_text: fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
target_text: de miu baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu lab'a miu. te, ngaa dhu dhèu tao pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi.

source_text: what i tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that publish ye upon the house-tops.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu mesa mi, miu hud'i lami lole ku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. aa ngaa dhu ja'a paholo le dènge miu, miu se hud'i lami peka ku palème era.

source_text: and fear not them who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
target_text: baku madha'u dènge dhèu rai-haha, te rèngu bisa dhoka pamadhe ngi'u aae dhèu di, te ngaa bisa boe pa'ele iie samanga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua, te dhoka nèngu di dhu dènge koasa ho pamaso ngi'u aae dhèu dènge samanga kateme, asa d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo na loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and not one of them shall fall on the ground without your father.
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu. dhèu pahie ana mangungu ètu d'ara pasa dènge kab'ua ciki oo'e di. te ngaa ci'u sa bisa boe madhe, ladhe ama mi ètu sorga no'o mèka.

source_text: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
target_text: ama miu ètu sorga dhu loe boe ladhe-leru miu, toke j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki. d'ai rèu kètu ètu kab'a kètu miu, na ige nare aa'i hèi.

source_text: fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
target_text: de baku madha'u! lula ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: whoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will i also confess before my father who is in heaven.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, dhèu dhu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu katanga madha ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, ‘nèngu ne dhèu ja'a. '

source_text: but whoever shall deny me before men, him will i also deny before my father who is in heaven.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu pasili ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae, peka na nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a peka dènge ama ku ètu sorga kahèi, na, ‘ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e. '

source_text: think not that i am come to send peace on earth: i came not to send peace, but a sword.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, ja'a ne mai kèti dame asa rai-haha ne. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha ne èci lab'a èci.

source_text: for i am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke èèna, ‘èèna na, ana mone lab'a ama na, ana bhèni lab'a ina na, aa bhèni dhèu èmu ana na, lab'a ina nèti dhèu èmu na,

source_text: and a man's foes will be they of his own household.
target_text: te isi èmu mae-manyèla, lula èci lab'a èci. '

source_text: he that loveth father or mother more than me, is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me, is not worthy of me.
target_text: de dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i, risi nèti ina-ama na, aa risi nèti ana niki na. ladhe aad'o, na, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: and he that taketh not his cross, and followeth me, is not worthy of me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: he that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake, shall find it.
target_text: dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu dhoka neo mamuri hia ngi'u nèngu unu na, èèna na, mamuri na ele iia d'ara!

source_text: he that receiveth you, receiveth me, and he that receiveth me, receiveth him that sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, nèngu sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ja'a, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: he that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet, shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man, shall receive a righteous man's reward.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, lula na padhue-padhai lii holo-nori ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu d'ara mola, lula dhèu èèna madhutu tare'a-re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu d'ara mola.

source_text: and whoever shall give to drink to one of these little ones, a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, verily, i say to you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, tatu ama lamatua b'ala ne. masi ka dhèu hia èi hua ca galaa di, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe ne.

source_text: and it came to pass when jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
target_text: ropa yesus hia nare lii moa mi canguru dua ana madhutu na, hèia na la'e kako palème rae-rae ètu rai èèna, sèna ka aj'a dhèu ètu sèra. aa na peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: now when john had heard in the prison the works of christ, he sent two of his disciples,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. ropa na tadèngi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus tao, hèia na pua ana madhutu na ho lasi karèi yesus, peka na,

source_text: and said to him, art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na, nèngu neo pua kristus mai, sèna ka pala mamuri mi èdhi dhèu yahudi. ama ne, kristus, do? do, èdhi hud'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? ka lasi karèi yesus.

source_text: jesus answered and said to them, go and show john again those things which ye hear and see:
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se tadèngi le, aa mèdhi unu mi dènge madha. de lèpa ho lami peka dènge yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, yesaya, suri tèke le, peka na:

source_text: the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
target_text: dhèu bèdhu, ladhe rèdhi. dhèu karuku, kèd'i kako. dhèu pèd'a kusta, ka'uri ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, bisa tadèngi. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu unu aad'o, nanene lii lolo be'a.

source_text: and blessed is he to whom i shall not be the cause of his falling into sin.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e: lami peka dènge yohanis, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu a'oto, ladhe na parcaya ja'a taruu. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a pa'èra-èra!

source_text: and as they departed, jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning john, what went ye out into the wilderness to see? a reed shaken with the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae se, lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, lod'o miu neo paraga dènge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, miu pangee, na, neo paraga dènge dhèu dhu sèmi ngaa sa? tatu boe, miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aala-aala, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu ngèlu di!

source_text: but what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
target_text: aa tatu boe miu mèdhi dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: but what went ye out to see? a prophet? yes, i say to you, and more than a prophet.
target_text: de lami ladhe dhèu sèmi ngaa sa ètu nèi? mi pangee na, miu lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua! tare'a! te nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu kapai risi.

source_text: for this is he concerning whom it is written, behold, i send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, dhu suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: verily, i say to you, among them that are born of women, there hath not risen a greater than john the baptist: notwithstanding, he that is least in the kingdom of heaven, is greater than he.
target_text: nanene paie! ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis ne. te ngaa nèti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae, dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, nèngu dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: and from the days of john the baptist, until now, the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
target_text: karèi nèti yohanis pakako sasab'a na, d'ai sange ne'e ne, abhu dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo dhu pangee sala, peka na rèngu hud'i pamusu ku, sèna ka laka-seti dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: for all the prophets and the law prophesied until john.
target_text: toke d'ai lod'o mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tema madhutu atora musa, dènge atora dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua leo sèra.

source_text: and if ye will receive it, this is elijah who was to come.
target_text: de parcaya la ja'a! yohanis ne, nuka elia, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, peka mema le lula-nèti mamai na.

source_text: he that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: de dhu neo me'a mèu, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie!

source_text: but to what shall i liken this generation? it is like to children sitting in the markets, and calling to their fellows,
target_text: ja'a neo hia lii pakasame, sèna ka miu me'a, rupa sèmi mia ka dhèu taa limuri ne. te rèngu se cakaraa dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. rèngu dhu pa'oo-parodha dènge angalai ra, peka na,

source_text: and saying, we have piped to you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not lamented.
target_text: ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino dènge karej'e-karae, te ngaa miu roge-ledho boe. hèia ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: for john came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, he hath a demon.
target_text: miu se sama sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe roca. lod'o yohanis mai, nèngu d'èi puasa, aa ninu boe èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu, nidhu tao! '

source_text: the son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, behold, a man gluttonous, and a wine-bibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. but wisdom is justified by her children.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai le. ja'a puasa boe, aa kinu èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu èèna, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! dhèu tema mahu bia! la'e pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. nèngu dhu ne'a boe makae! ' te ngaa mi patadhe lii padhai ja'a ne! mamèu ama lamatua èèna, cèu ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu unu na.

source_text: then he began to upbraid the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they repented not.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua yesus pasanèd'e dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu pèri-pèri rae. na tao le tadha-tadha malaa ae risi ètu nèi, te ngaa ro'o boe ae eele nèti sasala ra, ho madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola.

source_text: woe to thee, chorazin; woe to thee, bethsaida: for if the mighty works which have been done in you had been done in tyre and sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
target_text: yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu dhèu korasin, aa miu dhèu betsaida! mate unu miu! bèli-camèd'a pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo! ja'a tao le rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya ama lamatua. masi ka miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe lamatua, te ngaa ladhe sèmi tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao se'e ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra èle le ho'a, aa tèke eele le sasala-sasigo ra ho madhutu ama lamatua. aa tatu ra pake le bèla mèdhi, dènge tao ahu mi kètu ho j'aj'i mi tadha, na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala ra. masi ka dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra dhèu yahudi boe, dhu mangaku na, tadhe lamatua.

source_text: but i say to you, it shall be more tolerable for tyre and sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
target_text: ja'a monya boe! bèli-camèd'a mèdhi unu mi! d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, hahuku dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and thou, capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works which have been done in thee, had been done in sodom, it would have remained until this day.
target_text: miu dhèu kapernaum! mage-mage, ee! mage mi pangee, na, ama lamatua paca'e miu lami asa sorga. aad'o! èèna na lamatua pèci mi asa d'ara naraka! ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu dhu j'aj'i uuru le ètu kota sodom, tatu ama lamatua parluu boe labhu pakèpu kota èèna. te ladhe dhèu sodom rèdhi tadha malaa se, tatu ra rai eele le nèti bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: but i say to you, that it shall be more tolerable for the land of sodom, in the day of judgment, than for thee.
target_text: tare'a! pe mèdhi unu mi! ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku dhèu sodom samaa risi nèti hahuku miu se!

source_text: at that time jesus answered and said, i thank thee, o father, lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them to babes.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pahuni pamèno-mèno j'ara-j'ara dhu ama hia huku mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, aa dhu padedha iisi ra. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu haha dènge dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: even so, father, for so it seemed good in thy sight.
target_text: tare'a, ama! te sèmi èèna ka, dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things are delivered to me by my father; and no man knoweth the son, but the father; neither knoweth any man the father, save the son, and he to whomsoever the son will reveal him.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, na, nanene paie-iie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u le koasa aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a ne. dhu tadhe mèu ja'a, dhoka ama ku di. aa dhu tadhe mèu ama, dhoka ana na, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka peka dènge ra, ho rèngu tadhe mèu ne kahèi.

source_text: come to me, all ye that labor, and are heavy laden, and i will give you rest.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu roe lula sab'a bia, mai madhutu ja'a! aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pasae bia, mai la asa ja'a!

source_text: take my yoke upon you, and learn from me: for i am meek and lowly in heart; and ye shall find rest to your souls.
target_text: ladhe miu sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a, ho kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, na, èdhi ca ropa dènge sapi dua ngi'u dhu nuni kataka pare rai èci. te ja'a ne, d'ara hua iia, aa lii mako. ladhe miu madhutu ja'a, miu j'aj'i èra hari.

source_text: for my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
target_text: lula a'aj'a ja'a, carui boe. aa paredha ja'a, bia boe kahèi.

source_text: at that time jesus went on the sabbath through the corn, and his disciples were hungry, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu kako re karasa oka dhèu. ana madhutu na manganga, hèia ra g'ètu are-gandum ka ra'a noo-noo.

source_text: but when the pharisees saw it, they said to him, behold, thy disciples do that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu madhutu pa'èra ad'a dhèu yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus se tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra kai ne, peka na, ana madhutu mu, g'ètu gandum lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a! rèngu baku tao sèmi ne'e! te tatao ne sisu atora èdhi.

source_text: but he said to them, have ye not read what david did when he was hungry, and they that were with him; how he entered into the house of god, and ate the show-bread, which it was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them who were with him, but only for the priests?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? miu teko bhèlu lii lolo daud, si? daud dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu manganga titu kèna. hèia na maso asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka nare roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua, ka rèngu ra'a. te ngaa dhu bisa ra'e roti se dhodhoka ama agama sèra. dhèu leo bisa boe. èle ka daud si ra'a, te ngaa ca dhèu sa pasala boe si. miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu baca mèdhi boe sasuri lii holo-nori ama lamatua!

source_text: or have ye not read in the law, that on the sabbath the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, suri kahèi nèti sasab'a ama agama yahudi sèra, ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. te ngaa rèngu sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but i say to you, that in this place is one greater than the temple.
target_text: nanene! uru èèna, èmu sabaj'a ka dhu kab'ua, te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhu kab'ua risi, nuka ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: but if ye had known what this meaneth, i will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: dhèu ja'a sèra hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia èci dènge èci. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu j'ara ne, na, badha korban dhu rèngu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' de ladhe miu me'a mèu sasoa nèti lii padhai lamatua ne, tatu miu pasala boe ana madhutu ja'a se. te ra tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: for the son of man is lord even of the sabbath.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète, peka na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: and when he had departed thence, he went into their synagogue.
target_text: èle ka yesus tèke eele era èèna, la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: and behold, there was a man who had his hand withered. and they asked him, saying, is it lawful to heal on the sabbath? that they might accuse him.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu mone ca dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka. dhèu parisi sèra dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho pasala yesus, ladhe sèmi na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and he said to them, what man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it shall fall into a pit on the sabbath, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ci'u manahu asa d'ara ro'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a, dhèu unu na mai name nare, sina ma?

source_text: how much then is a man better than a sheep? wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
target_text: de ama lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha, risi nèti dhèu unu kahib'i-kalèbho deo na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bisa tao j'ara dhu be'a lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: then saith he to the man, stretch out thy hand. and he stretched it out; and it was restored to a sound state like the other.
target_text: ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai! hèia, na j'ole kacui-aai dhu madhe èèna, kaca'a la èle dènge ka, sama dènge kacui-aai dhu iia èèna.

source_text: then the pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi se rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa titu kèna. èle ka ra kalua tèke eele èmu sabaj'a ne, hèia lasi pare'a, aku rèngu na, èdhi hud'i tenge ku j'ara, sèna ka pamadhe ne!

source_text: but when jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a ngangee rèngu dhu karehe ne, nèti èèna ka la'e asa era leo. dhèu ae madhutu ne, hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and charged them that they should not make him known:
target_text: te ngaa na kai si, peka na, mage lami palolo kahèi dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by isaiah the prophet, saying,
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna, madhutu sèmi lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka le mi dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri tèke, na,

source_text: behold, my servant, whom i have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: i will put my spirit upon him, and he shall show judgment to the gentiles.
target_text: ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a, dhu ja'a hag'e kore le. ja'a sue ne, aa d'ara ja'a karej'e taruu dènge ne. èèna na, ja'a pangèd'u ne roh ja'a, ho la'e aj'a-nori dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: he shall not contend, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
target_text: nèngu ne, ne'a boe tèb'a kakara. nèngu ne, ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: a bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he shall send forth judgment to victory.
target_text: d'ara na hua iia. dhu ne'a boe paj'èra dhèu. aj'u dhu oe padhe, na lèku eele boe. labhu dhu saruru, na tiu pamadhe boe. na loe boe aj'a-nori dhèu, toke dhèu aa'i-aa'i tao madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu mola nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and in his name shall the gentiles trust.
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i èèna na parcaya ne, lula re'a na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: then was brought to him one possessed with a demon, blind and dumb; and he healed him, so that the blind and dumb both spoke and saw.
target_text: ca tèka, rèti asa yesus ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao toke bèdhu aa ele lii. hèia yesus pa'èle ne dènge babège eele nidhu nèti dhèu ne'e. ka dhèu ne bisa nèdhi, aa bisa padhai lii.

source_text: and all the people were amazed, and said, is not this the son of david?
target_text: dhèu ae se, ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra malaa-maloha. ra papeka na, nèngu ne'e, ele boe ana-èpu daud, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka! nèngu ne'e, tatu dhèu dhu èdhi mate tae-tae èèna!

source_text: but when the pharisees heard it, they said, this man doth not cast out demons, but by beelzebub the prince of the demons.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu parisi tadèngi rare, hèia ra ro'o boe parcaya. ka ra papeka, na, wee! dhèu ne bisa babège nidhu, lula dhèu aae nidhu baalsebul ka dhu pangèd'u na koasa.

source_text: and jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them, every kingdom divided against itself, is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself, shall not stand.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai dhèu parisi se. hèia na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, lii padhai miu ne, lèke boe! ladhe ètu d'ara rai cue, ana kabarai na patao-palaha, tasa mera mia ho rai ne bisa taha! sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara kota èci, do d'ara èmu cue, èci patao dènge èci, tatu ra mae-manyèla, toke laho mae-mae, si!

source_text: and if satan casteth out satan, he is divided against himself; how then shall his kingdom stand?
target_text: de ladhe nidhu pamusu dènge nidhu, aa palab'a èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra nèd'u paredha nèbhu boe!

source_text: and if i by beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your children expel them? therefore they shall be your judges.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu re'a kahèi babège eele nidhu. ra pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o! de miu baku padhai lii ore dhu peka na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu, ho babège eele nidhu. pe dhèu miu unu mi ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: but if i cast out demons by the spirit of god, then the kingdom of god is come to you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a babège eele nidhu pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua, èèna pad'elo na, lamatua èèna tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhu ètu le katanga madha miu.

source_text: or else, how can one enter into a strong man's house, and seize his goods, except he shall first bind the strong man? and then he will plunder his house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo lasi mana'u èmu dhèu èci dhu èra, nèngu hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku dhèu lamatua èmu ne. heka na mana'u nèti mèdha-panyau na sèra.

source_text: he that is not with me, is against me; and he that gathereth not with me, scattereth abroad.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu pamusu dènge ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ja'a ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka pa'iu dhèu di.

source_text: wherefore i say to you, all manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to men: but the blasphemy against the holy spirit shall not be forgiven to men.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie lii padhai ja'a ne! ama lamatua dhu sadia saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu leo, ama lamatua sadia abho ne era. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu bani padhai pakarehe roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na èèna.

source_text: and whoever speaketh a word against the son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whoever speaketh against the holy spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pakarehe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala na. te ngaa cee ka dhu bani padhai lii pahahe roh ama lamatua, te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na, masi ka toke dai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by its fruit.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii taruu dènge dhèu parisi se, peka na, ngee paie-iie! aj'u dhu be'a, hia hua dhu be'a. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe, hia hua dhu karehe. nèti hua na, dhèu bisa tadhe aj'u ne, be'a do karehe.

source_text: o generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaketh.
target_text: te ngaa miu se ca ropa dènge mege, dhu ne'a dhoka kapod'e-kabèli di! miu me'a boe padhai lii dhu be'a. lula ngaa dhu tèke ètu d'ara, èèna ka dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara hèb'a na.

source_text: a good man, out of the good treasure of the heart, bringeth forth good things: and an evil man, out of the evil treasure, bringeth forth evil things.
target_text: dhèu be'a, tatu lii padhai na be'a, lula ètu d'ara na abhu j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu bhelu, tatu lii padhai na karehe, lula ètu d'ara na dhu pènu dènge bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: but i say to you, that for every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account in the day of judgment.
target_text: lèka la lii ja'a ne! te bèli-camèd'a lod'o èle rai-haha, ama lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i. lod'o èèna, dhèu èci-èci ka hud'i dhaa lii-lii nèngu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
target_text: de mage-mage! te bèli-camèd'a èèna, ama lamatua dadoo lii-lii miu sèra, aa pama'ète peka na, miu lèke huku do, aad'o.

source_text: then certain of the scribes and of the pharisees answered, saying, master, we would see a sign from thee.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, hèia pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi, peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i neo ngèdhi tadha malaa èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, koasa ama, tare'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but he answered and said to them, an evil and adulterous generation seeketh for a sign, and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet jonah.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke si, peka na, weh! miu dhèu taa limuri ne, mo'o boe madhutu ama lamatua! miu se me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a di! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a tao boe. lula uru èèna, lamatua hia le tadha malaa re yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai na. èèna d'ai le!

source_text: for as jonah was three days and three nights in the whale's belly: so shall the son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
target_text: yunus pea tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda ètu d'ara kabake i'a aae ci'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ja'a kahèi ètu d'ara ro'a dhèu madhe, tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda.

source_text: the men of nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of jonah; and behold, a greater than jonah is here.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, lamatua j'aj'i hakim. aa dhèu niniwe se titu j'aj'i sakasii ho galaa miu, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i se, goa! ' uru èèna, ropa dhèu niniwe sèra tadèngi lii padhai yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, hèia ra tèke eele sasala ra. te ngaa miu sèmi boe èèna. masi ka limuri ne, abhu le dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti yunus, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu se pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: the queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of solomon; and behold, a greater than solomon is here.
target_text: pe, ètu d'ara lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe lamatua j'aj'i hakim, bhèni aae syeba nèti balèu, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi. na paj'uj'u ai na mi miu, ho na galaa miu aa'i-aa'i dhu ana loo-limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi, goa! ' uru èèna, bhèni aae ne mai nèti rai kaj'èu ho neo nèdhi unu na mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu ètu talora aae miu dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: when the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and he findeth none.
target_text: ladhe babège eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne la'e pea asa era dhu kaliu, ho j'aj'i mi era ae iisi na. te ngaa abhu boe era dhu mèci ho na pea kalili.

source_text: then he saith, i will return into my house from whence i came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
target_text: hèia na pangee, peka na, ‘abhu boe era dhu be'a sèmi nèi, hua iia ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. ' ka la'e hari asa era nèngu uru èèna. na ladhe na, era ne mèu bia, aa dhu lalau rare pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. even so shall it be also to this wicked generation.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa nare angalai na dhèu pidhu dhu bhabhelu ra risi nèti nèngu. ka lasi pea ètu d'ara dhèu ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra kakeho ne. de limuri ne, mamuri dhèu ne asa ele iie-iie. sèmi èèna kahèi lèke mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a taa limuri ne.

source_text: while he was yet speaking to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na sèra, mai neo paraga dènge ne. rèngu titu ètu li'u, ka ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ne.

source_text: then one said to him, behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
target_text: hèia dhèu mai peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! ina dènge ari ama ètu li'u nèi. rèngu neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: but he answered and said to him that told him, who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, cee ka ina ku, aa cee ka a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a?

source_text: and he stretched forth his hand towards his disciples, and said, behold my mother and my brethren!
target_text: hèia na paj'uj'u asa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu ne, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, rèngu se'e se ka, ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: for whoever shall do the will of my father who is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi ama ku ètu sorga, rèngu ka ina ku aa a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: the same day jesus went out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus kalua nèti èmu èèna, la'e madhèdi asa sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: and great multitudes were gathered to him, so that he went into a boat, and sat down; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae-ae mai lingu rare ne. ka la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue, dhu panahu ètu era èèna, ho aj'a dhèu sèra. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu dae sèra nanene ne.

source_text: and he spoke many things to them in parables, saying, behold, a sower went forth to sow;
target_text: hèia na aj'a madha j'ara ae-ae mi rèngu pake lii pakasame. na lole, peka na, abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them:
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini se, abhu dhu lèke ètu j'ara. hèia manu-bhui mai, ka tutu ra'e aa'i hini se.

source_text: some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai dhu dènge hadhu. hini se muri malai, lula abhu rai ciki di.

source_text: and when the sun had risen, they were scorched; and because they had not root, they withered.
target_text: te ngaa ropa lod'o rea, hèia ana aaj'u se kamale, ka mango eele si. te amo ra marèma boe ètu d'ara rai.

source_text: and some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
target_text: abhu hini cahag'e dhu lèke ètu era j'u'u padhudhu. hèia j'u'u padhudhu se hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: but others fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some a hundred-fold, some sixty-fold, some thirty-fold.
target_text: te ngaa abhu hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai isi. hini se muri, ka ra kapai toke hua-hela. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu dhu èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na nanene paie-iie!

source_text: and the disciples came, and said to him, why speakest thou to them in parables?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka ama aj'a dhèu ae pake lii pakasame?

source_text: he answered and said to them, because it is given to you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, lula miu se neo me'a tare'a-re'a paredha ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka mema sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a aj'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: for whoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua hia ne asa ne'a ae. te ngaa dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, pe lamatua tao ne asa tabha goa.

source_text: therefore i speak to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
target_text: ja'a aj'a-nori si pake dhoka lii pakasame di, lula: ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ra pusi-pahae boe. '

source_text: and in them is fulfilled the prophecy of isaiah, which saith, by hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
target_text: rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu dhu yesaya suri mema le. yesaya èèna, nuka dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘miu èèna na tadèngi, te ngaa miu pakatele dhilu. miu èèna na ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa mo'o boe pame'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: for this people's heart is become gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and i should heal them.
target_text: lula d'ara dhèu se'e adhu sèmi hadhu, ra pakatele dhilu ra, aa ra pabèdhu musi madha ra. de hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ro'a dhilu ra katele-katipa, aa soro tèke si, sèna ka musi madha ra bèdhu sèmi èèna. hud'i laa, ho ja'a puri-pa'èle ia ka si, lula rèngu pusi-pahae boe ja'a. '

source_text: but blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
target_text: te ngaa miu se, oto! lula miu ladhe mèdhi dènge musi madha, aa tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu miu unu mi.

source_text: for verily i say to you, that many prophets and righteous men have desired to see the things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear the things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola, d'ara ra neo rèdhi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa bisa boe. d'ara ra neo kahèi tadèngi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu tadèngi le, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge ra, de mi nanene ka sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: when any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. this is he who received seed by the way side.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori nèti ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, te ngaa nèngu ne'a iia boe. hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu ne.

source_text: but he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and immediately with joy receiveth it;
target_text: hini dhu ceb'e lèke ètu rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia na sèmi nare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: yet he hath not root in himself, but endureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, forthwith he is offended.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, amo na marèma boe. nèti èèna ka, nare boe nèbhu ètu d'ara dhèu ne. ropa dhèu leo paj'èra ne lula na sèmi nare lii holo-nori ne, ka dhèu ne kèpe pa'èra heka a'aj'a sèra.

source_text: he also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora aae j'u'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori. te ngaa nèngu bhute dènge rupa-rupa j'ara, ho pakarej'e mamuri na. hèia bhabhute se'e ka seti eele lii holo-nori ne nèti d'ara nèngu, toke dènge heka kab'ua.

source_text: but he that receiveth seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; who also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some a hundred fold, some sixty, some thirty.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu rai isi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa paie dhilu na, sèna ka sèmi nare lii holo-nori, aa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. hèia na tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sama sèmi hini dhu muri toke kapai, ka na hua ae-ae. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu kahèi èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: another parable he proposed to them, saying, the kingdom of heaven is likened to a man who sowed good seed in his field:
target_text: yesus lolo hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua ne, nuka sèmi abhu ca dhèu la'e ceb'e hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and departed.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i bhèj'i luu, hèia dhèu bhelu mai, ka na ceb'e lamusi j'u'u ètu d'ara oka ne.

source_text: but when the blade had sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
target_text: ropa hini ètu d'ara oka ne d'ai hua-hela, hèia dhèu sab'a se, ladhe rèdhi j'u'u dhu muri palere-lere dènge hini se.

source_text: so the servants of the householder came and said to him, sir, didst thou not sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
target_text: ka lasi peka dènge lamatua oka ne, aku rèngu na, ‘ama! ca hari ni ji'i sèle hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka ama, si? nga tao ka muri mai pab'ali dènge j'u'u ae-ae? '

source_text: he said to them, an enemy hath done this. the servants said to him, wilt thou then that we go and gather them?
target_text: lamatua oka ne dhaa, peka na, ‘èèna tatao nèti dhèu bhelu. ' hèia dhèu sab'a se peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ama, ji'i la'a ko'o eele j'u'u sèi, do? '

source_text: but he said, no; lest while ye gather the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
target_text: te ngaa na b'ala, peka na, ‘hud'i laa, te ladhe miu ko'o eele j'u'u se, ana nganga'a èdhi se lèke bete kahèi.

source_text: let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest i will say to the reapers, gather ye first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
target_text: hud'i rèngu sène ra muri palere-lere toke hèru puu-g'ètu. pe d'ai lod'o na, ja'a peka dènge dhèu sab'a se, na, miu pakaboko uru ku j'u'u sèra. hèia èki si ca èki-ca èki ho tunu eele si. èle ku, heka ta pakaboko isi oka kèna, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara babesi. '

source_text: another parable he proposed to them, saying, the kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard-seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
target_text: èle, ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pake hari lii pakasame èci, sèna ka miu me'a tasamia ama lamatua j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu ae-ae. dhèu unu na sèra, mulai nuka sèmi lamusi dhu ana iiki titu kèna, dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge on its branches.
target_text: masi ka lamusi ne ana iiki d'ai seli, te ngaa ladhe na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae ètu d'ara oka ne. toke manu-bhui tao rèd'a ètu dadana-dadana na.

source_text: another parable he spoke to them; the kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
target_text: yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge ragi dhu bhèni èci nare, pab'ali dènge tarigu ca sak. hèia roti ne ca'e toke kapai, lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e deo na.

source_text: all these things jesus spoke to the multitude in parables; and without a parable he spoke not to them:
target_text: yesus aj'a dhèu ae dènge lii lolo rupa-rupa. lii padhai na, aa'i-aa'i se, dhodhoka pake lii pakasame di.

source_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, i will open my mouth in parables; i will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
target_text: na aj'a sèmi èèna, sèna ka madhutu sèmi lii nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, pe ja'a aj'a-nori pake lii pakasame. pe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu tadèngi rèdhi mèka, karèi nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: then jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came to him, saying, declare to us the parable of the tares of the field.
target_text: èle ka, yesus lèpa èmu tèke eele dhèu ae sèra. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai manèngi, na, ama! peka ku dènge ji'i sasoa nèti lii pakasame j'u'u deo sa!

source_text: he answered and said to them, he that soweth the good seed is the son of man;
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, dhèu dhu ceb'e hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: the field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
target_text: aa oka èèna, nuka rai-haha ne. hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka dhèu-dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu ama lamatua. aa j'u'u sèra, nuka ana pajuu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: the enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
target_text: aa dhèu bhelu dhu mai ceb'e lamusi j'u'u, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. aa lod'o puu-g'ètu èèna, nuka d'ai èle rai-haha ne. dhèu sab'a dhu pakaboko isi oka se, nuka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: as therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
target_text: ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ra oru rare j'u'u se ho tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: the son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them who do iniquity;
target_text: te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a pua ana pajuu nèti sorga mai. rèngu èèna na pakaboko dhèu-dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa rèngu oru rare kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka baku madhutu paredha lamatua.

source_text: and shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: èèna na ra core dhèu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i se asa d'ara ai naraka, nuka sèmi j'u'u dhu ai na'e pakèpu si. ètu nèi, dhèu se rasa j'èra titu kèna, aa tangi d'ara ma'ète mae-mae loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: then shall the righteous shine as the sun in the kingdom of their father. who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu pea taruu dènge ama dhèu aae ra ètu sorga. ètu nèi, dhèu se ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti, nuka sèmi madha lod'o. de dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ja'a, pasa dhilu paie-iie!

source_text: again, the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hid in a field; which, when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
target_text: yesus tabha hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu neo abhu mèdha kab'ua aae, dhu dhèu huni tèke ètu d'ara rai cakasib'i. ka dhèu ne la'e kèi, hèia na abhu mèdha ne, nèti èèna ka na karej'e-karae. èle èèna ka, na dhènu hari mèdha deo na. hèia na lèpa hari lai-lai, la'e pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. ka la'e hèli nare rai ne, sèna ka na unu mèdha dhu kab'ua aae deo na.

source_text: again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking goodly pearls:
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii pakasame, peka na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu d'aga ca dhèu dhu d'ara na neo abhu mutiara dhu kab'ua aae titu kèna. èle ka, na patangi-tenge mutiara ho neo hèli.

source_text: who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
target_text: ropa na rage mutiara cue dhu be'a titu kèna, hèia na lèpa lai-lai, sèna ka pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. hèia la'e tihe mutiara ne, sèna ka j'aj'i mi unu na.

source_text: again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
target_text: yesus peka hari, na, paredha ama lamatua, nuka sèmi pèku èci dhu dhèu sab'a dhasi lasi lolo ètu d'ara dano. ka pèku ne lèke rupa-rupa i'a.

source_text: which, when it was full, they drew to the shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast away the bad.
target_text: ropa pèku ne pènu dènge i'a, dhèu pèku se ded'e rèti asa dedha nebhe. hèia ra madhèdi kabhili i'a nèti pèku ne. i'a dhu be'a, ra tao asa d'ara kalera. te ngaa i'a dhu karehe, ra core eele.

source_text: so shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
target_text: èci èèna ka, ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne. èèna na ana pajuu lamatua mai nèti sorga, sèna ka hag'e eele dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra, core si asa d'ara ai naraka. ètu nèi, rèngu heka re'a j'aj'èra, aa loe boe tangi roma iisi.

source_text: jesus saith to them, have ye understood all these things? they say to him, yes, lord.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus karèi ra, aku nèngu na, miu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai se, do? ra dhaa peka na, nge'a, ama!

source_text: then said he to them, therefore every scribe who is instructed to the kingdom of heaven, is like a man that is a householder, who bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a! te mese agama aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a tare'a-re'a lii holo-nori lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru èèna, ka ra kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a ja'a, na, rèngu ca ropa dènge lamatua èmu dhu d'èi bhoke gud'a na, ho pad'elo mèdha-panyau na dhu dhui, dènge mèdha-panyau na dhu hiu.

source_text: and it came to pass, that when jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, hèia la'e, tèke eele era èèna,

source_text: and when he had come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
target_text: ho lèpa asa rae na. d'ai nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ho aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi lii padhai na malaa-maloha. ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! dhèu ne d'èlu-mèu titu kèna, nga! na sakola ètu mia ne? tasamia ka na bisa tao tadha malaa se'e?

source_text: is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called mary? and his brethren, james, and joses, and simon, and judas?
target_text: nèngu ne dhoka ana nèti ca dhèu tuka aj'u di. èdhi patadha be'a dènge ina na maria; aa dènge ari na aa'i-aa'i, nuka yakobis, yusuf, yudas dènge simon.

source_text: and his sisters, are they not all with us? whence then hath this man all these things?
target_text: èdhi tadhe ana hèni na kahèi, te èdhi pea ètu d'ara rae cue! de na abhu mamèu na nèti mia? aa na abhu koasa kapai ne nèti cee hari?

source_text: and they were offended in him. but jesus said to them, a prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and in his own house.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu se kacèki, toke ra ro'o heka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! dhèu d'èi risi pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti era leo, te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti rae rèngu unu ra.

source_text: and he did not many mighty works there, because of their unbelief.
target_text: lula d'ara ra adhu, toke ra parcaya boe yesus, nèti èèna ka na tao tadha malaa ae boe ètu d'ara rae na.

source_text: at that time herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of jesus,
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi galilea. nèngu ne dhu tadèngi le kahèi rupa-rupa j'ara lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: and said to his servants, this is john the baptist; he hath risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do show forth themselves in him.
target_text: na peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, aku nèngu na, ele boe yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a pua dhèu poro rare kètu na. limuri ne, na mamuri hari le! nèti èèna ka, na abhu koasa, tao tadha-tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: for herod had laid hold on john, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of herodias, his brother philip's wife.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna nèngu dhu tao lii langu dènge yohanis, toke na kèpe yohanis aa pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia-pa'ela mèka.

source_text: for john had said to him, it is not lawful for thee to have her.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai ne pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae, baku paleo èmu dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te j'ara ne, pamèci boe dènge ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi!

source_text: and when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa herodes dale boe lii kai na, hèia leo nare herodias. madhutu iia-iia na, herodes neo pamadhe yohanis tuka sarani. te ngaa na madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, lula ra parcaya na, yohanis ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, na pua dhèu sab'a na pamaso yohanis asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: but when herod's birth-day was kept, the daughter of herodias danced before them, and pleased herod.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, hèia herodes tao pesta hari jadi na. lod'o èèna, ana bhèni nèti bhèni aae herodias la'e roge ètu madha tamu se. na roge be'a titu kèna, toke d'ara herodes karej'e bia.

source_text: upon which he promised with an oath to give her whatever she would ask.
target_text: na roge nare, hèia herodes paroa ne, ka na peka, èu neo manèngi hadia ngaa nèti ja'a, na peka la! te èèna na ja'a hia èu. ja'a leko boe-monya boe. aa ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and she, being before instructed by her mother, said, give me here the head of john the baptist in a dish.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu aae peka sèmi èèna, hèia ina na kakèj'i ne. nèti èèna ka, ana ne la'e peka na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu nèti yohanis tuka sarani. tèke ne mi d'ara dula, ho rèti mai asa ne'e hia ja'a.

source_text: and the king was sorry: nevertheless for the sake of the oath, and of them who sat with him at table, he commanded it to be given her.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii manèngi ana bhèni ne, hèia d'ara herodes roe dènge. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe ère nare hari lii subha na, te tamu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le. nèti èèna ka, na madhutu dhoka dad'èi ana bhèni ne di.

source_text: and he sent, and beheaded john in the prison.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu lasi poro rare kètu yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and his head was brought in a dish, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, hèia ra tèke mi d'ara dula ho rèti lasi hia mi ana bhèni ne. ropa ana bhèni ne sèmi nare dula, hèia nèti asa ina na.

source_text: and his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told jesus.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se tadèngi, ka mai rare ngi'u aae na, ho lasi padhane. èle ka, lasi peka dènge yesus j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: when jesus heard of it, he departed thence in a boat, into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard of it, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
target_text: lod'o yesus tadèngi ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi yohanis, hèia nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna. hèia ra ca'e koha, ho lasi asa era dhu dhèu pea boe, sèna ka ra ae rare ciki. te ngaa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi koha yesus si dhu oro-oro re sebhe dano. ka dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae, kako karohe-karohe re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se d'ai uuru nèti yesus si.

source_text: and jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion towards them, and he healed their sick.
target_text: ropa na puru nèti dedha koha, hèia nèdhi dhèu ae-ae dhu mate le nèngu. ka na rasa kasia mi rèngu. hèia na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, this is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, hèia ana madhutu na, peka dènge ne, ama! hua iia ama pua dhèu se, sèna ka lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae-rae dhu padètu ètu se'e. te lod'o nihia le! ètu ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but jesus said to them, they need not depart; give ye them to eat.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, baku! miu ka dhu panga'a si.

source_text: and they say to him, we have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ira ee, ama! ji'i se dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, ho panga'a dhèu ae-ae sèmi ne'e ne. ji'i tao tasamia? te abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua di, aa i'a dua ngi'u di!

source_text: he said, bring them hither to me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, oo! be'a kèna. mèti ku mai!

source_text: and he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and broke, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi kaboko ètu dedha j'u'u. èle èèna ka, yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. hèia na ladhe asa dedha, ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle ka, na pamae roti se, hèia j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and they all ate, and were satisfied: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
target_text: ka dhèu se ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rara, hèia ana madhutu se pakaboko rare dhu ata, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and they that had eaten were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone pe d'ai lèmi riho sa, iga mèka dhèu bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and immediately jesus constrained his disciples to get into a boat, and to go before him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a rare, hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na ca'e koha, sèna ka lasi uru asa cabèka dano. te ngaa nèngu ètu èèna era, sena ka pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and when he had sent the multitudes away, he ascended a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
target_text: ropa rèngu lèpa aa'i mèu-mèu, hèia yesus ca'e la'e asa ledhe èci, ho sabaj'a. toke mèda, nèngu mesa na ètu èèna era.

source_text: but the boat was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
target_text: lod'o èèna, koha ana madhutu na d'ai le talora aae dano. te ngaa rèngu tuku d'ai madhe, lula ngèlu nèti madha, aa naha kapai tatèb'e koha ra.

source_text: and in the fourth watch of the night jesus went to them, walking on the sea.
target_text: oe d'ai mèu, hèia yesus la'e madhutu si. te ngaa nèngu dhu kako re dedha èi.

source_text: and when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, it is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, ana madhutu se cag'ag'a, hèia ra padhai dènge lii madha'u, aku rèngu na, heeh! nidhu kèna!

source_text: but immediately jesus spoke to them, saying, be of good cheer; it is i; be not afraid.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, peka na, miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne, yesus! mau-mau la!

source_text: and peter answered him and said, lord, if it is thou, bid me come to thee on the water.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia petrus peka na, ladhe ama kèna, pua la ja'a kako re dedha èi ne, dhiu asa ama.

source_text: and he said, come. and when peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water, to go to jesus.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa peka na, mai ka! hèia petrus puru nèti dedha koha, la'e re dedha èi, asa yesus.

source_text: but when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, lord, save me.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus rasa na ngèlu aae, hèia na madha'u bia. ka na mulai cène, hèia na pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ira oo, ama, ee! soru ku ja'a la!

source_text: and immediately jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said to him, o thou of little faith, why didst thou doubt?
target_text: yesus j'ole dènge ka kacui-aai na, ka kèpe nare petrus. hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, petrus, ee! nga tao ka d'ara èu kajari? èu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a, do?

source_text: and when they had come into the boat, the wind ceased.
target_text: ka dua ra ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, hèia ngèlu mau dènge.

source_text: then they that were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, in truth thou art the son of god.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na koa-kio padedha-dedha ne, peka na, ira ii! ama ne, mema tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: and when they had gone over, they came into the land of gennesaret.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, hèia ra puru lasi asa dedha nebhe nèti rae genesaret.

source_text: and when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all the surrounding country, and brought to him all that were diseased;
target_text: lod'o ra puru èèna, dhèu ae dhu tadhe le. hèia dhèu pa'oo, peka na, wee! yesus mai le! ra rai lasi peka palème, hèia dhèu rèti dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were restored to health.
target_text: ra manèngi sèna ka ra goi lèke kodho yesus. te ra pangee na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a goi lèke suu kodho na, tatu dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i se goi kodho yesus, ka ra èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: then came to jesus scribes and pharisees, who were of jerusalem, saying,
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu parisi dènge mese agama ca nau mai nèti yerusalem, ho paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi rèngu. lod'o rèngu tadèngi, na, ladhe ana madhutu yesus ra'a-rinu dhu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu ad'a ra, hèia ra nasa. ka rèngu mai ho pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe ai? èèna na, sisu le ad'a bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: but he answered and said to them, why do ye also transgress the commandment of god by your tradition?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu lab'a paredha ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu ad'a tatao nèti bèi-baki miu di.

source_text: for god commanded, saying, honor thy father and mother: and, he that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
target_text: te ama lamatua paredha, peka na, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa peka hari, na, ‘ladhe ca dhèu padhèd'a aapa ina do ama na, hud'i huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but ye say, whoever shall say to his father or his mother, it is a gift, by whatever thou mightest be profited by me; and honor not his father or his mother, he shall be free. thus have ye made the commandment of god of no effect by your tradition.
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ca dhèu parluu boe pake mèdha-panyau na, sèna ka soru-bara ina-ama na, masi ka rèngu ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ladhe na pamoa le neo hia mèdha ne asa lamatua' te ngaa dènge aj'a sèmi èèna, miu core eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho gati dènge atora unu miu.

source_text: ye hypocrites, well did isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a dhu peka le, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! èèna na, nuka sèmi yesaya, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: this people draw nigh to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
target_text: ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa dènge boe d'ara.

source_text: but in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
target_text: masi ka rèngu tao sèmi èèna, te ngaa parcuma. ra pusi-pahae boe ja'a, te rèngu sèra pahae dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. '

source_text: and he called the multitude, and said to them, hear, and understand:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ètu èèna, ka na aj'a si, peka na, pasa dhilu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu!

source_text: not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara hèb'a, pakaj'alu boe dhèu. te ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: then came his disciples, and said to him, knowest thou that the pharisees were offended after they heard this saying?
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu na mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama me'a, do? dhèu parisi se d'ara pèd'a ropa tadèngi lii padhai ama.

source_text: but he answered and said, every plant, which my heavenly father hath not planted, shall be extirpated.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ama ku ètu sorga, èèna na core eele dhèu dhu aj'a madhutu boe dad'èi na. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu ko'o eele j'u'u dhu na d'èi boe.

source_text: let them alone: they are blind leaders of the blind. and if the blind leadeth the blind, both will fall into the ditch.
target_text: de baku pusi-pahae dènge dhèu parisi sèi! te rèngu ca ropa dènge dhèu bèdhu dhu pakako dhèu bèdhu. èèna na ra manahu palere-lere asa d'ara ro'a lasi.

source_text: then answered peter and said to him, declare to us this parable.
target_text: ka petrus lii, peka na, ama, lole ku dènge ji'i la, sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na!

source_text: and jesus said, are ye also yet without understanding?
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, miu me'a mèka kahèi?

source_text: do ye not yet understand, that whatever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e: ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara hèb'a, la'e taruu asa kabake, èle èèna kalua hari la'e asa d'ara kakus.

source_text: but those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu, toke ama lamatua madenge dènge ne, aa d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
target_text: te j'ara-j'ara karehe, ae ka dhu mai nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee dhu bhelu, pamadhe dhèu, bersina, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, mana'u, sakasii kapod'e-kabèli, dènge pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: these are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
