target_text: j'ara-j'ara se'e ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu dhoka ra'a j'amo boe ai madhutu ad'a, èèna sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: then jesus went thence, and departed into the territories of tyre and sidon.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tèke eele era ne'e, kako la'e asa kota tirus dènge kota sidon.

source_text: and behold, a woman of canaan came out of the same territories, and cried to him, saying, have mercy on me, o lord, thou son of david; my daughter is grievously afflicted with a demon.
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu ina ca dhèu dhu j'aj'aj'i na nèti rai ne'e. nèngu dhèu yahudi boe. ropa na tadèngi nare yesus mai le asa ne'e, hèia la'e manèngi, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ja'a la! te ana bhèni ja'a, lèke nidhu tao. kasia ku ji'i la! te na j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: but he answered her not a word. and his disciples came and besought him, saying, send her away; for she crieth after us.
target_text: te ngaa yesus mau-mau, aa dhaa boe ngaa-ngaa ciki sa. hèia ana madhutu na mai peka dènge ne, ama, ina ne pa'oo-parodha loe boe. be'a risi ama babège eele ne nèti ne'e!

source_text: but he answered and said, i am not sent but to the lost sheep of the house of israel.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, ho soru-bara dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi, lula rèngu kako sala j'ara, nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu re'a heka j'ara. te na pua boe ja'a sèna ka soru-bara dhèu leo.

source_text: then came she and worshiped him, saying, lord, help me.
target_text: te ngaa ina ne mai padètu-dètu asa yesus. ka na patitu kètu urutuu dènge lii manèngi, ama! sue ku ja'a la!

source_text: but he answered and said, it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, pantas boe tare nganga'a nèti ana-ana, ka hia mi busa. dènge lii dhu pacele, sasoa na, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu unu na, heka bisa ladhe-leru dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and she said, truth, lord: yet the dogs eat of the crums which fall from their master's table.
target_text: te ngaa ina ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, tare'a ama! te ngaa busa dhu mate mema ètu ro'a mei. rèngu ra'a kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe eele nèti d'ara pega ana sèra. sasoa na, ropa ana-ana ra'a, busa kahèi abhu ra'a. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i ladhe-leru dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: then jesus answered and said to her, o woman, great is thy faith: be it to thee even as thou wilt. and her daughter was healed from that very hour.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus peka na, ira ii! ina parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a! de lèpa ka, lula ngaa dhu ina manèngi èèna, j'aj'i le! èle èèna ka, na lèpa, ka na ladhe nèdhi ana na dhu èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and jesus departed from thence, and came nigh to the sea of galilee; and ascended a mountain, and sat down there.
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era ne'e, hèia ra kako madhutu re sebhe dano galilea. ka ra ca'e asa ledhe cue, hèia yesus madhèdi ho aj'a-nori si.

source_text: and great multitudes came to him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at jesus' feet; and he healed them:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ae-ae mai asa yesus. ra rèti dènge dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dhèu lii aad'o, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu pèd'a leo kahèi. ra pamadhèdi dhèu pèd'a se padètu-dètu dènge haga yesus. ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: so that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the god of israel.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia dhèu ae se malaa. ra papeka na, ira ii! malaa titu kèna, nga! dhèu haga roe cabèka, bisa kako èra hari. dhèu bèdhu, bisa rèdhi. dhèu karuku, bisa kako. aa dhèu lii aad'o, bisa padhai lii! se'e se, tatu tatao ama lamatua. aa lamatua èèna ka, dhu uru-uru sèra bèi-baki èdhi pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: then jesus called his disciples to him, and said, i have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and i will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
target_text: lalu eele pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae-ae se. abhu dhu mai nèti era kaj'èu, ra pakaboko ètu ne'e tèlu lod'o kèna, toke gee ra èle aa'i le. be'a risi baku hia si lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra bèbha ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and his disciples say to him, whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to satisfy so great a multitude?
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama! era ne'e kaj'èu nèti rae. tatu, èdhi bisa boe panga'a tare dhèu ae-ae sèmi se'e.

source_text: and jesus saith to them, how many loaves have ye? and they said, seven, and a few little fishes.
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, roti miu pèri bua? ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, dhoka pidhu di, dènge i'a pèri ngi'u di!

source_text: and he commanded the multitude to sit on the ground.
target_text: ka yesus pua dhèu se'e madhèdi ètu rai.

source_text: and he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and broke them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
target_text: hèia nare roti pidhu bua dènge i'a sèra, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti se, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and they all ate and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that were left seven baskets full.
target_text: hèia aa'i-aa'i ra'a toke bècu. ka ra kaboko rare nganga'a dhu ata, pènu pidhu soe hahake.

source_text: and they that had eaten were four thousand men, besides women and children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone ele boe d'ai èpa riho dhèu sa. dhae ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki sèra.

source_text: and he sent away the multitude, and took a boat, and came into the borders of magdala.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua dhèu ae-ae sèra lèpa. hèia na ca'e asa dedha koha, ho lasi asa rai magadan.

source_text: the pharisees also and the sadducees came, and, tempting, desired him that he would show them a sign from heaven.
target_text: ca tèka, pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki, mai paraga dènge yesus. rèngu neo pakarèi dènge ne, sèna ka tenge j'ara neo pamanahu yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi sèmi ne'e ka, ama! tao ku tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, dhu peka na, ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: he answered and said to them, when it is evening, ye say, it will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, ladhe èdhi tèdhi liru mea ropa lod'o cèna, èdhi te'a, na, ‘bèli èj'i mai boe. '

source_text: and in the morning, it will be foul weather to-day: for the sky is red and lowering. o ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o rea, aa liru mèdhi, na èdhi te'a, na, ‘doe ne'e, oe èj'i. ' de ladhe miu bisa patadhe mere tadha ètu liru sèmi sèra, nga tao ka miu bisa boe patadhe mere sasoa nèti tadha-tadha jaman?

source_text: a wicked and adulterous generation seeketh for a sign; and there shall no sign been to it, but the sign of the prophet jonah. and he left them, and departed.
target_text: miu dhèu lod'o limuri ne, me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu di! miu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a dale boe tao. lula uru èèna, lamatua dhu tao le tadha malaa re yunus, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. de èèna d'ai le! ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus tèke eele si.

source_text: and when his disciples had come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
target_text: ropa yesus si lasi asa ca bèka dano, hèia ana madhutu na, heka sanèd'e, na, rèngu rèti boe roti tao gee j'ara.

source_text: then jesus said to them, take heed and beware of the leaven of the pharisees and of the sadducees.
target_text: tadèngi rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, hèia na peka na, miu baku pamud'e dènge ragi dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki.

source_text: and they reasoned among themselves, saying, it is because we have taken no bread.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ana madhutu na bingu, ka ra peka, na peka ngaa nèi? ele boe ne'a na, èdhi tèti boe roti, sina ma?

source_text: which when jesus perceived, he said to them, o ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, wee, miu seli-kolane, nga! nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu parcaya boe ja'a, do?

source_text: do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
target_text: miu dhae me'a iia mèka koasa ja'a, do? te lod'o ja'a pamae lèmi bua roti ho panga'a lèmi riho dhèu sèra, dhu sisa, miu pakaboko mere pèri soe?

source_text: neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
target_text: aa tasamia hari dènge roti pidhu bua dhu ja'a panga'a èpa riho dhèu sèra? abhu pèri soe hahake dhu miu pakaboko nèti dhu ra'a risi sèra?

source_text: how is it that ye do not understand that i spoke not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the pharisees and of the sadducees?
target_text: nga tao ka miu mo'o boe me'a dènge lii padhai ja'a deo na? ja'a padhue-padhai boe lula roti. te ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, sèna ka miu baku pamud'e dènge tatao dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki. te lii aj'a-nori ra bisa ère rare dhèu ae, nuka sèmi ragi dhu tao roti j'aj'i kapai.

source_text: then they understood that he did not caution them against the leaven of bread, but against the doctrine of the pharisees and of the sadducees.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, hèia heka rèngu re'a kèna, na nèngu peka boe roti. te ngaa na padhue-padhai nèti a'aj'a dhu sale nèti dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki.

source_text: when jesus came into the borders of cesarea phillippi, he asked his disciples, saying, who do men say that i the son of man am?
target_text: èle, hèia yesus si lasi asa rai dhu padètu dènge kota kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, madhutu lii papeka dhèu, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, cee?

source_text: and they said, some say that thou art john the baptist: some elijah; and others, jeremiah, or one of the prophets.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, abhu dhu peka na, ama ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu mamuri hari. cahag'e peka na, ele boe ama ne, elia. cahag'e hari ale na, yermia. ladhe aad'o, na, ca dhèu leo nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra.

source_text: he saith to them, but who say ye that i am?
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari si, ladhe madhutu miu mesa mi, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: and simon peter answered and said, thou art the christ, the son of the living god.
target_text: hèia simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama ne, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho neo hia mai! aa ama ne, ana ama lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia!

source_text: and jesus answered and said to him, blessed art thou, simon-barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it to thee, but my father who is in heaven.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lii, peka na, simon, ana yunus! èu ne, oto kapai! te nèti boe dhèu rai-haha dhu peka lii ne'e dènge èu. te ngaa ama ku ètu sorga ka peka dènge èu.

source_text: and i say also to thee, that thou art peter, and upon this rock i will build my church: and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
target_text: nanene, ee! karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a pangare èu, ‘petrus'. dhu sasoa na, hadhu. lula parcaya èu, èra sèmi hadhu, èèna na èu j'aj'i era padhèdi nèti dhèu-dhèu ja'a dhu parcaya. masi ka rèngu abhu j'aj'èra toke madhe, te ngaa rèngu taha taruu.

source_text: and i will give to thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatever thou shalt bind on earth, shall be bound in heaven; and whatever thou shalt loose on earth, shall be loosed in heaven.
target_text: ja'a èèna na hia èu hak, sèna ka èu uri dhèu-dhèu ja'a, nuka sèmi èu mèd'u gagoe sorga. te, ngaa dhu èu kai ètu rai-haha, èèna na lamatua kai ètu sorga kahèi. dènge ngaa dhu èu hia isin ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua hia le isin ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: then he charged his disciples that they should tell no man that he was jesus the christ.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka yesus kai si ho rèngu baku peka dènge dhèu, na, nèngu ne, kristus.

source_text: from that time forth jesus began to show to his disciples, that he must go to jerusalem, and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku ku asa yerusalem. te ngaa ètu nèi, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae, nèti dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: then peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, be it far from thee, lord: this shall not be to thee.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia petrus ère nare yesus asa karasa, ka na kai, aku nèngu na, ama, baku padhai lii sèmi èèna! tatu ama lamatua soro tèke boe j'ara ne j'aj'i!

source_text: but he turned, and said to peter, get thee behind me, satan; thou art an offense to me: for thou savorest not the things that are of god, but those that are of men.
target_text: te ngaa lii padhai petrus ne, madhutu boe dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus kabib'a, ka jèke ne, peka na, heh! pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! lii padhai èèna nèti dhèu aae nidhu! èu baku bhabhae ja'a! èu ne dhodhoka pangee madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: then said jesus to his disciples, if any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, hèia yesus aj'a ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu ku bèli-bèli! nèngu hud'i pa'uru ku dad'èi ama lamatua, aa pabhèlu eele dad'èi nèngu unu na. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, nèngu hud'i madhutu ja'a taruu, sama sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na, la'e asa era mamadhe na.

source_text: for whoever will save his life, shall lose it: and whoever will lose his life for my sake, shall find it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri hia ngi'u aae na di, èèna na mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara!

source_text: for what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ladhe lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ètu mia? masi ka èu pasae mèti aa'i isi rai-haha ne, èu bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu!

source_text: for the son of man will come in the glory of his father, with his angels; and then he will reward every man according to his works.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a mai hari dènge dadedha nèti ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga. lod'o èèna, pe ja'a b'ala mi ca dhèu-ca dhèu madhutu tatao ra.

source_text: verily i say to you, there are some standing here, who shall not taste death, till they shall see the son of man coming in his kingdom.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! nèti miu aa'i-aa'i se, bèli-camèd'a abhu cahag'e dhu madhe boe, toke ra rèdhi ja'a, nuka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha.

source_text: and after six days, jesus taketh peter, james, and john his brother, and bringeth them upon a high mountain apart.
target_text: èle èna lod'o, ka yesus paroa petrus, yakobis dènge ari na yohanis, sèna ka lasi asa ledhe dhu dedha èci, ho pea mesa ra ètu nèi.

source_text: and he was transfigured before them: and his face shone as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra ladhe na, rupa yesus leko-leo. rèhu na kaha'a nuka sèmi madha lod'o, aa mèdha-papake na j'aj'i pudhi kale'e.

source_text: and behold, there appeared to them moses and elijah talking with him.
target_text: kaca'a la, rèngu ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu padhai lii dènge musa dènge elia.

source_text: then answered peter, and said to jesus, lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for moses, and one for elijah.
target_text: hèia petrus bingu, ka na padhai lii leli, aku nèngu na, ama! ji'i karej'e titu kèna ètu era ne'e ne! de be'a risi ji'i patitu paleo tèlu bua. cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: while he was yet speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold, a voice out of the cloud, which said, this is my beloved son, in whom i am well pleased: hear ye him.
target_text: lod'o petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna era, cag'ag'a laa, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare rèngu. hèia rèngu malaa-maloha tadèngi lii èci dhu kalua nèti d'ara ra'i-liru ne, peka na, nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a. nanene ne paie-iie!

source_text: and when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were in great fear.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii ne, hèia ana madhutu na madha'u titu kèna, ka ra bèbha sagèb'a ètu rai.

source_text: and jesus came and touched them, and said, arise, and be not afraid.
target_text: te ngaa yesus mai gai si, ka na peka na, mi kèd'i ka, baku madha'u!

source_text: and when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save jesus only.
target_text: ka ana madhutu se boti kètu ra, te ngaa ra ladhe rèdhi heka dhèu èci sa ètu era èèna, dhoka yesus di.

source_text: and as they were descending the mountain, jesus charged them, saying, tell the vision to no man, until the son of man be raised again from the dead.
target_text: èle ka, ra puru nèti ledhe ne. hèia yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, ngaa dhu heka ladhe mèdhi deo na, mage peka dènge dhèu èci sa kahèi! te ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. èle èèna, ladhe ja'a mamuri hari, heka miu lole dènge dhèu kèna.

source_text: and his disciples asked him, saying, why then say the scribes, that elijah must first come?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama ne mema kristus, te ngaa elia ètu mia? te mese agama se aj'a, peka na, elia hud'i mai uuru ku, èle èèna, heka kristus mai kèna. te ngaa madhutu ama, tasamia?

source_text: and jesus answered and said to them, elijah truly will first come, and restore all things:
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema lèke. elia hud'i mai uuru ku, ho bhoke j'ara hia kristus.

source_text: but i say to you, that elijah is come already, and they knew him not, but have done to him whatever they pleased: likewise will also the son of man suffer by them.
target_text: nanene paie! elia mai le, te ngaa dhèu tadhe boe ne. rèngu paj'èra ne, madhutu dad'èi ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a rèngu paj'èra ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: then the disciples understood that he spoke to them concerning john the baptist.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, ana madhutu na heka re'a, na, elia dhu yesus peka ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani.

source_text: and when they had come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man kneeling down to him, and saying,
target_text: èle ka, ropa rèngu lèpa, paraga dènge dhèu ae dhu mate le. hèia ama ca dhèu mai patitu kètu urutuu, ka na manèngi yesus,

source_text: lord, have mercy on my son; for he is lunatic, and grievously distressed; for often he falleth into the fire, and often into the water.
target_text: na peka, ama! sue ku ana ja'a la! te nèngu dhu huj'u kahib'i, aa na j'èra titu kèna. ladhe èi papèd'a ne cèu, na bèbhe sa d'ara èi, do d'ara ai. ama sue ku la!

source_text: and i brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
target_text: ana ne, ja'a kèti le asa ana-ana madhutu ama ku, te ngaa ra tao rare boe ne.

source_text: then jesus answered and said, o faithless and perverse generation, how long shall i be with you? how long shall i suffer you? bring him hither to me.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus jèke ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, heh! miu se seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a le miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a mèu boe. aa miu parcaya boe ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ja'a hud'i mate hari ku miu, d'ai pèri lod'o? mèti ana èèna mai!

source_text: and jesus rebuked the demon, and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
target_text: hèia, rèti ana ne, ka yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana ne'e. ka nidhu rai tèke eele ne, hèia ana ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: then came the disciples to jesus apart, and said, why could not we cast him out?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ropa yesus mesa na dènge ana madhutu sèra, ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège ngare nidhu deo na?

source_text: and jesus said to them, because of your unbelief: for verily i say to you, if ye have faith as a grain of mustard-seed, ye shall say to this mountain, remove hence to yonder place, and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible to you.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, miu babège mere boe, lula miu parcaya boe dènge d'ara kateme. sanèd'e! ladhe miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka sama sèmi lamusi ana iiki-iiki èci, miu bisa paredha ledhe èci, peka na, ‘hee ledhe, hari sa nèi, lamu! ' tatu na hari kahèi. de miu bisa tao ngaa èèna ka, sad'i parcaya dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: however, this kind goeth not out, but by prayer and fasting.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e! nidhu sèmi se'e se, mema bhelu titu kèna. ladhe miu sabaj'a boe aa puasa boe, ho manèngi mi ama lamatua, na, miu babège mere boe nidhu sèmi sèra.

source_text: and while they abode in galilee, jesus said to them, the son of man will be betrayed into the hands of men:
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na dhu pakaboko ètu propensi galilea. na peka dènge rèngu, na, nèbhu heka, te ra neo pahie ja'a asa dhèu leo rai kara.

source_text: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised again: and they were exceedingly grieved.
target_text: hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a ja'a mamuri hari. ropa ana madhutu na sèra tadèngi lii deo na, hèia d'ara ra susa titu kèna.

source_text: and when they had come to capernaum, they that received tribute -money, came to peter, and said, doth not your master pay tribute?
target_text: lod'o yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa rae kapernaum, hèia dhèu roro bea mai paraga dènge petrus, ka ra karèi ne, na, mese miu b'ae bea èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i do, aad'o?

source_text: he saith, yes. and when he had come into the house, jesus anticipated him, saying, what thinkest thou, simon? from whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? from their own children, or from strangers?
target_text: hèia petrus dhaa, na b'ae! ropa petrus lepa, ka yesus karèi dènge ka, aku nèngu na, simon, èu pangee ku la! dhèu aae-dhèu aae ètu rai-haha ne abhu bea nèti cee? nèti ana matana ra, do, nèti dhèu leo?

source_text: peter saith to him, from strangers. jesus saith to him, then are the children free.
target_text: petrus dhaa, na, nèti dhèu leo! ka yesus tuhu lii padhai na, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ana dhèu aae di dhu b'ae boe, si?

source_text: notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast a hook, and take the fish that first cometh up: and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: take that, and give to them for me and thee.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge bea èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa hud'i laa, sèna ka dhèu roro bea se baku nasa dènge èdhi. de be'a risi lamu madulu i'a asa d'ara dano. i'a dhu èu abhu uuru èèna, èu bhoke hèb'a na. pe èu abhu doi iia cue. more, ho b'ae bea èdhi dua ti. te doi ne, d'ai le bea èdhi dua ti.

source_text: at the same time came the disciples to jesus, saying, who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus lasi karèi ne, peka na, ama! nèti dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, cee ka dhu kapai risi?

source_text: and jesus called a little child to him, and set him in the midst of them,
target_text: hèia yesus paroa nare ana iiki èci, mai patitu asa talora aae rèngu.

source_text: and said, verily i say to you, except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ra, nanene paie-iie! dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, rèngu hud'i ub'a ngangee ra, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi ana iiki dhu ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: whoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: lula dhèu dhu ne'a pahaha iisi sama sèmi ana iiki ne, nèngu èèna ka dhu kapai risi ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: and whoever shall receive one such little child in my name, receiveth me.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu haha nuka sèmi ana iiki ne, lula na parcaya ja'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare le ja'a ne.

source_text: but whoever shall cause one of these little ones who believe in me, to sin, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao ana iiki sèna ka madhutu j'ara dhu sale, toke ana ne parcaya heka ja'a, na, mata unu na! be'a risi dhèu èki hadhu aae cue, mi ladha goro na, ho pacène ne asa d'ara dhasi marèma.

source_text: woe to the world because of offenses! for it must needs be that offenses come; but woe to that man by whom the offense cometh!
target_text: rai-haha ne mema era dhu pènu dènge dhudhu-sete, lula abhu j'ara ae dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala-sasigo. te ngaa dhèu dhu dui babia risi, nuka dhèu dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho soro dhèu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: wherefore, if thy hand or thy foot causeth thee to sin, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet, to be cast into everlasting fire.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala, pake kacui-aai èu, do, haga èu, na, poro eele ne! te be'a risi èu maso asa d'ara sorga dènge ai cabèka, do, haga calaa. mage dhoka ra core èu asa d'ara ai naraka, dènge ai do haga dhu tesa.

source_text: and if thy eye causeth thee to sin, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes, to be cast into hell-fire.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala, pake musi madha èu, na, cèru eele ne! te be'a risi èu maso asa d'ara sorga dènge musi madha cabèka. mage dhoka ra core èu asa d'ara ai naraka, dènge musi madha dhu tesa.

source_text: take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones: for i say to you, that in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my father who is in heaven.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e, ee! baku mi pahaha ana iiki sèmi se'e se. te abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu madhenga si. aa ana pajuu se dhu lasi taruu, peka dènge ama lamatua ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi ana se.

source_text: for the son of man is come to save that which was lost. how think ye? if a man hath a hundred sheep, and one of them is gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and go to the mountains, and seek that which is gone astray? and if he findeth it, verily i say to you, he rejoiceth more over that sheep, than over the ninety and nine which went not astray.
target_text: mi pangee paie-iie, te ja'a hia lii pakasame èci sèmi ne'e ka: abhu dhèu èci dhu kahib'i-kalèbho na, cangasu ngi'u. ca lod'o, ci'u nèti kahib'i-kalèbho se, kako sala j'ara. madhutu ngangee miu, dhèu madhenga ne tao tasamia? tatu na tèke eele ceo nguru ceo ngi'u sèra ètu ledhe, ho la'e tenge ci'u dhu ele ne. ladhe na abhu hari, tatu na karej'e, ropa na ladhe nèdhi ci'u ne, risi nèti kahib'i-kalèbho na ceo nguru ceo ngi'u dhu ele boe sèra. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai ho hia mamuri mi dhèu dhu kako sale nèti j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: even so it is not the will of your father who is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
target_text: te, masi ka ana iiki ca dhèu di dhu kako sala j'ara, te ngaa ama ku ètu sorga d'èi boe kahèi.

source_text: moreover, if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
target_text: yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe a'ari èu dhèu parcaya tao sale mi èu, na, èu mesa mu lamu paraga dènge ne. ladhe miu dua mi mesa mi, heka èu peka sasala nèngu kèna. ladhe na sèmi nare lii padhai èu, na, miu dua mi pabe'a hari le kèna.

source_text: but if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe no'o boe sèmi nare lii padhai èu, lamu paroa more angalai mu ca dhèu do dua dhèu, ho lami paraga dènge ne, sèna ka padhai lii hari. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, ‘ètu d'ara lii langu èci, hud'i abhu ku dua-tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka sèmi rare lii galaa ra. '

source_text: and if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it to the church: but if he shall neglect to hear the church, let him be to thee as a heathen and a publican.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe no'o boe nanene lii miu, lami lole dènge juma'at. aa ladhe na d'èi boe nanene lii juma'at kahèi, tao ne nuka sèmi ca dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. ladhe aad'o na, cap ne nuka sèmi dhèu bhelu, conto sèmi dhèu roro bea sèra.

source_text: verily i say to you, whatever ye shall bind on earth, shall be bound in heaven: and whatever ye shall loose on earth, shall be loosed in heaven.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie lii padhai ja'a ne! ngaa dhu miu oro ètu rai-haha ne, èèna ka dhu lamatua oro le ètu sorga. aa ngaa dhu miu hia isin ètu rai-haha ne, èèna ka lamatua hia le isin ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: again i say to you, that if two of you shall agree on earth, concerning any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them by my father who is in heaven.
target_text: aa ja'a peka hari, na, ladhe abhu dhèu dua dhu sabaj'a dènge d'ara èci, pe ama ku ètu sorga hia ngaa dhu ra manèngi.

source_text: for where two or three are assembled in my name, there am i in the midst of them.
target_text: te, ladhe abhu dua, do tèlu dhèu, pakaboko sabaj'a sama-sama, lula rèngu dhèu ja'a, na, ja'a ètu talora aae rèngu kahèi.

source_text: then came peter to him, and said, lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and i forgive him? till seven times?
target_text: èle èèna, ka petrus karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a neo karèi ciki. ladhe a'ari ja'a tao sale pahari-pahari mi ja'a, èèna na d'ai pèri hari ja'a hud'i hia ne abho? d'ai pidhu hari, do?

source_text: jesus saith to him, i say not to thee, until seven times: but, until seventy times seven.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, aad'o! èu hud'i abho ne pidhu kali pidhu nguru hari, toke èu ige more heka.

source_text: therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened to a certain king who would take account of his servants.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua nuka sèmi dhèu aae dhu ige kèlu na ètu pegawi na.

source_text: and when he had begun to reckon, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
target_text: ropa na ige nare, hèia na pua dhèu lasi paroa pegawi dhu pakèlu toke riho kehi.

source_text: but as he had not ability to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne b'ae nare boe kèlu na. ka dhèu aae paredha, peka na, ‘lami pahie eele dhèu ne dènge bhèni-ana niki na aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ra j'aj'i ènu. aa mèdha-panyau na, pahie aa'i kahèi, ho b'ae kèlu-g'ètu na. '

source_text: the servant therefore fell down, and worshiped him, saying, lord, have patience with me, and i will pay thee all.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne tadèngi nare, hèia na pabèbha iisi, ho patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha dhèu aae, ka pamako, aku nèngu na, ‘ira ee! ama dhèu aae hia ja'a tebho d'ai ciki sa! sèna ka ja'a b'ae kèlu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. '

source_text: then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
target_text: ropa tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae rasa kasia dènge ne. ka dhèu aae pabhèlu eele aa'i mèu-mèu kèlu na, ka pua na lèpa.

source_text: but the same servant went out, and found one of his fellow-servants, who owed him a hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, pay me what thou owest.
target_text: te ngaa ropa na d'ai li'u, hèia pegawi ne paraga dènge angalai na dhu pakèlu nèngu doi ciki di. ka na kèpe angalai ne, hèia pacèli ladha goro na, aa na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ‘weh! b'ae ka d'ara lai-lai ne kèlu èu sèra! '

source_text: and his fellow-servant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, have patience with me, and i will pay thee all.
target_text: ropa angalai na tadèngi, hèia na patitu kètu urutuu, ka pamako ne, peka na, ‘ira ee! angalai, ee! hia ku ja'a tebho d'ai ciki sa! pe ja'a b'ae kèlu ja'a sèra! '

source_text: and he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne peka na, ‘bisa boe! ja'a mate heka panèbhu. èu b'ae dènge ka lod'o doe ne'e kahèi! ' èle ka, la'e pamaso angalai na asa d'ara bèdho, toke na b'ae aa'i kèlu na.

source_text: so when his fellow-servants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told to their lord all that was done.
target_text: ropa pegawi dhu leo ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, hèia d'ara ra susa. ka lasi lolo dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: then his lord, having called him, said to him, o thou wicked servant, i forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia dhèu aae ne paroa pegawi dhu ne'a boe manèngi makasi ne. dhèu aae jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ‘heh, dhèu bhelu-katub'a! lula èu ne manèngi sèna ka ja'a sue èu, nèti èèna ka ja'a pabhèlu eele le kèlu èu sèra.

source_text: shouldst thou not also have had compassion on thy fellow-servant, even as i had pity on thee?
target_text: te ngaa, nga tao ka èu kasia boe angalai èu sa hèi, sama sèmi ja'a kasia èu ne? '

source_text: and his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due to him.
target_text: ka dhèu aae nasa bia dènge ne, hèia na pua pamaso dhèu ne asa d'ara bèdho, sèna ka ra paj'èra ne, toke na b'ae aa'i kèlu na sèra.

source_text: so likewise shall my heavenly father do to you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
target_text: hèia yesus pa'èle lii pakasame na, peka na, ama ku ètu sorga pa'iga sèmi èèna kahèi mi dedha miu. pe na huku miu, ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala nèti a'ari miu dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: and it came to pass, that when jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from galilee, and came into the borders of judea, beyond jordan:
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare aa'i j'ara sèra, hèia la'e tèke eele galilea asa propensi yudea, ètu cabèka loko yarden.

source_text: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
target_text: dhèu ae ka dhu madhutu ne, ka na puri-pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a ètu nèi.

source_text: the pharisees also came to him, tempting him, and saying to him, is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dhu madhutu kahèi, dhu neo pamanahu ne. ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe dhèu mone leo le èmu, bisa ia eele dhèu èmu na, sad'i na abhu j'ara dhu la'e asa pa'ie-pa'ela. sèmi èèna, do?

source_text: and he answered and said to them, have ye not read, that he who made them, at the beginning made them male and female,
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, na miu se dhu me'a mèu agama. te ngaa tasamia ka miu me'a boe isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua? te ètu d'ara sasuri nèti lii lolo uru tèka, dhu suri peka na, ‘ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni. '

source_text: and said, for this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they two shall be one flesh?
target_text: aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, ‘nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ina-ama na, sèna ka la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, te dua ra dhu j'aj'i le èci. '

source_text: wherefore they are no more two, but one flesh. therefore what god hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe ama lamatua unu na dhu hia dua ra j'aj'i le èci, na, dhèu rai-haha baku pacèri si hari!

source_text: they say to him, why did moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare yesus peka sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi se karèi hari ne, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka musa peka na, dhèu bisa pa'ia-pa'ela, sad'i nèngu tao uuru ku sasuri pa'ia hia dhèu èmu na?

source_text: he saith to them, moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, musa soro tèke bèi-baki miu pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali ra, lula rèngu sèra kètu hadhu èci èèna ka dènge miu! te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, dad'èi na sèmi boe èèna.

source_text: and i say to you, whoever shall put away his wife, except for lewdness, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoever marrieth her who is put away, committeth adultery.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu, ee! ladhe bhèni ad'u uuru madha j'ara makae, dhèu èmu na bisa ia eele ne. te ngaa ladhe ia eele bhèni ne dhu ad'u boe j'ara makae, hèia dhèu mone na leo hari dènge bhèni leo, nèngu ne tao le j'ara makae!

source_text: his disciples say to him, if the case of the man is so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia ana madhutu na sèra, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, be'a risi baku leo-èmu.

source_text: but he said to them, all men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala si, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae ka dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii padhai lii ja'a ne. dhodhoka dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare si.

source_text: for there are some eunuchs, who were so born from their mothers womb: and there are some eunuchs, who were made eunuchs by men: and there are eunuchs, who have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. he that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
target_text: te abhu dhèu dhu leo boe èmu, lula karèi nèti rara iisi ne, nèngu sèmi èèna ka. abhu kahèi dhu leo boe èmu, lula dhèu tao ne sèmi èèna. aa abhu kahèi dhu no'o boe leo-èmu, lula na neo pakako sasab'a ama lamatua di. dhèu dhu re'a mèu a'aj'a ne, hud'i laa nèngu sèmi dènge be'a.

source_text: then were brought to him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu sa'u rèti ana-ana ra asa yesus, sèna ka yesus tao kacui-aai na mi rèngu, aa dènge hia lii mèngi-nale. te ngaa ana madhutu na kai dhèu se.

source_text: but jesus said, suffer little children, and forbid them not to come to me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: hèia yesus nasa dènge ana madhutu na, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana se mai asa ja'a! baku bhabhae si! te dhèu dhu sèmi rèngu se'e ka, dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
target_text: èle èèna ka yesus tao kacui-aai na mi ana se, aa na manèngi ho ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale. èle, hèia yesus pakèd'i la'e, tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: and behold, one came and said to him, good master, what good thing shall i do that i may have eternal life?
target_text: ca tèke, dhèu èci mai karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! ja'a hud'i tao ku j'ara dhu hua iia tasamia, sèna ka ke'a tare'a, na, ja'a bisa maso sorga? te ja'a neo mamuri taruu sama-sama dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and he said to him, why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, god: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka, èu karèi ja'a lula-nèti ngaa dhu hua iia? dhodhoka ama lamatua di, dhu hua iia. te ladhe èu neo mamuri taruu dènge ne, na, mamuri la madhutu paredha na.

source_text: he saith to him, which? jesus said, thou shalt do no murder, thou shalt not commit adultery, thou shalt not steal, thou shalt not bear false witness,
target_text: ka dhèu ne karèi hari, aku nèngu na, paredha dhu mia èèna? hèia yesus b'ala ne, peka na, baku pamadhe dhèu; baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe èu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii dhu kapod'e-kabèli;

source_text: honor thy father and thy mother: and, thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
target_text: pakab'ua ina-ama mu; aa sue ku dhèu èu, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu mesa mu.

source_text: the young man saith to him, all these things have i kept from my youth: what lack i yet?
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, na, paredha aa'i-aa'i sèra ja'a tao madhutu le. de, ngaa hari dhu kura?

source_text: jesus said to him, if thou wilt be perfect, go and sell what thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii dhèu ne, hèia yesus peka na, ladhe èu neo madhutu aa'i dad'èi ama lamatua, lèpa ho pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau èu, sèna ka papala hia dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa sèra. èle èèna, mai ho madhutu ja'a. te èèna na, ama lamatua pala hia èu mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu sorga.

source_text: but when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare lii yesus, hèia dhèu ne lèpa dènge d'ara pèd'a laho mae-mae, lula nèngu kaja titu kèna.

source_text: then said jesus to his disciples, verily i say to you, that a rich man shall with difficulty enter into the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: èle èèna, ka yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, lèka la ja'a, te dhèu kaja carui titu kèna maso sorga.

source_text: and again i say to you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of god.
target_text: carui èèna, nuka sèmi badha onta dhu kapai, maso la'e asa d'ara oka na re ro'a j'aj'au.

source_text: when his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, who then can be saved?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu se tadèngi rare, rèngu malaa, hèia ra dhaa, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, cee ka dhu bisa maso sorga?

source_text: but jesus beheld them, and said to them, with men this is impossible, but with god all things are possible.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe patae si, ka na lii, peka na, ladhe dhèu rai-haha dhu tao, mema bisa boe. te ngaa ladhe ama lamatua ka dhu tao, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i!

source_text: then answered peter, and said to him, behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee? what shall we have therefore?
target_text: hèia petrus pasanèd'e, aku nèngu na, ama! ji'i se tèke eele le mèdha-panyau ji'i aa'i-aa'i, ho madhutu ama. de ji'i abhu ngaa?

source_text: and jesus said to them, verily i say to you, that ye who have followed me in the regeneration, when the son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of israel.
target_text: na dhaa, peka na, parcaya la ja'a ne! pe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua tao pahiu aa'i mèu-mèu, ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha aae èèna. lod'o èèna kahèi, miu dhu madhutu ja'a, madhèdi kahèi ètu dedha kadera paredha canguru dua sèra, sèna ka j'aj'i hakim mi canguru dua suku èdhi dhèu isra'el!

source_text: and every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands for my name's sake, shall receive a hundred-fold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
target_text: dhèu dhu tèke eele èmu na, a'ari na, ina-ama na, ana niki na, aa oka-tedhe na, ho madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a èèna abhu hari cangasu kali. aa d'ai ka lod'o èle rai-haha ne, nèngu kahèi abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: but many that are first shall be last, and the last shall be first.
target_text: de sanèd'e paie! madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, dhèu ae dhu padedha iisi na, rèngu sèra ka dhu j'aj'i mi ana iiki. te ngaa dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu haha, aa te ngaa madhutu a'abhu lamatua, nèngu ka dhu kapai.

source_text: for the kingdom of heaven is like to a man that is a householder, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers into his vineyard.
target_text: èle èèna, ka yesus aj'a peka na, paredha ama lamatua èci èèna ka dènge lii pakasame ne: abhu ca dhèu lamatua oka anggor, dhu kèd'i mad'ae aae d'ara hake èna sa. na la'e tenge dhèu sèna ka sab'a ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and when he had agreed with the laborers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
target_text: na abhu dhèu sab'a, hèia rare lii èci, ho sab'e d'ara ca lod'o, bab'ae na, ca doi iia. dhèu se d'èi kahèi, ka lamatua oka ne pua lasi sab'a.

source_text: and he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the market-place,
target_text: pe d'ara hake ceo sa, la'e asa d'ara pasa. ètu era nèi, nèngu paraga dènge dhèu pèri-pèri dhu madhèdi iia d'ara.

source_text: and said to them, go ye also into the vineyard; and whatever is right, i will give you. and they departed.
target_text: hèia na lii dènge ra, ‘miu se neo sab'a ètu d'ara oka ja'a, do? pe ja'a b'ae miu madhutu kab'ua dhu lèke. ' ropa tadèngi rare, ro'o kahèi, hèia lasi dènge ka sab'a.

source_text: again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
target_text: d'ai lod'o titu mera sa, dènge hake tèlu lod'o nihia, lamatua oka ne la'e tenge hari dhèu sab'a.

source_text: and about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith to them, why stand ye here all the day idle?
target_text: d'ara hake lèmi lod'o nihia sa, la'e hari. na laladhe, na, abhu dhèu dhu titu iia d'ara era. ka na lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ‘nga tao ka karèi nèti mad'ae toke sange ne'e ne, miu se titu iia d'ara, sab'a boe ngaa-ngaa? '

source_text: they say to him, because no man hath hired us. he saith to them, go ye also into the vineyard; and whatever is right, that shall ye receive.

source_text: so when evening was come, the lord of the vineyard saith to his steward, call the laborers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last to the first.
target_text: toke d'ai èle jam sab'a, hèia lamatua oka ne pua madho na, peka na, ‘paroa dhèu sab'a se, sèna ka b'ae rui sasab'a ra èci-èci. mulai nèti dhèu sab'a limuri tèka, toke dhèu sab'a uuru. '

source_text: and when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
target_text: ka madho ne paroa uuru dhèu dhu sab'a hake lèmi nihia. na b'ae si ca dhèu, ca doi iia.

source_text: but when the first came, they supposed that they should receive more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
target_text: èle ka, na paroa dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, toke dhèu dhu sab'a mulai nèti hake èna mad'ae deo na. dhèu se, pangee na, ele boe rèngu abhu risi nèti dhèu dhu sab'a hake lèmi nihia. re'a boe na, rèngu abhu kahèi ca dhèu, ca doi iia.

source_text: and when they had received it, they murmured against the master of the house.
target_text: ropa ra sèmi rare, hèia ra ka'ugu dènge lamatua oka èèna, aku rèngu na,

source_text: saying, these last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal to us, who have borne the burden and heat of the day.
target_text: ‘ira, iii! bisa boe sèmi ne'e, ama! rèngu dhu mai limuri tèka, dhoka sab'a ca jam di. te ngaa ji'i dhu karèi mad'ae aae ka, sab'a toke èi kabhèsu hae! te ngaa tasamia ka ama b'ae ji'i èci èèna ka dènge rèngu se? '

source_text: but he answered one of them, and said, friend, i do thee no wrong: didst thou not agree with me for a penny?
target_text: hèia lamatua oka ne dhaa, na, ‘angalai! ja'a tipu boe èu. lula èu mesa mu mo'o kahèi sab'a ètu d'ara ca lod'o dhu bab'ae na ca doi iia. tare'a si? de ja'a b'ae madhutu sèmi lii pama'ète èdhi dua ti, si?

source_text: take that which is thine, and depart: i will give to this last, even as to thee.
target_text: de be'a risi more doi j'aj'èra èu ho lèpa ka. ladhe ja'a neo b'ae mi dhèu dhu sab'a limuri tèka nèti èu, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a neo b'ae èu, èèna na madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: is it not lawful for me to do what i will with my own? is thy eye evil because i am good?
target_text: lula doi-dhari ja'a, ja'a bisa pake madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a. tasamia ka, angalai nasa lula babe'a d'ara ja'a? '

source_text: so the last shall be first, and the first last: for many are called, but few chosen.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o ama lamatua j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. na pala-bagi hia dhèu-dhèu unu na, madhutu dad'èi d'ara na. de dhèu dhu mai limuri tèka, èèna na abhu pala sama sèmi dhèu dhu mai uuru. aa dhèu dhu mai uuru, pe na abhu pala nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mai limuri tèka.

source_text: and jesus going up to jerusalem, took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said to them,
target_text: èle ka, yesus si mulai lasi asa yerusalem. ètu talora j'ara na paroa ana madhutu na, sèna ka rèngu mesa ra di. ka na lii hari, peka na,

source_text: behold, we go up to jerusalem; and the son of man will be betrayed to the chief priests, and to the scribes, and they will condemn him to death,
target_text: mi nanene paie! ne'e ne, èdhi lati asa yerusalem. te ngaa ètu nèi dhèu pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, asa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èle èèna, ra huku pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: and will deliver him to the gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he will rise again.
target_text: hèia ra soro ja'a asa dhèu leo rai kara dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. ka ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a, aa ra hake paru isi ja'a. èle èèna, heka ra paku pamadhe ja'a ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ja'a tare'a-re'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: then came to him the mother of zebedee's children, with her sons, worshiping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
target_text: hèia dhèu èmu sabadeus palere-lere dènge ana na, yohanis dènge yakobis, lasi paraga dènge yesus. ka na patitu kètu urutuu ho neo pamako yesus.

source_text: and he said to her, what wilt thou: she saith to him, grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left in thy kingdom.

source_text: but jesus answered and said, ye know not what ye ask. are ye able to drink of the cup that i shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that i am baptized with? they say to him, we are able.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii manèngi ne, hèia yesus peka yakobis dènge yohanis, na, miu se, me'a boe ngaa dhu miu manèngi. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae. de tasamia? miu pangee na, miu bisa pasae kahèi j'aj'èra se, sama-sama dènge ja'a, do? dua ra dhaa dhu dènge boe pake ngangee, aku rèngu na, oo, bisa, ama!

source_text: and he saith to them, ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that i am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared by my father.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ra, mema, èèna na miu pasae j'aj'èra kahèi sèmi ja'a. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana do kariu ja'a, ja'a dènge boe hak ho pama'ète. èèna hak ama lamatua. na pama'ète nare le, cee-cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu era sèra.

source_text: and when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu dhèu canguru sèra tadèngi lii manèngi dua ra, hèia ra nasa.

source_text: but jesus called them to him, and said, ye know that the princes of the gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
target_text: te ngaa yesus paroa nare si aa'i-aa'i ra, hèia na peka, sèmi ne'e! miu dhu me'a le, si? dhèu aae-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u paredha, ènyi kabarai ra toke ra bisa boe kalau sa kahèi. aa dhèu kapai kabarai ètu rai-haha ne, dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, hia paredha risi eele, toke kabarai ra abhu boe d'oa kètu ciki sa.

source_text: but it shall not be so among you: but whoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
target_text: te ngaa baku miu tao sèmi èèna! de nèti miu se cee ka dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku nuka sèmi ènu, sèna ka lalau dhèu leo.

source_text: and whoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
target_text: aa cee dhu neo j'aj'i kètu, nèngu hud'i tao iisi na nuka sèmi ènu.

source_text: even as the son of man came not to be ministered to, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

source_text: and as they departed from jericho, a great multitude followed him.
target_text: ka yesus si kako taruu. ropa rèngu kalua nèti kota jeriko, dhèu ae dhu madhutu rèngu.

source_text: and behold, two blind men sitting by the way-side, when they heard that jesus passed by, cried out, saying, have mercy on us, o lord, thou son of david.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bèdhu dhèu dua dhu madhèdi ètu sebhe j'ara. ropa dua ra tadèngi na, dhèu dhu kako re èèna, nuka yesus nèti nasaret, hèia ra parodha, peka na, ama! ana-èpu daud! ji'i se dhu tatae ama, karèi nèbhu ka! sue ku ji'i la!

source_text: they say to him, lord, that our eyes may be opened.
target_text: ka dua ra dhaa, na, ama! hia la ji'i se bisa ngèdhi!

source_text: so jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
target_text: tadèngi lii dhaa dua ra, hèia yesus rasa kasia. ka na g'ag'e musi madha ra, hèia dua ra rèdhi dènge ka. èle ka, dua ra lasi dènge madhutu yesus.

source_text: and when they drew nigh to jerusalem, and had come to bethphage, to the mount of olives, then jesus sent two disciples,

source_text: saying to them, go into the village over against you, and immediately ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her, loose them, and bring them to me.

source_text: all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

source_text: and the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, hosanna to the son of david: blessed is he that cometh in the name of the lord: hosanna in the highest.
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu cahag'e dhu kako uuru nèti yesus, aa cahag'e kako re limuri. dhèu se pa'oo-parodha palere-lere, peka na, hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! lula ana-èpu daud mai le! hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! lula ama lamatua ka dhu pua dhèu ne'e mai. hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! lula ama lamatua dhu nèd'u mema paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi!

source_text: and the multitude said, this is jesus the prophet of nazareth of galilee.

source_text: and jesus went into the temple of god, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold doves.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi taruu asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. ètu madha èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ne, dhèu tao nuka sèmi pasa, ho pahia-pahèli koro j'aha dhu dhèu tema pake j'aj'i mèdha korban lod'o sabaj'a. ropa ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus babèga eele si nèti era èèna. na lege eele mei-mei dhu ra pake pasilu doi, aa na paguri eele bagu-bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui.

source_text: and said to them, it is written, my house shall be called the house of prayer, but ye have made it a den of thieves.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘ja'a patitu èmu ne, sèna ka dhèu mai manèngi-mangaj'i ètu ne'e. ' dad'èi lamatua sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa miu tao èmu ne, nuka sèmi era kaboko dhèu parapo!

source_text: and the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
target_text: èle, ka dhèu bèdhu dènge dhèu karuku mai sa yesus ètu èmu sabaj'a ama lamatua. ka na puri-pa'èle aa'i si.

source_text: and when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, hosanna to the son of david; they were greatly displeased,
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. ropa rèdhi yesus tao tadha malaa, hèia ra ka'uu-kamuki. risi-risi hari, ropa ra tadèngi ana-ana pa'oo palere-lere ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne, dhu peka na, hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! lula ana-èpu dhèu aae daud mai le!

source_text: and said to him, hearest thou what these say? and jesus saith to them, yes: have ye never read, out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
target_text: ka kètu kapai se lii dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, eeh! èu tadèngi lii padhai lii ana-ana se? èèna lèke boe! te ngaa yesus b'ala si, na, oo, ja'a tadèngi. te, nga tao? miu baca mèdhi mèka ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua lula-nèti ana-ana dhu koa-kio ama lamatua, do? te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna dhu suri, na, ‘ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le, ana rara iisi hiu, dènge ana-ana iiki, ho koa-kio ne. '

source_text: and he left them, and went out of the city into bethany, and he lodged there.
target_text: hèia yesus si tèke eele kota ne, lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: now in the morning as he was returning into the city, he was hungry.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae na, yesus si lèpa hari asa kota yerusalem. te ngaa ètu talora j'ara, nèngu manganga le.

source_text: and when he saw a fig-tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing on it, but leaves only, and said to it, let no fruit grow on thee henceforth for ever. and immediately the fig-tree withered.
target_text: na ladhe nèdhi aj'u ca kapua buli sebhe j'ara dhu dhèu tema ra'a hua na. de la'e ka padètu-dètu dènge aj'u ne'e, ho neo ladhe sèku dhu hua le, do dhae. te ngaa ropa d'ai kapua aaj'u ne, na nèdhi boe hua cue sa, lula rèu heka sub'u mai kèna. hèia na peka mi aj'u ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua cue sa, de èèna na èu hua heka! ropa na lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia aj'u ne mango dènge ka.

source_text: and when the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, how soon is the fig-tree withered!
target_text: ropa ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne, hèia ra malaa. ka ra karèi, peka na, tasamia ka aj'u ne mango?

source_text: jesus answered and said to them, verily i say to you, if ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig-tree, but also, if ye shall say to this mountain, be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, na, nanene paie-iie! ladhe miu lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua, aa dènge boe d'ara kajari, miu kahèi bisa tao sama sèmi dhu ja'a tao ne. miu bisa tao risi hari nèti ne'e. sèmi: miu bisa paredha ledhe pidha asa d'ara dhasi la'e. tatu ama lamatua pidha eele kahèi ledhe ne nèti era na, sad'i miu parcaya nèngu tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and all things whatever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu manèngi nèti ama lamatua, èèna na miu abhu, sad'i miu parcaya ne tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and when he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, by what authority doest thou these things; and who gave thee this authority?
target_text: d'ai yerusalem, yesus si maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa nèngu aj'a dhèu madha j'ara ama lamatua, hèia kètu agama yahudi, mese agama sèra, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a, mai karèi yesus, na, med'a na, cee ka dhu pua èu tao maruru ètu era ne'e ne? cee ka dhu hia èu hak?

source_text: and jesus answered and said to them, i also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, i also will tell you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a, na, dhèu se dhu neo pamanahu ne. hèia na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: the baptism of john, whence was it? from heaven, or from men? and they reasoned with themselves, saying, if we shall say, from heaven; he will say to us, why then did ye not believe him?
target_text: lii karèi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis tuka sarani, si? cee ka dhu hia ne hak, ho sarani dhèu? ama lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha? ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, waa! nara le èdhi, nga! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu hia hak', pe na b'ala èdhi, peka na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: but if we shall say, from men; we fear the people: for all hold john as a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhaa na, ‘dhèu rai-haha ka dhu hia hak', mage dhoka dhèu aa'i-aa'i patao dènge èdhi. lula rèngu parcaya, na, yohanis ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: and they answered jesus, and said, we cannot tell. and he said to them, neither do i tell you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra dhaa peka na, ji'i nge'a boe. hèia yesus b'ala si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a parluu boe peka na, cee ka dhu hia ja'a hak.

source_text: but what think ye? a certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, son, go, work to-day in my vineyard.
target_text: yesus padhai lii taruu dènge kètu kapai sèra, aku nèngu na, miu pangee sèku dènge lii lolo ne. abhu ca dhèu ama, dènge ana mone na dhèu dua. na peka dènge ana uuru èèna, ‘ana, deo ne'e èu lamu sab'a asa d'ara oka. '

source_text: he answered and said, i will not; but afterward he repented, and went.
target_text: te ngaa ana ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘eeh! ja'a laku boe. ' te ngaa nèbhu boe ka, na manyasa, ka la'e.

source_text: and he came to the second, and said likewise. and he answered and said, i go, sir: and went not.
target_text: ka ama ra pua ana limuri, peka na, ‘deo ne'e, èu lamu sab'a asa d'ara oka. ' ka ana ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘be'a, ama! pe ja'a laku. ' te ngaa te'a boe na, nèngu dhu la'e boe.

source_text: which of the two did the will of his father? they say to him, the first. jesus saith to them, verily i say to you, that the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of god before you.
target_text: ropa lole nare, hèia yesus karèi dhèu se'e, peka na, ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: nèti ana dhèu dua se, mia ka dhu tao madhutu lii paredha ama ra? hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ana uuru! ka na peka, aku nèngu na, oo. te ngaa nanene paie, te ja'a peka dhu lèke kèna. te dhèu dhu miu cap, na, dhèu dhu laku-laku boe, sama sèmi dhèu roro bea, dènge bhèni kajeo, bèli-camèd'a rèngu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i uuru dhèu unu ama lamatua, nèti miu. te miu dhoka sad'i dhaa di, peka na, 'oo' mi ama lamatua, te ngaa tao boe madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: for john came to you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
target_text: uru èèna, yohanis tuka sarani, aj'a le miu j'ara tasamia, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri mola. te ngaa miu parcaya boe ne. aa te ngaa ropa dhèu laku-laku boe sèra, nanene lii a'aj'a nèti yohanis, rèngu tèke eele sasala ra, sèna ka tao madhutu a'aj'a èèna. miu dhu me'a le. te ngaa miu loe boe nèti ad'u-ue sasala-sasigo, ho madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: hear another parable; there was a certain householder, who planted a vineyard, and hedged it around, and digged a wine-press in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a remote country:
target_text: yesus lole nare, ka na lolo hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, abhu ca dhèu lamatua rai dhu la'e tao oka, ho sèle anggor ètu dedha rai na ca kasib'i. ka na tao tedhe rai reo. aa na tao bak cue era pacèli èi anggor. dhèu ne patitu kahèi era madhenge dhu dedha aae èci. èle, ka na hia oka ne mi dhèu seb'a, sèna ka d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia la'e ka asa rai kaj'èu.

source_text: and when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
target_text: ropa d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, lamatua oka ne pua dhèu sab'a na, lasi asa dhèu seb'a se, sèna ka rare pala nèngu.

source_text: and the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu seb'a oka se'e, pusi-pahae boe dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua oka ne. abhu dhu lèke game, abhu dhu ra pamadhe, aa abhu dhu lèke pèci dènge hadhu.

source_text: again he sent other servants more than the first: and they did to them in like manner.
target_text: ka lamatua oka ne pua hari dhèu sab'a na canau, ae risi nèti dhèu sab'a dhu lasi uuru sèra. te ngaa dhèu seb'a oka se tao hari bhabhelu sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu sab'a se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but last of all he sent to them his son, saying, they will reverence my son.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka lamatua oka ne, pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pangee, na, ‘ladhe ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, tatu ra sèmi na dènge be'a, aa ra pakab'ua ne kahèi. '

source_text: but when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, this is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu seb'a se ladhe rèdhi ana ne, hèia ra papeka, ‘wee, mi laladhe ku laa! te mone heka nèi hia ana d'èlu na mai. nèngu ne'e ka dhu bèli-camèd'a, unu aa'i mèdha-panyau mone heka ne. de ta pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi unu oka ne. '

source_text: and they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
target_text: hèia kèpe rare ana ne, ka ra nuni asa li'u oka, hèia ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: when therefore the lord of the vineyard cometh, what will he do to those husbandmen?
target_text: ka yesus pa'èle lii lolo na, ka na karèi dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: ladhe lamatua oka ne lèpa mai, madhutu ngangee miu, na tao dhèu seb'a oka se tasa mera mia?

source_text: they say to him, he will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard to other husbandmen, who will render him the fruits in their seasons.
target_text: hèia kètu kapai yahudi sèra dhaa, peka na, tatu na pamadhe dhèu bhelu se aa'i-aa'i. èle, na hia hari dhèu leo seb'a oka ne, dhu èèna na pabagi dènge be'a, ropa d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu.

source_text: jesus saith to them, did ye never read in the scriptures, the stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the lord's doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ele boe miu se baca mèdhi boe, ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu core eele, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu era padhèdi èmu! ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu kabhili nare, aa na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe na be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: therefore i say to you, the kingdom of god shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits of it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, de miu sanèd'e paie-iie. uru èèna, ama lamatua hag'e nare èdhi dhèu yahudi se, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. te ngaa, lula miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a, èèna na lamatua pili nare dhèu leo rai kara. te dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na, dhu nia j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: and whoever shall fall on this stone, shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
target_text: ja'a peka paled'a-led'a dènge miu. ja'a ka, hadhu padhèdi èèna. dhèu dhu bèbhe lèke hadhu ne, èèna na nèngu laho kao-kao. aa ladhe hadhu ne bèbhe lèke dhèu, èèna na dhèu ne laho kao-kao.

source_text: and when the chief priests and pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke of them.
target_text: ropa kètu kapai yahudi dènge dhèu parisi tadèngi lii padhai yesus, hèia re'a, na, lii ne padhèto dènge rèngu. rèngu se ca ropa dènge dhèu seb'a oka anggor, aa dènge tuka dhu core eele hadhu era padhèdi èmu.

source_text: but when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
target_text: de ra nasa titu kèna. ka rèngu mulai tenge j'ara ho kèpe ne. te ngaa rèngu madha'u dènge dhèu ae, dhu peka na yesus ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bani boe tao ngaa-ngaa mi dedha nèngu.

source_text: and jesus answered, and spoke to them again by parables, and said,
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii hari dènge rèngu pake lii upama, aku nèngu na,

source_text: the kingdom of heaven is like to a certain king, who made a marriage for his son,
target_text: paredha ama lamatua èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu aae ca dhèu dhu tao pesta kab'i ana mone na.

source_text: and sent his servants to call them that were invited to the wedding: and they would not come.
target_text: ropa dhèu pananasu rare, hèia na pua dhèu sab'a na, sèna ka lasi peka dhèu-dhèu dhu abhu nèru, ra peka na, ‘mai ka, te d'ai tadha ta'a-tinu kèna. ' te ngaa dhèu dhu abhu nèru se ro'o boe mai.

source_text: again, he sent other servants, saying, tell them who are invited, behold, i have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come to the marriage.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se lèpa, lasi peka dènge dhèu aae. ropa na tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae pua dhèu sab'a na dhu leo hari, aku nèngu na, ‘lami peka hari dènge dhèu sèra ho mai ka, te pesta neo mulai kèna. ja'a para sapi, ka pananasu kore le dhu be'a titu kèna. peka si mai ka, ra'a-rinu, te aa'i-aa'i tesa le. '

source_text: but they made light of it, and went, one to his farm, another to his merchandise.
target_text: dhèu sab'a se lasi peka sèmi dhu dhèu aae moa èèna. te ngaa dhèu dhu lèke nèru se, pusi-pahae boe. abhu dhu lasi ladhe oka ra, abhu dhu lasi era sasab'a ra,

source_text: and the remnant took his servants, and treated them spitefully, and slew them.
target_text: aa cahag'e hari ra kèpe rare dhèu sab'a se nèti dhèu aae ne, ho ra game toke madhe.

source_text: but when the king heard of it, he was wroth: and he sent his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae nasa bia. ka na paredha sordad'u na, lasi pamadhe aa'i dhèu-dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu sab'a na sèra. hèia sordad'u se tunu pakèpu-ladhu ai kota ne toke mera dènge rai.

source_text: then he saith to his servants, the wedding is ready, but they who were invited were not worthy.
target_text: èle, ka dhèu aae paroa nare dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, ka na peka, ‘pesta kab'i ne tesa aa'i le, te ngaa dhèu-dhèu dhu ja'a nèru, nia boe madhèdi ètu d'ara pesta ja'a.

source_text: go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, invite to the marriage.
target_text: de lami ka asa j'ara oka-hoo, sèna ka nèru cee dhu sad'i miu paraga. '

source_text: so those servants went out into the highways, and collected all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a se lasi asa j'ara oka-hoo. hèia rèti mai dhèu ae-ae dhu ra paraga ètu j'ara, sèna ka ra'a-rinu ètu pesta kab'i ne. dhèu se'e, nuka dhèu dhu be'a dènge dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a, mai papènu ètu era kakab'i ne.

source_text: and when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who had not a wedding-garment:
target_text: ka dhèu aae la'e asa era pesta ne ladhe palème tamu sèra. hèia ladhe nèdhi tamu ca dhèu dhu pake boe mèdha-papake pesta.

source_text: and he saith to him, friend, how camest thou in hither, not having a wedding-garment? and he was speechless.
target_text: ka dhèu aae karèi ne, peka na, ‘hee, angalai! èu nga tao ka mai asa ne'e pake boe mèdha-papake pesta? ' te ngaa dhèu ne loo-loo sène.

source_text: then said the king to the servants, bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into utter darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae paredha dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, aku nèngu na, ‘uj'u haga dènge ai dhèu ne'e ne, ho core ne asa li'u la'e. hud'i laa na tangi dènge abhu j'èra ètu era dhu maroga kiu-kiu nèi. '

source_text: for many are called, but few are chosen.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ama lamatua paroa dhèu ae, te ngaa dhodhoka dhu ciki di dhu kabhili nare j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: then went the pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai yesus, hèia dhèu-dhèu parisi rare lii èci ho neo pamanahu aa galaa ne.

source_text: and they sent out to him their disciples, with the herodians, saying, master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of god in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
target_text: ka dhèu se pua dhèu rèngu palere-lere dènge dhèu-dhèu nèti partei politik herodes, sèna ka lasi pakarèi dènge yesus. dhèu se koa-kad'iri yesus, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a d'ara ama mola. ama dhu me'a boe kapod'e-kabèli, aa dhu ladhe boe rèhu dhèu. ama dhu tema aj'a-nori lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge boe koe-kapengo.

source_text: tell us therefore, what thinkest thou? is it lawful to give tribute to cesar, or not?
target_text: mamai ji'i ne, neo karèi j'ara èci. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea mi dhèu aae kapai roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a mema, na, rèngu neo madulu d'ara na, sèna ka nèngu padhai lii lab'a dhèu paredha roma. hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu mema dhèu ho'a tema! tasamia ka miu neo pamanahu ja'a dènge j'ara ne'e?

source_text: show me the tribute-money. and they brought to him a penny.
target_text: pad'elo sèku ja'a doi iia cue, dhu dhèu pake ho b'ae bea! hèia ra pad'elo doi iia ne mi yesus.

source_text: and he saith to them, whose is this image, and superscription?
target_text: ka na karèi si, ne'e ne, rèhu cee? aa ne'e ne, ngara cee?

source_text: they say to him, cesar's. then saith he to them, render therefore to cesar, the things which are cesar's; and to god, the things that are god's.
target_text: ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, èèna keser, dhèu aae kapai paredha roma. hèia yesus peka dènge ra, na, ladhe sèmi èèna hia la mi dhèu paredha ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak dhèu paredha. aa hia la mi ama lamatua ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak ama lamatua.

source_text: when they had heard these words, they marveled, and left him, and departed.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i malaa, lula ngaa dhu na peka sèra lèke tare'a-re'a. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa boe abhu j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. hèia lasi ka tèke eele yesus.

source_text: the same day came to him the sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu nèti partei saduki. dhèu se'e ka dhu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. lod'o èèna, dhèu se'e kahèi dhu tenge j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. nèti èèna ka, rèngu mai pakarèi dènge ne, peka na,

source_text: saying, master, moses said, if a man shall die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.
target_text: ama mese! musa dhu suri tèke le atora hia ji'i, dhu peka na: ladhe dhèu mone ca dhèu madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na dhu dènge boe ana, na, ari nèti dhèu mone ne, hud'i leo nare hari bhèni balu ne, sèna ka abhu kolo gati madha a'a na.

source_text: now there were with us seven brothers: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased; and having no issue, left his wife to his brother.
target_text: mema uru èèna musa aj'a sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi sèmi ne'e: abhu ana mone dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. ana partama leo-èmu, te ngaa madhe dènge boe kolo. hèia ari na leo nare bhèni balu ne.

source_text: likewise the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, na madhe, dènge boe ana kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ari ka tèlu na; nèngu madhèdi kahèi dènge bhèni balu ne, te ngaa madhe kahèi dènge boe ana. sèmi èèna ka toke ari na dhu limuri tèka, madhe kahèi.

source_text: and last of all the woman died also.
target_text: ka bhèni balu ne madhe.

source_text: therefore in the resurrection, whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
target_text: de dhu ji'i neo karèi, sèmi ne'e ne: bhèni balu ne dhu leo nèdhi dènge mone dhèu pidhu se. bèli-camèd'a lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ropa ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe sèra, na, bhèni ne j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu cee?

source_text: jesus answered and said to them, ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of god.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus b'ala si, peka na, ladhe lii pakarèi miu sèmi èèna, miu se sala kapai le! te miu se me'a mere boe isi sasuri ama lamatua. aa me'a boe kahèi koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna.

source_text: for in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of god in heaven.
target_text: dhu lèke ka sèmi ne'e! pe ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu nèti mamadhe ra, rèngu se paleo heka èmu, sama sèmi ana pajuu na ètu sorga dhu leo boe èmu.

source_text: but as concerning the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken to you by god, saying,
target_text: aa ja'a neo peka kahèi, lula-nèti dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari, do aad'o. ètu d'ara sasuri musa, dhu lole na, aj'u iiki ca kapua dhu ai na'e te ngaa kèpu boe. nèti lii lolo ne, èdhi bisa te'a, na, dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari. te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na,

source_text: i am the god of abraham, and the god of isaac, and the god of jacob? god is not the god of the dead, but of the living.
target_text: ‘ja'a ne ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu. nuka abraham, isak dènge yakob. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pahaha iisi era mi ja'a toke d'ai sange ne'e ne. ' de èdhi te'a, na, lod'o ama lamatua peka sèmi èèna, baki èdhi se dhu madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa ama lamatua peka na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu te'a na, samanga rèngu dhu mamuri era, masi ka rèngu dhu madhe nèbhu le. de masi ka madhe, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. te dhodhoka dhèu mamuri di, dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, dhèu dhu madhe, aad'o, si? !

source_text: and when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare lii padhai yesus ne, hèia dhèu saduki se re'a heka b'ala. te ngaa dhèu ae se malaa-maloha, ka ra papeka na, ira ii! lii padhai dhèu ne'e ne be'a seli eele, nga!

source_text: but when the pharisees had heard that he had put the sadducees to silence, they were assembled about him.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi tadèngi, na, yesus segi le dhèu saduki, hèia ra pakaboko ho lasi pakarèi dènge ne.

source_text: then one of them who was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
target_text: nèti rèngu se, abhu ca dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu j'ara-j'ara agama, la'e pakarèi dènge yesus, aku nèngu na,

source_text: master, which is the great commandment in the law?
target_text: ama mese! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e ka: atora nèti ad'a dènge agama èdhi, ae d'ai seli. paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu nèti musa, mia ka dhu dedha risi?

source_text: jesus said to him, thou shalt love the lord thy god with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
