target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, paredha dhu dedha risi ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua suri, peka na: ‘ama lamatua èèna, tare'a lamatua miu. de miu se hud'i sue risi ne nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i sanao-maena taruu mi nèngu, tadhe paie ne, dènge sab'a pa'èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: this is the first and great commandment.
target_text: ne'e ne ka, paredha dhu dedha dènge kapai risi!

source_text: and the second is like it, thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
target_text: aa abhu paredha ka dua dhu peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu mesa mu. '

source_text: on these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
target_text: dua paredha se, nuka kapua nèti atora musa dènge lii aj'a-nori aa'i-aa'i ra nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. dhèu tatu boe madhutu paredha leo, ladhe nèngu madhutu uuru boe dua paredha dhu dedha risi se.

source_text: while the pharisees were assembled, jesus asked them,
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi dhu pakaboko era ètu èèna, ka yesus karèi si, peka na,

source_text: saying, what think ye of christ? whose son is he? they say to him, the son of david.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ama lamatua dhu padhadha tèke le, ho pua kristus mai, sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu unu na. de madhutu a'abhu miu, na, kristus èèna ana-èpu cee? hèia ra dhaa peka na, nèngu èèna, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud.

source_text: he saith to them, how then doth david in spirit call him lord, saying,
target_text: yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka roh mola-mèci èèna peka dènge dhèu aae daud, na, nèngu paroa kristus, ‘lamatua'? te daud suri tèke na,

source_text: the lord said to my lord, sit thou on my right hand, till i make thy enemies thy footstool?
target_text: ‘ama lamatua peka mema le dènge lamatua ja'a, na, mai ho madhèdi ètu era hua iia ne, ètu baboa g'ana ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao musu-musu èu sèra, pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: if david then calleth him lord, how is he his son?
target_text: de nèti lii ne'e ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud mesa na paroa kristus ne, ‘lamatua'. de ladhe dhèu peka na, kristus dhoka ana-èpu daud di, èèna dhae d'ai mèka. lula nèngu lamatua nèti dhèu aae daud kahèi!

source_text: and no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man, from that day forth, ask him any more questions.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai yesus, dhèu parisi se nuka sèmi dhèu goa sa, te ca dhèu sa bisa boe dhaa lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, nèti lod'o èèna, rèngu bani heka tenge j'ara ho pakarèi ne.

source_text: then jesus spoke to the multitude, and to his disciples,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus aj'a ana madhutu na dènge dhèu ae leo dhu palere dènge rèngu.

source_text: saying, the scribes and the pharisees sit in moses's seat.
target_text: na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra abhu hak ho aj'a-nori atora musa mi dhèu.

source_text: all therefore, whatever they bid you observe, that observe and do: but do not ye according to their works: for they say, and do not.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i nanene si, aa tao madhutu lii a'aj'a ra. te ngaa mage mi madhutu ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue, lula rèngu mesa ra madhutu boe lii a'aj'a rèngu sèra.

source_text: for they bind heavy burdens, and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
target_text: rèngu laka-seti dhèu sèna ka madhutu atora agama ra dhu pabia dhèu. te ngaa rèngu mesa ra ro'o boe soru-bara dhèu, sèna ka madhutu atora sèra.

source_text: but all their works they do to be seen by men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ra ad'u-ue sèra, sèna ka dhèu koa-kad'iri si. nuka sèmi: ètu katanga rèi ra, dhu èki dènge mèdha èci dhu suri lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa ètu lele aai ra kahèi. te ngaa rèngu tao parisi hari, sèna ka dhèu padedha si, peka na, ‘ira ii! dhèu se, dhèu mola! '

source_text: and love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
target_text: ladhe rèngu maso asa d'ara èmu gareja, do, d'ara pesta rèngu d'èi tenge era dhu be'a risi, sèna ka dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si.

source_text: and greetings in the markets, and to be called by men, rabbi, rabbi.
target_text: ladhe lasi asa d'ara pasa, rèngu d'èi dhèu pakab'ua si. ra tenge j'ara, sèna ka dhèu pahaha iisi mi rèngu, aa d'èi dhèu paroa ra, ‘ama mese, dhu hua iia. '

source_text: but be not ye called rabbi: for one is your master, even christ; and all ye are brethren.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madhutu j'ara rèngu se'e! dhèu baku paroa miu ‘ama mese', lula mese miu dhoka ca dhèu di. aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi se'e, pa'a'ari.

source_text: and call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your father who is in heaven.
target_text: mage j'oka padedha dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, peka na, ‘ama', lula ama miu ètu sorga dhoka èci di.

source_text: neither be ye called masters: for one is your master, even christ.
target_text: dhèu baku paroa miu kahèi, ‘lamatua', lula ama lamatua miu dhodhoka èci di, nuka ja'a ne, dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: but he that is greatest among you, shall be your servant.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu, mage padedha iisi mi, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka dhèu pakab'ua ra. nèti miu se, cee ka dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku nuka sèmi ènu, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo.

source_text: and whoever shall exalt himself, shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself, shall be exalted.
target_text: te dhèu dhu pamone-pabhèni, èèna na lamatua pamanahu ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu pahaha iisi nuka sèmi ana iiki, bèli-camèd'a lamatua ded'e padedha ne.

source_text: but woe to you, scribes and pharisees! hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering, to go in.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi se! miu mema dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere pala miu, lula miu mo'o boe parcaya ja'a, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pamoa tèke pua mai. aa dhu bhelu risi hari, miu bhabhae dhèu neo mai asa d'ara rai paredha ama lamatua, sèna ka ra baku parcaya ja'a.

source_text: woe to you, scribes and pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
target_text: hee, miu mese-mese agama dènge dhèu-dhèu parisi! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! bèli-camèd'a miu pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu, sèna ka parame mere èmu ra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, miu pa'abhe bhabhelu miu, dènge j'ara sabaj'a panèbhu-nèbhu, ho dhèu peka na, miu dhèu d'ara mola. te ngaa èèna na, ama lamatua hia huku dhu bia risi mi miu.

source_text: woe to you, scribes and pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him two-fold more the child of hell than yourselves.
target_text: hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! bèli-camèd'a miu pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu lami asa mia èèna ka, palème lèu, do, ca'e-puru ledhe, neo tenge dhoka ca dhèu di, sèna ka maso partei agama miu. te ngaa ropa na maso, miu ad'u-ue mamuri na asa bhelu risi, toke na abhu hahuku dhu babia na, dua hari risi nèti miu ètu d'ara naraka.

source_text: woe to you, ye blind guides, who say, whoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor.
target_text: wee! d'ara miu dhu bèdhu le. nga tao ka limuri ne miu neo pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu leo? pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu aj'a leli, peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu pajaji pake soo-subha dhu ale èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, na, dhèu ne pa'èki boe dènge lii pajaji na èèna. te ngaa ladhe na pajaji pake subha dènge ale mèdha hualaa ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, na, nèngu heka pa'èki dènge lii pajaji na. '

source_text: ye fools, and blind: for which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
target_text: miu goa kabao! miu pangee na, ama lamatua pakab'ua risi mèdha hualaa sèra nèti èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i na, do? aad'o! te èmu ne'e ka dhu tao mèdha sèra j'aj'i mola-mèci!

source_text: and whoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
target_text: miu se aj'a ore-leli kahèi, peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu pajaji pake subha ale mei korban dhu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dhèu ne pa'èki boe dènge lii pajaji na. te ngaa ladhe na pajaji pake subha aa ale mèdha ètu dedha mei korban, na, dhèu ne heka pa'èki dènge lii pajaji na kèna. '

source_text: ye fools, and blind: for which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
target_text: miu mema bèdhu tare'a-re'a. tatu mei korban ne, kab'ua risi nèti mèdha ètu dedha mei èèna. te mei èèna ka dhu tao mèdha korban rèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci mi ama lamatua.

source_text: whoever therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things upon it.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu subha ale mei korban ne, na, be'a risi ale mei dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha mei èèna.

source_text: and whoever shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth in it.
target_text: aa ladhe dhèu subha ale èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, na, be'a risi ale kahèi èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dènge kolongara ama lamatua. te nèngu ka dhu pea ètu talora aae na.

source_text: and he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of god, and by him that sitteth upon it.
target_text: aa ladhe dhèu subha ale sorga, na, èèna èci èèna ka dènge nèngu ale kadera paredha ama lamatua, palere-lere dènge kolongara na, te nèngu ka dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu èèna.

source_text: woe to you, scribes and pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint, and anise, and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ye ought to have done, and not to leave the others undone.
target_text: hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu d'èlu-mèu titu kèna pa'iga capala nèti canguru pala dhu miu hia lamatua. miu pa'iga aa'i mèu-mèu, toke bubhu nèti d'ara oka, èci sa tèke eele boe. miu ige toke lutu-sela nuka sèmi, rèu d'are, ka'unyi, dènge lasona. te ngaa miu pabhèlu eele atora dhu kab'ua risi nèti ama lamatua! te mamuri miu mola boe. miu sue boe dhèu dhu unu aad'o. aa mamuri miu madhutu boe dad'èi lamatua. be'a risi miu tao madhutu aa'i dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, heka mi pa'ige kèna bubhu-bubhu dhu lutu sèra, dhu miu neo hia mi lamatua.

source_text: ye blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel.
target_text: d'ara miu bèdhu, te ngaa tasamia ka neo era paj'uj'u j'ara hia dhèu leo? miu tao atora toke lutu, ho pua dhèu madhutu, te ngaa atora dhu kab'ua risi nèti ama lamatua, miu mesa mi pusi-pahae boe. nuka sèmi miu sule eele kikidui dhu ana iiki-iiki nèti èi dhu miu minu, te ngaa badha aae sèmi kabao, miu dhèle kateme!

source_text: woe to you, scribes and pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
target_text: hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu rase pega-mago toke mèu kale'e, te ngaa dhoka re li'u di. masi ka re d'ara na dhu kaj'alu titu kèna nèti mana'u miu dènge dèu ngara miu. mamuri miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: thou blind pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
target_text: wee, dhèu parisi dhu bèdhu, ee! rase uuru ku re d'ara pega-mago miu sèra! dènge sèmi èèna, re li'u na j'aj'i mèu kahèi!

source_text: woe to you, scribes and pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like whitened sepulchers, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
target_text: wee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu ca ropa dènge ro'a dhèu madhe dhu lame dènge èi dama pudhi. dhèu ladhe re li'u na, be'a titu kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara, pènu dènge rui dhèu madhe, aa dhu hèu oone-oone.

source_text: thus ye also outwardly appear righteous to men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
target_text: miu èci èèna ka! miu d'èi tao iisi mi sèmi dhèu dhu mola-mèci. nèti li'u dhèu rèdhi, na, miu nuka sèmi dhèu d'ara mola. te ngaa ètu d'ara, miu cakaraa dhèu bhelu-katub'a. te miu padhai lii leo, tao leo, aa pabhèlu eele paredha ama lamatua sèra.

source_text: woe to you, scribes and pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchers of the righteous,
target_text: hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo! miu pakapai ro'a nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa dule pabe'a-be'a ro'a dhèu d'ara be'a.

source_text: and say, if we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
target_text: te ngaa miu peka na, ‘sèmi ji'i se mamuri tèu èci èèna ka dènge bèi-baki ji'i, tatu ji'i madhutu boe pamadhe dhèu dhu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. '

source_text: wherefore ye are witnesses to yourselves, that ye are the children of them who killed the prophets.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, miu unu mi bhoke rahasia miu, na, miu bhelu èci èèna ka dènge bèi-baki miu.

source_text: fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
target_text: de la'a, sina ma. miu tao taruu la bhabhelu toke d'ai èle, madhutu tatao bèi-baki mi!

source_text: ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
target_text: miu tare'a-re'a bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka dènge mege dhu dènge raco. miu pangee, na, ama lamatua huku boe miu? aad'o! tatu na pèci miu asa d'ara ai naraka!

source_text: wherefore behold, i send to you prophets, and wise men, and scribes; and some of them ye will kill and crucify, and some of them ye will scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
target_text: sanèd'e paie! pe ja'a pua ana madhutu ja'a mai, ho ra aj'a-nori dènge pad'elo miu j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu lèke. te ngaa èèna na miu pamadhe cahag'e, aa cahag'e hari miu paku pamadhe si ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. abhu kahèi dhu miu hake-paru si ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, aa abhu cahag'e kahèi miu paj'èra si toke ra rai nèti kota èci asa kota leo.

source_text: that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous abel, to the blood of zacharias son of barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
target_text: lod'o uru sèra, bèi-baki miu pamadhe habel. masi ka nèngu ne, d'ara dhu mola. bèi-baki miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti lai ana-lai èpu. toke d'ai sakaria, ana nèti barakia. ra pamadhe ne ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i padètu dènge mei korban. lula miu madhutu bhabhelu bèi-baki mi, nèti èèna ka miu hud'i tago mere raa nèti dhèu dhu d'ara mola se'e.

source_text: verily i say to you, all these things shall come upon this generation.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a! te miu ana lod'o limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a abhu huku lula j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu dhu bèi-baki miu ad'u-ue karèi nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: o jerusalem, jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them who are sent to thee, how often would i have gathered thy children, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
target_text: hee, miu dhèu yerusalem! miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu-dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa pèci pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha na dhu mai soru-bara miu. ja'a ke'a boe roca pamako miu, sèna ka lèpa mai asa ja'a ne, nuka sèmi manu rena dhu bhiri-sarobho ana na ètu d'ara èla na. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a.

source_text: behold, your house is left to you desolate.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua pusi-pahae heka dènge èmu miu. ka bèli-camèd'a, èmu èèna dhèu pea heka ètu d'ara.

source_text: for i say to you, ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, blessed is he that cometh in the name of the lord.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te bèli-camèd'a miu mèdhi heka ja'a toke d'ai lod'o na, miu mangaku, peka na, ‘èdhi manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pala-bagi mamèngi-nale mi dhèu ne'e, lula lamatua ka dhu pua na mai. ' miu mangaku sèmi èèna, heka mèdhi hari ja'a kèna.

source_text: and jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
target_text: ka yesus neo tèke eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa na kalua, ana madhutu na mai paj'uj'u babe'a èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne.

source_text: and jesus said to them, see ye not all these things? verily i say to you, there shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, na, èmu ne, mema saraga. te ngaa nanene, ee! nèbhu heka dhèu mai paguri eele aa'i hadhu se.

source_text: and as he sat upon the mount of olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, tell us, when will these things be? and what will be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
target_text: hèia yesus la'e madhèdi asa ledhe saitun. ka ana madhutu na mai padhai lii mesa ra dènge ne, peka na, ama! peka hari ku laa, lii padhai ama deo na. j'aj'aj'i na pèri lod'o? mamai hari ama na lod'o mia? aa tadha-tadha na tasamia? tasamia kahèi dènge lod'o èle rai-haha?

source_text: and jesus answered and said to them, take heed that no man deceive you.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, j'aga paie mamuri miu, sèna ka dhèu baku kapod'e-kabèli miu.

source_text: for many will come in my name, saying, i am christ; and will deceive many.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ae mai tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua padhadha karèi nèti uru ka. ' dènge j'ara ne, rèngu monya dhèu ae.

source_text: and ye will hear of wars, and rumors of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
target_text: ladhe miu mèdhi ka, dhèu pamusu, do, tadèngi lii palolo dhèu papara-pakèj'i ètu mia-mia, na, miu baku madha'u kahèi. te j'ara se'e se, hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku, te ngaa lod'o èle rai-haha ne dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there will be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes in divers places.
target_text: dhèu nèti ca suku, èèna na pamusu dènge suku leo. negara èci pamusu, lab'a negara leo. ètu mia-mia abhu rai opo, aa manganga-mad'èu dhu kapai titu kèna.

source_text: all these are the beginning of sorrows.
target_text: te ngaa sèra sa, heka tadha partama kèna, dhu peka na, lod'o èle rai-haha dètu ae le. èèna nuka sèmi bhèni dhu mulai kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: then will they deliver you up to be afflicted, and will kill you: and ye will be hated by all nations for my name's sake.
target_text: de miu hud'i j'aga paie ku ngi'u miu! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu mai paj'èra dènge pamadhe miu. aa dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, èèna na d'èi boe miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and then will many be offended, and will betray one another, and will hate one another.
target_text: taa èèna, dhèu ae ka dhu soro kabodho dènge ro'o heka madhutu ja'a. rèngu panasa èci dènge èci, aa èci pahie èci.

source_text: and many false prophets will rise, and will deceive many.
target_text: èèna na abhu dhèu dhu tema leko-monya se, peka na, rèngu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. ka dhèu ae ka dhu lèka si.

source_text: and because iniquity will abound, the love of many will become cold.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a bhabhelu dhèu asa tabha, toke dhèu re'a heka pasue èci dènge èci.

source_text: but he that shall endure to the end, the same shall be saved.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu taha taruu toke madhe, tatu ama lamatua pala hia ne mamuri.

source_text: and this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world, for a testimony to all nations; and then shall the end come.
target_text: te dhèu hud'i palolo pale-lème ku lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, toke suu-suu rai d'ai ro'a kakilu ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu j'ara mamuri lamatua. èle èèna ku, rai-haha ne heka èle kèna.

source_text: when therefore ye shall see the abomination of desolation spoken of by daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, whoever readeth, let him understand,
target_text: yesus padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, daniel, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci dhu bhelu-katub'a risi eele mai. èèna na maso titu ètu era laluri ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, nèngu pahera eele era ne'e. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua soro kabodho tèke eele era ne'e. de ropa miu mèdhi ka sèmi èèna, na mi pajiko paie-iie ka! dhèu cee dhu baca sasuri ne'e hud'i pajiko paie-iie ku!

source_text: then let them who are in judea flee to the mountains:
target_text: te ne'e ne j'aj'i tadha dhu peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dètu ae le. ropa mèdhi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea, rai ka asa ledhe.

source_text: let him who is on the house-top not come down to take any thing out of his house:
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu kalua nèti d'ara èmu le, na maso ia ka mere mèdha-panyau. te ngaa rai dènge ka, sèna ka baku lèke mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: neither let him who is in the field return back to take his clothes.
target_text: dhèu ètu d'ara oka, lèpa ia ka mere mèdha-papake mi. te ngaa rai dènge ka!

source_text: and woe to them that are with child, and to them that nurse infants in those days!
target_text: dhu j'èra risi ka, ina dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu pasusu ana dhu heka rara iisi hiu sèra. te rèngu se bisa boe rai pamèri.

source_text: but pray ye that your flight may not be in the winter, neither on the sabbath:
target_text: de hua iia miu sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra èèna mage lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai, do, lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: for then shall be great tribulation, such as hath not been since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
target_text: te lod'o èèna j'èra titu kèna! karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, toke d'ai sange ne'e ne, dhèu dhae ladhe rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu kapai sèmi èèna na. aa èèna na, dhèu paraga heka dènge j'aj'èra dhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and except those days should be shortened, there would no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
target_text: te ngaa miu oto kapai, te ama lamatua pab'ab'e lod'o èèna. ladhe aad'o, na, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa taha mamuri. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua sue dhèu unu na dhu hag'e nare sèra, nèti èèna ka na pab'ab'e lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: then if any man shall say to you, lo, here is christ, or there; believe it not.
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai ka, miu tadèngi dhèu, peka na, ‘ladhe ku la! kristus ka ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo peka na, ‘kristus ka nèi! ' te ngaa baku miu parcaya!

source_text: for false christs will arise, and false prophets, and will show great signs and wonders; so that, if it were possible, they would deceive the very elect.
target_text: te èèna na, abhu dhèu mai tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa dhèu leo peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu kèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na rèngu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, pake koasa nidhu, sèna ka kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. dhèu se tenge j'ara ho dhèu unu ama lamatua sèra lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: behold, i have told you before.
target_text: de miu hud'i j'aga paie-iie mamuri miu! lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se, dhae d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e mema le miu!

source_text: wherefore, if they shall say to you, behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
target_text: ladhe dhèu peka dènge miu, na, ‘kristus ètu le d'ara tana lapa nèi! ', na baku lami kahèi. aa ladhe abhu dhu peka na, ‘kristus nuka ètu d'ara èmu! ', na, baku miu parcaya kahèi.

source_text: for as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even to the west; so shall also the coming of the son of man be.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ladhe ja'a mai hari asa rai-haha ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi ja'a, nuka sèmi dhèu ladhe rèdhi bela kaha'a nèti dhimu asa haa.

source_text: for wherever the carcass is, there will the eagles be collected.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, pe miu me'a ja'a ètu era mia. nuka sèmi dhèu re'a na, ladhe dhèu rèdhi manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi badha madhe, ra lela pa'oru ètu mia, na ra re'a èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, na, tatu abhu sisi hèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: immediately after the tribulation of those days, shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, ho peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe oe èle ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, ‘èèna na, madha lod'o maroga kiu-kiu, hèru heo heka. hua hètu-hua hètu kabhui nèti dedha-liru, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru patogo èci dènge èci. '

source_text: and then shall appear the sign of the son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha ètu dedha-liru, dhu pad'elo, peka na, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari kèna. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne j'aj'i madha'u toke ra tangi. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a puru mai dènge ra'i-liru, heka rèngu ladhe rèdhi koasa dènge dadedha ja'a kèna.

source_text: and he will send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
target_text: ka ja'a pake lii tèbhe dhu mèdhu ho pua ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, sèna ka pakaboko rare dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a kabhili kore le, nèti suu-suu rai-haha, nèti haa toke dhimu, nèti badae toke balèu.

source_text: now learn a parable of the fig-tree; when its branch is yet tender and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
target_text: ja'a pakasame sèmi aj'u ca kapua. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, tadha na, oe dètu hèru hadhu kèna.

source_text: so likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe miu mèdhi ka d'ai lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, nuka sèmi dhu ja'a peka-padhai deo na, èèna tadha, na, mamai ja'a dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: verily i say to you, this generation shall not pass, till all these things shall be fulfilled.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri loo-limuri ne, èèna na abhu cahag'e dhu dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o j'aj'èra se dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa lii padhai ja'a ne ca lamusi sa bisa boe ele.

source_text: but of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my father only.
target_text: ca dhèu sa re'a boe pèri lod'o ja'a mai hari. ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga re'a boe kahèi. ja'a mesa ku ke'a boe kahèi. dhodhoka ama ku mesa na dhu ne'a.

source_text: but as the days of noah were, so will also the coming of the son of man be.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa ja'a mai hari, nuka sèmi taa uru sèra, lod'o noh mamuri era.

source_text: for as in the days that were before the flood, they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that noah entered into the ark,
target_text: èi aae dhae j'aj'i mèka lala, te ngaa dhèu-dhèu dhu ra'a-rinu, aa paleo èmu sèmi biasa. dhèu sèra tao taruu sèmi èèna, toke noh maso asa d'ara kapa aae èèna.

source_text: and knew not until the flood came, and took them all away: so also will be the coming of the son of man.
target_text: te ngaa ropa èi aae lala, hae nèti aa'i si, rèngu heka kabèdhi kèna, lula ngaa dhu j'aj'i sèra. èci èèna ka dènge mamai ja'a bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: then will two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ladhe abhu dhèu dua ètu d'ara oka, cag'ag'a laa ama lamatua ded'e nèti ca dhèu, aa ca dhèu hari tèke eele.

source_text: two women will be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
target_text: ladhe dhèu bhèni dhèu dua dhu maj'u are, kaca'a la ama lamatua ded'e nèti ca dhèu, aa ca dhèu hari tèke eele.

source_text: watch therefore; for ye know not what hour your lord cometh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i bori pa'èra mema kahèi, te miu me'a boe pèri lod'o lamatua miu lèpa hari mai.

source_text: but know this, that if the master of the house knew in what watch the thief would come, he would watch, and would not suffer his house to be broken up.
target_text: pangee paie-iie! ladhe lamatua èmu dhu ne'a mema, na, mèda none dhèu mana'u mai, tatu na pasaruru boe musi madha na, sèna ka dhèu mana'u baku maso asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not, the son of man cometh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra mema kahèi. te mamai hari ja'a èèna, dènge sahèka!

source_text: who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them food in due season?
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, miu hud'i j'aj'i ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a dhu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi lamatua na. te ladhe lamatua na neo la'e rai kaj'èu, na ded'e dhèu sab'a dhu sèmi èèna ku, ho uri nganga'a-nganginu hia isi èmu na.

source_text: blessed is that servant, whom his lord, when he cometh, shall find so doing.
target_text: ladhe lamatua na lèpa, ladhe nèdhi dhèu sab'a na dhu sab'e dènge be'a, tatu na karej'e.

source_text: verily i say to you, that he will make him ruler over all his goods.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a, te bèli-camèd'a lamatua èmu hia dhèu sab'a ne koasa, sèna ka ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but if that evil servant shall say in his heart, my lord delayeth his coming;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu sab'a ne, dhèu bhelu, tatu na ngee ètu d'ara na,

source_text: and shall begin to beat his fellow-servants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
target_text: ‘be'a kèna! lamatua ja'a la'e le, de cee ne'a na pèri lod'o lèpa hari mai! ' nèti ngangee sèmi ne'e ne, hèia na kalabhe dhèu sab'a leo sèra. aa nèngu madhèdi na'a-ninu mau-mau bera-bera dènge dhèu mahu sèra.

source_text: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
target_text: te ngaa dhu ne'a nare boe, na, cag'ag'a laa lamatua na lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and will cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: hèia lamatua na capa paj'èra ne, ka core ne asa li'u, sèna ka na pa'èci dènge dhèu padhai lii leo, tao leo sèra. ètu era ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula ra j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened to ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus tuhu hari lii lula-nèti ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i bori mema-mema ho soru mamai ja'a, nuka sèmi lii pakasame ne. sèmi ne'e: ca tèka dhèu bhèni dhèu canguru dhu kalua re mèda, lasi soru broit dhèu mone, rèti dènge labhu èi mènyi asa èmu angalai ra.

source_text: and five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
target_text: te ngaa nèti rèngu canguru dhèu se, abhu lèmi dhu goa, aa lèmi dhu d'èlu-mèu.

source_text: they that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
target_text: lèmi dhu goa se, rèti boe èi mènyi dhu risi.

source_text: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
target_text: te ngaa lèmi dhu d'èlu-mèu se, rèti parisi.

source_text: while the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
target_text: d'ai èmu, broit dhèu mone dhae mai mèka. nèbhu-nèbhu ka, dhèu bhèni se musi madha ra sakaa, hèia ra bhèj'i luu titu kèna.

source_text: and at midnight there was a cry made, behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
target_text: re'a rare boe te, d'ai talora mèda sa, hèia tadèngi lii pa'oo, peka na, ‘wee! broit mai le! mai lati soru ne! '

source_text: then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi, hèia dhèu bhèni se kèd'i ka. ka ra kèpe ka labhu ra èci-èci.

source_text: and the foolish said to the wise, give us of your oil: for our lamps are gone out.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhèni dhu goa se, peka dènge bhèni aanga ra, aku rèngu na, ‘angalai, ee! bagi hia ji'i èi mènyi miu ciki la, te labhu ji'i di ruru-ruru kèna! '

source_text: but the wise answered, saying, not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhèni dhu d'èlu-mèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, ‘irii! baku nasa, te bisa boe. te èi mènyi ji'i d'ai boe èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti! de be'a risi lami hèli ètu era dhu pahia èi mènyi. '

source_text: and while they were going to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready, went in with him to the marriage, and the door was shut.
target_text: hèia lasi ka hèli èi mènyi. te ngaa ropa rèngu lasi, broit dhu d'ai le. ka dhèu bhèni dhu d'èlu-mèu se, lasi ka asa d'ara pesta, palere-lere dènge broit dènge tamu aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa rèngu aa'i-aa'i d'ai d'ara, ka ra bèdho èmu.

source_text: afterward came also the other virgins, saying, lord, lord, open to us.
target_text: hèia dhèu bhèni dhèu lèmi dhu goa se, lèpa mai. ka ra paroa peka na, ‘ama! ama! conge ku èmu hia ji'i la! '

source_text: but he answered and said, verily i say to you, i know you not.
target_text: te ngaa ama ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘wee, bisa boe, te miu se cee, ja'a tadhe boe! '

source_text: watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour in which the son of man cometh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra taruu, te miu me'a boe kahèi, lod'o do hake pèri ja'a lèpa hari mai.

source_text: for the kingdom of heaven is as a man traveling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered to them his goods.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, ropa ja'a tèke eele miu, na, miu hud'i sab'a paie-iie hia ja'a, nuka sèmi lii pakasame ne: abhu lamatua ca dhèu neo pakèd'i la'e asa rai kaj'èu. ropa na pa'èra neo la'e, hèia na paroa nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ka na paredha si, aku nèngu na, ‘miu pake doi ne, tao mi poko. ladhe ja'a lèpa mai, miu pad'elo dènge ja'a, miu abhu leto ca ngaa. '

source_text: and to one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and forthwith took his journey.
target_text: ka na pabagi doi hualaa mi dhèu sab'a ka èci, lèmi saku, sèna ka pab'unge ne. dhèu sab'a ka dua abhu doi dua saku, aa ka tèlu abhu doi ca saku, madhutu a'èra rèngu èci-èci ra. ka lamatua ne pakèd'i la'e ka.

source_text: then he that had received the five talents, went and traded with the same, and gained other five talents.
target_text: ropa sèmi rare doi ne, hèia dhèu sab'a ka èci la'e dènge d'aga. nèbhu boe, na abhu leto doi lèmi saku hari.

source_text: and likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu sab'a ka dua. na abhu leto, doi dua saku hari.

source_text: but he that had received one, went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ka tèlu dhu abhu doi ca saku deo na, la'e kèi ro'a ka na padhènu doi lamatua na asa d'ara.

source_text: after a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
target_text: nèbhu ae ku, heka lamatua rèngu lèpa. hèia na paroa dhèu sab'a na sèra, ho parisa doi na, dhu na hia si uri.

source_text: and he that had received five talents, came and brought other five talents, saying, lord, thou deliveredst to me five talents: behold, i have gained besides them five talents more.
target_text: dhèu sab'a ka èci, la'e ka saraka doi canguru saku, ka na peka, ‘ama! doi ama ka ne'e. ca hari ni, ama hia ja'a doi lèmi saku. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a abhu leto lèmi saku kahèi. '

source_text: his lord said to him, well done thou good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, i will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
target_text: ropa lamatua na tadèngi, hèia na karej'e. ka na peka, na, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu be'a. èu ne maj'èni, aa d'èi madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a, masi ka ja'a aad'o. lula èu ne bisa uri dhu ciki sèmi ne'e, de èèna na ja'a ded'e èu sèna ka uri j'ara dhu kapai aae hari. pe ja'a tao pesta, sèna ka ta'a-tinu sama-sama. '

source_text: he also that had received two talents came, and said, lord, thou deliveredst to me two talents: behold, i have gained two other talents besides them.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu sab'a ka dua, la'e saraka mi lamatua na, doi èpa saku, ka na peka na, ‘ama! ca hari ni, ama hia ja'a doi dua saku. te ngaa ladhe ku la, ja'a abhu leto dua saku kahèi. '

source_text: his lord said to him, well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, i will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
target_text: ka lamatua ne karej'e kahèi, ka na peka na, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu be'a kahèi. èu ca dhèu dhu maj'èni, aa madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a, masi ka ja'a aad'o. lula èu bisa uri dhu ciki sèmi ne'e ne, de èèna na ja'a ded'e èu ho uri dhu kapai hari. pe ja'a tao pesta, sèna ka ta'a-tinu sama-sama. '

source_text: then he who had received the one talent came, and said, lord, i knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strewed:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu sab'a ka tèlu, la'e peka dènge lamatua na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! ja'a ke'a na, ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara adhu. te ama more ngaa dhu dhèu leo tao, aa puu more ngaa dhu dhèu leo sèle.

source_text: and i was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast what is thine.
target_text: ka ja'a madha'u, mage doi se ele, hèia ama huku ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a huni paie-iie ne. ka se'e, ama! de more hari ka, te doi ama se, kura boe ca ana ma sa! '

source_text: his lord answered and said to him, thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that i reap where i have not sown, and gather where i have not strewed:
target_text: ropa lamatua ne tadèngi nare, hèia na jèke dhèu sab'a ne, aku nèngu na, ‘wee, èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu bhelu aa bai-eed'a! èu dhu me'a, na, ja'a kore ngaa dhu dhèu leo tao, aa puu kore ngaa dhu dhèu leo sèle,

source_text: thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming i should have received my own with interest.
target_text: nga tao ka èu lamu boe tèke doi ne mi bank? sèna ka ropa ja'a lèpa, ja'a kore bunga na, masi ka ciki oo'e, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! '

source_text: take therefore the talent from him, and give it to him who hath ten talents.
target_text: ka lamatua ne pua dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, ‘mere doi nèti nèngu ne, ho hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu abhu leto lèmi saku èèna.

source_text: for to every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
target_text: te dhèu dhu uri paie-iie ngaa dhu ètu adhe-aai na, èèna na, na abhu ae hari. te ngaa dhèu dhu ro'o boe uri ngaa dhu ètu d'ara adhe-aai na, èèna na rare aa'i nèti nèngu.

source_text: and cast ye the unprofitable servant into utter darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: kèpe mere dhèu sab'a dhu guna boe ne. nuni pa'oro ne, pèci asa li'u nèi. soro tèke ne, sèna ka na tangi, aa dui nare j'aj'èra ètu era maroga aatu-aatu nèi! '

source_text: when the son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then will he sit upon the throne of his glory:
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a puru mai dènge dadedha nèti ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga. èle na ja'a madhèdi ètu kadera paredha dhu dedha risi, sèna ka parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and before him shall be gathered all nations: and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri rèdhi ètu rai-haha, mai asa madha ja'a. pe ja'a hag'e si, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha pacèri kahib'i-kalèbho nèti kahib'i-ka'ia, sèna ka j'aj'i mi dua kaboko.

source_text: and he will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, ja'a hia si re g'ana ja'a. te ngaa dhu leo sèra, ja'a hia si re kariu ja'a.

source_text: then will the king say to them on his right hand, come, ye blessed of my father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a kèd'u paredha nuka sèmi dhèu aae. èèna na dhèu-dhèu ètu g'ana ja'a, ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘miu se'e se, ka dhu abhu mèngi-nale nèti ama ku. mai lati asa d'ara èmu na, dhu na tao tèke hia miu, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: for i was hungry, and ye gave me food: i was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: i was a stranger, and ye took me in:
target_text: ja'a nèru miu, lula uru èèna lod'o ja'a manganga, miu ka dhu panga'a ja'a. aa lod'o ja'a koko kamango, miu ka hia ja'a kinu. ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa miu hia ja'a manubha ètu d'ara èmu miu.

source_text: naked, and ye clothed me: i was sick, and ye visited me: i was in prison, and ye came to me.
target_text: ja'a dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa miu ka dhu papake ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa miu ka dhu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho, aa miu ka dhu mai pa'asu-pareo dènge ja'a. '

source_text: then will the righteous answer him, saying, lord, when saw we thee hungry, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
target_text: ropa dhèu-dhèu ètu sebhe g'ana ja'a se tadèngi lii ja'a ne, ra dhaa peka na, ‘lamatua, ne'e ne tasamia kèna? lamatua peka na, lamatua manganga, ka ji'i panga'a. lamatua koko kamango, ka ji'i hia minu.

source_text: when saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
target_text: lamatua sèmi dhèu leo kara, ka ji'i hia manubha ètu d'ara èmu ji'i. lamatua dènge boe mèdha-papake, ka ji'i papake lamatua.

source_text: or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came to thee?
target_text: lamatua pèd'a, ka ji'i lalau-lalo'o lamatua, lamatua ètu d'ara bèdho, ka ji'i dhiu pa'asu-pareo. te ngaa j'ara se'e se, lod'o mia ka dhu ji'i tao mi lamatua? '

source_text: and the king will answer and say to them, verily i say to you, inasmuch as ye have done it to one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it to me.
target_text: pe ja'a dhaa si, peka na, ‘parcaya la ja'a! te lod'o miu tao j'ara se'e se mi dhèu unu ja'a, masi ka tao mi dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, sèra sa miu tao le mi dedha ja'a kahèi! '

source_text: then will he say also to them on the left hand, depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
target_text: èle èèna, dhèu-dhèu dhu ètu sebhe kariu ja'a, ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘hee, dhèu bhelu-katub'a! ama lamatua dhu dhoo le miu. pakaj'èu nèti ne'e ne! pe ja'a paredha dhèu mai kèpe miu, sèna ka pèci asa d'ara ai naraka dhu heo robhe-robhe. te ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le era j'aj'èra ne, hia mi nidhu dènge dhèu aae ra.

source_text: for i was hungry, and ye gave me no food: i was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
target_text: ja'a babège eele miu, lula lod'o ja'a manganga, miu hia boe ja'a ku'a. aa lod'o ja'a koko kamango, miu hia boe ja'a kinu.

source_text: i was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
target_text: ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa miu soru boe ja'a asa d'ara èmu mi. ja'a dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa miu papake boe ja'a. lod'o ja'a pèd'a-tarègu, miu lalau-lalo'o boe ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho, te ngaa miu pa'asu-pareo boe ja'a sa kahèi. '

source_text: then will they also answer him, saying, lord, when saw we thee hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister to thee?
target_text: ropa dhèu bhelu-katub'a se tadèngi lii ja'a sèmi èèna, hèia ra b'ala, peka na, ‘lamatua ne tasamia kèna? lamatua peka na, lamatua manganga, te ngaa ji'i hia boe mu'a. lamatua koko kamango, te ngaa ji'i hia boe minu. lamatua nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe hia manubha ètu d'ara èmu ji'i. lamatua dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa ji'i papake boe. lamatua ètu d'ara papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa ji'i lalau-lalo'o boe. lamatua ètu d'ara bèdho, te ngaa ji'i pa'asu-pareo boe. te ngaa j'ara se'e se, ji'i tao mi lamatua lod'o mia? '

source_text: then will he answer them, saying, verily i say to you, inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
target_text: pe ja'a dhaa mi rèngu, peka na, ‘parcaya la ja'a! te lod'o miu soru-bara boe dhèu-dhèu dhu haha ae d'ai seli, èci èèna ka dènge miu soru-bara boe ja'a. '

source_text: and these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
target_text: ka dhèu bhelu-katub'a abhu j'aj'èra, toke d'ai mia-mia. te ngaa dhèu-dhèu dhu d'ara mola, abhu mamuri taa-taa, toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and it came to pass, when jesus had finished all these sayings, he said to his disciples,
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, hèia na lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: ye know that after two days is the passover, and the son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
target_text: miu me'a le, na, di dua lod'o ka d'ai lod'o babe'a èdhi, nuka pesta paska. lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èle èèna, ra paku pamadhe ja'a ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then assembled the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, in the palace of the high priest, who was called caiaphas,
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, dhu pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu kayafas. kayafas ne, nuka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: and consulted that they might take jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
target_text: rèngu se tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus pahuni-pahuni, sèna ka pamadhe ne.

source_text: but they said, not on the feast -day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu rare lii èci, peka na, mata ku! mage èdhi kèpe ne ètu d'ara lai-lai ne, lula lod'o-lod'o be'a dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae dhu d'èi nèngu, tao maruru.

source_text: now when jesus was in bethany, in the house of simon the leper,
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu dhu lèke èi papèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. lod'o dhu d'ai mèka lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi, yesus si ra'a ètu d'ara èmu simon.

source_text: there came to him a woman having an alabaster-box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head as he sat at table.
target_text: ropa rèngu ra'a era, bhèni ca dhèu mai paraga dènge yesus. nèngu nèd'u boto cue dhu tao nèti hadhu dhu kab'ua. boto ne dhu isi na, èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua titu kèna. ka bhèni ne hake pamae katanga boto ne. hèia na pahae mau-mau èi hèu mèngi ne mi kètu yesus, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: but when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, to what purpose is this waste?
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi tatao bhèni ne, hèia ra nasa. ka ra paka'uu, aku rèngu na, heh! bhèni ne bhori eele iia d'ara, èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua aae ne. baku na tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: for this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
target_text: be'a risi nèngu pahie! sèna ka kab'ua na bagi mi dhèu-dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: when jesus understood it, he said to them, why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu, hèia na lii peka na, miu se baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e, lula na pahae le èi hèu mèngi ne mi ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: for ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
target_text: te dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa pa'èci taruu dènge miu. te ngaa ja'a ne mamuri nèbhu heka dènge miu.

source_text: for in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
target_text: aa bhèni dhu pahae èi hèu mèngi mi ngi'u ja'a ne, sèmi ngaa te, nèngu pahèu mèngi mema le ngi'u aae ja'a. te mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka.

source_text: verily i say to you, wherever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, which this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! sad'i ètu mia èèna ka, ladhe dhèu palolo lii lolo be'a ama lamatua palème rai-haha ne, tatu rèngu papeka kahèi babe'a bhèni ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e ne.

source_text: then one of the twelve, called judas iscariot, went to the chief priests,
target_text: ca dhèu nèti canguru dua ana madhutu yesus se, dhu ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o èèna kahèi, kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra, sèna ka neo pahie yesus mi rèngu.

source_text: and said, what will ye give me, and i will deliver him to you? and they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
target_text: ropa yudas d'ai dhèu se'e, hèia na karèi, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe ja'a bhoke j'ara ho miu bisa kèpe yesus, miu hia ja'a ngaa? hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie ne dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae. ka ra ige rare tèlu nguru doi iia, aa ra j'ole asa yudas.

source_text: and from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
target_text: èle, ka yudas li'u ka la'e, hèia na tenge j'ara ho saraka yesus asa d'ara adhe-aai rèngu.

source_text: now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread, the disciples came to jesus, saying to him, where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
target_text: d'ara tèu mai-tèu mai, abhu lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi dhu nanèbhu na pidhu lod'o. ra pangare lod'o babe'a se, na, ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. ropa pesta èèna neo mulai, ana madhutu yesus se mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! mèda ne'e, èdhi bhoke lod'o babe'a èdhi. de ama neo sèna ka ji'i la'a roro kahib'i-kalèbho, aa lalau era pesta paska ètu mia?

source_text: and he said, go into the city to such a man, and say to him, the master saith, my time is at hand; i will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, lami asa d'ara kota, pe mi paraga dènge ama ca dhèu. miu peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e, ‘ama! ama mese rasa lod'o mamadhe na nèbhu heka. hèia na manèngi era èci ètu d'ara èmu ama, sèna ka na tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. '

source_text: and the disciples did as jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ana-ana madhutu na, tao sèmi dhu na peka. ka ra lalau nganga'a kalela paska ètu era èèna.

source_text: now when the evening was come, he sat down with the twelve.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda, hèia yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, madhèdi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and as they were eating, he said, verily i say to you, that one of you will betray me.
target_text: ropa dhu ra'a era, hèia na lii, peka na, mi nanene! ca dhèu nèti miu se, èèna na pahie ja'a asa adhe-aai dhèu leo kara.

source_text: and they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say to him, lord, is it i?
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, d'ara rèngu roe-bhilu. ka rèngu èci-èci karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: and he answered and said, he that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same will betray me.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti na palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahie ja'a.

source_text: the son of man goeth, as it is written concerning him: but woe to that man by whom the son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man, if he had not been born.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa mate unu na! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, bèli-camèd'a pasae nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: then judas, who betrayed him, answered and said, master, is it i? he said to him, thou hast said.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yudas karèi kahèi, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma? hèia yesus b'ala ne, mema tare'a èu unu mu ka dhu peka lii èèna. de cee hari?

source_text: and as they were eating, jesus took bread, and blessed it, and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, take, eat; this is my body.
target_text: rèngu dhu ra'a era, hèia yesus ded'e nare roti cue, aa na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a. mere ho mi'e ka!

source_text: and he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, drink ye all of it;
target_text: èle ka, yesus nare galaa dhu pènu dènge èi anggor, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. hèia na j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na lii, peka na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, mere ho minu.

source_text: for this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sin.
target_text: te èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna. èèna na ja'a madhe, te ngaa raa ja'a suti, sèna ka sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. raa ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e dhèu, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua pajaji èèna, mema limuri ne j'aj'i le. de mere ho minu ka!

source_text: but i say to you, i will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when i drink it new with you in my father's kingdom.
target_text: te ngaa nanene paie-iie! mulai nèti mèda ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. pe ja'a dènge ama ku madhèdi ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka ja'a kinu hari kèna dènge miu.

source_text: and when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the mount of olives.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia rèngu sod'a lii sod'a èci, ho koa-kio ama lamatua. ka mèda èèna kahèi, rèngu lasi dènge ka asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: then saith jesus to them, all ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, i will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
target_text: ropa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, ciki hari ètu d'ara mèda ne'e kahèi, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na, ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala. '

source_text: but after i am risen again, i will go before you into galilee.
target_text: ja'a madhe tare'a, te ngaa ladhe ja'a mamuri hari, laku mate miu ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: peter answered and said to him, though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will i never be offended.
target_text: te ngaa petrus d'èi boe nanene lii na, ka na peka, ama! masi ka dhèu leo rai tèke eele ama, te ngaa ja'a rai boe!

source_text: jesus said to him, verily i say to thee, that this night, before the cock shall crow, thou wilt deny me thrice.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala aku nèngu na, petrus! sèmi èèna, do? lèka la lii ja'a ne! ètu d'ara mèda ne'e ne kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu dhu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: peter said to him, though i should die with thee, yet will i not deny thee. likewise also said all the disciples.
target_text: te ngaa petrus no'o boe sèmi. ka na peka, aad'o, ama! ladhe ama madhe, ja'a madhe kahèi. te ja'a rai boe, tèke eele ama! angalai petrus se, peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: then cometh jesus with them to a place called gethsemane, and saith to the disciples, sit ye here, while i go yonder and pray.
target_text: ka yesus si kako taruu asa ledhe saitun, d'ai d'ara oka cue, ngara na getsemani. ètu era ne'e yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, miu madhèdi uuru ku mi ne'e, te ja'a neo laku manèngi-mangaj'i asa nèi.

source_text: and he took with him peter, and the two sons of zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
target_text: te ngaa na paroa nare petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis, ho lasi palere-lere dènge ne. mulai nèti èèna ka, d'ara na ma'ète laho mae-mae, aa roe-bhilu.

source_text: then saith he to them, my soul is exceeding sorrowful, even to death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
target_text: rèngu kako kaj'èu mèka, te na peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, d'ara ja'a susa titu kèna! ja'a nuka sèmi oe madhe sa. miu madhèdi, mate ja'a mi ne'e.

source_text: and he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, o my father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless, not as i will, but as thou wilt.
target_text: ka la'e ako kaj'èu ciki, hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ho sabaj'a, aku nèngu na, ama pasue! ladhe ama d'èi na, ja'a baku pasae j'aj'èra ne'e. te ngaa baku madhutu dad'èi ja'a, hud'i laa madhutu dad'èi ama di.

source_text: and he cometh to the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith to peter, what, could ye not watch with me one hour?
target_text: sabaj'a nare, hèia lèpa la'e asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra. te ngaa rèngu dhu bhèj'i luu. ka yesus parèi si, hèia na lii dènge petrus, peka na, hee, petrus! nga tao ka miu se bhèj'i? ja'a ètu nèi nèbhu boe, te ngaa miu lake mere boe beke ciki sa mate ja'a!

source_text: watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
target_text: ruri pamako musi madha miu. kèd'i ho beke dènge ja'a. te d'ara miu mema d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa ngi'u miu èra boe. de hua iia miu sabaj'a, sèna ka ladhe lèke dadugu-rariu miu bisa taha.

source_text: he went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, o my father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except i drink it, thy will be done.
target_text: ka yesus la'e hari sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ladhe ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra ne'e, hud'i laa madhutu dad'èi ama di.

source_text: and he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
target_text: sabaj'a nare, hèia na mai hari asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu se. te ngaa dhu ra bhèj'i hari, lula musi madha ra sakaa titu kèna.

source_text: and he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
target_text: ka na tèke eele si, la'e hari manèngi-mangaj'i catèka. na manèngi-mangaj'i hari mi ama, sèna ka baku soro tèke nèngu pasae j'aj'èra èèna, te ngaa hud'i laa madhutu dhoka dad'èi ama di.

source_text: then he cometh to his disciples, and saith to them, sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
target_text: sabaj'a nare ka, na lèpa hari, la'e parèi ana madhutu na, peka na, miu se bhèj'i taruu, do? kèd'i ka! te dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, dètu le. dhèu se mai ho kèpe ja'a kèna, ho saraka asa adhe-aai dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
target_text: wee, kèd'i ka! bhoke musi madha miu, ladhe ku asa nèi. te dhèu dhu pahie ja'a, nuka mai nèi.

source_text: and while he was yet speaking, lo, judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staffs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, yudas dhu nare le era èèna dènge dhèu ae-ae. dhèu se mai rèti hela dènge aj'u cèki ho neo kèpe ne. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, lula madhutu paredha nèti kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: now he that betrayed him, gave them a sign, saying, whomsoever i shall kiss, that same is he; hold him fast.
target_text: yudas dhu peka mema le mi dhèu se'e, na, miu ladhe paie-iie! dhèu dhu ja'a uu, nèngu ka dhu miu kèpe! te nèngu ka dhu miu tenge!

source_text: and forthwith he came to jesus, and said, hail master; and kissed him.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai madha yesus, hèia yudas lii dènge ka, saloom, ama mese! hèia yudas uu yesus.

source_text: and jesus said to him, friend, why art thou come? then they came, and laid hands on jesus, and took him.
target_text: èle ka, yesus peka dènge ne, hee, yudas! tao ka laa, madhutu dad'èi èu. ka dhèu ae sèra ara lasi neo kèpe ne.

source_text: and behold, one of them, who were with jesus, stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest, and smote off his ear.
target_text: te ngaa dhu re'a boe, na, dhèu unu yesus ca dhèu dhu bete hela na, ka seru pama'ète rèu dhilu dhèu èci. dhèu dhu nu'a ne, nuka ca dhèu ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: then said jesus to him, put up again thy sword into its place: for all they that take the sword, shall perish by the sword.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pasaluu hela èu èèna asa d'ara sope na. te dhèu dhu pake rèka ho neo uri pamere lii langu, èèna na nèngu madhe dènge rèka kahèi.

source_text: thinkest thou that i cannot now pray to my father, and he will presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
target_text: èu me'a boe, do? ja'a bisa manèngi ama ku, ho na hia ana pajuu na d'ai nguru riho mai nèti sorga, sèna ka soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: but how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa, ra kèpe ja'a. te aa'i-aa'i dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua lula-nèti ja'a ne, hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: in that same hour said jesus to the multitudes, are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staffs to take me? i sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu mai kèpe ne, aku nèngu na, madhutu miu, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, do? nga tao ka miu mai kèpe ja'a ne, mèti dènge hela dènge aj'u cèki? bèli-bèli ja'a aj'a miu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu èci sa tao boe ngaa-ngaa mi ja'a.

source_text: but all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa! mai ka, kèpe ja'a! te j'ara ne'e ne, dhu suri tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. ropa ana madhutu yesus rèdhi sèmi èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia ra rai tèke eele ne mesa-mesa.

source_text: and they that had laid hold on jesus, led him away to caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu dhu kèpe yesus, rèti ne asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi dhu ngara na, kayafas, lula dhèu kapai sèra dhu pakaboko le ètu era èèna. dhèu se nuka, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, aa dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: but peter followed him at a distance, to the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants to see the end.
target_text: ropa ra rèti yesus, petrus madhutu nèti limuri, toke d'ai èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi èèna. petrus la'e kahèi asa madha èmu, ho madhèdi dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu ètu sèra. te neo ne'a, ngaa ka dhu j'aj'i.

source_text: now the chief priests and elders, and all the council, sought false testimony against jesus, to put him to death;
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu ne, kètu agama yahudi sèra dhu padhue-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi uri lii langu agama. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra tenge j'ara, sèna ka pamanahu yesus, lula ra neo huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: but found none: and, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. at the last came two false witnesses,
target_text: masi ka rèngu hia sakasii monya ae kahèi, te ngaa rèngu abhu boe sasala èci sa dhu rèngu bisa pake. nèbhu boe ka, rèngu abhu sakasii dhèu dua.

source_text: and said, this man said, i am able to destroy the temple of god, and to build it in three days.
target_text: dhèu dua se, peka na, ji'i tadèngi le kahèi, dhèu ne peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, ja'a patitu kore hari. '

source_text: and the high priest arose, and said to him, answerest thou nothing, what is it which these testify against thee?
target_text: ka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu era èèna. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu tadèngi le lii galaa dhèu se'e dhu ra galaa èu. nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ca hèb'a sa?

source_text: but jesus held his peace. and the high priest answered and said to him, i adjure thee by the living god, that thou tell us whether thou art the christ the son of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa boe ngaa-ngaa. hèia kètu kapai ne karèi hari, na, ja'a neo karèi! te ngaa èu hud'i dhaa tare'a-re'a ku, nuka sèmi èu dhaa mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri ètu sorga. abhu dhèu dhu peka na, èu ne, kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu na moa tèke karèi nèti uru ka. tare'a sèmi èèna, do?

source_text: jesus saith to him, thou hast said: nevertheless i say to you, hereafter shall ye see the son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, tare'a, nuka sèmi lii ama èèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a miu mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. pe ja'a madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua ètu sorga, sèna ka kèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ne, dhu koasa na kapai risi eele èèna. èle na, ja'a puru mai hari ètu dedha ra'i-liru.

source_text: then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, he hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare yesus peka sèmi èèna, hèia kètu kapai ne nasa bia, toke na ciu pamae kodho madhera na. hèia na pa'oo mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi parluu sakasii tao ngaa hari era! miu unu mi tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu miu, lii padhai na. nèngu tao iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. ne'e ne pahaha ama lamatua! miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le, na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua, na, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku!

source_text: what think ye? they answered and said, he is guilty of death.
target_text: de miu neo pama'ète sèmi mia hari? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra parodha, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne mema sala tare'a! de hud'i huku pamadhe ne!

source_text: then they spit in his face, and buffetted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
target_text: ka dhèu pèri-pèri lasi sabhuu ilu mi yesus. hèia ra hake-paru, aa tèb'e pa'oke ne.

source_text: saying, prophesy to us, thou christ, who is he that smote thee?
target_text: èle ka, ra lalangu ne, peka na, wee! èu ne'e ka kristus, si? èu peka sèku! dhèu cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu?

source_text: now peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came to him, saying, thou also wast with jesus of galilee.
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus madhèdi era ètu madha èmu. ka ènu bhèni ca dhèu mai lii dènge ne, peka na, deo na, èu kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna, si?

source_text: but he denied before them all, saying, i know not what thou sayest.
target_text: te ngaa na pasili ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, peka na, aad'o! nga tao ka èu karèi sèmi èèna! ja'a tadhe boe ne.

source_text: and when he had gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said to them that were there, this man was also with jesus of nazareth.
target_text: ka petrus kalua la'e titu ètu hèb'a oka. hèia bhèni leo hari èci ladhe nèdhi ne ètu èèna. ka bhèni ne peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a kèdhi dhèu ne'e ne palere-lere dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna.

source_text: and again he denied with an oath, i do not know the man.
target_text: hèia petrus jèke ne, peka na, èu ne tao-tao huj'u! ja'a bani subha! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu nèi!

source_text: and after a while came to him they that stood by, and said to peter, surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech betrayeth thee.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka dhèu leo ètu sèra sa peka dènge ne, hee! èu ne baku kapod'e-kabèli d'ara lii, dhu peka na, èu kako palere boe dènge dhèu ne! te nèti lii padhai èu, èci èèna ka dènge laloe lii dhèu galilea!

source_text: then began he to curse and to swear, saying, i know not the man. and immediately the cock crowed.
target_text: te ngaa na padhèd'a, ka b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e ne! ropa na peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: and peter remembered the word of jesus, who said to him, before the cock shall crow, thou wilt deny me thrice. and he went out, and wept bitterly.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi lii kokotoo manu, hèia petrus ngee nèdhi lii yesus, dhu peka na, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu dhu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a. sanèd'e nare lii ne'e, hèia la'e asa li'u ka tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: when the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against jesus to put him to death.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uri lii langu agama sèra, rare lii èci sèna ka neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: and when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to pontius pilate the governor.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra èki ne rèti asa madha gubernur pilatus. te rèngu d'èi sèna ka gubernur huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: then judas, who had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
target_text: ropa yudas tadèngi na, yesus abhu hahuku madhe, hèia na manyasa, lula nèngu ka dhu pahie yesus. ka la'e hari asa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, ho neo hia hari la'a doi iia tèlu nguru bua sèra.

source_text: saying, i have sinned in that i have betrayed innocent blood. and they said, what is that to us? see thou to that.
target_text: na peka na, ja'a tao le sasala-sasigo, lula ja'a pahie le dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. te ngaa dhèu se b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! ji'i se pusi-pahae heka èu ne! èu mesa mu ka dhu d'ui more sasala èèna.

source_text: and he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
target_text: ka yudas ceb'e eele doi sèra asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia la'e kadhoe iisi na, toke na madhe aapa.

source_text: and the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, it is not lawful to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra kaboko rare doi dhu na ceb'e eele sèra. ra padhue, aku rèngu na, doi se'e mage èdhi tao asa d'ara boaraka doi, lula doi se doi kaj'alu.

source_text: and they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
target_text: de be'a risi èdhi hèli tare rai ca kasib'i nèti dhèu tao èru rai sèi. ladhe dhèu mai nèti rai leo, do, dhèu dhu èdhi tadhe boe madhe, èdhi padhane si ètu era ne'e ne.

source_text: wherefore that field has been called, the field of blood, to this day.
target_text: ka ra hèli rai ne, kab'ua na nèti doi deo sa. nèti èèna ka, rai ne, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu pangare na, ‘rai raa'.

source_text: then was fulfilled that which was spoken by jeremiah the prophet, saying, and they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of israel did value;
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu madhutu lii nèti ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yermia, dhu suri tèke na, rèngu pake doi iia tèlu nguru bua ho hèli rai. rèngu pake doi se, lula doi se kab'ua nèti hèli dhèu, madhutu sèmi dhu dhèu isra'el pama'ète rare le.

source_text: and gave them for the potter's field, as the lord appointed me.
target_text: rai ne, rèngu hèli nèti dhèu tao èru rai, madhutu lii paredha dhu ama lamatua hia mi ja'a.

source_text: and jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, art thou the king of the jews? and jesus said to him, thou sayest.
target_text: ropa dhèu se rèti yesus d'ai gubernur, hèia na karèi yesus, tasamia? èu ne, tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do? na dhaa, peka na, tare'a. ama peka lèke kèna.

source_text: and when he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
target_text: te ngaa ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra galaa ne dènge lii langu ae-ae, na dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa hèi.

source_text: then saith pilate to him, hearest thou not how many things they testify against thee?
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari ne, peka na, èu tadèngi boe lii padhai lii rèngu, do? dhèu se hia sasala ae-ae mi dedha èu. te ngaa tasamia ka èu b'ala boe si hèi? !

source_text: and he answered him to not a word; so that the governor marveled greatly.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa hèi, toke gubernur malaa.

source_text: now at that feast, the governor was wont to release to the people a prisoner, whom they would.
target_text: tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai ka lod'o kalela paska, dhèu yahudi hag'e rare ana bèdho ca dhèu, sèna ka gubernur patabuli ne.

source_text: and they had then a notable prisoner, called barabbas.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu bèdho ca dhèu, ngara na barabas. dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadhe le nèngu ne, lula nèngu ca dhèu bhelu-katub'a titu kèna.

source_text: therefore when they were assembled, pilate said to them, whom will ye that i release to you? barabbas, or jesus, who is called christ?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu ae lasi asa gubernur pilatus ho manèngi, sèna ka patabuli dhèu bèdho èci, sèmi biasa. hèia pilatus karèi si, aku nèngu na, be'a. de ja'a patabuli cee? ètu ne'e barabas, aa abhu kahèi yesus, dhu dhèu paroa ne, kristus. mia ka dhu ja'a patabuli? miu ka dhu pama'ète.

source_text: for he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
target_text: gubernur peka sèmi èèna, te ne'a na kètu agama yahudi rèti yesus asa nèngu, lula rèngu se tèka d'ara dènge yesus.

source_text: when he was sitting on the judgment-seat, his wife sent to him, saying, have thou nothing to do with that just man: for i have suffered many things this day in a dream, because of him.
target_text: gubernur ètu d'ara uri lii langu ne era, dhèu èmu na moa lii, peka na, ama! mage-mage, oo! te yesus ne dhu dènge boe sasala. lula nèngu ne'e ka, mèda deo na, ja'a nii aapa. toke d'ai sange ne'e, d'ara ja'a dhae tèka mèka.

source_text: but the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask barabbas, and destroy jesus.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, dadugu dhèu ae ètu èèna, ho ra manèngi gubernur patabuli barabas, aa huku pamadhe yesus.

source_text: the governor answered and said to them, which of the two will ye that i release to you? they said, barabbas.
target_text: ka na karèi hari si, aku nèngu na, nèti dhèu dua se, mia ka dhu ja'a patabuli? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra dhaa, peka na, barabas! patabuli barabas di!

source_text: pilate saith to them, what shall i do then with jesus, who is called christ? they all say to him, let him be crucified.
target_text: èle ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tao tasa mera mia mi yesus, dhu ra peka na kristus ne? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha peka na, paku pamadhe ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: and the governor said, why, what evil hath he done? but they cried out the more, saying, let him be crucified.
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur karèi hari, peka na, te sala na, ngaa? ja'a parisa le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa! te ngaa ra asa pa'oo-parodha, aku rèngu na, pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: when pilate saw that he could not prevail at all, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, i am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
target_text: nèbhu boe, na ne'a heka tao tasamia hari, lula dhèu se'e asa ka ra hino neo patao. nèti èèna ka, nare èi ho j'amo ai ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, aa na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ja'a tago boe mamadhe dhèu ne'e ne! miu aa'i-aa'i mi ka dhu hud'i pasae mere mamadhe na!

source_text: then answered all the people, and said, his blood be on us, and on our children.
target_text: hèia dhèu se'e dhaa dènge lii pa'oo-parodha peka na, oo, hud'i laa! hud'i laa ji'i dènge ana-èpu ji'i tago ngare raa na!

source_text: then he released barabbas to them: and when he had scourged jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia na peka, la'a, sina ma. hèia na patabuli barabas madhutu dad'èi ra. èle èèna ka, na pua dhèu j'aga, lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui. game rare, ka sordad'u rèti yesus, sèna ka neo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then the soldiers of the governor took jesus into the common hall, and gathered to him the whole band of soldiers.
target_text: èle èèna ka, sordad'u ère rèti yesus asa tana lapa ètu d'ara benteng rèngu. d'ai nèi, rèngu paroa rare angalai ra ca batalion.

source_text: and they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
target_text: hèia ra papake ne kodho madhera èci dhu mea aae.

source_text: and when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, hail, king of the jews?
target_text: ka rare loro aj'u padhudhu ra ènyu tao sèmi solo. hèia ra ènyi solo ne mi kètu yesus, ho ra sasei ne, tao nuka sèmi rèngu ded'e dhèu aae hiu, dhu pake solo dhèu aae. èle èèna ka, ra j'ole hia ne aj'u ca'èta asa ai g'ana na, nuka sèmi tatea paredha. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ra, patangara dènge yesus, aa ra pamakae ne, peka na, pakab'ua dhèu aae dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and they spit upon him, and took the reed, and struck him on the head.
target_text: hèia ra sabhuu ne ilu, aa rare aj'u ca'èta dhu na kèpe deo na, ka ra d'eu kètu na.

source_text: and after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
target_text: ropa ra sasei rare ne, hèia ra bhoke eele kodho madhera. èle èèna ka, ra papake hari mèdha-papake na. ka rèti ne asa li'u kota yerusalem, ho neo paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: and as they came out, they found a man of cyrene, simon by name: him they constrained to bear his cross.
target_text: ropa ra ère rèti yesus, d'ai talora j'ara paraga dènge dhèu kota kirene èci dhu neo la'e asa d'ara kota. ngara na, simon. dhèu se laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha gati yesus.

source_text: and when they had come to a place called golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
target_text: ka ra d'ai era èci, ngara na golgota. ètu d'ara lii aram, sasoa na, era rui kètu.

source_text: they gave him vinegar to drink, mingled with gall: and when he had tasted of it, he would not drink.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu se'e hia yesus ninu èi anggor dhu pab'ali rare le dènge èi na'i dhu pèd'u, sèna ka bisa taha rarii. ka yesus camuci, hèia juku eele.

source_text: and they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, they parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture they cast lots.
