source_text: and immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
target_text: èle èèna ka, herodes paredha komedhaa sordad'u lasi poro rare kètu yohanis nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and brought his head in a dish, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, ra tao asa d'ara dula èci, ka rèti la'a asa ana bhèni èèna. na sèmi nare, hèia nèti asa ina na la'e.

source_text: and when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis sèra tadèngi ra poro rèti le kètu yohanis, rèngu mai nedhe rèti ngi'u nèngu lasi padhane. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo mamadhe yohanis.

source_text: and the apostles assembled themselves to jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ana madhutu yesus dhu na pua lasi asa rae-rae ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua sèra, lèpa hari mai, ka ra pakaboko hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge yesus ngaa dhu rèngu tao dènge aj'a mi dhèu.

source_text: and he said to them, come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai patangi-tenge yesus. lula dhèu ae seli eele, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na abhu boe tebho ra'a-rinu hèi. nèti èèna ka, yesus ale dènge ana madhutu sèra, peka na, be'a risi èdhi pakèd'i nèti era ne'e lati tenge era èci dhu mau, sèna ka èdhi ae tara ciki.

source_text: and they departed into a desert place in a boat privately.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha cue lasi asa era dhu mau, kaj'èu nèti d'ara rae.

source_text: and the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran on foot thither out of all cities, and out went them, and came together to him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, ladhe rèdhi koha rèngu kako re sebhe dano. hèia ra kalua nèti rae ka kako pamèri madhutu re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, rèngu d'ai uuru yesus si.

source_text: and jesus, when he came out, saw many people, and was moved with compassion towards them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
target_text: ropa yesus puru nèti dedha koha, ladhe laa, na, dhèu ae dhu mate ne. dhèu se'e re'a heka tao iisi ra tasamia. nèti èèna ka, d'ara yesus sue si, te rèngu sama sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe ana madhenga. èle èèna ka, na aj'a si j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and when the day was now far spent, his disciples came to him, and said, this is a desert place, and now the time is far passed: send them away, that they may go into the country around, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
target_text: na aj'a nèti loo nètu, toke d'ai nihia la'e. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai padhue dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! hua iia ama ku pua si lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae dhu dètu ètu era se'e. te oe mèda kèna, aa ètu era ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: he answered and said to them, give ye them to eat. and they say to him, shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, baku tao sèmi èèna! hud'i laa, pe miu panga'a si. hèia ra karèi hari ne, ira, ee! ladhe èdhi panga'a dhèu ae sèmi ne'e, èdhi kalua doi ae bia, nga. sama sèmi gaji tuka ca tèu kateme, nga! aa èdhi tare doi sèra, nèti mia hua kèna!

source_text: he saith to them, how many loaves have ye? go and see. and when they knew, they say, five, and two fishes.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu lami karèi sèku dhèu sèra, teko cee dhu nèti nganga'a mèra. hèia ra lasi karèi, ka mai peka dènge ne, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di.

source_text: and he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ho madhèdi cakaboko-cakaboko ètu dedha j'u'u.

source_text: and they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
target_text: dhèu se'e madhèdi sèmi dhu yesus pua. abhu kaboko dhu dhèu cangasu-cangasu, aa abhu kaboko dhu dhèu lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru.

source_text: and when he had taken the five loaves, and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and broke the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes he divided among them all.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra, ka na ladhe asa dedha. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, nare roti lèmi bua, ka na ku'u pamae ca'èta-'èta. hèia na hia mi ana madhutu na, ho lasi papala hia dhèu dhu madhèdi sèra. na pala-bagi i'a dua ngi'u sèra kahèi.

source_text: and they all ate, and were satisfied.
target_text: ka dhèu sèra ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
target_text: ra'a èle, hèia ana madhutu na sèra lasi pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele sèra, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and they that ate of the loaves, were about five thousand men.
target_text: dhèu dhu ra'a sèra, dhèu mone di, lèmi riho dhèu, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and immediately he constrained his disciples to get into the boat, and to go to the other side before to bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua ana madhutu sèra pakèd'i uuru dènge koha asa rae betsaida ètu cabèka dano. te nèngu dhae la'e mèka, ho na pua dhèu ae sèra lèpa.

source_text: and when he had dismissed them, he departed to a mountain to pray.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra lèpa, na la'e asa ledhe èci ètu èèna, ho na manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and when evening was come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land. and he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary to them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh to them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them. but when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out. for they all saw him, and were troubled. and immediately he talked with them, and saith to them, be of good cheer: it is i; be not afraid.
target_text: lod'o mèda le, ka yesus puru mai. na ladhe nèdhi ana madhutu na sèra dènge koha lasi d'ai talora dano le. lula ngèlu madha mèdhu ae, ka ra tuku koha d'ai madhe. d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus heka la'e madhutu si kèna. te ngaa na kako re dedha èi. ropa na kako oe seli koha ra, ana madhutu sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia èci karèi èci, aku rèngu na, irii! ngaa nèi? nidhu, do? hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, we! miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne!

source_text: and he went up to them into the boat; and the wind ceased: and they were greatly amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
target_text: ropa yesus ca'e la'e asa dedha koha, kabèdhi laa, ngèlu mau dènge. ana madhutu na sèra malaa bia.

source_text: for they considered not the miracle of the loaves; for their heart was hardened.
target_text: rèngu heka rèdhi kèna, yesus pake koasa na, lod'o panga'a lèmi riho dhèu èèna. te ngaa rèngu re'a iia boe koasa yesus, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu.

source_text: and when they had passed over, they came into the land of gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ra panahu koha ètu dae genesaret.

source_text: and when they had come out of the boat forthwith they knew him,
target_text: ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si. ka ra rodhe lème, aku rèngu na, ee! yesus mai le!

source_text: and ran through that whole region around, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was. and whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch, if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him, were healed.
target_text: dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lasi peka palème rae, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia, jèru rèti a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a asa yesus. sad'i ra tadèngi yesus ètu era èci, na, rame-rame nedhe rèti dhèu pèd'a mai. ra paj'unu si ètu d'ara tana lapa ètu èèna. te ra pangee, na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a sèra goi lèke sebhe kodho yesus di, èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu goi lèke kodho na, hèia èle nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: then came together to him the pharisees, and certain of the scribes, who came from jerusalem.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu partei agama parisi canau dènge mese-mese agama mai nèti kota yerusalem neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled that is to say with unwashed hands, they found fault. for the pharisees, and all the jews, except they wash their hands often eat not, holding the tradition of the elders. and when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. and many other things there are, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, and of brazen vessels, and tables. then the pharisees and scribes asked him, why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashed hands?
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi. nuka sèmi, dhèu neo ra'a-rinu hud'i j'amo uuru ku kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe lèpa nèti d'ara pasa, hud'i diu uuru ku èi. toke mèdha dapu rèngu sèmi èru-pangala, pega, curu, galaa, cere, hud'i rase uuru ku madhutu atora ad'a, heka bisa pake ra'a-rinu kèna. ladhe dhèu yahudi cahag'e madhutu boe ad'a rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi nasa. nèti èèna ka, ra nasa ropa rèdhi ana madhutu yesus sèra ra'a-rinu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a rèngu. ka rèngu mai pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe kacui-aai? sèra sa, pasala dènge ad'a nèti bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: he answered and said to them, well hath isaiah prophesied concerning you hypocrites, as it is written, this people honoreth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me. but, in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se mema padhai lii leo, tao leo! nèti uru nèka mai yesaya suri tèke le, lii padhai lii ama lamatua sèmi ne'e, ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio kolongara ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa nèti boe d'ara. tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, lèke boe. rèngu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa rèngu madhutu dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. ' miu èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: for laying aside the commandment of god, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do. and he said to them, full well ye reject the commandment of god, that ye may keep your own tradition,
target_text: miu tèke eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho madhutu atora dhèu rai-haha. tatao miu ne, d'èlu-mèu bia!

source_text: for moses said, honor thy father and thy mother; and, whoever curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
target_text: karèi nèti uuru èèna, musa peka le lii paredha ama lamatua sèmi ne'e ka, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa tabha hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ana èci padhèda ama na, do ina na, hud'i ra huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but ye say, if a man shall say to his father or mother, it is corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free. and ye suffer him no more to do aught for his father or his mother;
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu èci pamoa le neo hia ngaa èci mi ama lamatua, masi ka ina dènge ama na j'èra oe madhe èèna ka, te ngaa pake boe mèdha èèna ho soru-bara si, lula nèngu moa le neo hia mi lamatua. '

source_text: making the word of god of no effect through your traditions, which ye have delivered: and many such like things ye do.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka le, miu pake heka dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa miu gati eele dènge atora miu dhu hiu. atora ae le dhu miu gati eele sèmi èèna.

source_text: and when he had called all the people to him, he said to them, hearken to me every one of you, and understand.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa hari dhèu leo ètu sèra, ka na peka na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie, sèna ka miu me'a.

source_text: there is nothing from without a man, that entering into him, can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara d'èlu, pakaj'alu boe. te ngaa dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: if any man hath ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene.

source_text: and when he had entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele dhèu sèra, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. ka ana madhutu sèra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: and he saith to them, are ye so void of understanding also? do ye not perceive, that whatever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him. because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all kinds of food.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu me'a boe kahèi? sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: ngaa dhu dhèu ra'a, èèna be'a. te ngaa dhu kalua mai, karehe. èèna be'a boe. ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara d'èlu, ho èèna na kalua hari asa li'u la'e. lii yesus èèna neo peka mi èdhi, nganga'a aa'i-aa'i, èci sa dhu luri boe.

source_text: and he said, that which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
target_text: ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu, nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
target_text: te j'ara bhelu-katub'a ae ka dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee karehe, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe nèngu, mana'u, pamadhe dhèu,

source_text: thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness;
target_text: gagoo-gagehu, bersina, bhelu-katub'a, leko-monya, dhèu dhu taha nare boe d'ara, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèngu, padhai lii pamanahu dhèu, padedha iisi, tatao dhu lèke boe, dènge kètu hadhu.

source_text: all these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
target_text: j'ara karehe aa'i-aa'i sèra mai nèti d'ara dhèu. sèra ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu. ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge dhèu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and from thence he arose, and went into the borders of tyre and sidon, and entered into a house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
target_text: èle ka, yesus tèke eele era èèna, ka la'e asa kota èci, ngara na tirus. d'ai nèi, lasi asa d'ara èmu èci, lula yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe pahuni ngi'u.

source_text: for a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet: the woman was a greek, a syrophenician by nation, and she besought him that he would cast forth the demon out of her daughter.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bhèni dintiu èci dhu nèti rai finisia ètu propensi siria. ropa na tadèngi yesus ètu èèna, na mai manèngi yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana bhèni na.

source_text: but jesus said to her, let the children first be satisfied: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to the dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii èci, peka na, ana-ana hud'i ra'a uuru ku, ho sisa na, ra core hia busa kèna. dènge lii pacele èèna, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu, heka dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and she answered and said to him, yes, lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crums.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni èèna b'ala, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a ama. te ngaa busa mate le ètu ro'a mei. nèngu abhu kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe nèti d'ara pega ana iiki sèra. madhutu bhèni èèna, lod'o ana ra'a, na, busa na'a kahèi. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i soru-bara dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and he said to her, for this saying, depart; the demon is gone out of thy daughter.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii dhaa bhèni ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, tare'a! lii padhai lii èu èèna, mola-mola na kèna! lèpa ka! te nidhu rai le nèti ana èu.

source_text: and when she had come to her house, she found the demon had gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne la'e ka. na d'ai èmu, ana na dhu bhèj'i luu. nidhu kalua le.

source_text: and again, departing from the borders of tyre and sidon, he came to the sea of galilee, through the midst of the borders of decapolis.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si pakèd'i nèti kota tirus, kako lasi madhutu nebhe dhasi re kota sidon. nèti era èèna, rèngu lasi taruu d'ai dano galilea. hèia ra lasi asa rai èci dhu dènge canguru kota, dhu ra biasa pangare na, ‘dekapolis'.

source_text: and they bring to him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu lii aad'o aa katele-katipa. angalai na lere rèti ne asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus tao ai mi kètu na, sèna ka na èle.

source_text: and he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu ae sèra, ka la'e mesa na dènge dhèu èèna. yesus pamaso kacui-aai na asa ro'a dhilu dhèu eèna dua-dua. èle èèna ka, na tao ilu ètu kacui-aai na, ka na g'ag'e he'o dhèu ne'e.

source_text: and looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith to him, effatha, that is, be opened.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe asa dedha, na ère a'ae madhera, ka na paredha, aku nèngu na, efata. sasoa na, bhoke ka!

source_text: and immediately his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spoke plain.
target_text: na peka dhoka sèmi èèna di, kabèdhi laa, dhilu dhèu èèna tadèngi dènge. sèmi èèna kahèi, he'o dhu sakaa èèna, mako ka na padhai lii dènge.

source_text: and he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them; so much the more a great deal they published it;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa era dhèu ae sèra. ka yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, nanene, ee! baku lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, ja'a ka dhu pa'èle dhèu ne'e ne. masi ka na kai si, te ngaa dhèu se'e lasi lolo palème d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and were beyond measure astonished, saying, he hath done all things well; he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, malaa bia. ra papeka isi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e, dhèu di, nga! nèngu tao pabe'a aa'i mèu-mèu. dhèu katele bisa tadèngi, aa dhèu lii aad'o bisa padhai lii.

source_text: in those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, jesus called his disciples, and saith to them, i have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat: and if i send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for some of them came from a distance.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, dhèu ae mai kamue rare yesus neo nanene lii holo-nori na. dhèu sèra tèlu lod'o kèna ètu era èèna dènge yesus. nèti èèna ka, gee ra èle aa'i le. hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae se'e. cahag'e mai nèti rae kaj'èu, ètu era ne'e d'ai tèlu lod'o kèna, ka nganga'a rèngu aad'o heka ciki sa. baku hia ra lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra mad'ea ho bèbha ètu j'ara.

source_text: and his disciples answered him, from whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus sèra dhaa, peka na, ama. era ne kaj'èu nèti rae. èdhi panga'a tare boe dhèu ae sèmi ne'e!

source_text: and he asked them, how many loaves have ye? and they said, seven.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, roti miu pèri bua era? ka ra dhaa peka na, ama. roti ji'i ate dhoka pidhu bua di.

source_text: and he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and broke, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they set them before the people.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, hèia na pua dhèu ae sèra madhèdi ètu rai. ka nare roti pidhu bua sèra, hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. sabaj'a nare, hèia na pamae roti pidhu bua sèra. ka na hia ana madhutu na papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
target_text: rèngu dènge i'a pèri ngi'u kahèi. ka yesus sabaj'a hari manèngi makasi. èle èèna ka, na hia ana madhutu na papala hari mi dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: so they ate, and were satisfied: and they took up of the fragments that were left, seven baskets. and they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he dismissed them.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ele boe d'ai èpa riho sa. ra ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rare, hèia ana madhutu yesus pakaboko nganga'a sisa, ka ra ige pidhu soe hahake. èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and forthwith he entered into a boat with his disciples, and came into the parts of dalmanutha.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa, yesus dènge ana madhutu na ca'e koha pakèd'i asa rae èci, ngara na dalmanuta.

source_text: and the pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
target_text: lod'o yesus si d'ai dalmanuta, dhèu partei parisi pèri-pèri mai paraga dènge yesus. ra tenge j'ara neo pamanahu ne. ra manèngi, peka na, ama. pad'elo tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èu tare'a-re'a abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, why doth this generation seek for a sign? verily i say to you, there shall no sign be given to this generation.
target_text: hèia yesus ère a'ae madhera, ka na dhaa si, peka na, ladhe ja'a madhutu lii padhai lii miu ne, ja'a manyasa! nga tao ka miu manèngi tadha malaa? baku sèmi èèna. ja'a bisa tao tadha malaa. te ngaa ja'a parluu boe pad'elo mi miu.

source_text: and he left them, and entering into the boat again, departed to the other side.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu parisi sèra, la'e hari asa dedha koha. ka na pakèd'i dènge ana madhutu na sèra asa cabèka dano.

source_text: now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the boat with them more than one loaf.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai talora dano, hèia ana madhutu na sèra heka sanèd'e kèna, na, rèngu rèti boe nganga'a leo, dhoka roti cue di.

source_text: and he charged them saying, take heed, beware of the leaven of the pharisees, and of the leaven of herod.
target_text: tadèngi ra ale roti, hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu mage-mage ku! baku lèke pangaru karehe nèti dhèu aae herodes dènge dhèu parisi. pangaru rèngu, sama sèmi ragi dhu dhèu pakihu tao roti.

source_text: and they reasoned among themselves, saying, it is because we have no bread.
target_text: ra tadèngi na padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu sèra malaa. ka ra papeka isi-aanga si, peka na, mone heka nèi, peka ngaa ne? tao-tao èdhi tèti boe roti, ka na lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: and when jesus knew it, he saith to them, why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai rèngu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu me'a mere boe ngaa dhu ja'a peka na, do? mema kahadhu miu kateme.

source_text: having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
target_text: miu mèdhi dènge madha le, te ngaa mo'o boe me'a! èci èèna ka dènge miu mèdhi mèka. miu tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu le, te ngaa mo'o boe nanene. èci èèna ka dènge miu tadèngi mèka. miu bhèlu le, do?

source_text: when i divided the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? they say to him, twelve.
target_text: roti lèmi bua dhu ja'a pamae kore ka hia dhèu lèmi riho sèra ra'a, si? ca hari ni, miu pakaboko mere roti dhu risi sèra pèri soe? ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, canguru dua soe, ama.

source_text: and when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? and they said, seven.
target_text: ka na karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a pamae kore roti pèri bua sèra, ka hia dhèu èpa riho ra'a sa, do aad'o? miu pakaboko mere sisa pèri soe hahake? ka ra dhaa, na, pidhu, ama.

source_text: and he said to them, how is it that ye do not understand?
target_text: hèia na peka, na, mema tare'a! miu mèdhi dènge madha le. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu me'a mèka koasa ja'a kapua nèti mia?

source_text: and he cometh to bethsaida; and they bring a blind man to him, and besought him to touch him.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai rae betsaida, dhèu rèti dhèu bèdhu èci mai asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu ne.

source_text: and he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw aught.
target_text: ka yesus kadhèi nare kacui-aai dhèu ne, ka dua ra lasi asa li'u rae. èle èèna ka, yesus sabhuu ilu mi musi madha dhèu ne, hèia na g'ag'e. ka na karèi, peka na, samia? èu mèdhi le, do dhae?

source_text: and he looked up, and said, i see men as trees walking.
target_text: ka dhèu èèna padoa kètu, ka na ladhe sa g'ana-kariu, hèia na dhaa, peka na, oo! ja'a kèdhi dhèu kako rango-rango era, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u dhu kako.

source_text: after that, he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
target_text: hèia yesus caro hari kacui-aai na ca tèka mi musi madha dhèu ne'e. ka na ladhe patae hari, ho neo ne'a, na, musi madha na be'a le, do dhae. ne'e ne, heka nèdhi dènge mèu kèna.

source_text: and he sent him away to his house, saying, neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
target_text: ka yesus pua na lèpa, te ngaa pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ka, te ngaa madhutu j'ara leo. re ia ka betsaida.

source_text: and jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of cesarea philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying to them, who do men say that i am?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si kako palème rae-rae ètu kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, yesus karèi ana madhutu na, peka na, madhutu lii lolo dhèu, na, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: and they answered, john the baptist: but some say, elijah; and others, one of the prophets,
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, dhèu cahag'e peka, na, èu ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu madhe le, te ngaa mamuri hari. abhu cahag'e peka na, èu ne, elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. aa abhu cahag'e hari peka na, ama ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo.

source_text: and he saith to them, but who say ye that i am? and peter answereth and saith to him, thou art the christ.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari rèngu, madhutu a'abhu miu, ja'a ne, cee? petrus dhaa, peka na, ama ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka.

source_text: and he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e si, aku nèngu na, baku lolo mi cee-cee kahèi, ee!

source_text: and he began to teach them, that the son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, and the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus mulai peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna, lula dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi, kètu agama yahudi, dènge mese agama sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare boe ja'a. ho èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, na, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and he spoke that saying openly. and peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
target_text: yesus peka boe dènge pahuni, hèia petrus ère ne asa karasa na, ka na kai, aku nèngu na, ama, baku padhai lii sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe dhèu tao ama ku sèmi èèna.

source_text: but when he had turned about, and looked on his disciples, he rebuked peter, saying, get thee behind me, satan: for thou savorest not the things that are of god, but the things that are of men.
target_text: lii padhai lii petrus èèna, madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia yesus kabib'a, ka ladhe asa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra. ka na nasa dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, weh! èèna lii dhèu aae nidhu! èu pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! èu madhutu dhoka dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di. madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: and when he had called the people to him with his disciples also, he said to them, whoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu ae sèra ho mai pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na. ka na aj'a si, peka na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, hud'i taha taruu bèli-bèli. nèngu hud'i tèke eele dad'èi na, ho madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu hud'i taha taruu kahèi, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha nèngu unu na ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for whoever will save his life, shall lose it; but whoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri dhoka lalau ngi'u aae na di, bèli-camèd'a mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara! te ngaa dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, aa lula na peka-padhai j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri dhu ma'ète boe dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul:
target_text: mi nanene, ee! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: or what will a man give in exchange for his soul?
target_text: masi ka èu bau mèti aa'i kakaja rai-haha ne, te ngaa bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu.

source_text: whoever therefore shall be ashamed of me, and of my words, in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also will the son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his father with the holy angels.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu ètu rai-haha limuri ne, bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa. rèngu pusi-pahae boe madhutu ama lamatua. de cee dhu makae madhutu ja'a, do makae madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a makae kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua. te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a mai hari nèti sorga, palere dènge ana pajuu ama lamatua sèra. ji'i puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, heka dhèu re'a mèu kèna, ja'a ne cee.

source_text: and he said to them, verily i say to you, that there are some of them that stand here who shall not taste death, till they have seen the kingdom of god come with power.
target_text: miu baku bhèlu lii padhai lii ja'a ne. abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu madhe mèka, pe mèdhi ama lamatua nèd'u paredha dènge koasa kapai.

source_text: and after six days, jesus taketh with him peter, and james, and john, and leadeth them up upon a high mountain apart by themselves; and he was transfigured before them.
target_text: èle èna lod'o, hèia yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, yohanis, lasi asa ledhe èci dhu dhèu pea boe. ropa d'ai ledhe èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, yesus leko-leo.

source_text: and his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can whiten them.
target_text: aa mèdha-papake na pudhi kale'e. abhu mèka mèdha dhu pudhi sèmi èèna ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and there appeared to them elijah, with moses: and they were talking with jesus.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, rèngu rèdhi yesus padhai lii dènge elia dènge musa.

source_text: and peter answered and said to jesus, master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for moses, and one for elijah. for he knew not what to say: for they were greatly terrified.
target_text: ka petrus si madha'u bia. hèia petrus malaa, ka na padhai lii ore leli. hèia na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! èdhi ètu era ne'e, be'a titu kèna! hua iia risi, ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua, cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: and there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, this is my beloved son: hear him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare si. hèia ra tadèngi lii èci nèti ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, mi nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. miu nanene paie ne!

source_text: and suddenly, when they had looked around, they saw no man any more, save jesus only with themselves.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, petrus si laladhe palème, te ngaa rèdhi heka dhèu leo ètu èèna. ate dhoka yesus mesa na.

source_text: and as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the son of man were risen from the dead.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru nèti ledhe èèna. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ngaa dhu miu mèdhi deo na, baku lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. ho lod'o d'ai ja'a mamuri hari, na, miu heka lolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
target_text: rèngu tèke pa'èra lii moa èèna ètu d'ara ra. ra ale boe dènge dhèu èci sa. te ngaa tèlu ra pakarèi isi-aanga, na padhai lii ngaa ne, peka na, ‘nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe'? tasamia, ee?

source_text: and they asked him, saying, why say the scribes that elijah must first come?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, mese agama sèra peka na, ‘elia hud'i mai uru ku, heka kristus mai kèna. ' te ngaa madhutu ama, tare'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and he answered and told them, elijah verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written concerning the son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at naught.

source_text: but i say to you, that elijah is indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they pleased, as it is written concerning him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pasa paie dhilu miu! elia mai le. te ngaa dhèu paj'èra ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu. èèna lèke dènge ngaa dhu baki-baki èdhi sèra suri tèke le karèi nèti uuru ka.

source_text: and when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

source_text: and immediately all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, saluted him.

source_text: and he asked the scribes, what question ye with them?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, miu pab'ala lii ngaa na?

source_text: and one of the multitude answered and said, master, i have brought to thee my son, who hath a dumb spirit;
target_text: dhèu èci nèti talora dhèu ae sèra ara sa madha, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, mu nanene ku laa! ja'a mai kèti ana mone ja'a dhu pèd'a, ho ama ku puri-pa'èle ne. nèngu lii aad'o, bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and wherever he taketh him, he teareth him; and he foameth and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away; and i spoke to thy disciples that they should cast him out, and they could not.
target_text: ladhe nidhu maso asa d'ara ngi'u na, na hake ngi'u ana ne mi rai. ho hèb'a na horo karaka, na na'e ngutu na kico-kico sèna. ho ngi'u na patèku sèmi aj'u. ja'a manèngi le ana madhutu ama ku babège eele nidhu èèna. te ngaa ra bisa boe.

source_text: he answered him, and saith, o faithless generation, how long shall i be with you, how long shall i suffer you? bring him to me.
target_text: ropa na nanene nare, hèia yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa. miu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a! ja'a mate miu nèbhu sange mia hari ku? mèti ana èèna asa ne'e mai!

source_text: and they brought him to him: and when he saw him, immediately the spirit tore him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed, foaming.
target_text: hèia ra sa'u rèti ana èèna asa madha yesus. te ngaa ropa nidhu ladhe nèdhi yesus, na kalabhe ana ne mi rai, ka ana ne bèbhe kapod'e ètu rai, aa hèb'a na horo karaka.

source_text: and he asked his father, how long is it since this came to him? and he said, from a child.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ama na, nèngu sèmi ne'e ne, pèri lod'o kèna? ka ama na dhaa, karèi nèti ana iiki ka mai.

source_text: and often it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
target_text: nidhu èèna nèbhu ae le neo pamadhe ana ne'e. na tule ne pèri-pèri hari kèna asa d'ara ai, aa na pacène le kahèi asa d'ara èi. de ama ku sue ja'a. ladhe bisa, na, ama puri-pa'èle ku ana ja'a la.

source_text: jesus said to him, if thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu peka na ‘ladhe bisa'? ja'a bisa tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa hud'i èu parcaya uuru ku!

source_text: and immediately the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, lord, i believe; help thou my unbelief.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mone èèna dhaa dènge oe tangi, aku nèngu na, ama, mema ja'a parcaya, te ngaa pa'èra hari ku lalèka ja'a ne'e!

source_text: when jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying to him, thou dumb and deaf spirit, i charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ae mai lingu, ka na paredha nidhu èèna, aku nèngu na, heh! nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu ka nèti ana ne'e! sèna ka na bisa tadèngi aa na padhai lii kahèi. èu baku maso ia ka asa d'ara ana ne'e!

source_text: and the spirit cried, and rent him severely, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; so that many said, he is dead.
target_text: ropa nidhu tadèngi lii yesus, hèia na pakèce. ka na hake ana ne mi rai, ka na rèbha-rèbha sène, heka nidhu kalua nèti d'ara ana èèna kèna. ana èèna kalau heka, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le. ka dhèu ètu sèra sa peka, aku rèngu na, waa! ana ne madhe le!

source_text: but jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana ne, ka na pakèd'i ne. hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and when he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, why could not we cast him out?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, tèke eele era èèna, lasi dhuli èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, rèngu mesa ra, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège eele nidhu èèna?

source_text: and he said to them, this kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! nidhu sèra mema bhelu. de ladhe miu manèngi boe a'èra nèti lamatua, na, miu bisa boe babège eele nidhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they departed thence, and passed through galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna, lasi taruu asa propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna,

source_text: for he taught his disciples, and said to them, the son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they will kill him; and after that he is killed, he will rise the third day.
target_text: lula na neo aj'a ana madhutu na di. ka na lole dènge si, nèbhu heka dhèu pahie eele ja'a dènge dhèu leo. hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: but they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
target_text: yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra malaa. rèngu bani heka karèi sasoa lii padhai lii nèngu.

source_text: and he came to capernaum: and being in the house, he asked them, what was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi d'ai kapernaum. ropa ra maso asa d'ara èmu èci, yesus karèi si, peka na, deo na miu pasisu ngaa ètu talora j'ara?

source_text: but they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
target_text: èci sa bani boe dhaa, lula ètu talora j'ara deo na, rèngu ako pasala d'ara, nèti ra pasisu, cee ka dhu kapai risi ètu talora rèngu.

source_text: and he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith to them, if any man desireth to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
target_text: hèia yesus madhèdi, ka na holo si, peka na, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri nèngu hud'i sama sèmi dhèu haha dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu.

source_text: and he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said to them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus sa'u nare ana iiki èci, ka la'e asa talora rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na,

source_text: whoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi ana iiki ne, èèna sama sèmi nèngu lalau-lalo'o ja'a kahèi. aa nèngu lalau-lalo'o ama ku kahèi, dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and john answered him, saying, master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name, and he followeth not us; and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus dhu ngara na yohanis, peka na, ama! ca tèka ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu pake kolongara ama ku, ho na babège eele nidhu. te ngaa ji'i kai ne, lula nèngu dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: but jesus said, forbid him not; for there is no man who shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, baku mi kai ne! te dhèu dhu pake kolongara ja'a, ho na tao tadha malaa, nèngu pa'ele iie boe kolongara ja'a.

source_text: for he that is not against us, is on our part.
target_text: ladhe nèngu palab'a boe dènge èdhi, nèngu na dhèu èdhi.

source_text: for whoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to christ, verily i say to you, he shall not lose his reward.
target_text: de mi sanèd'e paie! ladhe abhu dhèu ne'a, na, miu madhutu kristus, ka na soru-bara miu, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe rui-j'aj'èra nèngu. masi ka dhèu dhu hia miu èi iia ca galaa èèna ka, ama lamatua bhèlu boe tatao nèngu èèna.

source_text: and whoever shall cause one of these little ones that believe in me, to fall into sin, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge ra, peka na, mage-mage, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao ana iiki èci kako sala j'ara, toke ana ne parcaya heka ja'a! be'a risi hia dhèu èèna, rare hadhu aae cue, ho èki mi ladha goro ne, ho pacène ne asa talora dhasi.

source_text: and if thy hand causeth thee to fall into sin, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake kacui-aai èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge kacui-aai kateme.

source_text: where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

source_text: and if thy eye causeth thee to fall into sin, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of god with one eye, than having two eyes, to be cast into hell-fire.

source_text: for every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
target_text: a'aj'a ja'a ne, mema bia. de ladhe cee dhu madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu, sèmi dhèu dhu neo paga sisi hud'i masi uuru ku, sèna ka sisi paga èèna taha nèbhu.

source_text: salt is good: but if the salt hath lost its saltness, with what will ye season it? have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

source_text: and he arose from thence, and cometh into the borders of judea, by the further side of jordan: and the people resort to him again; and, as he was accustomed, he taught them again.

source_text: and the pharisees came to him, and asked him, is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, nanori musa peka, dhèu bisa pa'ia-pa'ela, sad'i dhèu mone tao uru ku sasuri pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu na.

source_text: and jesus answered and said to them, for the hardness of your heart, he wrote you this precept.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala si, peka na, nanene, ee! musa suri sèmi èèna, lula miu kètu hadhu.

source_text: but from the beginning of the creation, god made them male and female.

source_text: for this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone tèke eele ina-ama na, ho mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu na,

target_text: sèna ka dua ra j'aj'i mi èci. '

source_text: what therefore god hath joined together, let not man separate.

source_text: and in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi mesa ra asa d'ara èmu cue. ètu èèna, rèngu karèi ne lii aj'a deo sa.

source_text: and they brought young children to him, that he should touch them; and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.

source_text: but when jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said to them, suffer the little children to come to me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of god.
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na nasa dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. baku magee si. te dhèu sèmi sèra ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: verily i say to you, whoever shall not receive the kingdom of god, as a little child, he shall not enter it.
target_text: miu sanèd'e paie! dhèu cee dhu neo mai asa katanga-madha lamatua, d'ara na kateme hud'i d'èi paraga dènge ne, èci èèna ka ana iiki dhu d'ara d'èi paraga dènge ina-ama ra. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus liku nare ana iiki se, ka na tao kacui-aai na mi dedha kètu ana iiki se èci-èci, ho na hia si lii mamèngi.

source_text: and when he had gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, good master, what shall i do that i may inherit eternal life?
target_text: ropa yesus si neo pakèd'i, dhèu kaja èci rai mai neo paraga dènge ne. hèia na pacud'u ètu madha yesus, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a neo karèi ciki. ja'a tao tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne maso sorga ho mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: and jesus said to him, why callest thou me good? there is none good, but one, that is god.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ne ‘hua iia'? dhèu rai-haha ne èci sa dhu hua iia boe. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu hua iia.

source_text: thou knowest the commandments, do not commit adultery, do not kill, do not steal, do not bear false witness, defraud not, honor thy father and mother.
target_text: èu me'a le, lii paredha ama lamatua sèra nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: ‘baku pamadhe dhèu; baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli; baku monya ho parame more mèdha-panyau dhèu; aa pakab'ua ina-ama èu. '

source_text: and he answered and said to him, master, all these have i observed from my youth.
target_text: dhèu èèna dhaa, peka na, tare'a, ama mese! nèti ana ngèru ka mai, ja'a madhutu le lii paredha sèra aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: then jesus beholding him loved him, and said to him, one thing thou lackest: go, sell whatever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven; and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

source_text: and he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
target_text: ropa dhèu ne tadèngi nare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, d'ara na laho mae-mae. la'e ka èmu dènge d'ara dhu pèd'a bia, lula nèngu dhèu kaja tare'a.

source_text: and jesus looked around, and saith to his disciples, how hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of god!
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe la'e-mai, aa peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi nanene! dhèu kaja carui titu kèna maso sorga!

source_text: and the disciples were astonished at his words. but jesus answereth again, and saith to them, children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of god!
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, ana madhutu na bingu. ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, mi nanene paie! mema carui ladhe dhèu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. baku ngee èèna mud'a!

source_text: it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhèu kaja maso sorga ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, sama carui dènge badha onta ci'u dhu kapai maso asa oka na re ro'a j'aj'au.

source_text: and they were astonished beyond measure, saying among themselves, who then can be saved?
target_text: lii padhai lii yesus ne asa pamalaa dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i si. ka ra pakarèi, peka na, ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, cee ka dhu bisa abhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: and jesus looking upon them, saith, with men it is impossible, but not with god: for with god all things are possible.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe si èci-èci, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, madhutu dhèu rai-haha, na, carui. te ngaa baku bhèlu, madhutu ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: then peter began to say to him, lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus padhai lii, peka na, ama, ji'i tèke eele le ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i unu ji'i, ho madhutu èu. de ji'i abhu bab'ala na ngaa?

source_text: jesus answered and said, verily i say to you, there is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's, but he shall receive a hundred-fold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come, eternal life.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, aa tèke eele ina-ama na, a'ari na, ana-èpu na, oka-tedhe na, sasab'a-la'a na, dènge isi èmu aa'i-aa'i, ho la'e peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu ètu mia-mia, lèpa loo limuri, nèngu abhu hari ngaa-ngaa sèra, d'ai cangasu hari. aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tèke eele sèra, èèna na nèngu abhu risi hari. aa nèngu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi, lula madhutu ja'a. te ngaa ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, nèngu mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua. bab'ala nèngu, sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: but many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu padedha iisi, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli. te ngaa dhèu dhu ngee, na, nèngu dhèu haha di, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu kapai.

source_text: and they were in the way, going up to jerusalem; and jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. and he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen to him,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa kota yerusalem. yesus kako uuru. ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge dhèu leo dhu kako pa'èci madhutu ne re limuri. rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai dhu yesus peka dènge rèngu uru èèna, peka na, dhèu neo pamadhe ne ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bingu dènge madha'u. hèia yesus paroa nare ana madhutu na sèra mesa ra, ho na peka hari dènge rèngu dhèu neo tao ngaa mi dedha nèngu ètu yerusalem.

source_text: saying, behold, we go up to jerusalem; and the son of man will be delivered to the chief priests, and to the scribes; and they will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the gentiles;
target_text: yesus peka dènge si, mi nanene! èdhi neo lati asa yerusalem. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ètu nèi, dhèu neo pahie eele ja'a asa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èle èèna, ra uku-ked'i pamadhe ja'a. ra tule eele ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: and they will mock him, and will scourge him, and will spit upon him, and will kill him: and the third day he will rise again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a. ra paru'e ilu mi ja'a. aa ra dhedhe pamae iisi ja'a. èle èèna, heka ra pamadhe ja'a kèna. mema ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa d'ai camèda, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and james and john the sons of zebedee come to him, saying, master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatever we shall desire.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana sabadeus, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, mai asa yesus. ka ra manèngi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i neo padhai lii dènge ama ciki.

source_text: and he said to them, what would ye that i should do for you?
target_text: ka yesus karèi si, miu neo ngaa?

source_text: they said to him, grant to us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ama mèd'u paredha, ji'i manèngi ama pamadhèdi ji'i dua mi, èci re sebhe g'ana, èci hari re kariu, sèna ka ji'i paredha hèi.

source_text: but jesus said to them, ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that i drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that i am baptized with?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu dua mi se me'a boe lii manèngi miu èèna. èèna na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae. de tasamia? miu ngee, na, miu se bisa pasae j'aj'èra dènge ja'a toke madhe, do?

source_text: and they said to him, we can. and jesus said to them, ye shall indeed drink of the cup that i drink of: and with the baptism that i am baptized with shalt ye be baptized;
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i bisa, ama! ka yesus b'ala, peka na, mema, èèna na, miu pasae j'aj'èra kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a.

source_text: but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand, is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
target_text: te ngaa cee dhu madhèdi re sebhe g'ana, do sebhe kariu ja'a, èèna hak ja'a aad'o. te dhu hak ka ama lamatua dhu pama'ète mema le, na, cee-cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu era sèra.

source_text: and when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with james and john.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra tadèngi lii manèngi yakobis dènge yohanis sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa bia.

source_text: but jesus called them, and saith to them, ye know that they who are accounted to rule over the gentiles, exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa aa'i-aa'i si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, sina ma? dhèu-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u paredha j'eli ana kabarai sèna ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto. dhèu kapai kabarai dhu tadhe boe lamatua hia paredha risi eele, ka ana kabarai bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: but so it shall not be among you: but whoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
target_text: te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna! nèti talora miu, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku ana pua-paleha ho lalau dhèu leo.

source_text: and whoever of you will be the chief, shall be servant of all.
target_text: cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i tao ngi'u na sama sèmi ènu.

source_text: for even the son of man came not to be ministered to, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a mai hia boe dhèu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. te ngaa ja'a mai ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu ae, dènge hia mamuri ja'a ho sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: and they came to jericho: and as he went out of jericho with his disciples, and a great number of people, blind bartimeus, the son of timeus, sat by the highway-side begging.
target_text: yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dènge dhèu ae titu kèna kako lasi kota jeriko. ropa rèngu neo kako taruu, dhèu bèdhu èci madhèdi ètu sebhe j'ara, na kanata ai ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu kako re èèna. ngara na bartimeos, ana nèti timeos.

source_text: and when he heard that it was jesus of nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, jesus, thou son of david, have mercy on me.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu dhu kako mai sèra, yesus nèti rae nasaret na kahèi, ka na rodhe, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! ji'i mate èu nèbhu ae le! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, thou son of david, have mercy on me.
target_text: ropa ra nanene lii rodhe na, hèia dhèu sèra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu mau-mau ku laa! te ngaa na rodhe asa aae, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called: and they call the blind man, saying to him, be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
target_text: hèia yesus titu taha, ka na peka, mèti ku na mai sa ne'e! ka ra lasi peka dènge dhèu bèdhu èèna, peka na, èu mau-mau ka laa! te ama mese paroa èu nèi. de mai lati ka!

source_text: and he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to jesus.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, ka bartimeos pèci eele sig'i kalolo na, hèia na kèd'i titu la'e paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and jesus answered and said to him, what wilt thou that i should do to thee? the blind man said to him, lord, that i may receive my sight.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, peka na, èu parluu ngaa? dhèu bèdhu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! ja'a manèngi ho ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: and jesus said to him, go, thy faith hath made thee whole. and immediately he received his sight, and followed jesus in the way.
target_text: yesus peka hari dènge ne, lula èu parcaya, ja'a bisa tao paie musi madha èu. ne'e ne kahèi musi madha èu èle dènge! de lamu ka! ka musi madha bartimeos èle dènge. èle ka la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and when they came nigh to jerusalem, to bethphage, and bethany, at the mount of olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge kota yerusalem, ka ra dhuli uuru dua rae, ngara na betfage dènge betania, ètu sebhe ledhe saitun. ètu èèna, yesus si mate ciki oo'e di. ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uuru.

source_text: and saith to them, go into the village over against you: and as soon as ye have entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, on which never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
target_text: na pua si, peka na, miu dua mi lami uuru asa d'ara rae nèi. ropa miu maso lami, miu mèdhi ana badha keled'ei ci'u, dhu ra èki ètu èèna, dhu dhèu dhae manya'e mèka. lami ho lècu eele dhari a'èki na, ho ère mèti mai asa ne'e.

source_text: and if any man shall say to you, why do ye this? say ye that the lord hath need of him; and immediately he will send him hither.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu karèi miu, ‘nga tao ka miu ère mèti ana keled'ei ne? ' mi peka dènge si, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ladhe pake nare, na, na hia hari mai. '

source_text: and they went, and found the colt tied by the door without, in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu na dhèu dua sèra lasi, ka rèdhi ana keled'ei ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu madha èmu cue ètu sebhe j'ara. ra lècu eele dhari èki na, ka ra ère rèti mai.

source_text: and certain of them that stood there, said to them, what do ye, loosing the colt?
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, peka na, we! nga tao ka miu pakako mèti keled'ei dhèu?

source_text: and they said to them even as jesus had commanded; and they let them go.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ho ladhe na pake nare, na, ji'i ngèti hari mai. ka dhèu sèra soro tèke si lasi pakako rèti ana keled'ei èèna.

source_text: and they brought the colt to jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
target_text: hèia ra rèti ana keled'ei èèna asa yesus. ka ra hèle sig'i-kalolo rèngu mi dedha keled'ei, ka yesus manya'e.

source_text: and many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off trees, and strewed them in the way.
target_text: ropa oe maso d'ara kota, ka dhèu ae rare sig'i-kalolo, ka ra hèle mi dedha j'ara oka-hoo. dhèu cahag'e lasi para rèu palam ètu sebhe j'ara, ho ra tao mi talora j'ara oka-hoo. tatao sèmi èèna na, sama sèmi tadha èci dhu peka na, rèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: and they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, hosanna: blessed is he that cometh in the name of the lord.
target_text: dhèu cahag'e kako uru ètu madha yesus; aa cahag'e kako limuri. ka ra pa'oo, peka na, hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu mai pake kolongara na, lula ama lamatua hia ne mai!

source_text: blessed be the kingdom of our father david, that cometh in the name of the lord: hosanna in the highest.
target_text: hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud! hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu era dedha risi eele!

source_text: and jesus entered into jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round upon all things, it being now evening, he went out to bethany, with the twelve.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai d'ara kota, ka yesus si maso asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus ladhe palème era èmu èèna. te ngaa, lula lod'o nihia ae le, ka ra lèpa hari asa rae betania.

source_text: and on the morrow, when they had come from bethany, he was hungry,
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ka rèngu kalua nèti betania lasi asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara ka yesus manganga.

source_text: and seeing a fig-tree afar off, having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing on it: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves: for the time of figs had not yet come.
target_text: ka na ladhe nèdhi ana aaj'u èci ètu sebhe j'ara. hua aj'u na, dhu dhèu ra'a. yesus la'e padètu ho neo ne'a aj'u na, hua do aad'o. na ladhe aj'u èèna hua boe cue sa. te mema d'ai mèka hèru hua. rèu heka mare kèna.

source_text: and jesus answered and said to it, let no man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. and his disciples heard it.
target_text: ka yesus peka mi aj'u èèna, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua, mulai ti deo ne'e, èu bisa heka hia hua èu asa dhèu leo! ana madhutu yesus sèra tadèngi na padhai lii dènge nasa sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they come to jerusalem: and jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
target_text: yesus si kako taruu asa yerusalem, d'ai nèi ka yesus maso asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu èèna, dhèu tao pasa ho ra pahia koro j'aha dhu biasa dhèu pake tao korban ho ra sabaj'a. ropa yesus nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na lalèta si asa li'u. na tule eele mei dhu ra pake ho pasilu doi sèra, aa na tule paguri eele bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui sa.

source_text: and would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
target_text: ka yesus kai si aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka ra rèti ia ka mèdha rèngu re d'ara madha èmu èèna.

source_text: and he taught, saying to them, is it not written, my house shall be called by all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
target_text: ka na aj'a si, peka na, miu me'a le lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke le, peka na: ‘ja'a tao èmu ne'e, sèna ka suku aa'i-aa'i mai sabaj'a ètu ne'e. ' te ngaa miu tao èmu ne j'aj'i era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people were astonished at his doctrine.
target_text: ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra re'a rare tatao yesus sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa dènge ne. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ra madha'u, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus.

source_text: and when evening had come, he went out of the city.
target_text: d'ara lod'o cèna sa, yesus si kalua hari nèti kota yerusalem lèpa lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: and in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig-tree dried up from the roots. and peter calling to remembrance, saith to him, master, behold, the fig-tree which thou cursedst is withered.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yesus si lasi hari asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara, ka ra rèdhi aj'u dhu yesus padhai lii med'a na. ka ana madhutu yesus sèra malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi aj'u èèna mango le d'ai amo. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii padhai lii yesus med'a na. ka na peka na, ama! ladhe ku! aj'u dhu ama dhoo med'a na, madhe le!

source_text: and jesus answering, saith to them, have faith in god.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, we! sad'i miu parcaya ama lamatua sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i kahèi.

source_text: for verily i say to you, that whoever shall say to this mountain, be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that the things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatever he saith.
target_text: ladhe miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, miu bisa pua ledhe hia na pidha asa d'ara dhasi. pe lamatua pidha eele ledhe èèna, sad'i miu baku parcaya dènge d'ara cabèka. miu parcaya mi ama lamatua, hud'i dènge d'ara kateme ku.

source_text: therefore i say to you, whatever things ye desire when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
target_text: baku bhèlu! sad'i miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, ngaa dhu miu manèngi, tatu ama lamatua bisa hia miu.

source_text: and when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have aught against any: that your father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sabaj'a, aa te ngaa na tèka d'ara era dènge dhèu leo, nèngu hud'i la'e pabe'a uuru ku dènge dhèu èèna. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga heka saku eele sasala miu kèna.

source_text: but if ye do not forgive, neither will your father who is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
target_text: ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu tèka d'ara dènge dhèu, ho mo'o boe hia abho, na, tatu ama miu ètu sorga no'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: and they come again to jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi taruu. ropa d'ai yerusalem, ka ra maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa maso asa madha èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi sèra mai,

source_text: and say to him, by what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
target_text: ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, cee ka dhu pua èu mai tao maruru ètu ne'e med'a na? cee ka hia èu hak!

source_text: and jesus answered and said to them, i will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and i will tell you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a, na, rèngu neo tenge j'ara ho pamanahu ne. ka na b'ala si, peka na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku ja'a, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: the baptism of john, was it from heaven, or from men? answer me.
target_text: ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis, tuka sarani èèna, sina ma? cee ka dhu pua nèngu la'e sarani dhèu? lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they reasoned with themselves, saying, if we shall say, from heaven; he will say, why then did ye not believe him?
target_text: ra pajiko la'e-mai, ka ra padhue, peka na, eea! nara èdhi le! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu pua yohanis, ' na b'ala hari, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: but if we shall say, from men; they feared the people: for all men counted john that he was a prophet indeed.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi bisa boe peka kahèi, na, ‘dhèu rai-haha dhu pua ne. ' te aad'o na, dhèu ae tao dènge èdhi. lula dhèu ae parcaya, yohanis èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: and they answered and said to jesus, we cannot tell. and jesus answering saith to them, neither do i tell you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe! ka yesus dhaa hari si, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and he began to speak to them by parables. a certain man planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a place for the wine-vat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra. ka na lole pake lii upama èci, peka na, dhèu èci la'e tao oka ho neo sèla anggor ètu dedha rai na. ka na tao tedhe reo nare oka èèna, aa tao bak cue ho kanate èi anggor asa d'ara la'e kahèi. hèia na patitu èmu madhenga oka cue dhu dedha. èle èèna ka, na hia dhèu leo seb'a oka èèna, ho ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia na pakèd'i asa rai leo la'e.

source_text: and at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
target_text: lod'o d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu hua anggor, ka lamatua oka pua ana paleha na èci la'e asa dhèu sab'a oka sèra, ho na manèngi pala na.

source_text: and they caught him, and beat him and sent him away empty.
target_text: ropa d'ai nèi, ka dhèu seb'a sèra kèpe rare, ka game ne. hèia ra pua ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and again, he sent to them another servant: and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
target_text: ka lamatua oka pua hari ana paleha leo èci. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra dhedhe panu'a kètu na. ka ra pamakae ne, dènge magèle eele ne.

source_text: and again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka èèna pua hari ana paleha leo èci la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra hake pamadhe ne. ra tao samia èèna ka, lamatua oka pua taruu ana paleha na la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra game cahag'e, aa pamadhe cahag'e.

source_text: having yet therefore one son, his well-beloved, he sent him also last to them, saying, they will reverence my son.
target_text: ate eele dhodhoka ana mone mesa dhu pasue nèti lamatua oka. lula na abhu heka j'ara dhu leo, ka lamatua oka na pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pajiko, peka na, ‘sèmi ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, na, rèngu sèmi rare dènge be'a, aa ra nanene ne. '

source_text: but those husbandmen said among themselves, this is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.
target_text: hèia na pua ana na la'e. ropa dhèu seb'a sèra rèdhi ana na mai, ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, peka na, ‘we! mi ladhe ku laa! mone heka nèi pua ana d'èlu na mai! ladhe ama na madhe, nèngu ne'e ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i mèdha pusaka ama na. de mai ti pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi tare pusaka na! '

source_text: and they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe, ka ra pamadhe ne, hèia ra core eele ngi'u aae na asa li'u tedhe la'e. lii pakasame ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka.

source_text: what therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard to others.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi dhèu kapai sèra, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, lamatua oka èèna tao dhèu seb'a sèra tasa mera mia? madhutu ngangee ja'a, tatu nèngu mai ho pamadhe aa'i dhèu seb'a sèra, sèna ka na hia dhèu leo hari seb'a oka anggor na.

source_text: and have ye not read this scripture; the stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti baca le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu sèra core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu padhèdi.

source_text: this was the lord's doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes?
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na dhu pili nare, ka na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe, na, be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: and they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people; for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and departed.
target_text: dhèu kapai sèra re'a dènge, na, yesus padhai lii paraga, pake lii pakasame èèna. rèngu sèra sama sèmi dhèu seb'a oka anggor èèna. hèia ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus. te ngaa ra madha'u dènge dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus. ka ra kako eele ne.

source_text: and they sent to him certain of the pharisees, and of the herodians, to catch him in his words.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu kapai yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu nèti partei herodes, lasi pakarèi dènge yesus, ho ra neo sahèdhe ne.

source_text: and when they had come, they say to him, master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of god in truth: is it lawful to give tribute to cesar, or not?
target_text: ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, d'ara ama ku mola, aa d'èi boe kapod'e-kabèli. ama me'a d'ara dhèu. ama peka dad'èi lamatua dènge mola-mola, lula ama pili boe rèhu dhèu. de, ji'i neo karèi ama ku ca j'ara. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea asa dhèu aae kapai dhu paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: shall we give, or shall we not give? but he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that i may see it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu neo sahèdhe ne, sèna ka na padhai lii lab'a paredha roma. ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, nga tao ka miu neo sahèdhe ja'a dènge lii karèi sèmi èèna! cob'a pad'elo ku mi ja'a doi pudhi cue!

source_text: and they brought it: and he saith to them, whose is this image and superscription? and they said to him, cesar's.
target_text: ka ra j'ole doi pudhi cue hia ne. hèia yesus nare, ka laladhe. ka na karèi si, peka na, rèhu dènge ngara cee ètu doi pudhi ne? ka ra dhaa, peka na, èèna dhèu aae kapai paredha roma!

source_text: and jesus answering, said to them, render to cesar the things that are cesar's, and to god the things that are god's. and they wondered at him.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: then come to him the sadducees, who say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: master, moses wrote to us, if a man's brother shall die, and leave his wife, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise seed to his brother.
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: now there were seven brothers: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: and the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: and the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: in the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her for a wife.
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: and jesus answering, said to them, do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of god?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: for when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels who are in heaven.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: and concerning the dead that they rise; have ye not read in the book of moses, how in the bush god spoke to him, saying, i am the god of abraham, and the god of isaac, and the god of jacob?
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: he is not the god of the dead, but the god of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: and one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, which is the first commandment of all?
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: and jesus answered him, the first of all the commandments is, hear, o israel; the lord our god is one lord.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and thou shalt love the lord thy god with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
target_text: de miu hud'i sue risi eele ne nèti aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i d'èi pa'èci dènge ne dènge d'ara kateme, aa tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '
