source_text: blessed be the lord god of israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people.
target_text: koa-kio ama lamatua dhèu isra'el! te na mai le ho sui nare dhèu unu na, sèna ka rèngu baku j'aj'i sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: and hath raised up a horn of salvation for us, in the house of his servant david:
target_text: lamatua ded'e le ca dhèu dhu koasa na kapai titu kèna, ho hia èdhi mamuri. nèngu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets, who have been since the world began:
target_text: lamatua moa mema, karèi nèti uru ka, re dhèu dhu maj'èni rèti lii padhai na.

source_text: that we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
target_text: limuri ne na neo patabuli èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, aa nèti dhèu dhu d'ara pèd'a dènge èdhi.

source_text: to perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant: the oath which he swore to our father abraham,
target_text: na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi bèi-baki èdhi, lula na sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji na mi rèngu, dhu na pa'èki dènge baki abraham.

source_text: that he would grant to us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, might serve him without fear,
target_text: na patabuli le èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, sèna ka ta pahaha iisi mi nèngu, dhu dènge heka d'ara madha'u.

source_text: in holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
target_text: na patalale le èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa mamuri mola-mèci dènge be'a taa-taa, ètu katanga madha na.

source_text: and thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the highest, for thou shalt go before the face of the lord to prepare his ways;
target_text: yohanis, ee! èu ne, ana ja'a. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadhe èu, na, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu dedha risi aa'i. èèna na, lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu, sèna ka ra pakabhèle kacui-aai ra ho soru mamai lamatua.

source_text: to give knowledge of salvation to his people, by the remission of their sins,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lamu paj'uj'u j'ara hia mi dhèu unu lamatua, sèna ka re'a, na, ama lamatua hia mamuri mi rèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu saku eele sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: through the tender mercy of our god; by which the day-spring from on high hath visited us, to give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shades of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
target_text: lula d'ara lamatua taleo aa rasa kasia mi dedha èdhi, nèti èèna ka, na hia èdhi taa-tebho dhu hiu, nuka sèmi lod'o hiu nèti saraa dhu hiu. èdhi dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa èdhi dhu pea dènge d'ara madha'u ètu sanabhu mamadhe, lula pabe'a mèka dènge lamatua, bèli-camèd'a abhu saraa ho lere èdhi asa j'ara dhu nèti mera-milu.

source_text: and the child grew, and became strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his showing to israel.
target_text: ka yohanis asa kapai noo-noo. aa roh lamatua pa'èra ne. na kapai mai, hèia la'e pea ka ètu d'ara mamoo, toke d'ai lod'o na pakako sasab'a mi dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: and it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from cesar augustus, that all the world should be taxed. and this taxing was first made when cyrenius was governor of syria.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara kirenius j'aj'i gubernur ètu siria, dhèu aae kapai agustus, hia paredha, dhu peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu paredha roma, hud'i lèpa asa rae èta-èsu ra ho madhutu sensus! èèna heka hiu-lai kèna, dhèu paredha roma ige ana kabarai na.

source_text: and all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i lèpa asa rai èta-èsu ra, sèna ka madhutu sensus.

source_text: and joseph also went up from galilee, out of the city of nazareth, into judea, to the city of david, which is called bethlehem; because he was of the house and lineage of david to be taxed with mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf pea ètu rae nasaret, ètu propensi galilea. nèngu dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni ca dhèu, ngara na maria, dhu dènge le babia. yusuf ne, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ka nèngu hud'i lèpa ku asa kota daud, nuka betlehem ètu propensi yudea, sèna ka madhutu sensus. nèti èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa kota betlehem.

source_text: and so it was, that while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
target_text: ropa dua ra ètu nèi, maria d'ai lod'o nara iisi.

source_text: and she brought forth her first-born son, and wrapped him in swaddling-clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, dua ra abhu boe kama ètu d'ara losmen. nèti èèna ka, dua ra maso lasi asa d'ara oka badha. hèia maria nara iisi ana uuru, mone ca dhèu. ka pasig'i ne dènge kaha'i bèla, aa paj'unu ètu d'ara karab'a, era badha ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
target_text: mèda èèna, abhu ana madhenga badha dhèu pèri-pèri dhu beke madhenge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a ètu li'u kota.

source_text: and lo, the angel of the lord came upon them, and the glory of the lord shone around them; and they were in great fear.
target_text: kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. hèia saraa lamatua rai-reo nare rèngu, ka ra madha'u bia.

source_text: and the angel said to them, fear not: for behold, i bring you good tidings of great joy which shall be to all people.
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne peka, baku madha'u! nanene pabe'a-be'a! te ja'a ne mai ho peka lii lolo be'a èci hia miu. cee dhu tadèngi lii ne'e, tatu rèngu karej'e.

source_text: for to you is born this day, in the city of david, a savior, who is christ the lord.
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne, sèmi ne'e ka: deo ne'e, ca dhèu ina nara iisi le kristus ètu betlehem, nuka kota dhèu aae daud. kristus ne'e ka dhu ama lamatua pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka. lamatua hia na mai, sèna ka na patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèngu ne'e, èèna na dhèu paroa na, ‘lamatua'!

source_text: and this shall be a sign to you; ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling-clothes, lying in a manger.
target_text: pe miu tadhe ne sèmi ne'e ka: miu paraga dènge ana rara iisi hiu ca dhèu dhu pahutu dènge sig'i. ra paj'unu ne ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: and suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising god, and saying,
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, hèia cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae mai nèti sorga. ka ra pa'èci dènge ne. hèia ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge lii sod'a, peka na,

source_text: glory to god in the highest, and on earth peace, good will towards men.
target_text: ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua! nèngu dhu nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi. ama lamatua neo hia dame dènge mera-milu mi dhèu rai-haha, dhu pakarej'e d'ara na!

source_text: and it came to pass, when the angels had departed from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, let us now go even to bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the lord hath made known to us.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu se lèpa hari asa sorga. hèia ana madhenga badha se padhai lii, peka na, mai lati ku asa betlehem, ho ladhe ku ana nèi! te lamatua pa'adhu le lii ne hia èdhi.

source_text: and they came with haste, and found mary and joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
target_text: hèia lasi ka lai-lai asa betlehem. ka rèngu paraga maria dènge yusuf. aa ladhe rèdhi kahèi ana dhu heka rara iisi, dhu bhèj'i ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: and when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
target_text: ropa rèngu rèdhi ana ne, hèia ra lolo, peka na, deo na ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu peka le dènge ji'i, lula-nèti ana ne'e ne! ka ra lolo aa'i-aa'i toke èle.

source_text: and all they that heard it, wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, tadèngi lii lolo ana madhenga badha se.

source_text: but mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
target_text: te ngaa maria tèke ka ètu d'ara na, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le. aa na pangee mau-mau, ho neo ne'a sasoa na tasa mera mia.

source_text: and the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising god for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told to them.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhenga badha se lèpa hari asa era kahib'i-kalèbho ra. hèia ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. ra manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula dhu rèngu tadèngi aa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra, lèke tare'a-re'a sèmi ngaa dhu ana pajuu ama lamatua peka sèra.

source_text: and when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called jesus, who was so named by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
target_text: ropa ana iiki ne d'ai aru lod'o, ka ra suna ne madhutu atora musa. hèia ama dènge ina na pangare ne, ‘yesus'. ngara ne, ngara dhu ana pajuu nèti sorga peka le dènge rèngu, lod'o ina na dènge mèka babia.

source_text: and when the days of her purification according to the law of moses were accomplished, they brought him to jerusalem, to present him to the lord;

source_text: as it is written in the law of the lord, every male that is the first born of his mother shall be called holy to the lord
target_text: rèngu madhutu atora lamatua dhu peka na, bhèni dhu nara iisi ana mone uuru, nèngu hud'i saraka ana ne j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the lord, a pair of turtle-doves, or two young pigeons.

source_text: and behold, there was a man in jerusalem, whose name was simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of israel: and the holy spirit was upon him. and it was revealed to him by the holy spirit, that he should not see death, before he had seen the lord's christ.

source_text: for my eyes have seen thy salvation,

source_text: and joseph and his mother marveled at those things which were spoken concerning him.

source_text: and simeon blessed them, and said to mary his mother, behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

source_text: and a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, lamatua bhoke patalele d'ara dhèu. te ngaa èu, maria, pe mu paraga dènge j'aj'èra ae-ae, nuka sèmi samala dhu lose adhe-usu èu.

source_text: and there was one anna, a prophetess, the daughter of phanuel, of the tribe of asher: she was of a great age, and had lived with a husband seven years from her virginity; and she was a widow of about eighty four years, who departed not from the temple, but served god with fastings and prayers night and day.
target_text: ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu kahèi bhèni heka ca dhèu, ngara na hana. umur na, aru nguru èpa tèu kèna. ngara ama na fanuel, nèti suku aser. na leo-èmu pidhu tèu, ka dhèu èmu na madhe. hana ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèngu loe boe sabaj'a dènge puasa ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua mèda-mèu.

source_text: and she coming in that instant, gave thanks likewise to the lord, and spoke of him to all them that looked for redemption in jerusalem.

source_text: and when they had performed all things according to the law of the lord, they returned into galilee, to their own city nazareth.

source_text: and the child grew, and became strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of god was upon him.
target_text: ka yesus asa kapai, asa èra, asa d'èlu-mèu dènge ne'a madha j'ara ae-ae. aa ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi yesus kahèi.

source_text: now his parents went to jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
target_text: yusuf dènge maria dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lasi asa kota yerusalem ho madhutu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: and when he was twelve years old, they went up to jerusalem according to the custom of the feast.
target_text: ca tèka, ropa umur yesus canguru dua tèu, hèia la'e palere dènge ina-ama na asa yerusalem, lasi ra'a kalela paska sèmi biasa.

source_text: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child jesus tarried behind in jerusalem; and joseph and his mother knew not of it. but they, supposing him to be in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their relations and acquaintance.
target_text: lod'o èle paska, yusuf dènge maria mulai lèpa lasi asa nasaret palere-lere dènge dhèu ae dhu lèpa asa galilea. te ngaa rèngu re'a boe, na, yesus ètu yerusalem era. ra pangee, na, nèngu palere dènge mone aanga-angalai na. te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o nihia, yusuf dènge maria rèdhi boe ne. ka dua ra mulai patangi-tenge kèna. lasi pakarèi mi a'ari ra, aa mone aanga-angalai ra.

source_text: and when they found him not, they returned to jerusalem, seeking him.
target_text: lula rage boe ne, hèia dua ra lèpa hari sa yerusalem, lasi tenge ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

source_text: and all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nanene lii dhaa na, malaa-maloha, lula nèngu tare'a-re'a ne'a mèu isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, aa na ne'a dhaa lii karèi dènge mola.

source_text: and when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said to him, son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and i have sought thee sorrowing.

source_text: and he said to them, how is it that ye sought me? knew ye not that i must be about my father's business?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka ina dènge ama paj'èra iisi tenge ja'a? me'a, si? ja'a dènge urusan ètu èmu ama ku.

source_text: and they understood not the saying which he spoke to them.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu re'a rare boe sasoa lii na.

source_text: and he went down with them, and came to nazareth, and was subject to them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

source_text: and jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with god and man.
target_text: hèia yesus asa tabha kapai, asa tabha d'èlu-mèu, asa pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, dènge dhèu rai-haha asa tabha d'èi ne.

source_text: now in the fifteenth year of the reign of tiberius cesar, pontius pilate being governor of judea, and herod being tetrarch of galilee, and his brother philip tetrarch of iturea and of the region of trachonitis, and lysanius the tetrarch of abilene, annas and caiaphas being the high priests, the word of god came to john the son of zacharias in the wilderness.
target_text: taa èèna, tiberius j'aj'i dhèu aae kapai dhu nèd'u paredha ètu roma, canguru lèmi tèu kèna. pontius pilatus j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi yudea. herodes j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi galilea. a'a herodes ka pelipus, j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi iturea dènge propensi trakonitis. aa lisanias j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi abilene. taa èèna kahèi hanas dènge kayafas, dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ètu kota yerusalem. lod'o èèna, yohanis, ana sakaria, dhu pea ètu era kaj'èu nèti rae. ètu era ne'e, lamatua pangèd'u ne lii.

source_text: and he came into all the country about jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance, for the remission of sins;
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yohanis la'e asa d'ara rae dhu dètu dènge loko yarden, ho peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i ele-ho'a ku, aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala sèra. èle èèna, miu sarani uuru ku, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, miu pabe'a le dènge lamatua.

source_text: as it is written in the book of the words of isaiah the prophet, saying, the voice of one crying in the wilderness, prepare ye the way of the lord, make his paths straight.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, baki yesaya, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, abhu dhèu dhu ètu d'ara mamoo, pa'oo, peka na: ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pa'èra, sèna ka tao paie-iie j'ara, ho sèmi mamai lamatua! pamola j'ara sèna ka lami soru ne.

source_text: every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
target_text: dhènu pamera era kajèlo aa'i-aa'i. tao pamera-mera ledhe aa'i-aa'i. tao pamola j'ara dhu koe-kalèko, tao pamilu j'ara dhu ako kabhuku.

source_text: and all flesh shall see the salvation of god.
target_text: sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a, na, ama lamatua neo pakaj'èu dhèu nèti sasala-sasigo ra. '

source_text: then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized by him, o generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
target_text: dhèu ae mai nèti mia-mia, manèngi ho yohanis sarani si. te ngaa na jèke si, peka na, miu se dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! miu èci èèna ka mege dhu dènge raco! mage miu pangee na miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti hahuku lamatua, sad'i dhoka ele-ho'a di! aad'o! nèbhu heka lamatua huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tare'a-re'a ele boe ho'a.

source_text: bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, we have abraham for our father: for i say to you, that god is able of these stones to raise up children to abraham.
target_text: mage miu pangee na, ‘ja'a ne lèke boe huku, lula ja'a ana-èpu baki abraham. ' abhu ètu mia sèmi èèna? j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham bisa boe tao miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci. lamatua bisa tao hadhu se, sèna ka j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. ja'a peka kèna! pad'elo ètu d'ara mamuri miu, dhu peka na, miu tèke eele le sasala-sasigo miu, aa mai ho madhutu lamatua.

source_text: and now also the ax is laid to the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit, is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku j'ara be'a. ladhe aad'o, na, hahuku lamatua dhu bia, bèbhe mai lèke miu, nuka sèmi dhèu pake kataka ho patue aj'u nèti amo na. nuka sèmi èèna ka! aj'u dènge boe guna, ladhe hua-hela na nèti boe babe'a! de be'a risi patue ne, aa core eele asa d'ara ai la'e.

source_text: and the people asked him, saying, what shall we do then?
target_text: hèia dhèu ae karèi yohanis, ladhe sèmi èèna, ji'i se tasamia?

source_text: he answereth and saith to them, he that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath provisions, let him do likewise.

source_text: then came also publicans to be baptized, and said to him, master, what shall we do?

source_text: and he said to them, exact no more than that which is appointed you.
target_text: ka na dhaa, miu se d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. de nèti deo ne'e, miu hud'i sab'a ku dènge mola. baku roro bea risi nèti atora paredha. hud'i laa kabarai b'ae madhutu atora na.

source_text: and many other things in his exhortation he preached to the people.

source_text: and jesus being full of the holy spirit, returned from jordan, and was led by the spirit into the wilderness,
target_text: ropa yohanis sarani nare yesus, hèia yesus la'e, tèke eele loko yarden. roh ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ne, ka pakako ne asa d'ara mamoo èci.

source_text: being forty days tempted by the devil. and in those days he ate nothing; and when they were ended, he was afterward hungry.
target_text: ka yesus pea ètu èèna toke èpa nguru lod'o. ètu era ne'e, na'a-ninu boe ngaa-ngaa, ka na manganga titu kèna. aa dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne.

source_text: and the devil said to him, if thou art the son of god, command this stone that it be made bread.
target_text: na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ladhe èu ne tare'a ana ama lamatua, èu dènge koasa. de tao hadhu se j'aj'i roti, ho mu'a si.

source_text: and jesus answered him, saying, it is written, that man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, peka na, èu hari! me'a boe, do? dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘mamuri dhèu rai-haha, mesa boe dhoka nèti nganga'a-nganginu di! '

source_text: and the devil taking him up upon a high mountain, showed to him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. and the devil said to him, all this power will i give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered to me, and to whomsoever i will, i give it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu nèti hari yesus asa era èci dhu dedha aae, hèia na paj'uj'u dènge yesus a'èra dènge koasa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. hèia na pamako yesus, na, a'èra dènge koasa paredha aa'i-aa'i sèra, ètu d'ara kacui-aai ja'a. de ja'a dènge hak ho pangèd'u mi cee èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ko'o.

source_text: if thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a neo hia mi èu. te ngaa sad'i èu tao ku ca j'ara, heka ja'a hia èu kèna. mud'a iiki-iiki! èu pahaha iisi mi ja'a! dhoka èèna di.

source_text: and jesus answered and said to him, get thee behind me, satan: for it is written, thou shalt worship the lord thy god, and him only shalt thou serve.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, abhu ètu mia j'ara na sèmi èèna? te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘èu dhoka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua di. aa èu sogo-tagu dhoka mi nèngu di. '

source_text: and he brought him to jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, if thou art the son of god, cast thyself down from hence.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae nidhu nèti hari yesus asa kota yerusalem. d'ai era ne'e, na paca'e yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka na peka, ladhe tare'a-re'a èu ne ana ama lamatua, na, ridhu asa haha nèi!

source_text: for it is written, he will give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, ho mai j'aga èu.

source_text: and in their hands they will bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
target_text: èèna na ra sibhe èu, sèna ka haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: and jesus answering, said to him, it is said, thou shalt not tempt the lord thy god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii nidhu ne, èu baku karihu kahadhu dènge ja'a ne. lula dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, na, ‘baku sèku ama lamatua. '

source_text: and when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
target_text: dhèu aae nidhu ne tenge j'ara rupa-rupa ho sèku yesus, te ngaa tao nare boe. ka la'e tèke eele yesus, na mate hari lod'o dhu be'a.

source_text: and jesus returned in the power of the spirit into galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the surrounding region.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lèpa hari asa propensi galilea, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci hia ne koasa. nèbhu boe ka dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara rai èèna, mulai tadhe kolongara na.

source_text: and he taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
target_text: na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu mia-mia. ka dhèu koa-kio ne, peka na, yesus ne dhu ele madha, nga!

source_text: and he came to nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath, and stood up to read.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mai asa rae na nasaret. lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, dhu ra pangare na ‘sabat', hèia la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèmi dhu tema na tao. ka na kèd'i titu ho neo baca nèti sasuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and there was delivered to him the book of the prophet isaiah. and when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
target_text: ka ra j'ole hia ne sasuri nèti baki yesaya. hèia na bhoke tenge ayat, ka na baca, peka na,

source_text: the spirit of the lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the broken-hearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
target_text: koasa roh ama lamatua abhu ètu ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na paj'uj'u ja'a, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu-dhèu dhu unu aad'o. nèngu pua le ja'a mai, ho lole, na, dhu ana bèdho, èèna na patalala si; dhu bèdhu, èèna na bisa rèdhi hari; dhu lèke ènyi nèti dhèu, èèna na patabuli eele.

source_text: to preach the acceptable year of the lord.
target_text: te limuri ne d'ai le lod'o lamatua, sèna ka pala mamuri mi dhèu unu na.

source_text: and he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. and the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
target_text: baca nare sasuri ne, ka yesus lulu hari, hèia na j'ole asa ama dhu nèd'u kasasi, ka na madhèdi. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna ladhe patae ne.

source_text: and he began to say to them, this day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, dhu miu tadèngi nèti sasuri ama lamatua deo na, ne'e ne, j'aj'i le!

source_text: and all bore him testimony, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. and they said, is not this joseph's son?
target_text: ka dhèu sèra mulai padhai lii padedha yesus, aku rèngu na, waa! ngaa dhu na padhai lii deo na, be'a titu kèna! te ngaa nèngu ne ana yusuf, si? tasamia ka na bisa sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and he said to them, ye will surely say to me this proverb, physician, heal thyself: whatever we have heard done in capernaum, do also here in thy country.
target_text: hèia yesus lole dènge si, tatu miu tadèngi le lii dhu peka na, ‘wee, dote! puri uuru ku ngi'u èu! ' miu neo pake lii èèna, ho kabèli hari sa ja'a, peka na, ‘nga tao ka èu tao boe tadha malaa èci hia ji'i ètu ne'e, sèmi dhu èu tao le ètu kota kapernaum nèi? '

source_text: and he said, verily i say to you, no prophet is accepted in his own country.
target_text: mamola na sèmi ne'e: dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti d'ara rae unu na.

source_text: but i tell you in truth, many widows were in israel in the days of elijah, when the heaven was shut three years and six months when great famine was throughout all the land: but to none of them was elijah sent, save to sarepta, a city of sidon, to a woman that was a widow.
target_text: tare conto nuka sèmi baki elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ca tèka, èj'i mai boe tèlu tèu catenga. taa èèna, abhu bhèni balu ae ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua hia boe elia ho soru-bara si ètu isra'el sèra. lamatua dhoka pua la'e asa ca dhèu bhèni balu ètu rae sarfat, dhu dètu dènge kota sidon. masi ka bhèni ne dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: and many lepers were in israel in the time of elisha the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving naaman the syrian.
target_text: tare hari conto leo nèti elisa, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. taa èèna, dhèu yahudi ae dhu lèke èi papèd'a kusta ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua pa'èle boe si nèti papèd'a ra. ama lamatua dhoka pua elisa la'e puri-pa'èle dhèu kusta èci, ngara na naaman, masi ka nèngu ne dhèu siria, dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: and all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra nasa titu kèna dènge ne.

source_text: and rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
target_text: ka ra kèd'i aa'i-aa'i, ra babège eele ne nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna. hèia ra nuni rèti ne asa karasa rae, ho neo tule ne nèti dedha tèbhi ètu èèna, asa haha la'e.

source_text: but he passing through the midst of them, went away,
target_text: te ngaa na kako asa li'u la'e re talora aae rèngu, ka tèke eele si ètu era èèna.

source_text: and came down to capernaum, a city of galilee, and taught them on the sabbath-days.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus puru la'e asa kota kapernaum ètu sebhe dano galilea. d'ai lod'o-lod'o sabaj'a, na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
target_text: dhèu sèra malaa ladhe ra nanene lii padhai na, te ne'a mèu isi lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: and in the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
target_text: ca tèka, ropa yesus aj'a-nori ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao, na pa'oo-parodha, peka na,

source_text: saying, let us alone; what have we to do with thee, jesus of nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? i know thee who thou art, the holy one of god.
target_text: ee! yesus, dhèu nasaret! èu neo tao ngaa mi ji'i? èu mai sèna ka palaho ji'i, do? ji'i se tadhe èu. èu ne, dhèu mola, dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho hia mai.

source_text: and jesus rebuked him, saying, hold thy peace, and come out of him. and when the demon had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, rèno laa! hutu hèb'a èu na! kalua ka nèti dhèu ne'e! cag'ag'a laa, nidhu ded'e kalabhe dhèu ne asa rai, ètu talora aae dhèu sèra. ropa pabèbhe nare, hèia nidhu ne kalua tèke eele aa papèd'a boe isi dhèu ne hèi.

source_text: and they were all amazed, and spoke among themselves, saying, what a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, ka ra peka na, ira ii! lii padhai dhèu ne'e, dènge koasa kapai bia! toke nidhu madhutu paredha na kahèi, ka kalua nèti dhèu!

source_text: and the fame of him went out into every place of the surrounding country.
target_text: hèia lii lolo lula-nèti yesus pale-lème rai èèna aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into simon's house. and the mother of simon's wife was taken with a violent fever; and they besought him for her.
target_text: lod'o rèngu kalua nèti èmu sabaj'a, yesus la'e asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. lod'o èèna, teto na dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro isi pana bia. hèia ra manèngi yesus, peka na, ama! puri-pa'èle ku bhèni heka ne, laa!

source_text: and he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered to them.
target_text: ka yesus la'e titu ètu sebhe koi, ka puri papèd'a bhèni heka ne. cag'ag'a laa, èi papèd'a na ele dènge ka. hèia na kèd'i la'e lalau nganga'a hia si ra'a-rinu.

source_text: now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases, brought them to him: and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o nihia èèna kahèi, ropa lod'o oe cèna, dhèu lere rèti dhèu pèd'a ae-ae mai asa yesus. èi papèd'a ra rupa-rupa. hèia na bane ai mi dhèu pèd'a se'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, thou art christ the son of god. and he rebuking them, suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was christ.
target_text: nèti dhèu pèd'a se abhu kahèi dhu nidhu tao. hèia yesus paredha nidhu se, sèna ka kalua nèti dhèu sèra. ra rai kalua dènge lii taraa, peka na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua! te nidhu se re'a, na, nèngu ne kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. nèti èèna ka, yesus kai si sèna ka bisa boe ra padhai ca hèb'a sa, lula-nèti nèngu.

source_text: and when it was day, he departed, and went into a desert place; and the people sought him, and came to him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
target_text: asa bèli d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus kèd'i, ka la'e asa era dhu kaliu èci ètu li'u kota. hèia dhèu tenge ne asa mia-mia. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka ra pamako ne, aku rèngu na, ama pea ka dènge ji'i laa! lamu iia ka asa era leo!

source_text: and he said to them, i must preach the kingdom of god to other cities also, for therefore am i sent.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku asa rae-rae leo, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèti paredha ama lamatua. te ama lamatua pua ja'a mai ne, sèna ka pakako sasab'a èèna.

source_text: and he preached in the synagogues of galilee.
target_text: hèia na kako nèti rae èci asa rae leo, ho aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: and it came to pass, that as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of god, he stood by the lake of gennesaret.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu sebhe dano galilea. dhèu ae mai sèna ka neo nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. rèngu mai toke ra kalibhu rare yesus.

source_text: and saw two boats standing by the lake: but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
target_text: padètu dènge era èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pamèu pèku ra ètu dedha nebhe. ka yesus nèdhi koha dua bua dhu panahu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and he entered into one of the boats, which was simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. and he sat down, and taught the people out of the boat.
target_text: cue nèti koha se, unu simon. èle ka, yesus ca'e asa dedha koha ne, ka na manèngi sèna ka simon tob'e asa era marèma ciki. hèia na madhèdi ho aj'a dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: now when he had left speaking, he said to simon, lanch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
target_text: aj'a nare, hèia na padhai lii dènge simon, peka na, simon! padedha hari ku asa d'ara marèma, ho core pèku la'a. te èèna na miu abhu i'a ae.

source_text: and simon answering said to him, master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing; nevertheless, at thy word i will let down the net.
target_text: ka simon dhaa, peka na, te ngaa, ama. ji'i sab'a d'ai madhe d'ara camèd'a kateme kèna, te abhu boe ci'u sa hèi! te ngaa lula ama ku peka le sèmi èèna, ja'a madhutu! ja'a papuru sèku.

source_text: and when they had done this, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net broke.
target_text: hèia ra papuru pèku. ropa ra neo ère paca'e hari, re'a boe na pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a, ka mulai mae.

source_text: and they beckoned to their partners, who were in the other boat, that they should come and help them. and they came, and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.
target_text: hèia simon rodhe angalai na ètu koha leo sèra, ho mai bara rèngu ère pèku. ka ra da'u i'a tao asa d'ara koha, toke koha dua bua se pènu dènge i'a, ka oe cène.

source_text: when simon peter saw it, he fell down at jesus' knees, saying, depart from me; for i am a sinful man, o lord. for he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken: and so was also james and john the sons of zebedee, who were partners with simon. and jesus said to simon, fear not: from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
target_text: angalai simon se, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, ana nèti sabadeus, ètu era èèna kahèi. rèngu se malaa, lula ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna. ropa simon petrus ladhe nèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, hèia na patitu dènge ka, kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus, hèia na peka, ja'a ne, ca dhèu dhu ue le sasala ae-ae. de be'a risi, lamatua padètu ia ka dènge ja'a. te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, simon! pangee ia ka j'ara ne'e, te ja'a neo pake miu se. miu tema le tenge i'a. te ngaa deo ne'e ne, ja'a aj'a miu sèna ka tenge dhèu ho madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and when they had brought their boats to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
target_text: èle ka, rèngu nuni dènge ka koha ra asa dedha nebhe. ka lasi tèke eele ka ngaa-ngaa ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold, a man full of leprosy: who seeing jesus, fell on his face, and besought him, saying, lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
target_text: ètu rae èci, yesus paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu ngi'u na pènu dènge èi papèd'a kusta. ropa dhèu ne nèdhi yesus, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u d'ai rai. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sue ku ja'a laa! te ja'a ke'a, na, ama bisa puri-pa'èle papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a. sad'i ama mo'o.

source_text: and he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, i will: be thou clean. and immediately the leprosy departed from him.
target_text: ka yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ho g'ag'e ne. aa na peka, ja'a ko'o! èu èle dènge kèna! ropa na padhai lii nare, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge.

source_text: and he charged him to tell no man: but go, and show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as moses commanded for a testimony to them.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e ne, peka na, baku bhèlu, ee! èu èle le, te ngaa baku peka dènge dhèu èci sa! èu hud'i madhutu uuru ku paredha baki musa. de lamu asa ama agama, ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a èi papèd'a ne èle tare'a, do dhae. èle èèna na, èu hia mèdha èci sèmi tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, èu ne èle tare'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: but so much the more a fame of him went abroad: and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
target_text: masi ka yesus kai, te ngaa lii lolo nèti koasa na, pale-lème nèti dhèu èci asa èci d'ai mia-mia. ka dhèu mai sèmi tao cèci sa, ho ra nanene na aj'a-nori. hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a ra.

source_text: and he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
target_text: te ngaa catèka-catèka, yesus d'èi kahèi patalele iisi, ho la'e manèngi-mangaj'i asa era dhu kaliu.

source_text: and it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, who had come out of every town of galilee, and judea, and jerusalem: and the power of the lord was present to heal them.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu cue. lod'o èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge pèri-pèri mese agama, mai ho nanene lii padhai na. dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae ètu propensi galilea, propensi yudea, dènge kota yerusalem. ama lamatua hia yesus koasa, sèna ka pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: and behold, men brought in a bed a man who was taken with the palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him. and when they could not find by what way they might bring him in, because of the multitude, they went upon the house-top, and let him down through the tiling with his couch, into the midst before jesus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri ded'e rèti dhèu karuku èci ètu dedha karad'a. rèngu tenge-tenge j'ara, sèna ka yesus puri-pa'èle ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ne, dhèu sèmi tao cacèci sa, ka rèngu bisa boe pasuki asa d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ra ded'e dhèu ne asa kolo èmu. rare dedha, ka ra bèdi eele rèu èmu, sèna ka tao ro'a, ho dulu dhèu karuku ne dènge karad'a kateme asa haha la'e. ra dulu dhèu ne'e asa talora aae dhèu ae-ae se, lèke mola-mola ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and when he saw their faith, he said to him, man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
target_text: ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus ne'a, na, rèngu se parcaya, na, nèngu bisa pa'èle angalai ra nèti karuku na. ka na lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a saku pamèu le sasala èu.

source_text: and the scribes and the pharisees began to reason, saying, who is this who speaketh blasphemies? who can forgive sins but god alone?
target_text: ropa tadèngi yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka dhèu parisi dènge mese agama sèra, pakarèi, na, eeh! dhoka ama lamatua dhu dènge hak di, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. cee ka nèngu ne, ka na tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua! ne'e ne pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua!

source_text: but when jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering, said to them, what reason ye in your hearts?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a d'ai d'ara rèngu. hèia na peka, nga tao ka miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua?

source_text: which is easier, to say, thy sins are forgiven thee; or to say, rise and walk? but that ye may know that the son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, he said to the sick with the palsy, i say to thee, arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thy house.
target_text: ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a ne dènge hak kahèi, ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe ja'a lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, ‘ja'a abho le sasala èu, ' miu mèdhi boe koasa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka na, ‘kèd'i ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka. ' ladhe nèngu kèd'i dènge ka, na, miu heka mèdhi koasa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ka na piku asa dhèu karuku ne, aa lii, peka na, titu ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: and immediately he arose before them, and took up that on which he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu ne kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, ka kèpe nare karad'a na. hèia na lèpa ka dènge koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and they were all amazed, and they glorified god, and were filled with fear, saying, we have seen strange things to-day.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i se malaa. ka ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, lamatua kapai risi eele! deo ne'e ne, èdhi tèdhi le dènge musi madha èdhi unu ti, tadha malaa dhu kapai!

source_text: and after these things he went forth, and saw a publican named levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said to him, follow me.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe nèdhi dhèu roro bea ca dhèu, dhu madhèdi ètu era roro doi bea. ngara dhèu ne, lewi. ka yesus peka dènge ne, mai ka madhutu ja'a!

source_text: and he left all, arose, and followed him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii paroa ne, hèia lewi kèd'i dènge ka, tèke eele aa'i-aa'i sèra, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and levi made him a great feast in his own house; and there was a great company of publicans, and of others that sat down with them.
target_text: èle ka, lewi tao tatao kapai ètu èmu na, ka na nèru yesus. aa na nèru kahèi angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, dènge tamu-tamu dhu leo ho lasi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: but their scribes and pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
target_text: te ngaa pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge mese-mese agama, ka'uu-kamuki mi ana madhutu yesus, aku rèngu na, tasamia ka miu mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku boe, nuka dhèu roro bea, dènge dhèu karehe sèra? dhèu be'a bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa!

source_text: and jesus answering, said to them, they that are well need not a physician; but they that are sick.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge rèngu, peka na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii. te ngaa dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe.

source_text: i came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
target_text: mamai ja'a ne, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu karehe sèra. te ngaa ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu ngee na, ngi'u ra mola le.

source_text: and they said to him, why do the disciples of john fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
target_text: hèia dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge mese-mese agama ka'ugu mi yesus, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, rèngu tema puasa dènge sabaj'a. ana-ana madhutu dhèu parisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka, ana madhutu ama sèra, loe boe dènge ra'a-rinu? rèngu se re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: and he said to them, can ye make the children of the bride-chamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
target_text: ka na dhaa pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao pesta kab'i, dhèu-dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, bisa boe puasa, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna, dènge rèngu era, tatu rèngu ra'a palere aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then they will fast in those days.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu leo rai rèti mone dhu kab'i ne, hèia angalai na susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: and he spoke also a parable to them: no man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old: if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new, agreeth not with the old.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu mèka dhèu dhu rare bèla hiu ca'èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ladhe base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a èèna karuku, na kodho ne asa mae aae.

source_text: and no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles will perish. but new wine must be put into new bottles, and both are preserved.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhua dhu heka rèti nèti kapua, dhèu bhori boe asa sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha madhore eele, aa dhua èèna soli soo-soo asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu, hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu. sèmi èèna ka, yesus aj'a si, peka na, lii aj'a na dhu hiu bisa boe pab'ali dènge lii aj'a dhu dhui nèti dhèu parisi.

source_text: no man also having drank old wine, immediately desireth new: for he saith, the old is better.
target_text: dhèu dhu rinu rèdhi le èi anggor dhui, d'èi boe rinu dhu hiu. te dhu re'a na, ‘èi anggor dhu kee risi nuka èi anggor dhui! '

source_text: and it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through corn-fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, kako re j'ara ètu sebhe oka dhèu. ka ana madhutu na puru are-gandum dhu ètu madha rèngu sèra. hèia ra sarod'e d'ara kacui-aai, ka ra'a.

source_text: and certain of the pharisees said to them, why do ye that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath-days?
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus tao sèmi èèna, ka ra kai ne, peka na, tasamia ka ana-ana èu se sisu atora agama èdhi? rèngu sab'a lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a! ladhe ku laa! rèngu puru are-gandum nèi. baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: and jesus answering them, said, have ye not read so much as this, what david did, when himself was hungry, and they who were with him; how he went into the house of god, and took and ate the show-bread, and gave also to them that were with him, which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia, ee? miu sanèd'e lii lolo baki daud? daud dènge dhèu madhutu na lula manganga ae, ka maso lasi asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. hèia ra'e roti dhu ama agama hia le lamatua. te ngaa roti se'e dhodhoka ama agama di dhu bisa ra'e. dhèu leo bisa boe. ka baki daud si ra'e, te ngaa ca dhèu sa peka boe, na, rèngu sale. miu se, sèmi baca mèdhi boe sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua!

source_text: and he said to them, that the son of man is lord also of the sabbath.
target_text: pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète, na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a.

source_text: and it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue, and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered:
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhu leo, yesus la'e aj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci, dhu ai madhe cabèka.

source_text: and the scribes and pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the sabbath; that they might find an accusation against him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri mese agama, dènge dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dhu tenge j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. ra tatae, tao-tao na neo puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa abhu j'ara ho galaa ne ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: but he knew their thoughts, and said to the man who had the withered hand, rise, and stand forth in the midst. and he arose, and stood forth.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. nèti èèna ka, na paroa dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, aku nèngu na, angalai! mai ku. titu ètu talora aae ne! hèia la'e titu dènge ka ètu talora èèna.

source_text: then said jesus to them, i will ask you one thing; is it lawful on the sabbath-days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, ja'a karèi ku miu laa. madhutu atora agama èdhi, ngaa dhu èdhi bisa tao ètu lod'o a'ae sasab'a? èdhi tao dhu be'a, do, tao dhu karehe? hia mamuri mi dhèu, do, pa'ele iie mamuri na?

source_text: and looking around upon them all, he said to the man, stretch forth thy hand. and he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe palème rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, peka na, j'ole ai èu mai! ka na soro ai na, hèia èle dènge ka.

source_text: and they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to jesus.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu kapai se nasa titu kèna. hèia ra peka, na, èdhi tenge hari ku j'ara leo, sèna ka pamanahu ne!

source_text: and it came to pass in those days, that he went out to a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to god.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, yesus la'e sabaj'a asa ledhe èci. na sabaj'a ètu èèna camèd'a kateme.

source_text: and when it was day, he called to him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae, yesus paroa ana madhutu na. ka nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, hag'e nare canguru dua dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. dhèu dhu hag'e nare sèra, nuka:

source_text: simon whom he also named peter and andrew his brother, james and john, and philip and bartholomew,
target_text: simon dhu yesus pangare ne, ‘petrus' anderias ari simon, yakobis, yohanis ari yakobis, pelipus, bertolomeos,

source_text: matthew and thomas, james the son of alpheus, and simon called zelotes,
target_text: mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, simon nèti partei politik selot,

source_text: and judas the brother of james, and judas iscariot, who also was the traitor.
target_text: yudas ana yakobis, aa yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahia yesus.

source_text: and he came down with them, and stood in the plain; and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all judea and jerusalem, and from the sea-coast of tyre and sidon, who came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
target_text: ropa puru mai nèti ledhe deo na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, ae taha ètu era mera èci. ètu èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu pakaboko. dhèu se mai nèti propensi yudea, nèti kota yerusalem, aa nèti tirus dènge sidon, nuka dua kota ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: and they that were afflicted with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
target_text: rèngu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus, aa abhu kahèi dhu neo manèngi sèna ka na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. ka yesus pa'èle si. na pa'èle kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dènge magèle eele nidhu nèti dhèu sèra.

source_text: and the whole multitude sought to touch him; for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
target_text: dhèu ae dhu neo goi ne. te ropa goi lèke ne, dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra, lula abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti nèngu.

source_text: and he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, blessed are ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of god.
target_text: èle ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na aj'a si, aku nèngu na, dhèu unu aad'o sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, j'aj'i dhèu aae miu dhu be'a.

source_text: blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
target_text: dhèu dhu kabake manganga sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula lamatua ka dhu hia miu bècu-manèsa. dhèu dhu tangi dènge d'ara susa sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na d'ara mi karej'e.

source_text: blessed are ye when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, on account of the son of man. rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers to the prophets.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ka dhèu dhu abhu susa lula madhutu ja'a, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala rui-j'aj'èra miu ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, do pakarehe kolongara miu, do j'èli marèu miu, do bata eele miu, tao sèmi dhèu bhelu sa, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua bhèlu boe miu ètu sorga. de ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu sèmi èèna, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu! aa karae laa dènge pasoa-pasoka! mage malaa kahèi, lula dhèu dhu paj'èra miu limuri ne, bèi-baki ra dhu uru èèna, paj'èra le dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra kahèi. de ladhe miu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi sèra, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala hia miu ae-ae ètu sorga!

source_text: but woe to you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula mamuri karej'e miu, dhoka d'ai ne'e di.

source_text: woe to you that are full! for ye shall hunger. woe to you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
target_text: dhèu dhu bècu-manèsa! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula hèru manganga madèu dhu seli eele, mai salake nare miu. dhèu dhu kea rae-rae sèra! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula j'aj'èra mai, tao miu tangi ngob'i-ngob'i.

source_text: woe to you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi dhèu koa-kad'iri! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula uru sèra bèi-baki miu d'èi pad'iri kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu rèti lii leko-monya sèra!

source_text: but i say to you who hear, love your enemies, do good to them who hate you,
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! èu hud'i sue ku musu èu, aa tao pabe'a laa mi dhèu dhu tèka d'ara dènge èu.

source_text: bless them that curse you, and pray for them who despitefully use you.
target_text: sabaj'a ho manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia babe'a mi dhèu dhu dhoo èu. aa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu rupa-rupa.

source_text: and to him that smiteth thee on the one cheek, offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke, forbid not to take thy coat also.
target_text: ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, soro hari ripi cabèka ho na tèb'e. ladhe dhèu parame rare kodho pana èu, na, hia hari laa kodho èu dhu leo.

source_text: give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods, ask them not again.
target_text: ladhe dhèu manèngi mèdha èu èci, hia laa. aa ladhe dhèu ded'e rèti mèdha èu èci, soro tèke sène. mage mu manèngi hari!

source_text: and as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
target_text: èu hud'i tao ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu neo dhèu tao mi ngi'u èu.

source_text: for if ye love them who love you, what thanks have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
target_text: èu d'èi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu èu mesa mu. èèna be'a. te ngaa kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu sue dhèu rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and if ye do good to them who do good to you, what thanks have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
target_text: ladhe èu pabe'a dhoka dènge dhèu dhu be'a dènge èu di, kolo-karisi ètu mia? te dhèu bhelu sèra, re'a b'ala babe'a dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and if ye lend to them from whom ye hope to receive, what thanks have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much in return.
target_text: ladhe èu dhodhoka hia pija mi dhèu dhu bisa pula hari doi èu, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu kahèi re'a hia dhèu leo pija doi, sad'i bèli-camèd'a sèmi aa'i hari dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: but love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the highest: for he is kind to the unthankful and to the evil.
target_text: te ngaa dhu lèke ka, sèmi ne'e: sue la musu èu sèra! aa tao la be'a mi rèngu. ngaa dhu ra parluu, hia si pija. baku pangee, na, ra pula hari do aad'o. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na ama lamatua b'ala èu. pe èu j'aj'i ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. lula mamuri èu sama sèmi ama mu, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue j'ara hua iia hia dhèu bhelu. nèngu d'èi kahèi tao j'ara hua iia hia dhèu dhu re'a boe manèngi makasi.

source_text: be ye therefore merciful, as your father also is merciful.
target_text: de èu hud'i pad'elo ku kasia mi dhèu, nuka sèmi ama mu ètu sorga dhu pad'elo kasia na mi èu.

source_text: judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii aj'a na, peka na, baku lee dhèu, sèna ka dhèu baku lee hari èu. baku kahèti leli lii padhai dhèu, te aad'o na dhèu tao hari èu sèmi èèna kahèi. pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku nui sasala èu.

source_text: give, and it shall be given to you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. for with the same measure that ye give to others, it shall be measured to you again.
target_text: ladhe èu hia dhèu ngaa dhu ra parluu, pe èu abhu hari. te bèli-camèd'a ra hia hari èu pènu ai. èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu isi kab'ui asa d'ara balee a'uku, ka ra karèko ne, aa cèci ne, toke bua lale eele. dhu èu abhu, sama èci èèna ka. ladhe èu hia ciki, èu abhu hari ciki kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èu hia ae, èu abhu hari ae-ae.

source_text: and he spoke a parable to them; can the blind lead the blind? will they not both fall into the ditch?
target_text: yesus aj'a pake lii upama kahèi. na lole, peka na, dhèu bèdhu bisa boe pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu bèdhu dhu leo. te aad'o na, dua ra manahu asa d'ara ro'a lasi!

source_text: the disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect, shall be as his master.
target_text: ana sakola bisa boe mèu risi nèti mese na! te ngaa ladhe na madhutu dènge be'a lii a'aj'a mese na, nèngu bisa j'aj'i sama sèmi mese na.

source_text: and why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thy own eye?
target_text: èu pa'èki more sasala dhèu, masi ka ana iiki-iiki èèna ka. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu sèmi pame'a boe sa. èèna, nuka sèmi èu mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu musi madha dhèu. masi ka agarii aae dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, te ngaa èu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa!

source_text: either how canst thou say to thy brother, brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thy eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thy own eye? thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thy own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
target_text: tasamia ka èu bani peka dènge angalai mu, na, ‘mai, ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu. ' te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe ladhe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, te agarii dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu! weeh! èu ne, mema dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! tao eele uru ku agarii nèti d'ara madha èu, heka èu ladhe mèdhi, ho tiu eele ahu ca katèd'a èèna, nèti d'ara madha angalai mu.

source_text: for a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
target_text: ka yesus tabha lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu ètu mia, aj'u be'a, ladhe d'ai lod'o hua, hua na karehe. aa abhu boe ladhe aj'u karehe na hua, hua na be'a.

source_text: for every tree is known by its own fruit: for from thorns men do not gather figs, nor from a bramble bush do they gather grapes.
target_text: dhèu bisa tadhe ladhe aj'u ca kapua, be'a do aad'o, mai nèti hua na. dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, peka na, ètu mia dhèu puu lolobhangi, do, hua anggor nèti aj'u padhudhu.

source_text: a good man out of the good treasure of his heart, bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart, bringeth forth that which is evil: for from the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, ne'a tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'ara kaj'alu, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu-katub'a. te nèti lii padhai na, èdhi bisa tadhe babe'a-karehe dhèu.

source_text: and why call ye me lord, lord, and do not the things which i say?
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, miu se loe boe paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua'. te ngaa tasamia ka miu mo'o boe tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a?

source_text: whoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, i will show you to whom he is like.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene lii padhai ja'a, ho na tao madhutu, nèngu ne èci èèna ka

source_text: he is like a man who built a house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu dhu èra. na kèi ro'a fanderen toke abhu hadhu. hèia na padhèdi fanderen, heka na patitu èmu kèna. ladhe èi aae lala, èmu ne gaged'o boe sa hèi, lula era padhèdi na èra.

source_text: but he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that, without a foundation, built a house on the earth, against which the stream beat vehemently, and immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house was great.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nanene dènge d'ara kajari, aa madhutu boe lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu sad'i j'aj'i di. na tao boe fanderen, te ngaa na patitu èmu na ètu dedha rai ètu sebhe loko. hèia ropa èi aae lala, èmu na guri laho mae-mae!

source_text: now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into capernaum.
target_text: ropa aj'a nare, ka yesus lèpa asa kota kapernaum.

source_text: and a certain centurion's servant, who was dear to him, was sick, and ready to die.
target_text: ca dhèu komedhaa sordad'u roma pea ètu ne'e. abhu dhèu sab'a na èci dhu nèngu parcaya. dhèu sab'a ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: and when he heard of jesus, he sent to him the elders of the jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
target_text: lod'o èèna, komedhaa tadèngi le tatao yesus, hèia na pua dhèu heka yahudi pèri-pèri lasi manèngi yesus mai puri dhèu sab'a ne.

source_text: and when they came to jesus, they besought him earnestly, saying, that he was worthy for whom he should do this:
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra pamako yesus, sèna ka na la'e palere dènge rèngu. ra manèngi, peka na, dhèu roma ne, dhèu be'a! ama hud'i tolong ne.

source_text: for he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
target_text: te nèngu ka patitu èmu sabaj'a cue hia ji'i, lula na sue èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: then jesus went with them. and when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, lord, trouble not thyself: for i am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof;
target_text: ka yesus madhutu dènge si. rèngu dhae rare mèka èmu, te ngaa komedhaa ne pua le angalai na la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama roca ia ka mai asa d'ara èmu ja'a, te ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a.

source_text: wherefore neither thought i myself worthy to come to thee; but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed. for i also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and i say to one, go, and he goeth; and to another, come, and he cometh; and to my servant, do this, and he doeth it.
target_text: aa ja'a nia boe kahèi ara dhiu asa katanga madha ama. ja'a ke'a ama dènge koasa. de sad'i ama padhai lii nèti èèna, tatu dhèu sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ja'a ke'a j'ara ne'e ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi ho paredha sordad'u ja'a. ladhe ja'a hia paredha mi sordad'u ja'a, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘mai sa ne'e' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a pua dhèu sab'a ja'a, ‘sab'a ne'e' tatu na sab'a madhutu kahèi. de sad'i ama padhai lii di, dhèu sab'a ja'a ne, èle dènge.

source_text: when jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned himself about and said to the people that followed him, i say to you, i have not found so great faith, no, not in israel.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, yesus malaa. ka na kabib'a sa dhèu ae dhu madhutu na sèra, hèia na peka, nia kahèi nga! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a paraga kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: and they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant well that had been sick.
target_text: de yesus d'ai dhoka era èèna di. hèia angalai komedhaa se lèpa. ropa d'ai èmu komedhaa, ladhe na, dhèu sab'a ne èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called nain: and many of his disciples went with him, and many people.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, pakèd'i lasi asa rae èci, ngara na nain. dhèu ae kako palere dènge ne.

source_text: now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and many people of the city were with her.
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu dènge hèb'a tedhe maso asa rae ne, ra paraga dènge dhèu ca nau lasi padhane dhèu madhe. dhèu madhe ne, ana mone mesa nèti ca dhèu bhèni balu.

source_text: and when the lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, weep not.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi bhèni balu ne, ka d'ara na roe. hèia na lii dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, ina! tangi ia ka!

source_text: and he came and touched the bier: and they that bore him stood still. and he said, young man, i say to thee, arise.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e padètu-dètu, ka na g'ag'e karad'a dhèu madhe ne. ka dhèu dhu pasae karad'a ne titu taha. hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu madhe, aku nèngu na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and he that was dead sat up, and began to speak, and he delivered him to his mother.
target_text: ka ana ne mamuri hari, hèia na kèd'i madhèdi. èle èèna ka, na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae dhu titu reo rare ne. aa yesus peka dènge bhèni balu ne, aku nèngu na, ina! ana mu ka ne'e.

source_text: and there came a fear on all: and they glorified god, saying, that a great prophet hath risen among us; and, that god hath visited his people.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra madha'u titu kèna! ka ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua pua le ca dhèu na dhu kapai risi, dhu nèti lii padhai na hia èdhi! abhu hari dhu leo, peka na, ama lamatua mai le ètu talora aae èdhi, ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na!

source_text: and this rumor of him went forth throughout all judea, and throughout all the neighboring region.
target_text: hèia lii lolo ne, ra palolo d'ai mia-mia ètu propensi yudea dènge era leo kahèi.

source_text: and the disciples of john informed him of all these things. and john calling two of his disciples sent them to jesus, saying, art thou he that should come? or look we for another? when the men had come to him, they said, john the baptist hath sent us to thee, saying, art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
target_text: ana madhutu yohanis tadèngi aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu yesus ad'u-ue. ka lasi lole dènge yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. hèia na pua dhèu dua lasi, ho karèi ne, peka na, ama ne tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ji'i mate tae-tae, do? do, ji'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? èle ka ra paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: and in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities, and diseases, and of evil spirits; and to many that were blind he gave sight.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se ètu èèna, yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti papèd'a ra. na bata eele nidhu nèti dhèu. aa na pa'èle dhèu bèdhu, ka rèdhi hari.

source_text: then jesus answering, said to them, go, and tell john what things ye have seen and heard; that the blind see, the lame walk, lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, lèpa ka ho mi peka dènge a'a ku yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi dènge mèdhi unu mi, sèmi dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, ‘dhèu bèdhu rèdhi hari. dhèu karuku, kèd'i ho kako hari. dhèu pèd'a kusta, isi ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, tadèngi hari. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, nanene lii lolo be'a. '

source_text: and blessed is he, to whom i shall not be a stumbling block.
target_text: lami ho peka kahèi dènge a'a ku yohanis, na, ‘dhèu dhu makae boe sèmi rare ja'a, rèngu abhu a'oto. '

source_text: and when the messengers of john had departed, he began to speak to the people concerning john, what went ye out into the wilderness to see? a reed shaken with the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra lula-nèti yohanis, na, lod'o miu lami tenge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a èèna, miu pangee, na, paraga dènge dhèu dhu lalole na sèmi ngaa? tatu miu lami boe ho paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aai-roe èèla, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu lai ngèlu di!

source_text: but what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they who are gorgeously appareled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
target_text: tatu lami boe ho ladhe dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna, era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: but what went ye out to see? a prophet? yes, i say to you, and much more than a prophet.
target_text: de miu lami tenge dhèu cee ètu nèi? miu pangee na lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, do? tare'a! te nèngu risi nèti ca dhèu nèti padhai lii lamatua.

source_text: this is he, concerning whom it is written, behold, i send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke le, na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: for i say to you, among those that are born of women, there is not a greater prophet than john the baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of god, is greater than he.
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis. te ngaa dhèu dhu ana iiki-iiki ètu talora aae dhèu unu ama lamatua, kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: and all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified god, being baptized with the baptism of john.
target_text: dhèu dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu re'a le, peka na, j'ara lamatua èèna, j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu roro bea sèra. lula rèngu uru èèna abhu sarani aa nanene kahèi lii aj'a-nori nèti yohanis.

source_text: but the pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of god against themselves, being not baptized by him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi sèra, ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi boe yohanis sarani si.

source_text: and the lord said, to what then shall i liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, ja'a pakasame dhèu-dhèu taa limuri se'e dènge ngaa? dhèu sèmi ngaa ka see?

source_text: they are like children sitting in the market-place, and calling one to another, and saying, we have piped to you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
target_text: rèngu se, èci èèna ka dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. ra re'a dhoka pa'oo-parodha dènge ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino, te ngaa miu roge boe dènge karej'e. aa ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: for john the baptist came neither eating bread, nor drinking wine; and ye say, he hath a demon.
target_text: te, yohanis tuka sarani ninu boe èi anggor, aa na d'èi puasa, miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘nèngu ne nidhu tao! '

source_text: the son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, behold, a gluttonous man, and a wine-bibber, a friend of publicans and sinners.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tema kinu èi anggor dènge ku'a roti. ka miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘dhèu ne, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! aa tema mahu! pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! aa partei èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe! dhu ne'a heka ngi'u na! '

source_text: but wisdom is justified by all her children.
target_text: te ngaa mi patadhe lii ja'a ne! dhèu dhu re'a mèu, tatu rèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: and one of the pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. and he went into the pharisee's house, and sat down at table.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota ne, abhu dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na simon. ca lod'o, na nèru yesus si mai ra'a asa èmu nèngu. hèia yesus si lasi madhèdi, ka neo ra'a.

source_text: and behold, a woman in the city, who was a sinner, when she knew that jesus sat at table in the pharisee's house, brought an alabaster-box of ointment,
target_text: lod'o èèna, bhèni kajeo ca dhèu tadèngi kahèi, na, yesus si neo ra'a-rinu ètu èèna. ka na maso la'e, nèd'u dènge èi hèu mèngi ca boto dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: and stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
target_text: na mai padètu dènge yesus re kabodho na. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu haga yesus. na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, toke èi madha na hae lèke haga yesus. ka na seka haga yesus pake rèu kètu na, aa na loe boe uu haga yesus kahèi. èle ka, na pasuti èi hèu mèngi èèna mi haga yesus.

source_text: now when the pharisee who had invited him, saw it, he spoke within himself, saying, this man, if he were a prophet, would have known who, and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him, for she is a sinner.
target_text: simon ne'a mèu j'ara mamuri bhèni ne. nèti èèna ka, na pajiko ètu d'ara na, ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha, na, yesus ne, dhèu dhu nèti boe lii padhai ama lamatua! ladhe tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ka dhu pua ne mai, tatu nèngu ne'a, na, bhèni dhu g'ag'e nèngu ne, bhèni kajeo. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, sèmi boe nèngu ne, lula dhèu mola-mèci bisa boe padètu dènge dhèu kaj'alu!

source_text: and jesus answering, said to him, simon, i have somewhat to say to thee. and he saith, master, speak.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu simon ngee. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, simon! sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo peka dènge èu ca j'ara. hèia simon dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama mese, peka laa.

source_text: there was a certain creditor, who had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
target_text: ka yesus core lii, peka na, abhu ca dhèu dhu tema hia dhèu pija doi na. uru èèna, na hia nèdhi dhèu dua pija doi na. dhèu èci, abhu lèmi ngasu doi iia, aa ca dhèu hari lèmi nguru di.

source_text: and when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
target_text: te ngaa d'ai lod'o pula doi se'e, dua ra bisa boe b'ae rare. ka dhèu dhu hia pija, rasa kasia mi rèngu dua ra. nèti èèna ka, na peka mi dua ra, sèna ka b'ae ia ka kèlu ra sèra. de madhutu èu, nèti dhèu dua se, cee ka dhu sue risi dhèu tema hia dhèu pija doi ne?

source_text: simon answered and said, i suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. and he said to him, thou hast rightly judged.
target_text: ètu d'ara ciki oo'e na kahèi, simon dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu kèlu na ae risi! ka yesus dhaa, na, mema tare'a!

source_text: and he turned to the woman, and said to simon, seest thou this woman? i entered into thy house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe bhèni ne, hèia na peka dènge simon, aku nèngu na, èu ladhe sèku bhèni ne. deo na ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu tèke boe èi sèna ka rase haga ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa bhèni ne pabasa haga ja'a dènge èi madha na, ka na seka pake rèu kètu na.

source_text: thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman, since the time i came in, hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
target_text: aa ropa èu soru ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu uu boe ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa karèi nèti ja'a ètu d'ara èmu èu, bhèni ne loe boe uu haga ja'a.

source_text: my head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
target_text: èu bhèlu eele ad'a dhu palona èi hèu mèngi mi kètu tamu, ropa ja'a mai deo na. te ngaa bhèni ne bhori le èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua titu kèna mi haga ja'a.

source_text: wherefore i say to thee, her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
target_text: èu nanene paie! sasala bhèni ne, mema ae. te ngaa lamatua saku eele aa'i le, lula na pad'elo le sasue na dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ja'a. te ngaa bagi dhèu dhu rasa na tao boe sasala ae, nèngu ngee na parluu boe abhu abho ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, nèngu ne'a boe sue aa ne'a boe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and he said to her, thy sins are forgiven.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge bhèni ne, peka na, ja'a saku eele le sasala èu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: and they that sat at table with him, began to say within themselves, who is this that forgiveth sins also?
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ra'a palere-lere, paka'uu, aku rèngu na, huuh! na ngee na, nèngu ne cee? ! na bani titu kèna saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu! j'ara ne'e ne dhodhoka ama lamatua mesa na, dhu dènge hak ho saku eele sasala dhèu!

source_text: and he said to the woman, thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu lèka le ja'a, nèti èèna ka lamatua hia le èu mamuri. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: and it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and showing the glad tidings of the kingdom of god: and the twelve were with him,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae ètu sèra. la'e lolo dènge dhèu dad'èi ama lamatua. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and certain women, who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, mary called magdalene, out of whom went seven demons.
target_text: ètu d'ara kaboko rèngu, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu. bhèni se dhu uru èèna abhu rupa-rupa papèd'a, aa cahag'e dhu nidhu tao. te ngaa yesus ka dhu puri-pa'èle aa'i si. nuka sèmi maria nèti rae magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus bata eele pidhu nidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: and joanna the wife of chuza herod's steward, and susanna, and many others, who ministered to him of their substance.
target_text: abhu kahèi susana, dènge mama yohana. yohana ne, dhèu èmu kusa. kusa ne, kapala urusan nèti èmu dhèu aae herodes. aa abhu ae kahèi bhèni leo dhu lasi palere-lere dènge yesus si. bhèni se pake doi-dhari rèngu mesa ra ho ogo yesus si ètu j'ara.

source_text: and when many people were collected, and had come to him out of every city, he spoke by a parable:
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu mai nèti rae-rae ho tenge yesus. ropa dhèu ae se pakaboko, hèia na lolo dènge ra pake lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: a sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
target_text: abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu la'e ceb'e hini asa d'ara oka na. hini se cahag'e lèke ètu j'ara. ropa dhèu kako re èèna, j'èli lèke hini se. aa manu-bhui mai ka tutu ra'e aa'i.
