target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus èci, ngara na yudas iskariot, dhu èèna na pahie yesus, ka'ugu aku nèngu na,

source_text: why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
target_text: wee! nga tao ka nèngu pahie boe èi hèu mèngi ne? te kab'ua na nuka sèmi gaji dhèu èci d'ara ca tèu. be'a risi pahie, sèna ka kab'ua na pabagi mi dhèu unu aad'o sèra!

source_text: this he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bore what was put in it.
target_text: aa te ngaa yudas peka sèmi ne'e ne lula boe nèti nèngu sue dhèu-dhèu unu aad'o. te ngaa lula nèngu, dhèu mana'u. nèngu ne dhu tèke doi yesus si, te ngaa ae ka dhu huni nare nèti d'ara kas.

source_text: then said jesus, let her alone: against the day of my burial hath she kept this.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa bhèni ne tao sèmi ne'e. te nèngu dhu tèke èi hèu mèngi ne, sèna ka lalau ngi'u aae ja'a ho ra padhane ja'a.

source_text: for the poor ye have always with you; but me ye have not always.
target_text: dhèu unu aad'o dhu bera-bera dènge miu. te ngaa ja'a ne bèli-camèd'a aad'o heka ètu talora miu.

source_text: many people of the jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came, not for jesus' sake only, but that they might see lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
target_text: èle èèna, dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu re'a, na, yesus ètu rae betania. ka dhèu se mai neo rèdhi ne, aa neo rèdhi lasarus kahèi. te rèngu tadèngi le, na, yesus pamamuri hari le lasarus nèti mamadhe.

source_text: but the chief priests consulted that they might put lazarus also to death;
target_text: te ngaa kètu-kètu agama padhue ho neo pamadhe lasarus.

source_text: because that by reason of him many of the jews went away, and believed on jesus.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi ae dhu tadèngi le lii palolo lula-nèti lasarus ne, ka dhèu se parcaya yesus. rèngu se ro'o heka nanene ama-ama dhèu yahudi.

source_text: on the next day, many people that had come to the feast, when they heard that jesus was coming to jerusalem,
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu ae dhu mai madhutu kalela paska ètu kota yerusalem, tadèngi, na, yesus neo mai asa era ne'e kahèi.

source_text: took branches of palm-trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, hosanna; blessed is the king of israel that cometh in the name of the lord.
target_text: ka lasi pare rèu palam ho pake soru mamai yesus, sama sèmi nèngu ne, dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. hèia ra pa'oo aa'i-aa'i ra, aku rèngu na, hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! te lamatua paj'uj'u d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu aae isra'el, dhu nèti kolongara lamatua!

source_text: and jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
target_text: ka yesus abhu badha keled'ei èni ci'u, hèia na manya'e. se'e se j'aj'i nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na,

source_text: fear not, daughter of sion: behold, thy king cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
target_text: miu dhèu kota yerusalem, baku madha'u! miu dhèu kota ‘sion' se, ladhe ku asa nèi! te dhèu aae miu nuka mai nèi! nèngu mai manya'e keled'ei èni ci'u.

source_text: these things his disciples understood not at the first: but when jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written concerning him, and that they had done these things to him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus re'a mèka sasoa nèti j'ara se'e se. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ropa yesus mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na, aa ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha, rèngu heka sanèd'e j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti nèngu ne. rèngu sanèd'e kahèi tatao dhèu ae se mi dedha yesus.

source_text: the people therefore that were with him when he called lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bore testimony.
target_text: lod'o yesus pamamuri hari lasarus nèti mamadhe, hèia na paroa ne kalua nèti ro'a dhèu madhe èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu sama-sama dènge yesus. de limuri ne rèngu lolo palème lula-nèti ngaa dhu uru èèna rèngu rèdhi dènge musi madha ra.

source_text: for this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa yesus padètu dènge yerusalem, dhèu ae mai soru ne lula rèngu tadèngi le, na, nèngu ka dhu tao tadha malaa èèna.

source_text: the pharisees therefore said among themselves, perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu parisi peka, na, peeh! ladhe ku laa! dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, parai-oru ho neo madhutu ne! bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu j'èra! ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, èdhi tao tasamia hari?

source_text: and there were certain greeks among them, that came to worship at the feast.
target_text: abhu dhèu yunani pèri-pèri dhu mai asa kota yerusalem palere-lere dènge dhèu leo, ho neo madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. ètu èèna, rèngu neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: the same came therefore to philip, who was of bethsaida of galilee, and desired him, saying, sir, we would see jesus.
target_text: hèia dhèu se mai paraga dènge pelipus, dhu rae nèngu ka betsaida ètu propensi galilea. ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ji'i neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: philip cometh and telleth andrew: and again, andrew and philip tell jesus.
target_text: ka pelipus la'e peka dènge anderias. hèia dua ra lasi peka dènge yesus.

source_text: and jesus answered them, saying, the hour is come, that the son of man should be glorified. verily, verily, i say to you, except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lod'o ja'a d'ai kèna. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, heka ama lamatua neo ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a kèna. tare'a sèmi èèna! èdhi pakasame ku dènge hini èci. ladhe èdhi sèle hini ca lamusi, na, hini ne ele iie uuru ku dènge j'ara boho ètu d'ara rai, heka na muri mai, hèia na hia hua-hela ae-ae kèna. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, hini èèna cue dhoo-dhoo di.

source_text: he that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it to life eternal.
target_text: dhèu dhu pahae boe dad'èi ama lamatua, lula nèngu sue ae mamuri na ètu rai-haha ne, èèna na mamuri na ele iie d'ara. te ngaa dhèu dhu sadia tèke eele mamuri rai-haha na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: if any man serve me, let him follow me; and where i am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my father honor.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo sab'a hia ja'a, nèngu hud'i madhutu ja'a taruu. ja'a ètu mia, na, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a ètu èèna kahèi. te ladhe abhu dhèu dhu sab'a hia ja'a, èèna na ama ku ètu sorga pakab'ua nèngu.

source_text: now is my soul troubled; and what shall i say? father, save me from this hour: but for this cause i came to this hour.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, d'ara ja'a susa titu kèna. te ngaa ja'a neo peka ngaa hari? ja'a hud'i manèngi ku, peka na, ‘ama! patabuli ja'a, sèna ka ja'a baku madhe ku d'ara lai-lai ne, ' do? bisa boe! ja'a manèngi boe sèmi èèna, lula nèngu pua ja'a mai sèna ka madhe.

source_text: father, glorify thy name. then came there a voice from heaven, saying, i have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
target_text: de dhu ja'a manèngi ka, ‘ama. hud'i laa ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama. ' hèia lii èci nèti dedha-liru peka na, ja'a ded'e padedha-dedha le kolongara ja'a. aa ja'a neo ded'e padedha-dedha hari kolongara ja'a.

source_text: the people therefore that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered. others said, an angel spoke to him.
target_text: ka dhèu ae dhu titu ètu sèra sa, tadèngi lii ne'e kahèi, hèia ra peka na, ira ii! d'oro nga! cahag'e hari peka na, aad'o! ana pajuu lamatua èci nèti sorga padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: jesus answered and said, this voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
target_text: te ngaa yesus padhai lii dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, lii deo na, lii hia miu, hia boe ja'a.

source_text: now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
target_text: limuri ne, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne hud'i lasi asa madha ama lamatua, sèna ka na pama'ète lii langu rèngu. lamatua neo babège eele kahèi dhèu bhelu dhu paredha ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and i, if i shall be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men to me.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ded'e ka ja'a ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, pe ja'a ère kore dhèu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ra parcaya ja'a.

source_text: this he said, signifying what death he should die.
target_text: na padhai lii sèmi ne'e, ho peka j'ara mamadhe na.

' te nèngu ne, cee?

source_text: then jesus said to them, yet a little while is the light with you. walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, na, nèbhu heka saraa ja'a, d'elo heka miu. de lod'o ja'a dènge miu era, miu hud'i mamuri mola ku, sèna ka bhabhelu-katub'a baku hutu nare saraa dhu ètu d'ara miu. te dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara maroga, ne'a boe la'e asa mia.

source_text: while ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. these things spoke jesus, and departed, and concealed himself from them.
target_text: lod'o saraa ja'a ne era, miu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a, sèna ka miu j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa, ho me'a, na, miu neo lami mia. ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia la'e tèke eele dhèu se'e, sèna ka nèngu mesa-mesa na.

source_text: but though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
target_text: masi ka yesus tao le tadha malaa ae-ae ètu madha dhèu ae, te ngaa ro'o boe parcaya ne.

source_text: that the saying of isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the lord been revealed?
target_text: ne'e ne palèke dènge lii yesaya, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu suri peka na, lamatua! abhu boe dhèu dhu parcaya lii padhai ji'i! te masi ka lamatua pad'elo le koasa, te ngaa dhèu sèra ladhe rèdhi boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: therefore they could not believe, because that isaiah said again,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, limuri ne dhèu yahudi cahag'e parcaya boe lamatua, lèke sèmi dhu yesaya suri tèke ètu era leo d'ara sasuri na, peka na,

source_text: he hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and i should heal them.
target_text: ama lamatua pabèdhu le d'ara ra, sèna ka baku rèdhi ngaa-ngaa. na soro tèke d'ara ra adhu sèmi hadhu, sèna ka baku re'a mèu. soro tèke si sèmi èèna, sèna ka baku ra lèpa tenge ja'a, aa ja'a tao boe pabe'a si.

source_text: these things said isaiah, when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
target_text: yesaya peka sèmi ne'e, lula nèdhi le dadedha yesus, ka na lole mema lula-nèti yesus ne.

source_text: nevertheless, among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu ae dhu parcaya yesus. mesa boe dhèu biasa di, te abhu kahèi ama-ama dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya ne. te ngaa rèngu mangaku boe yesus ètu madha dhèu ae, lula ra madha'u, mage dhèu parisi babège eele si nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: for they loved the praise of men more than the praise of god.
target_text: ama-ama yahudi se pusi-pahae boe ho lamatua koa si, lula rèngu d'èi risi abhu koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: jesus cried, and said, he that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me:
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii dènge lii mèdhu, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, nèngu parcaya boe ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa nèngu parcaya kahèi dhèu dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: and he that seeth me, seeth him that sent me:
target_text: te dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi ja'a, na, nèngu ladhe nèdhi kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: i am come a light into the world, that whoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
target_text: ja'a mai sèna ka j'aj'i nuka sèmi saraa ètu rai-haha ne. ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a mamuri boe ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: and if any man hear my words, and believe not, i judge him not: for i came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ja'a, te ngaa madhutu boe, na, ja'a pama'ète boe hahuku na. te mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, neo boe pama'ète hahuku dhèu, te ngaa ja'a neo patabuli si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: he that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that i have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tule eele ja'a, aa d'èi boe sèmi lii holo-nori ja'a, pe na paraga dènge hakim. te d'ai èle rai-haha ne, lii holo-nori dhu ja'a lole kèdhi sèra, ka dhu pama'ète hahuku mi dedha rèngu èci-èci.

source_text: for i have not spoken from myself; but the father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what i should say, and what i should speak.
target_text: lula ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka pake kolongara ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a padhai lii kèti kolongara ama ku ètu sorga. te nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a. aa nèngu ka dhu paredha ja'a, sèna ka ja'a padhai lii ngaa.

source_text: and i know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatever i speak therefore, even as the father said to me, so i speak.
target_text: ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, lii paredha na hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. nèti èèna ka, lii padhai ja'a madhutu mola-mola ngaa dhu ama ku pua ja'a padhai lii.

source_text: now before the feast of the passover, when jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world to the father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhae d'ai mèka, yesus ne'a le, na, d'ai le lod'o ho nèngu tèke eele rai-haha ne, aa la'e hari asa ama na ètu sorga. nèngu sue titu kèna dhèu unu na ètu rai-haha ne, toke na saraka mamuri na kateme aae hia mi rèngu.

source_text: and supper being ended the devil having now put into the heart of judas iscariot, simon's son, to betray him;
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae nidhu dadugu-rariu le yudas, ana simon iskariot, sèna ka pahie eele yesus. ka yudas dhu pama'ète le, sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èèna, ropa yesus si madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu d'ara kalela paska.

source_text: jesus knowing that the father had given all things into his hands, and that he had come from god, and was going to god;
target_text: yesus ne'a mema le, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, de nèbhu heka nèngu lèpa hari la'e asa ama lamatua. aa nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ama na ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: he riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
target_text: hèia yesus kèd'i nèti mei, ka na tao eele kodho li'u na. nare bèla èci, ho èki mi lalole na.

source_text: after that, he poured water into a basin, and began to wash the disciples feet, and to wipe them with the towel with which he was girded.
target_text: ka na bhori èi asa d'ara bokor iiki cue. hèia na rase haga ana madhutu na sèra. ropa na rase pamèu nare haga dhèu èci, na seka pamango pake bèla dhu pa'èki ètu lalole na.

source_text: then he cometh to simon peter: and peter saith to him, lord, dost thou wash my feet?
target_text: na rase haga si èci-èci. ropa d'ai simon petrus, ka simon petrus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo rase haga ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: jesus answered and said to him, what i do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, deo ne'e ne, èu dhae me'a mèka ngaa dhu ja'a tao ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, èu heka me'a kèna.

source_text: peter saith to him, thou shalt never wash my feet. jesus answered him, if i wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasisu, aku nèngu na, ama baku tao sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe ama rase haga ja'a. hèia yesus peka na, ladhe ja'a rase pamèu boe haga èu, na, èu bisa boe pa'èki dènge ja'a.

source_text: simon peter saith to him, lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
target_text: ka simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, mesa boe haga di. te ngaa ama rase kacui-aai dènge kètu ja'a kahèi!

source_text: jesus saith to him, he that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is wholly clean: and ye are clean, but not all.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu diu le èi, parluu dhoka rase haga di. te ngi'u na mèu le. mema tare'a d'ara miu mèu le, te ngaa miu aa'i mi boe.

source_text: for he knew who would betray him; therefore said he, ye are not all clean.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula ne'a le cee ka dhu neo pahie ne. nèti èèna ka, na peka na, miu aa'i mi boe dhu mèu.

source_text: so after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said to them, know ye what i have done to you?
target_text: ropa yesus pamèu nare haga si, hèia na silu hari kodho na, ka madhèdi hari asa mei. ka na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, tasamia? ropa ja'a rase haga miu, miu me'a sasoa nèti dhu ja'a tao ne, do aad'o?

source_text: ye call me master, and lord: and ye say well; for so i am.
target_text: miu tema paroa ja'a ne, ‘ama mese' aa ‘lamatua'. èèna lèke kèna, lula mema hud'i sèmi èèna ku.

source_text: if i then, your lord and master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mese dènge lamatua miu ne, rase le haga miu nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha sa, na, tasamia hari dènge miu? miu hud'i lalau-lalo'o isi-aanga mi èci dènge èci; conto nuka: miu hud'i èci dènge èci rase haga mi.

source_text: for i have given you an example, that ye should do as i have done to you.
target_text: te ja'a tao le j'ara ne, sèna ka miu madhutu. ladhe ja'a tao tasamia, na, miu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: verily, verily, i say to you, the servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
target_text: ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge miu. ca dhèu ènu bisa boe risi nèti lamatua na. aa ca dhèu pajuu-paleha bisa boe risi nèti dhèu dhu pua nèngu.

source_text: if ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
target_text: lula miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, miu oto ladhe miu tao madhutu.

source_text: i speak not of you all; i know whom i have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, he that eateth bread with me, hath lifted up his heel against me.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii boe lula-nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. ja'a tadhe mèu dhèu dhu ja'a hag'e kore. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa j'ara ne hud'i j'aj'i ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘dhèu dhu madhèdi na'a-ninu pa'èci dènge ja'a, soro kabodho mi ja'a le. '

source_text: now i tell you before it cometh, that when it hath come to pass, ye may believe that i am he.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu, ho ladhe abhu dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele ja'a, na, miu bisa parcaya kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus.

source_text: verily, verily, i say to you, he that receiveth whomsoever i send, receiveth me; and he that receiveth me, receiveth him that sent me.
target_text: ja'a peka dènge miu tare'a-re'a kèna, dhèu cee dhu bhoke d'ara na ho sèmi nare dhèu dhu ja'a pua, na, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ja'a. aa cee ka dhu sèmi nare ja'a dènge be'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: when jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, verily, verily, i say to you, that one of you will betray me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia d'ara na mulai susa. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ca dhèu nèti miu, èèna na pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spoke.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ana-ana madhutu na palaladha èci dènge èci, te rèngu malaa. re'a boe na, cee ka dhu nèngu peka.

source_text: now there was leaning on jesus' bosom, one of his disciples, whom jesus loved.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu yesus sue nuka ja'a, yohanis dhu suri sasuri ne. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus.

source_text: simon peter therefore beckoned to him, to ask who it should be of whom he spoke.
target_text: hèia simon petrus pangètu kètu, ho ja'a karèi yesus, cee ka dhu na peka èèna.

source_text: he then lying on jesus' breast, saith to him, lord, who is it?
target_text: ka ja'a eso padètu dènge yesus, ho karèi ne, dhèu dhu ama peka ne, cee?

source_text: jesus answered, he it is to whom i shall give a sop, when i have dipped it. and when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to judas iscariot, the son of simon.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo kore roti ca'èta, ho cèb'u asa d'ara mago ne. èèna na ja'a hia mi dhèu dhu ja'a peka deo na. ka yesus cèb'u nare roti ne asa d'ara mago, hèia na j'ole asa yudas, ana simon iskariot.

source_text: and after the sop satan entered into him. then said jesus to him, what thou doest, do quickly.
target_text: ropa sèmi nare roti ne, hèia dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas. ka yesus peka dènge ne, èu neo tao ngaa, na, tao ka lai-lai. pamata ia ka.

source_text: now no man at the table knew for what intent he spoke this to him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo dhu madhèdi ètu sèra re'a rare boe, nga tao ka yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: for some of them thought, because judas had the bag, that jesus had said to him, buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
target_text: lula yudas dhu tèke doi-dhari, ka abhu dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, peka na, lamu hèli ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka tao pesta paska. aa abhu kahèi dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, lamu hia doi d'ai ciki sa, mi dhèu unu boe ngaa-ngaa sèra.

source_text: he then having received the sop, went immediately out: and it was night.
target_text: ropa yudas sèmi nare roti ne, hèia la'e dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kalua èèna, dhu mèda le.

source_text: therefore when he had gone out, jesus said, now is the son of man glorified, and god is glorified in him.
target_text: ropa yudas la'e, hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. d'ai lod'o kèna, ho ama lamatua ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. aa nèti j'ara ne'e, dhèu rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: if god is glorified in him, god will also glorify him in himself, and will immediately glorify him.
target_text: lula ja'a pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, aa pad'elo dadedha na, nèti èèna ka na ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a. na pamata heka.

source_text: little children, yet a little while i am with you. ye will seek me: and, as i said to the jews, whither i go, ye cannot come; so now i say to you.
target_text: ana aa'i-aa'i! masi ka ja'a sue miu titu kèna, te ngaa nèbhu heka ja'a pa'ana-lalu eele miu. èèna na miu patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe. lii dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, èci èèna ka dènge dhu ja'a lole dènge ama dhèu yahudi sèra, na, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa mèka madhutu. '

source_text: a new commandment i give to you, that ye love one another; as i have loved you, that ye also love one another.
target_text: ja'a hia miu lii paredha hiu èci, nuka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu. de miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: by this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
target_text: ladhe miu pasue sèmi èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, miu se, ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: simon peter said to him, lord, whither goest thou? jesus answered him, whither i go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterward.
target_text: ka simon petrus karèi, peka na, te ama neo lamu mia? hèia yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku asa era èci dhu èu bisa mèka lamu. te ngaa lod'o limuri ku, heka èu lamu kèna.

source_text: peter said to him, lord, why cannot i follow thee now? i will lay down my life for thy sake.
target_text: petrus karèi hari, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ja'a bisa mèka laku hèi? te ja'a dhu pa'èra iisi le ho madhe pala ama!

source_text: jesus answered him, wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? verily, verily, i say to thee, the cock will not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, do? èu neo soro mamuri èu sèna ka madhe pala ja'a? dhu lèke ka sèmi ne'e: manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te ngaa èu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in god, believe also in me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, d'ara miu baku susa. parcaya mi ama lamatua, aa parcaya mi ja'a kahèi.

source_text: in my father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, i would have told you. i go to prepare a place for you.
target_text: ètu èmu ama ku abhu kama ae-ae. ladhe era d'ai boe, tatu ja'a peka le dènge miu. ne'e ne, ja'a neo laku sadia tèke era hia miu ètu nèi.

source_text: and if i go and prepare a place for you, i will come again and receive you to myself; that where i am, there ye may be also.
target_text: ladhe ja'a laku aa sadia kore era pea hia miu, pe ja'a lèpa hari mai kore miu ho lati pea asa nèi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe ja'a ètu mia, na, miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and whither i go ye know, and the way ye know.
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara asa era dhu ja'a neo laku.

source_text: thomas saith to him, lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
target_text: te ngaa tomas karèi, peka na, ama! ji'i nge'a boe ama neo lamu mia. de tasamia ka ji'i nge'a j'ara ho la'a asa nèi?

source_text: jesus saith to him, i am the way, and the truth, and the life: no man cometh to the father, but by me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, abhu boe j'ara leo dhu bisa nèti dhèu asa ama ètu sorga. dhodhoka re ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te ja'a ne ka j'ara asa ama lamatua. ja'a ne ka kapua mamola. aa ja'a ne'e ka dhu hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: if ye had known me, ye would have known my father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
target_text: ladhe miu tadhe mèu ja'a, na, miu tadhe ama ku kahèi. de karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, miu tadhe nèngu le, dènge mèdhi ne kahèi.

source_text: philip saith to him, lord, show us the father, and it sufficeth us.
target_text: pelipus manèngi, peka na, ama mese! pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i! te èèna d'ai le.

source_text: jesus saith to him, have i been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me philip? he that hath seen me, hath seen the father; and how sayest thou then, show us the father?
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pelipus. ja'a sama-sama dènge miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, te ngaa miu tadhe iia mèka ja'a, do? te dhèu dhu nèdhi le ja'a, èèna sama sèmi nèngu nèdhi le ama ku. de, nga tao ka deo na èu peka na, ‘pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i'?

source_text: believest thou not that i am in the father, and the father in me? the words that i speak to you, i speak not from myself: but the father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
target_text: tasamia kèna? lod'o ja'a peka na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama, aa ama pa'èki dènge ja'a, èu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o? lii padhai dhu ja'a peka dènge miu sèra, mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku. aa na pake ja'a sèna ka sab'a taruu sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: believe me that i am in the father, and the father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
target_text: parcaya la mi ja'a ropa ja'a peka na, ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge ama ku, aa nèngu pa'èki dènge ja'a kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu bisa boe parcaya sèmi èèna, na, parcaya la ja'a, lula miu mèdhi le j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: verily, verily, i say to you, he that believeth on me, the works that i do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because i go to my father.
target_text: lii padhai ja'a se, lèke! te dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na nèngu bisa tao j'ara dhu ja'a tao kahèi. te ngaa, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku, ka ngaa dhu dhèu tao sèra, kapai risi nèti dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: and whatever ye shall ask in my name, that will i do, that the father may be glorified in the son.
target_text: miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, unu hak pake kolongara ja'a. de ladhe miu sabaj'a sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake la kolongara ja'a, pe èèna na ja'a tao hia miu. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a ded'e ama ku padedha-dedha, sèna ka hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a.

source_text: if ye shall ask any thing in my name, i will do it.
target_text: ja'a peka hari ca tèka: miu sabaj'a ho sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na ja'a tao hia miu.

source_text: if ye love me, keep my commandments.
target_text: yesus peka tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra.

source_text: and i will pray the father, and he will give you another comforter, that he may abide with you for ever; even the spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and will be in you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama ku, sèna ka, lod'o ja'a dènge heka miu, na, nèngu hia miu ca dhèu era sarai-maena, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. nèngu ne, nuka roh lamatua, dhu aj'a-nori miu ngaa dhu lèke. dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha ne ro'o boe sèmi rare ne, lula rèngu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi nèngu, aa tadhe boe nèngu. te ngaa miu tadhe ne, lula na pa'èki dènge miu. aa na muri ètu d'ara miu. èèna na, nèngu dènge miu taa-taa.

source_text: i will not leave you comfortless; i will come to you.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele boe miu mesa mi, nuka sèmi ana lalu-eela. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari mai asa miu.

source_text: yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because i live, ye shall live also.
target_text: nèbhu heka, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne rèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa miu mèdhi ja'a. lula ja'a mamuri hari, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: at that day ye shall know that i am in my father, and ye in me, and i in you.
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, miu me'a mèu, na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama ku; miu pa'èki dènge ja'a; aa ja'a pa'èki dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: he that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me, shall be loved by my father, and i will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi rare, aa tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, nèngu ka dhu sue ja'a. aa ama ku sue kahèi dhèu dhu sue ja'a. ja'a sue dhèu èèna kahèi, aa pad'elo iisi ja'a dènge ne.

source_text: judas, not iscariot, saith to him, lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself to us, and not to the world?
target_text: ètu era ne, abhu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. nèngu ne, yudas iskariot boe. ropa na tadèngi lii padhai yesus, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo pad'elo iisi mi ji'i. te ngaa tasamia ka ama pad'elo boe iisi mi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne?

source_text: jesus answered and said to him, if a man loveth me, he will keep my words: and my father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our abode with him.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu dhu sue ja'a, nuka dhèu dhu tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a. ama ku sue nèngu kahèi. ka ja'a dènge ama ku mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne.

source_text: he that loveth me not, keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but that of the father who sent me.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sue boe ja'a, nèngu madhutu boe lii holo-nori ja'a kahèi. aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi nèti ja'a, mai boe nèti ja'a, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: these things have i spoken to you, being yet present with you.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka tèke j'ara se'e dènge miu.

source_text: but the comforter, who is the holy spirit, whom the father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatever i have said to you.
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, ama ku pua mai ca dhèu era sarai-maena, nuka roh mola-mèci na. roh ne'e ka dhu gati ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. sasab'a na, nuka: aj'a-nori miu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, dènge pasanèd'e miu j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a padhue-padhai le dènge miu.

source_text: peace i leave with you, my peace i give to you: not as the world giveth, give i to you. let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
target_text: pe, ladhe d'ai lod'o ja'a laku, ja'a tao d'ara miu ho mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu bisa tao d'ara mera-milu sèmi èèna. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha ne bisa boe tao rare d'ara miu mera-milu sèmi èèna. de miu baku susa, aa baku madha'u.

source_text: ye have heard that i said to you, i go away, and come again to you. if ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because i said, i go to the father: for my father is greater than i.
target_text: miu tadèngi mèdhi le, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a tèke eele miu, te ngaa èèna na mai hari. ' d'ara miu baku susa. te ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, d'ara miu karej'e-karae, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku. ama ku kapai risi nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: and now i have told you before it cometh to pass, that when it hath come to pass, ye may believe.
target_text: sanèd'e, te ja'a dhu peka mema le dènge miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe j'ara se j'aj'i ku, na, miu bisa parcaya ja'a.

source_text: hereafter i will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a padhai lii heka dènge miu. te dhèu aae nidhu dhu mai le. nèngu nèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa koasa na lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: but that the world may know that i love the father; and as the father gave me commandment, even so i do. arise, let us go hence.
target_text: masi ka nidhu ne mai, te ngaa ja'a sab'a taruu madhutu paredha ama ku. ne'e ne ka dhu pad'elo dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, na, ja'a sue ama ku titu kèna. de mai lati ka!

source_text: i am the true vine, and my father is the husbandman.
target_text: yesus padhai lii, peka na, nanene! miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. ja'a ne sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. te ngaa ja'a ne, aj'u anggor dhu lèke! aa ama ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka.

source_text: every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh away; and every branch that beareth fruit, he cleaneth it, that it my bring forth more fruit.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, te ngaa sab'a boe ngaa-ngaa, ama ku core eele ne, sama sèmi dhèu sab'a oka dhu pare eele aa'i dadana dhu hua boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge ja'a, ama ku pamèu kaj'alu ètu d'ara dhèu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka poro pabab'a dadana, sèna ka hua na asa ae.

source_text: now ye are clean through the word which i have spoken to you.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a se'e, bisa le pamèu d'ara miu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu sab'a oka dhu pamèu dadana anggor.

source_text: abide in me, and i in you. as the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine: no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki taruu ku dènge ja'a, sama sèmi ja'a pa'èki dènge miu. te dadana dhu pare eele le nèti laa na, bisa boe hua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa dhu be'a, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a.

source_text: i am the vine, ye are the branches: he that abideth in me, and i in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
target_text: ja'a sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. miu nuka sèmi dadana nèngu. de dhèu dhu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi, na, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge dadana dhu hua ae-ae. te, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a, miu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a.

source_text: if a man abideth not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered: and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki boe taruu dènge ja'a, nèngu cakaraa dadana èci dhu guna heka. dadana sèmi èèna, dhèu poro eele, sèna ka pamango eele ne. hèia pakaboko ho core asa d'ara ai, tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: if ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye may ask what ye will, and it shall be done to you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pa'èki pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a taruu, aa lii holo-nori ja'a pea taruu ètu d'ara miu, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama lamatua, na tao hia miu.

source_text: in this is my father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae, sama sèmi dadana èci dhu hua ae-ae, èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo kahèi, na, miu ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: as the father hath loved me, so have i loved you: continue ye in my love.
target_text: sèmi mia ama sue ja'a, sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a sue miu. miu hud'i pa'èki ku pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa pad'elo dènge miu sasue ja'a.

source_text: if ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as i have kept my father's commandments, and abide in his love.
target_text: ladhe miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, hèia ja'a bisa pad'elo sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a tao madhutu lii paredha ama ku, hèia na pad'elo sasue na taruu mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: these things have i spoken to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be full.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a. te madhutu dad'èi ja'a, d'ara miu hud'i karej'e dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: this is my commandment, that ye love one another, as i have loved you.
target_text: lii paredha ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu.

source_text: greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sadia madhe sèna ka angalai na bisa mamuri, nèngu tatu sue tare'a-re'a angalai na. abhu boe sasue dhu risi eele hari sèmi èèna.

source_text: ye are my friends, if ye do whatever i command you.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu paredha ja'a taruu, miu j'aj'i angalai ja'a.

source_text: henceforth i call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but i have called you friends; for all things that i have heard from my father, i have made known to you.
target_text: ja'a paroa heka miu, na, ‘ana pua-paleha' ja'a. te ana pua-paleha èci, ne'a iia boe dad'èi lamatua na. te ngaa ja'a paroa miu, na, ‘angalai' ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele le aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku peka le dènge ja'a.

source_text: ye have not chosen me, but i have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatever ye shall ask of the father in my name, he may give it you.
target_text: miu pili boe ja'a. te ngaa ja'a ka dhu pili kore aa ded'e miu ho pakako sasab'a ne. de miu hud'i lami tao j'ara be'a ae-ae dhu taha nare nèbhu. èèna nuka sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua dhu hua na be'a taruu. ladhe miu tao ka sèmi èèna, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama ku, tatu na tao hia miu.

source_text: these things i command you, that ye love one another.
target_text: de dhu ja'a paredha miu sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: if the world hateth you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
target_text: yesus lii tabha hari, na, ladhe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi boe miu, na, sanèd'e, te karèi nèti uru ka rèngu d'èi boe ja'a.

source_text: if ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but i have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
target_text: ladhe miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, tatu ra sue miu. te ngaa miu sama boe dènge rèngu. te ja'a dhu hag'e kore le miu, sèna ka cèri eele miu nèti rèngu. nèti èèna ka rèngu d'èi boe miu.

source_text: remember the word that i said to you, the servant is not greater than his lord. if they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you: if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
target_text: baku bhèlu dhu ja'a peka kore le dènge miu, na, ‘ca dhèu ana pua-paleha risi boe nèti lamatua na. ' de ladhe rèngu paj'èra ja'a, tatu ra paj'èra miu kahèi. ladhe rèngu nanene ka lii holo-nori ja'a, na, rèngu nanene miu kahèi.

source_text: but all these things will they do to you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
target_text: èèna na ra paj'èra miu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te rèngu tadhe boe nèngu dhu pua ja'a kahèi.

source_text: if i had not come and spoken to them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka dènge rèngu, aa pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke mi rèngu, na, ra pangee taruu, na, rèngu dènge boe sala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ja'a mai le, aa padhai dènge rèngu sèmi èèna. de ladhe rèngu tao sala, na, rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho peka na, ‘wee! ji'i se nge'a boe, na, dhu ji'i tao sèra, sala. '

source_text: he that hateth me, hateth my father also.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe ja'a, nèngu d'èi boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: if i had not done among them the works which no other man hath done, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen, and hated both me and my father.
target_text: ja'a tao kèdhi le tadha malaa rupa-rupa ètu katanga madha ra, dhu dhèu leo tao rèdhi mèka. ladhe ja'a tao boe j'ara sèra sa, rèngu sala boe kahèi ladhe ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a. aa te ngaa rèngu dhu rèdhi le tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu d'èi boe ja'a, aa d'èi boe ama ku ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: but this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, they hated me without a cause.
target_text: te ngaa j'ara se'e se dhu j'aj'i le, sèna ka madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara atora ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘rèngu d'èi boe ja'a. aa te ngaa nanasa rèngu se'e dènge boe kolo-kapua. '

source_text: but when the comforter is come, whom i will send to you from the father, even the spirit of truth, who proceedeth from the father, he will testify concerning me.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu era sarai-maena èèna neo mai. nèngu èèna, nuka roh dhu tao miu me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke. na mai nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a laku le asa ama ku, pe ja'a hia roh na mai asa miu. na lole dènge miu lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: and ye also shall bear testimony, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
target_text: èèna na miu peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti ja'a kahèi, lula miu bera-bera dènge ja'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka.

source_text: these things have i spoken to you, that ye should not be offended.
target_text: ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka miu baku pakaj'èu nèti ja'a.

source_text: they shall put you out of the synagogues: yes, the time cometh, that whoever killeth you, will think that he doeth god service.
target_text: èèna na dhèu yahudi sèra babège eele miu nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra. mesa boe j'ara ne'e di, te bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ladhe dhèu pamadhe miu, ra pangee, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke hia ama lamatua.

source_text: and these things will they do to you, because they have not known the father, nor me.
target_text: rèngu tao miu sèmi èèna, lula rèngu tadhe iia boe ja'a. aa rèngu tadhe boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: but these things have i told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that i told you of them. and these things i said not to you at the beginning, because i was with you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka lèpa lod'o limuri ladhe j'aj'i, miu bisa sanèd'e, na, ja'a dhu peka mema le. te ngaa ja'a peka uuru mèka dènge miu, lula ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era.

source_text: but now i go to him that sent me, and none of you asketh me, whither goest thou?
target_text: yesus aj'a tabha hari, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. te ngaa abhu boe nèti miu ca dhèu sa dhu karèi, na, ‘ama neo lamu mia? '

source_text: but because i have said these things to you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu susa.

source_text: nevertheless, i tell you the truth: it is expedient for you that i depart; for if i go not away, the comforter will not come to you; but if i depart, i will send him to you.
target_text: te ngaa, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ladhe ja'a laku, na, miu abhu babe'a na. te ladhe ja'a laku boe, dhèu era sarai-maena èèna mai boe pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a laku, na, ja'a hia ne mai dènge miu.

source_text: and when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
target_text: pe ladhe na mai, na bhoke ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, ka re'a, na, d'ara dènge tatao ra, sala. na pamako si, sèna ka rèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. aa na pasanèd'e rèngu, na, ladhe lamatua pama'ète lii langu ra, peka na, rèngu se sala, do sala boe.

source_text: of sin, because they believe not on me;
target_text: dhèu era sarai-maena èèna pad'elo sasala ra, lula rèngu lèka boe ja'a.

source_text: of righteousness, because i go to my father, and ye see me no more;
target_text: nèngu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. lula ja'a lèpa asa ama ku, èèna na miu mèdhi heka ja'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu era sarai-maena ne mai gati ja'a.

source_text: of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
target_text: nèngu peka kahèi, na, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, lula lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le lii langu dhèu aae nidhu, dhu paredha rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have yet many things to say to you, but ye cannot bear them now.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa ne'e ne miu dhae bisa mèka me'a.

source_text: but, when he, the spirit of truth is come, he will guide you into all the truth: for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he shall hear, that will he speak: and he will show you things to come.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke èèna mai ka, nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka miu bisa me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. nèngu padhai lii boe nèti d'ara na mesa, te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na tadèngi sèra mai nèti ama ku. nèngu neo peka dènge miu kahèi, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i.

source_text: he will glorify me: for he will receive of mine, and will show it to you.
target_text: nèngu neo ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, lula na neo bhoke patalele aa'i hia miu, j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: all things that the father hath are mine: therefore i said, that he will take of mine, and show it to you.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ama ku, unu ja'a kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka deo na, roh lamatua èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a, aa pad'elo dènge miu.

source_text: a little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because i go to the father.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai, peka na, nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a.

source_text: then said some of his disciples among themselves, what is this that he saith to us, a little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, because i go to the father?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na cahag'e papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, a'abhu ama èèna, ngaa kèna? ka peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a. ' aa, nga tao ka na padhai lii, na, ‘lula ja'a neo laku asa ama ku'?

source_text: they said therefore, what is this that he saith, a little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
target_text: hèia ra pakarèi, peka na, a'abhu na ngaa, dhu peka na, ‘nèbhu heka'? èdhi te'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: now jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said to them, do ye inquire among yourselves of that which i said, a little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a rèngu neo karèi ne ca j'ara. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe, miu mèdhi hari ja'a kahèi. ' miu pakarèi sèmi èèna, si?

source_text: verily, verily, i say to you, that ye will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice: and ye will be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
target_text: be'a kahèi, ladhe miu neo me'a sèmi èèna. ja'a neo peka dènge miu kahèi sèmi ne'e: èèna na miu tangi dènge d'ara susa, te ngaa dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne karej'e-karae. masi ka d'ara miu susa, te ngaa èèna na d'ara miu karej'e-karae hari.

source_text: a woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
target_text: j'ara ne sama sèmi bhèni ca dhèu kabake pèd'a d'ai lod'o neo nara iisi. d'ara na rasa bia, lula d'ai lod'o j'aj'èra na kèna. te ngaa ladhe nara iisi nare, na, j'aj'èra na ele. te d'ara na karej'e, lula abhu dhèu hiu èci dhu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and ye now therefore have sorrow: but i will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ne'e ne miu tangi dènge d'ara susa. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ja'a mai paraga hari dènge miu, ka d'ara miu j'aj'i hari karej'e-karae. aa ladhe j'ara ne j'aj'i, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhabhae rare d'ara karae miu.

source_text: and in that day ye will ask me nothing: verily, verily, i say to you, whatever ye shall ask the father in my name, he will give it you.
target_text: aa ladhe j'ara sèmi sèra j'aj'i, miu pakarèi heka ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a. tare'a! ja'a peka hari dènge miu kèna, na, sad'i miu manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama ku, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na nèngu tao sèmi èèna hia miu.

source_text: hitherto ye have asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa pake kolongara ja'a. de manèngi la, sèna ka miu abhu. dènge j'ara ne, d'ara miu bisa karej'e tare'a-re'a.

source_text: these things have i spoken to you in proverbs: but the time cometh when i shall no more speak to you in proverbs, but i shall show you plainly concerning the father.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a tema aj'a-nori miu pake lii pakasame. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ja'a aj'a miu pake heka lii pakasame. te ja'a neo peka mola-mola lula-nèti ama ku.

source_text: at that day ye will ask in my name: and i say not to you, that i will pray the father for you:
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai, na, miu mesa mi dhu sabaj'a ho manèngi mi ama ku pake kolongara ja'a. baku dhoka ja'a mesa ku di dhu sabaj'a hia miu.

source_text: for the father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that i came from god.
target_text: te ama ku sue miu, lula miu sue ja'a. aa miu me'a mèu, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i came forth from the father, and am come into the world: again, i leave the world, and go to the father.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a tèke eele ama ku, ho mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo tèke eele rai-haha ne, ho laku pea pa'èci hari dènge ne.

source_text: his disciples said to him, lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi ne'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus se lii, aku rèngu na, de ne'e ne, ama padhai lii mola-mola kèna, aa aj'a-nori pake heka lii pakasame.

source_text: now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest from god.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama dhu me'a aa'i mèu j'ara-j'ara. dhèu parluu heka sèku ama dènge karèi ngaa-ngaa, lula ama dhu me'a uru le ngaa dhu ra neo karèi, aa lii dhaa na tasa mera mia. j'ara ne peka dènge ji'i, na, ama mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus answered them, do ye now believe?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? limuri ne, miu lèka ja'a, do?

source_text: behold, the hour cometh, and is even now come, that ye shall be scattered every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet i am not alone, because the father is with me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. nèbhu boe, mulai ciki-diki ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai paceb'a. ca dhèu-dhèu ka rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku, ho la'e lu'u. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a mesa ku boe, lula ama ku bera-bera dènge ja'a.

source_text: these things i have spoken to you, that in me ye may have peace. in the world ye will have tribulation, but be of good cheer: i have overcome the world.
target_text: ja'a peka tèke le j'ara se dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu mera-milu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ètu rai-haha ne pasusa dènge paj'èra miu. te ngaa pa'èra d'ara miu, lula ja'a segi aa'i le koasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne!

source_text: these words spoke jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, father, the hour is come; glorify thy son, that thy son also may glorify thee: as thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia na ladhe asa dedha-liru, ka sabaj'a, peka na: ama pasue. lod'o d'ai kèna ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. ja'a ne, ana ama. ama dhu pangèd'u ja'a hak, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ama hia hak ne, sèna ka ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mai ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha ho pad'elo dadedha ama.

source_text: and this is life eternal, that they may know thee the only true god, and jesus christ whom thou hast sent.
target_text: j'ara abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i tadhe ama ku, nuka ama lamatua dhu lèke. dhu leo aad'o. aa rèngu hud'i tadhe ku ja'a kahèi, nuka yesus kristus, dhu ama pua mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have glorified thee on the earth: i have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
target_text: ja'a pad'elo le dadedha ama ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a pa'èle le sasab'a dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a.

source_text: and now, o father, glorify thou me with thy ownself, with the glory which i had with thee before the world was.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o èdhi paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, ja'a bera-bera le dènge ama. lod'o èèna, dadedha ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dadedha ama. ne'e ne ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. de ja'a manèngi ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, sèna ka dadedha ja'a sama sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: i have manifested thy name to the men whom thou gavest to me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii sabaj'a, peka na, ama hia le dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ja'a aj'a-nori si, ho rèngu tadhe ama. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu ama, hèia ama pangèd'u si j'aj'i unu ja'a kahèi. ka ra tao madhutu lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: now they have known that all things whatever thou hast given me are from thee.
target_text: limuri ne re'a le, na, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a sèra, kapua ra nèti ama.

source_text: for i have given to them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that i came from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
target_text: te ja'a aj'a kore le rèngu lii holo-nori dhu ama hia mi ja'a. rèngu sèmi rare kahèi lii holo-nori se'e. re'a kahèi, na, ja'a mai nèti ama. ka ra parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i pray for them: i pray not for the world, but for them whom thou hast given to me; for they are thine.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a hia rèngu. ne'e ne, ja'a sabaj'a boe hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia dhèu-dhèu dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a, te rèngu se unu ama.

source_text: and all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and i am glorified in them.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i unu ja'a, sèra sa unu ama kahèi. aa aa'i-aa'i unu ama, sèra sa unu ja'a kahèi. ka dhèu unu ja'a se, dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: and now i am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and i come to thee. holy father, keep through thy own name those whom thou hast given to me, that they may be one, as we are.
target_text: ja'a pea boe taruu ètu rai-haha ne, lula nèbhu heka ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku. te ngaa dhèu se hud'i pea taruu ètu rai-haha ne. ama dhu mola-mèci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ladhe-leru si pake koasa dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a. ja'a manèngi kahèi ho rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ja'a pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci dènge ama.

source_text: while i was with them in the world, i kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest to me i have kept, and none of them is lost but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
target_text: karèi nèti ja'a ètu rai-haha ne bera-bera dènge rèngu, ja'a leru si, lula rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu ama. ja'a j'aga aa sanoro si, sèna ka rèngu pa'èki taruu dènge ama. abhu boe dhu ele. dhodhoka yudas di dhu cèri eele, madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua karèi nèti uru èèna.

source_text: and now i come to thee, and these things i speak in the world, that they may have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. ja'a peka le j'ara se'e lod'o ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era. dènge sèmi ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a se d'ara rèngu bisa karej'e-karae taruu, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i have given to them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as i am not of the world.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka-padhai le dènge rèngu lii holo-nori ama. dhèu leo ètu rai-haha tèka d'ara dènge dhèu unu ja'a, lula mamuri dhèu ja'a, sama boe dènge mamuri rèngu. ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi, te ja'a sama boe sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: i pray not that thou shouldst take them out of the world, but that thou shouldst keep them from the evil.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sabaj'a, ja'a manèngi boe ho ama more si nèti rai-haha ne. aad'o! te ngaa ja'a manèngi, ho ama j'aga si, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu.

source_text: they are not of the world, even as i am not of the world.
target_text: rèngu sama boe dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a dhu sama boe kahèi dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
target_text: pake ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka pamèu d'ara ra. te dhu lèke ka, lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: as thou hast sent me into the world, even so have i also sent them into the world.
target_text: ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pua-paleha rèngu kahèi sèmi èèna, sèna ka rèngu mamuri pale-lème ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and for their sakes i sanctify myself, that they also may be sanctified through the truth.
target_text: ja'a j'aga ngi'u ja'a ho mola-mèci taruu hia mi ama. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a j'aga mamuri ra kahèi sèna ka mola-mèci hia mi ama. te lii holo-nori ama dhu lèke, dhu tao si ho ra saraka mamuri rèngu kateme mi ama.

source_text: neither pray i for these alone; but for them also who shall believe on me through their word.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii manèngi-mangaj'i na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sabaj'a, mesa boe hia mi dhèu limuri ne'e di, te ngaa hia rèngu dhu lod'o limuri dhu parcaya ja'a kahèi, lula lii padhai dhèu se'e.

source_text: that they all may be one; as thou, father, art in me, and i in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
target_text: ama, ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, sama sèmi èdhi pa'èki j'aj'i èci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i èci dènge èdhi, ho hud'i laa dhèu rai-haha ne bisa parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: and the glory which thou gavest to me, i have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one.
target_text: ama pad'elo le dadedha ja'a mi dhèu sèra. ka ja'a ded'e le rèngu padedha-dedha sama sèmi ja'a. dènge jara ne'e, rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i èci, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi j'aj'i èci.

source_text: i in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them as thou hast loved me.
target_text: ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu. ama kahèi pa'èki dènge ja'a. rèngu hud'i pa'èki j'aj'i èci sèmi èèna ku, toke ra mamuri d'ara èci dènge be'a. te ladhe rèngu mamuri d'ara èci sèmi èèna, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne re'a, na, ama dhu sue si, nuka sèmi ama sue ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu re'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: father, i will that they also whom thou hast given to me be with me where i am; that they may behold my glory which thou hast given to me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
target_text: ama, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo, sèna ka rèngu bisa ladhe rèdhi ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. te ama sue ja'a mema-mema le, lod'o èdhi dhae paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne.

source_text: o righteous father, the world hath not known thee: but i have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
target_text: ama pasue dhu d'ara mola. te ngaa dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tadhe boe ama. ja'a tadhe ama. aa dhèu unu ja'a re'a kahèi, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and i have declared to them thy name, and will declare it: that the love with which thou hast loved me, may be in them, and i in them.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka le dènge rèngu, ama ne, cee. aa èèna na ja'a loe boe peka dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, lula ja'a d'èi ho rèngu re'a mèu sasue ama. te sasue dhu rèngu re'a rèdhi ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge sasue ama mi dedha ja'a, sèna ka hud'i laa ja'a pa'èki taruu dènge rèngu.

source_text: when jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook kedron, where was a garden, into which he entered, and his disciples.
target_text: ropa yesus manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia la'e palere-lere dènge ana madhutu na. lasi asa d'ara oka cue ètu sebhe loko kidron.

source_text: and judas also, who betrayed him, knew the place: for jesus often resorted thither with his disciples. judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns, and torches, and weapons.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu nèti partei agama parisi saraka mi yudas, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga pèri-pèri. te nèngu neo pahie eele yesus. yudas ne'a oka ne kahèi, lula yesus pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na ètu era ne'e pèri-pèri hari le. ka yudas si lasi asa oka ne rèti dènge ob'o, labhu lantera dènge rèka.

source_text: jesus therefore, knowing all things that were coming upon him, went forth, and said to them, whom seek ye?
target_text: aa te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a uru le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na j'aj'i. hèia ara la'e asa madha rèngu, ka na lii, peka na, miu tenge cee?

source_text: they answered him, jesus of nazareth. jesus saith to them, i am he. and judas also, who betrayed him, stood with them.
target_text: ka ra b'ala, na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka ne'e. lod'o èèna, yudas dhu titu dènge dhèu se'e. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pahie yesus.

source_text: as soon then as he had said to them, i am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
target_text: ropa yesus peka na, ja'a ka ne'e, hèia dhèu se hari kabodho, ka ra bèbha.

source_text: then he asked them again, whom seek ye? and they said, jesus of nazareth.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari, na, miu tenge cee? hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, yesus, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: jesus answered, i have told you that i am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go away:
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, deo na ja'a peka kore le, na, nèngu ka ja'a ne. de ladhe miu tenge ja'a, na, baku kèpe dhèu leo. hud'i si lasi.

source_text: that the saying might be fulfilled which he spoke, of them whom thou gavest to me, i have lost none.
target_text: nèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, sèna ka pamèci dènge ngaa dhu nèngu peka nèdhi le, na, ama. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, abhu boe èci sa dhu ele.

source_text: then simon peter, having a sword, drew it, and smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear. the servant's name was malchus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus nèti dènge samala iiki èci. ka na bete ho neo pare dhèu. kabèdhi laa, na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne ngara na malkus. nèngu ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: then said jesus to peter, put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my father hath given me, shall i not drink it?
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus, aku nèngu na, we, petrus! pasaluu hari samala èu èèna asa d'ara sope la'e. te ama ku dhu peka le, na, ja'a hud'i paraga ku dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. de hud'i laa! èèna nuka sèmi nèngu hia ja'a galaa èci dhu isi na pèd'u-èd'u. hud'i laa ja'a kinu toke èle.

source_text: then the band, and the captain, and officers of the jews took jesus, and bound him,
target_text: hèia komedhaa, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe yesus, ka ra èki ne.

source_text: and led him away to annas first, for he was father-in-law to caiaphas, who was the high priest that same year.
target_text: ka lere rèti uuru ne asa anas. anas ne, ama dhèu èmu kayafas. tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: now caiaphas was he who gave counsel to the jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
target_text: kayafas ne'e ka dhu peka nèdhi le dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi, aku nèngu na, be'a risi hia miu, ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and simon peter followed jesus, and so did another disciple. that disciple was known to the high priest, and went in with jesus into the palace of the high priest.
target_text: simon petrus dhu madhutu yesus re limuri palere-lere dènge ana madhutu yesus èci, nuka ja'a, yohanis ne. lula kètu kapai risi agama yahudi tadhe ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa maso kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus asa madha èmu na.

source_text: but peter stood at the door without. then went out that other disciple who was known to the high priest, and spoke to her that kept the door, and brought in peter.
target_text: te ngaa petrus titu ètu li'u, padètu dènge hèb'a tedhe. hèia ja'a laku asa li'u, ho peka dènge dhèu bhèni èci dhu j'aga hèb'a tedhe ne, sèna ka kèti petrus asa d'ara.

source_text: then saith the damsel that kept the door to peter, art not thou also one of this man's disciples? he saith, i am not.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne karèi petrus, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne, ca dhèu ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o!

source_text: and the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold and they warmed themselves: and peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu madhenga dènge ana pua-paleha sèra dhu titu manyiru ai. ka petrus la'e manyiru ai sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi.

source_text: the high priest then asked jesus concerning his disciples, and concerning his doctrine.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu kapai risi dhui nèti agama yahudi parisa yesus lula-nèti a'aj'a na, aa lula-nèti ana madhutu na.

source_text: jesus answered him, i spoke openly to the world; i ever taught in the synagogue and in the temple, whither the jews always resort; and in secret have i said nothing.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge nèngu, aku nèngu na, ja'a peka paled'a, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa tadèngi. ja'a tema aj'a ètu era dhu biasa dhèu yahudi èdhi pakaboko, nuka ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi, dènge ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ja'a padhai lii pahuni kèdhi boe.

source_text: why dost thou ask me? ask them who heard me, what i have said to them: behold, they know what i have said.
target_text: nga tao ka èu karèi ja'a? karèi la dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai ja'a. te, tatu re'a ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai.

source_text: and when he had thus spoken, one of the officers who stood by, struck jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, answerest thou the high priest so?
target_text: ropa na padhai lii sèmi èèna, dhèu j'aga èci dhu titu ètu èèna, tèb'e yesus, ka na peka na, èu baku padhai lii sèmi èèna dènge kètu kapai risi.

source_text: jesus answered him, if i have spoken evil, bear testimony of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii sale, na, pad'elo mia dhu sale nèti lii padhai deo na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka èu tèb'e ja'a?

source_text: now annas had sent him bound to caiaphas the high priest.
target_text: èle ka, anas pua dhèu lere ne asa kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o lere rèti ne, yesus dhu ra èki era.

source_text: and simon peter stood and warmed himself. they said therefore to him, art not thou also one of his disciples? he denied it, and said, i am not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus titu manyiru ai era. ka dhèu leo dhu ètu èèna, karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, peka na, aad'o!

source_text: one of the servants of the high priest being the kinsman of him whose ear peter cut off saith, did not i see thee in the garden with him?
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu sab'a èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. nèngu ne, pa'a'ari kahèi dènge dhèu dhu petrus pare pama'ète rèu dhilu na. hèia dhèu ne karèi petrus, peka na, waa! deo na, èu ne ètu d'ara oka nèi, si? te ja'a kèdhi èu ètu nèi!

source_text: peter then denied again, and immediately the cock crowed.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: then they led jesus from caiaphas to the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment-hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, lere rèti yesus nèti kayafas asa èmu jabatan gubernur ètu benteng sordad'u roma. dhèu yahudi se maso boe asa èmu dhèu roma, te èèna pakaj'alu rèngu. te ladhe ra maso, na, rèngu bisa boe ra'a pesta paska.

source_text: pilate then went out to them, and said, what accusation bring ye against this man?
target_text: hèia gubernur pilatus la'e asa li'u paraga dènge dhèu yahudi se. ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu pèci sasala ngaa mi dedha dhèu ne'e?

source_text: they answered and said to him, if he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up to thee.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a boe, na, tatu ji'i mai boe asa madha ama. ngaa hari ji'i mai saraka ne asa kacui-aai ama.

source_text: then said pilate to them, take ye him, and judge him according to your law. the jews therefore said to him, it is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
target_text: ka gubernur peka dènge dhèu se, na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa miu ka dhu uri lii langu na, madhutu atora miu dhèu yahudi. hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, peka na, bisa boe ama. ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge heka hak ho pama'ète hahuku madhe. dhoka miu dhèu paredha roma di dhu dènge hak èèna.

source_text: that the saying of jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying what death he should die.
target_text: lii padhai lii rèngu èèna, palèke dènge lii padhai dhu uru èèna yesus peka nèdhi le. te nèngu dhu peka le dènge dhèu unu na sèra, na, nèngu madhe madhutu j'ara paredha roma, nuka ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then pilate entered into the judgment-hall again, and called jesus, and said to him, art thou the king of the jews?
target_text: hèia gubernur maso hari asa d'ara benteng sordad'u. ka na paroa yesus, hèia na karèi, peka na, èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do?

source_text: jesus answered him, sayest thou this thing from thyself, or did others tell it thee concerning me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama ka peka sèmi èèna, do abhu dhèu leo ka dhu peka dènge ama lula-nèti ja'a?

source_text: pilate answered, am i a jew? thy own nation, and the chief priests, have delivered thee to me: what hast thou done?
target_text: hèia gubernur dhaa, na, eee! ja'a ne dhèu yahudi boe. ana kabarai èu mesa mu ka dhu saraka èu. ngaa hari kètu agama yahudi sèra. èu ne, tao sala ngaa? èu peka sèku!

source_text: jesus answered, my kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that i should not be delivered to the jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
target_text: ka yesus peka na, ja'a ne, dhèu aae boe nèti rai-haha ne. te ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae sama sèmi èèna, tatu dhèu-dhèu ja'a palab'a le, ka dhèu yahudi kèpe boe ja'a. tare'a, ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ca dhèu sa ètu rai-haha ne ded'e boe ja'a.

source_text: pilate therefore said to him, art thou a king then? jesus answered, thou sayest that i am a king. to this end was i born, and for this cause came i into the world, that i should testify to the truth. every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi hari, peka na, de èu ne, dhèu aae, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama unu mu ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ne dhèu aae. dhu lèke ka, rara iisi ja'a ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne ho j'aj'i dhèu aae, sèna ka ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe pa'èra j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, rèngu sèra ka dhu nanene ja'a.

source_text: pilate saith to him, what is truth? and when he had said this, he went out again to the jews, and saith to them, i find in him no fault.
target_text: ka gubernur karèi, peka na, dhu lèke èèna, sèmi ngaa sa? ropa gubernur pilatus padhai lii nare, hèia kalua hari la'e asa dhèu yahudi sèra. ka na peka, ja'a parisa le nèngu, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: but ye have a custom that i should release to you one at the passover: will ye therefore that i release to you the king of the jews?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lod'o d'ai pesta paska sèmi ne'e, ja'a patabuli ana bèdho ca dhèu hia miu. de tèu ne'e mo'o sèna ka ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do tasamia?

source_text: then they all cried again, saying, not this man, but barabbas. now barabbas was a robber.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, baku patabuli dhèu èèna! patabuli barabas di! barabas ne, ca dhèu dhu bhelu titu kèna.

source_text: then pilate therefore took jesus, and scourged him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus pua sordad'u na lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui.

source_text: and the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe, and said, hail, king of the jews! and they smote him with their hands.
target_text: aa sordad'u se'e rare kalai aj'u padhudhu kahèi, ho ènyu tao solo. ka ra lalilu solo ne mi kètu yesus, nuka sèmi rèngu neo ded'e dhèu aae hiu dhu pake solo dhèu aae. aa te ngaa sasoa na, ra neo pahahe ne di. hèia ra papake yesus kodho madhera èci dhu mea sanama mangèru, nuka sèmi dhèu aae biasa pake. aa ra sasei ne, peka na, tabea, dhèu aae yahudi! sordad'u se tèb'e ne g'ana-kariu kahèi.

source_text: pilate therefore went forth again, and saith to them, behold, i bring him forth to you, that ye may know that i find no fault in him.
target_text: ka gubernur la'e hari catèka peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a kèti ne asa li'u hia miu. te ngaa miu hud'i me'a ku, na, ja'a parisa kore le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: then jesus came forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. and pilate saith to them, behold the man!
target_text: ropa rèti yesus asa li'u, nèngu dhu pake era solo padhudhu dènge kodho madhera dhu mea sanama mangèru. hèia gubernur lii dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe ku, dhèu ne.

source_text: when therefore the chief priests and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, crucify him, crucify him. pilate saith to them, take ye him, and crucify him: for i find no fault in him.
target_text: ropa kètu agama dènge dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha palere-lere, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! te ngaa gubernur peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa miu ka dhu mèti ne, lami pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu palèke dènge hahuku madhe.

source_text: the jews answered him, we have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the son of god.
target_text: dhèu yahudi dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i dènge atora nèti ama lamatua. madhutu atora ne, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku, lula na ded'e iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua.

source_text: when pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai ra, hèia asa na madha'u.

source_text: and went again into the judgment-hall, and saith to jesus, whence art thou? but jesus gave him no answer.
target_text: ka la'e hari asa d'ara benteng, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu ne, dhèu mia? te ngaa yesus bhoka boe hèb'a.

source_text: then saith pilate to him, speakest thou not to me? knowest thou not, that i have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
target_text: ka gubernur jèke yesus, peka na, eeh! nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ja'a? èu dhu me'a, si? ja'a ne, dènge koasa pamadhe èu, do, patabuli èu.

source_text: jesus answered, thou couldst have no power against me; except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me to thee hath the greater sin.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe ama dhu dènge koasa sèmi èèna, na, lula ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te dhodhoka nèngu di dhu hia ama koasa èèna, sèna ka tao ngaa èci sa hia mi ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu saraka ja'a asa ama, rèngu sèra ka dhu pasae sasala bia risi.

source_text: and from thenceforth pilate sought to release him: but the jews cried out, saying, if thou let this man go, thou art not cesar's friend. whoever maketh himself a king, speaketh against cesar.
target_text: karèi nèti èèna ka, gubernur tenge j'ara ho patabuli yesus. te ngaa dhèu yahudi se pa'oo palere-lere, aku rèngu na, ladhe ama patabuli dhèu ne, tatu ama dhu pa'angalai boe dènge dhèu aae kapai, keser. te dhèu dhu ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu aae, nèngu èèna lab'a keser.

source_text: when pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought jesus forth, and sat down on the judgment-seat, in a place that is called the pavement, but in the hebrew, gabbatha.
target_text: ka ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai dhèu se, hèia na pua rèti yesus asa li'u. ka gubernur madhèdi ètu kadera pama'ète lii, ètu era èci dhu ra pangare na, tana lapang nèti hadhu kabela. madhutu lii aram, ngara na gabata.

source_text: and it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith to the jews, behold your king!
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sadia kalela paska. pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, gubernur peka dènge dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu aae miu!

source_text: but they cried out, away with him, away with him, crucify him. pilate saith to them, shall i crucify your king? the chief priests answered, we have no king but cesar.
