target_text: te dhèu dhu parcaya yesus, bhèni-mone, asa tabha ae.

source_text: so that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
target_text: lula tadha malaa ae dhu j'aj'i èèna, ka dhèu ae rèti dhèu pèd'a lasi ho ra pamadhèdi mi dedha dhèpi ètu sebhe j'ara. te ra pangee, peka na, ladhe petrus dènge yohanis kako re era ne'e, sad'i mamaho ra lèke rèngu di, dhèu pèd'a se èle dènge nèti papèd'a rèngu.

source_text: there came also a multitude out of the cities around to jerusalem, bringing sick persons, and them who were afflicted with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai taruu nèti rae-rae ètu sebhe kota yerusalem. rèti dènge dhèu-dhèu pèd'a, ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua se puri-pa'èle si aa'i-aa'i ra. rèngu rèti dhèu-dhèu dhu nidhu tao kahèi, ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua se babège eele aa'i nidhu-nidhu sèra.

source_text: then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him; which is the sect of the sadducees and were filled with indignation,
target_text: lula tatao dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra, nèti èèna ka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, dènge angalai nèngu nèti partei saduki sèra, tèka d'ara.

source_text: and laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra kèpa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus sèra, ka ra pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: but the angel of the lord by night opened the prison-doors, and brought them forth, and said,
target_text: te ngaa mèda èèna kahèi, ana pajuu lamatua èci mai nèti sorga asa d'ara bèdho èèna, ka na bhoke eele babèdho. hèia na lere nèti si asa li'u. ka na peka, aku nèngu na,

source_text: go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
target_text: lami dènge ka asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. lami peka aa'i dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu nèi, sèna ka ra madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu hiu nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: and when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. but the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, ako maroga era, rèngu madhutu ka lii paredha nèti ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga deo na. ka ra maso asa d'ara madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, hèia ra aj'a-nori dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra. nèbhu boe, hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi dènge angalai na sèra mai palere dènge dhèu kapai dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a isra'el. rèngu pakaboko ho parisa lii langu nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra. hèia ra pua dhèu lasi rare petrus si nèti d'ara bèdho, ho ra parisa lii langu ra.

source_text: but when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
target_text: te ngaa ropa rèngu d'ai èmu bèdho, petrus si aad'o heka ètu d'ara. ka ana j'aga sèra lèpa hari lasi peka dènge dhèu kapai sèra.

source_text: saying, the prison truly we found shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
target_text: ra peka na, ama-ama si, baku nasa. ropa ji'i d'ai èmu bèdho, ji'i ladhe, na, babèdho dhu patèke. aa dhèu j'aga sèra titu ètu era èèna. te ngaa ropa ji'i pua ra goe babèdho ho ji'i la'a asa d'ara, ji'i ngèdhi boe dhèu èci sa ètu d'ara.

source_text: now when the high priest, and the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them to what this would grow.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge kapala j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i malaa, aa sèmi dhèu dhu ele ngangee sa.

source_text: then came one and told them, saying, behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia dhèu èci mai peka, aku nèngu na, ama-ama si, nanene ku laa! dhèu dhu miu bèdho sèra, ètu li'u si, ra titu ho aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne!

source_text: then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, ka kapala j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èèna paroa dhèu j'aga pèri-pèri ho lasi kèpe hari petrus dènge angalai na sèra. te ngaa dhèu j'aga sèra madha'u, lula dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai-padhue petrus sèra, ae seli. ra pajiko, na, mage dhoka dhèu ae sèra patao-palaha, ho ra pèci si. nèti èèna ka, ropa rèngu kèpe hari petrus si, ra bani boe pake j'ara sakaa.

source_text: and when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lere rèti petrus si asa era pama'ète lii langu. ka kètu kapai risi agama mulai karèi si,

source_text: saying, did we not strictly command you, that ye should not teach in this name? and behold, ye have filled jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
target_text: peka na, ji'i kai le miu, sèna ka aj'a ia ka dhèu lula-nèti dhèu dhu neo tao j'ara mamuri hiu èèna, sina ma! te ngaa miu palab'a! miu pusi-pahae boe dènge lii paredha ji'i, te ngaa miu tao madhutu dad'èi miu di! miu lami aj'a-nori palème dhèu ètu kota yerusalem ne. èèna sama dènge miu core sasala mi dedha ji'i, peka na, ji'i se ka dhu pua dhèu lasi pamadhe yesus.

source_text: then peter and the other apostles answered and said, we ought to obey god rather than men.
target_text: hèia petrus kèd'i titu j'aj'i dhèu dhu padhai lii nèti angalai na sèra. ka na dhaa, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe abhu paredha nèti dhèu rai-haha dhu palab'a dènge dad'èi ama lamatua, ji'i ngo'o boe madhutu. te ngaa ji'i madhutu dhoka paredha ama lamatua di!

source_text: the god of our fathers raised up jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree:
target_text: dhèu dhu bhoke j'ara mamuri hiu èèna, nuka yesus. nèngu èèna ka dhu miu paku pamadhe ètu dedha aj'u palolo-palèbha. nèti uru ka mai, bèi-baki èdhi manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. ama lamatua èèna ka dhu pamamuri hari yesus nèti mamadhe na!

source_text: him hath god exalted with his right hand to be a prince and a savior, to give repentance to israel, and forgiveness of sins.
target_text: limuri ne, ama lamatua ded'e le yesus j'aj'i ai g'ana na. ka yesus nèd'u le paredha sama sèmi dhèu aae kapai. nèngu bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka lamatua patabuli eele dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. na neo hia j'ara mi èdhi dhèu isra'el se'e, sèna ka èdhi ae eele nèti sasala èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, d'ara ama lamatua pacuhi, ho na ige heka sasala èdhi dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the holy spirit, whom god hath given to them that obey him.
target_text: te èdhi tèdhi le dènge musi madha èdhi, yesus mema madhe tare'a, te ngaa na mamuri hari kahèi. limuri ne roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus.

source_text: when they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
target_text: tadèngi rare lii padhai lii petrus sèmi èèna, ka dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu era pama'ète lii langu èèna nasa titu kèna, ka ra neo pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra.

source_text: then stood up one in the council, a pharisee, named gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little time.
target_text: te ngaa ètu talora rèngu, abhu kahèi dhèu èci dhu madhèdi parisa lii, ngara na gamaliel. dhèu ae pakab'ua ne, lula nèngu ne mese dhu d'èlu-mèu nèti partei agama parisi. ropa petrus padhai lii nare, ka dhèu sèra neo pamadhe ne, hèia gamaliel kèd'i titu, ka na pua dhèu ho lere taha petrus si asa li'u.

source_text: and said to them, ye men of israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do concerning these men:
target_text: ropa petrus si d'ai li'u, ka gamaliel padhai lii dènge ama-ama ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, a'ari ti! èdhi hud'i pajiko paie ku! mage dhoka èdhi malai ae tao bhabhelu mi dedha dhèu se'e. èdhi hud'i pangee madhera.

source_text: for before these days rose theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to naught.
target_text: ele boe miu sanèd'e era, dhèu dhu ngara na teudas. nèngu madhe nèbhu le, te ngaa lod'o na mamuri era, na ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu kapai, pe d'ai dhèu èpa ngasu sa madhutu nèngu. te ngaa ropa ra pamadhe ne, ana-ana madhutu na paj'ala asa haa asa dhimu. toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu rèdhi heka rèngu. ra rai aa'i mèu-mèu le!

source_text: after this man rose judas of galilee, in the days of the taxing, and drew away many people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
target_text: aa miu sanèd'e hari ku lii lole èci. uru èèna, lèke lod'o dhèu paredha ige dhèu ètu d'ara kabarai. abhu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas, nèti propensi galilea. dhèu ae madhutu nèngu kahèi. te ngaa ra pamadhe ne kahèi. hèia ana-ana madhutu na rai paj'ala kahèi, ka d'ai sange ne'e tèdhi heka dhèu èci sa.

source_text: and now i say to you, refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work is from men, it will come to naught:
target_text: de a'ari! madhutu ngangee ja'a, baku pamadhe dhèu se'e. hud'i rèngu sène. te a'aj'a dènge kakako rèngu, ladhe mai nèti dhèu rai-haha, na, nèbhu boe, ele unu na.

source_text: but if it is from god, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against god.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe a'aj'a rèngu tare'a-re'a nèti ama lamatua, miu taha mere boe. nèti èèna ka, miu pajiko paie ku. mage dhoka miu palab'a dènge ama lamatua. tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra lèka, ka ra madhutu lii gamaliel.

source_text: and to him they assented: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of jesus, and let them go.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra paroa hari dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra, ka ra pua dhèu ho hake si. hèia ra kai si, ho baku ale-ale ia ka kolongara yesus. ka ra patabuli si.

source_text: and they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
target_text: hèia dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua se tèke eele era pama'ète lii langu èèna. ra pangee, na, masi ka kolongara rèngu ele iie lula madhutu lamatua yesus, te ngaa rèngu karej'e kahèi, lula rèngu hud'i abhu j'aj'èra sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, d'ara rèngu karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: and daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach jesus christ.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu lasi aj'a-nori dhèu, peka na, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nare nèti uru ka mai, nuka yesus di. ka ra peka padhue taruu, nèti ca èmu d'ai ca èmu, sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the grecians against the hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu dhu parcaya yesus asa tabha ae. te ngaa rèngu pake dua lii. dhèu yahudi cahag'e, pake lii aram. aa cahag'e hari, pake lii yunani. nèbhu boe ka, j'aj'i lii langu ètu talora dua kaboko dhèu se'e. dhèu dhu pake lii yunani, d'ara be'a boe dènge dhèu dhu pake lii aram. ra peka na, ne'e ne, lèke boe! ladhe miu papala nganga'a bèli-bèli, miu bia cabèka. bhèni balu ji'i abhu boe nganga'a.

source_text: then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples, and said, it is not reason that we should leave the word of god, and serve tables.
target_text: lula èèna ka, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhèu canguru dua, pakaboko dhèu dhu parcaya lamatua yesus aa'i-aa'i ra. ka ra peka, aku rèngu na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! ladhe ji'i ae eele nèti sasab'a ji'i, ho lalau dhoka nganga'a-nginu miu di, bisa kahèi, te ngaa, lèke boe! lula ji'i se hud'i aj'a-nori taruu lii holo-nori lamatua.

source_text: wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the holy spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
target_text: de madhutu ngangee ji'i, sèmi ne'e ka. be'a risi, hag'e mere dhèu pidhu nèti talora miu. tenge dhèu dhu kolongara be'a, dhu d'èlu-mèu, aa roh lamatua ator mamuri na. ladhe mi pili mere dhèu sèmi sèra, pe ji'i ded'e si, ho ra lalau nganga'a-nginu.

source_text: but we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èèna, ji'i abhu tebho ae ho manèngi-mangaj'i aa aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua.

source_text: and the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose stephen, a man full of faith and of the holy spirit, and philip, and prochorus, and nicanor, and timon, and parmenas, and nicolas a proselyte of antioch:
target_text: hèia dhèu se'e sèmi rare kahèi lii padhai lii petrus si. ka hag'e rare dhèu pidhu, nuka: dhèu èci, ngara na stefanus. nèngu ne parcaya tare'a-re'a lamatua yesus, dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake nèngu. aa angalai nèngu na, nuka: pelipus, prokorus, nikanor, timon, permenas, dènge nikolas, nèti kota antiokia. nèngu dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na maso agama yahudi.

source_text: whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
target_text: hèia lere rèti dhèu pidhu dhu ra pili rare sèra, asa madha dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua. ka ra bane ai dènge manèngi-mangaj'i hia si, ho ded'e si j'aj'i dhèu ladhe-leru bhèni balu ana-lalu, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ra abhu pala dhu pamera.

source_text: and the word of god increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
target_text: èèna ka, dhèu tadèngi lii holo-nori lamatua ètu mia-mia. hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus, asa tabha ae ètu kota yerusalem. aa ama agama yahudi sèra, ae kahèi dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus.

source_text: and stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and miracles among the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua hia berkat ae mi stefanus. na hia stefanus koasa kahèi, ho na tao tadha-tadha malaa dènge j'ara-j'ara kapai, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi unu ra.

source_text: then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the libertines, and cyrenians, and alexandrians, and of them of cilicia, and of asia, disputing with stephen.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu mai nèti rai-rai kaj'èu, nuka: kota kirene, kota aleksandria, propensi kilikia, dènge propensi asia. uru èèna, rèngu j'aj'i ènu dhèu leo, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka lamatua rèngu patabuli si. èle èèna ka, dhèu se'e pakaboko ètu yerusalem. rèngu tema le lasi asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhu ra patitu unu ra. èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, ra pangare ne, ‘j'aj'i heka ènu'. ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii stefanus, dhèu se d'èi boe, ka ra pab'ala dènge ne.

source_text: and they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spoke.
target_text: stefanus ne, dhèu d'èlu-mèu, lula nèngu padhai lii pake koasa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e segi boe nèngu.

source_text: then they suborned men, who said, we have heard him speak blasphemous words against moses, and against god.
target_text: ka ra tenge j'ara aapa mi dedha stefanus. ra lasi b'ae dhèu ho j'aj'i sakasii leko-monya, peka na, ji'i tadèngi, na, dhèu ne'e padhai lii pahaha musa dènge ama lamatua!

source_text: and they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
target_text: rèngu dadugu dhèu, toke d'ai dhèu heka ad'a yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tadèngi kahèi. ka ra nasa. nèti èèna ka, lasi kèpe rare stefanus, hèia ra nuni ne asa era pama'ète lii langu agama.

source_text: and set up false witnesses, who said, this man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
target_text: sakasii leko-monya rèngu sèra, ue lii langu ho pamanahu stefanus, peka na, dhèu ne loe boe padhai lii pakarehe èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. aa na peka pa'ele iie lii paredha ama lamatua, dhu musa papuru mi èdhi.

source_text: for we have heard him say, that this jesus of nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which moses delivered to us.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi kahèi, na peka, na, yesus, dhèu nasaret, neo sag'e eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne. aa nèngu ne neo pa'ele iie atora ad'a dhu baki musa tao tèka hia èdhi.

source_text: and all that sat in the council, looking steadfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu era pama'ète lii langu agama èèna ladhe kaloo stefanus, lula rèhu na sama sèmi rèhu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: then said the high priest, are these things so?
target_text: hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi karèi stefanus, peka na, dhèu se'e galaa èu ne, lèke do aad'o?

source_text: and he said, men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; the god of glory appeared to our father abraham when he was in mesopotamia, before he dwelt in charran, and said to him, depart from thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which i shall show thee.
target_text: ka stefanus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama-ama, aa a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu nanene ku ja'a. uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki èdhi abraham dhae tèke eele mèka rai èta-èsu na. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu kapai risi pad'elo iisi na mi nèngu. lamatua hia ne paredha, peka na, ‘pakèd'i nèti rai èta-èsu èu; tèke eele a'ari èu. lamu ka asa era èci, dhu bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu! ' hèia na pakèd'i ka nèti rai èta-èsu na, ètu rai mesopotamia, la'e asa kota haran.

source_text: then he came from the land of the chaldeans, and dwelt in charran. and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land in which ye now dwell.
target_text: hèia na tèke eele rai dhèu kasdim, ka la'e pea ètu kota haran. ropa ama d'èlu na madhe, ka ama lamatua lere ne asa rai ne'e ne, dhu ama-ama a'ari pea toke d'ai sange ne'e ne.

source_text: and he gave him no inheritance in it, no not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when as yet he had no child.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua hag'e boe rai ca kasib'i sa hia ne ho j'aj'i rai pusaka na. te ngaa ama lamatua moa tèke le, na, nèngu hia rai ne'e, j'aj'i rai pusaka ana-èpu na. te ngaa lod'o èèna, abraham dènge mèka ana.

source_text: and god spoke on this wise, that his offspring should sojourn in a foreign land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and treat them ill four hundred years.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, ‘bèli-camèd'a ana-èpu èu lasi pea ètu rai dhèu. ho dhèu rai èèna ènyi si, aa tao rèngu j'aj'i ènu, dènge paj'èra si toke d'ai èpa ngasu tèu.

source_text: and the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will i judge, said god: and after that they shall come forth, and serve me in this place.
target_text: ho ladhe èle èpa ngasu tèu èèna, ja'a huku dhèu kabarai dhu tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ènu sèra. hèia ana-èpu èu tèke eele rai èèna, ho rèngu mai asa era ne'e ne, sèna ka ra manèngi makasi mi ja'a. '

source_text: and he gave him the covenant of circumcision. and so abraham begat isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and isaac begat jacob, and jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na hia tadha lii moa ne dènge j'ara suna ana mone, j'aj'i tadha dhu sasoa na, abraham j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, ropa ana na, isak, d'ai umur aru lod'o, hèia na suna ne. aa isak suna ana na, yakob kahèi. aa yakob suna ana-ana mone na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, ladhe umur rèngu d'ai aru lod'o. rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, bèi-baki èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold joseph into egypt: but god was with him,
target_text: ca tèka, bèi-baki èdhi sèra d'ara pèd'a dènge ari ra yusuf, ka ra pahie eele ne ka j'aj'i ènu ètu rai masir nèi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ne.

source_text: and delivered him from all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom in the sight of pharaoh king of egypt; and he made him governor over egypt, and all his house.
target_text: nèti èèna ka lamatua patabuli eele ne nèti j'aj'èra nèngu. ama lamatua hia ne d'èlu-mèu, ka ne'a j'ara ae-ae, ka dhèu aae masir sue ne. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ne j'aj'i gubernur ètu rai masir. aa na nèd'u koasa kahèi ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: now there came a dearth over all the land of egypt and canaan, and great affliction; and our fathers found no sustenance.
target_text: hèia tèu manganga lèke rai masir dènge rai kana'an. tèu-tèu manganga mad'èu èèna, bia titu kèna. nèti èèna ka dhèu ètu mia-mia j'èra d'ai seli. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèi-baki èdhi abhu heka nganga'a.

source_text: but when jacob heard that there was corn in egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
target_text: te ngaa baki yakob tadèngi lii, na, ètu rai masir abhu nganga'a. ka na pua ana-ana na sèra, nuka bèi-baki èdhi, ho lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rai masir.

source_text: and at the second time joseph was made known to his brethren: and joseph's kindred was made known to pharaoh.
target_text: hèli rare, hèia ra lèpa. ropa oe èle nganga'a sèra, ka ama ra pua hari lasi hèli nganga'a ètu masir. lod'o èèna ka, heka yusuf bhoke d'ara, peka na, nèngu ne ari d'èlu rèngu. ka na patadha a'ari na sèra dènge dhèu aae masir.

source_text: then joseph sent, and called his father jacob to him, and all his kindred, seventy five souls.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf manèngi ama na dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i lasi pea asa rai masir. rèngu dhu lasi asa nèi, aa'i-aa'i ra pidhu nguru lèmi dhèu.

source_text: so jacob went down into egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
target_text: de baki yakob pidha asa nèi, toke d'ai bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe ètu masir.

source_text: and were carried over into sychem, and laid in the sepulcher that abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of emmor the father of sychem.
target_text: ka nèbhu aae ku, heka rèti rui bèi-baki èdhi sèra lèpa hari asa rae sikem ètu rai kana'an. ka ra tèke rui sèra ètu era dhu uru èèna baki abraham hèli nare nèti ana-èpu hemor.

source_text: but when the time of the promise drew nigh, which god had sworn to abraham, the people grew and multiplied in egypt,
target_text: stefanus tuhu hari lii, peka na, se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua moa tèke le, na, èèna na limuri hari nèngu neo hia rai pusaka mi baki abraham ètu era èèna. ropa oe d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua moa èèna, èdhi dhèu yahudi tabha ae titu kèna ètu rai masir nèi.

source_text: till another king arose, who knew not joseph.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae hiu èci paredha ètu nèi. te ngaa nèngu tadhe boe yusuf.

source_text: the same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and ill-treated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
target_text: dhèu aae ne'e ènyi ruri dhèu èdhi sèra. aa na bhelu titu kèna dènge bèi-baki èdhi. na laka-seti rèngu ho core eele ana rèngu dhu rara iisi hiu, sèna ka madhe.

source_text: in which time moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished in his father's house three months:
target_text: lod'o èèna, d'ai lod'o ina musa nara iisi ne. musa kabèb'u titu kèna! ina dènge ama na madhutu boe lii paredha dhèu aae. ra piara pahuni ne, toke d'ai tèlu hèru.

source_text: and when he was cast out, pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
target_text: ropa rèngu bisa heka pahuni ne ètu d'ara èmu, ka ra panangi eele ne. te ngaa ana bhèni dhèu aae masir rage nare ne, ka sa'u nèti asa èmu, ka na ladhe-leru ne sèmi ana d'èlu nèngu.

source_text: and moses was learned in all the wisdom of the egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu rai masir aj'a aa'i ne dènge mamèu ra, toke d'ai na j'aj'i dhèu d'èlu-mèu. nèngu ne d'èlu-mèu ètu d'ara lii padhai, aa ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a.

source_text: and when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of israel.
target_text: ropa musa d'ai umur èpa nguru tèu, hèia na neo patadha dènge dhèu isra'el nèngu sèra.

source_text: and seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the egyptian:
target_text: ropa na la'e, ka na nèdhi dhèu masir èci dhu game dhèu isra'el ca dhèu. ka na sarii dhèu isra'el èèna, aa na hake pamadhe dhèu masir èèna.

source_text: for he supposed his brethren to understand that god by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
target_text: te musa ngee, na, dhèu nèngu sèra re'a le, na, ama lamatua pua ne ho patabuli rèngu nèti j'aj'èra ra. te ngaa rèngu re'a mèka.

source_text: and the next day he showed himself to them as they were contending, and would have constrained them to be at peace again, saying, sirs, ye are brethren: why do ye wrong one to another?
target_text: bèli èèna, musa la'e hari ladhe dhèu isra'el na sèra. ka na rage dhèu dua pagama. aa na neo padame dhèu dua se, peka na, ‘weh! miu dua mi se, pa'a'ari. nga tao ka miu dua mi patao? '

source_text: but he that did his neighbor wrong, thrust him away, saying, who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu game angalai na, dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘cee ka dhu ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu ji'i! aa cee ka dhu paj'uj'u èu, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu j'ue lii langu ji'i?

source_text: wilt thou kill me, as thou didst the egyptian yesterday?
target_text: èu ngee, na, èu bisa pamadhe hari ja'a, sama sèmi èu pamadhe dhèu masir med'a na? '

source_text: then moses fled at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of madian, where he begat two sons.
target_text: ropa musa tadèngi nare lii ne'e, hèia na rai eele nèti rai masir, la'e pea ètu rai dhèu median. na leo-èmu ètu èèna, ka ra abhu ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and when forty years had expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount sina, an angel of the lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
target_text: d'ai èpa nguru tèu, hèia musa la'e asa d'ara mamoo èci, padètu dènge ledhe èci, ngara na ledhe sinai. ètu èèna, ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka pad'elo iisi na nèti d'ara ai dhu heo ètu ana aaj'u iiki ca kapua. ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, te ngaa kèpu boe.

source_text: when moses saw it, he wondered at the sight; and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the lord came to him,
target_text: ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka musa loo-loo sène. ka na la'e padètu ho neo ne'a, ngaa ka ne. kabèdhi laa, na tadèngi ama lamatua padhai lii nèti d'ara ai, peka na,

source_text: saying, i am the god of thy fathers, the god of abraham, and the god of isaac, and the god of jacob. then moses trembled, and durst not behold.
target_text: ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu! lamatua nèti baki abraham, baki isak, dènge baki yakob. ' tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka na madha'u toke d'ai isi karèbha. aa na bani heka doa kètu ho ladhe ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e èèna.

source_text: then said the lord to him, put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘we, musa! era dhu èu titu ne, era luri. bhoke eele salapa èu!

source_text: i have seen, i have seen the affliction of my people who are in egypt, and i have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. and now come, i will send thee into egypt.
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a bhèlu eele le dhèu isra'el unu ja'a ètu masir sèi. aad'o! ja'a sanèd'e si era. ja'a ke'a j'aj'èra rèngu. ja'a tadèngi le lii roma iisi rèngu manèngi sasue. de ja'a neo puru ho patabuli eele si. mai ku asa ne'e! ja'a neo pua èu lèpa hari asa masir nèi. '

source_text: this moses, whom they refused, saying, who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did god send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, ka lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi nèti d'ara ai èèna, na paredha musa ho lèpa hari asa masir. lamatua paj'uj'u nèngu ho patabuli eele dhèu isra'el nèti d'ara j'aj'èra rèngu. musa ne ka dhu uru èèna dhèu karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu ji'i? ' te ngaa ne'e ne, lamatua ka dhu ded'e ne!

source_text: he brought them out, after he had showed wonders and signs in the land of egypt, and in the red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, musa lèpa hari asa rai masir. ètu nèi, na tao tadha-tadha malaa ae. ka na kalua eele dhèu isra'el nèti masir. nèti si kako re dhasi mea, ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo d'ai èpa nguru tèu.

source_text: this is that moses, who said to the children of israel, a prophet will the lord your god raise up to you of your brethren, like me; him will ye hear.
target_text: ka musa peka dènge dhèu isra'el, aku nèngu na, ‘èèna na lamatua ded'e dhèu èci nèti talora miu, ho na paj'aj'i ne dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu, sama sèmi na ded'e nare ja'a. '

source_text: this is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on the mount sina, and with our fathers: who received the living oracles to give to us:
target_text: musa pa'èci dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra ètu d'ara mamoo. nèngu èèna ka dhu j'aj'i kalete mi bèi-baki èdhi dènge ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. te ana pajuu èèna ka dhu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua asa musa. sèra sa ka dhu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. lii holo-nori sèra ka dhu lamatua papuru ètu ledhe sinai.

source_text: whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into egypt,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa bèi-baki èdhi sèra ro'o boe nanene musa. aa ra tule eele ne, ho ra neo lèpa hari asa rai masir.

source_text: saying to aaron, make us gods to go before us: for as for this moses, who brought us out of the land of egypt, we know not what is become of him.
target_text: ka ra lasi rarange harun, aku rèngu na, ‘ari mu musa ka dhu pakalua eele èdhi nèti rai masir. te ngaa èdhi te'a heka nèngu ètu ro'a mia. de ji'i manèngi èu tao mèdha sogo-tagu èci hia èdhi, sèna ka mèdha sogo-tagu èèna lere èdhi. '

source_text: and they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
target_text: ka ra tao ka mèdha sogo-tagu èci, rupa sèmi ana sapi ci'u. èle èèna ka, ra para badha hia mèdha sogo-tagu èèna. ka ra ra'a-sisi rame-rame, lula rèngu karej'e nèti mèdha sogo-tagu dhu rèngu tao unu ra.

source_text: then god turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, o ye house of israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices during forty years in the wilderness?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua soro kabodho hia si. ka ra mulai sogo-tagu ka mèdha dedha-liru, sèmi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu. te ngaa lamatua soro tèke si sèmi èèna. èèna na lèke sèmi lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘weh! miu dhèu isra'el sèra! d'ara èpa nguru tèu, miu kako palème d'ara mamoo. aa miu para badha sèra, neo sogo-tagu mi ja'a, do, neo sogo-tagu mi cee?

source_text: yes, ye took up the tabernacle of moloch, and the star of your god remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and i will carry you away beyond babylon.
target_text: miu koa-kio boe ja'a! bèli-bèli miu sogo-tagu dhoka mèdha sogo-tagu miu sèra di. miu maso-kalua taruu d'ara èmu mèdha sogo-tagu nidhu, ngara na molok. miu biasa sogo-tagu nidhu hua-hètu èci kahèi, ngara na refan. de miu d'èi dhoka sogo-tagu mèdha pa'ue-ai miu. nèti èèna ka, limuri mai ja'a bhabhoo miu lami asa cabèka babel nèi. '

source_text: our fathers had the tabernacle of testimony in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking to moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
target_text: stefanus padhai lii taruu, peka na, ama lamatua paj'uj'u rupa nèti era manèngi-mangaj'i èci mi musa. hèia musa si patitu paleo manèngi-mangaj'i èci, dhu tao nèti ka'uri badha dènge bèla, sama sèmi rupa dhu lamatua pad'elo le. ka dhèu isra'el sèra mai sabaj'a mi ama lamatua ètu era èèna. ho ladhe rèngu pidha nèti ca'era asa era leo lasi, na, ra sag'e eele paleo manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, aa ra èki nèu ne, aa ra jèru rèti asa era hiu. ètu era hiu, ra patitu hari paleo èèna.

source_text: which also our fathers, that came after, brought in with jesus into the possession of the gentiles, whom god drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of david;
target_text: limuri mai, lod'o yosua si pamusu dènge dhèu rai leo ètu rai kana'an, ama lamatua babège eele si. ka na pabagi rai kana'an èèna hia bèi-baki èdhi. lod'o rèngu parame rare rai èèna, rèngu rèti paleo manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua asa era èèna. paleo èèna titu taruu ètu èèna, toke d'ai lod'o dhèu aae daud nèd'u paredha.

source_text: who found favor before god, and desired to find a tabernacle for the god of jacob.
target_text: dhèu aae daud manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, sama sèmi baki yakob si. ka daud pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, hèia lamatua hia nèngu berkat. ka na manèngi ho lamatua paj'uj'u nèngu sèna ka patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu hiu.

source_text: but solomon built him a house.
target_text: te ngaa ana nèti daud, ngara na soleman ka dhu patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua èèna.

source_text: yet, the most high dwelleth not in temples made with hands, as saith the prophet,
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua pea boe ètu d'ara èmu dhu dhèu rai-haha tao, lula uru èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èci suri tèke le, peka na,

source_text: heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build for me? saith the lord: or what is the place of my rest?
target_text: ‘dedha-liru èèna, kadera era ja'a madhèdi paredha. aa rai-haha èèna, era hue haga ja'a. de tasamia ka miu bisa tao èmu èci dhu be'a hia ja'a pea ètu d'ara? bisa boe!

source_text: hath not my hand made all these things?
target_text: lula dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu paj'aj'i! '

source_text: ye stiff-necked, and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the holy spirit: as your fathers did, so do ye.
target_text: hèia stefanus tuhu hari lii padhai na, ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, miu dhèu kètu hadhu! miu se, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu nanene boe nèngu. miu dhèu dhu palab'a dènge ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge bèi-baki miu dhu soro kabodho asa ne! ka limuri ne, miu neo hari palab'a dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, do?

source_text: which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them who showed before of the coming of the just one; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers;
target_text: bèi-baki miu sèra ka dhu paj'èra taruu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. miu peka ku! dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua mia ka dhu rèngu paj'èra boe? aad'o, sina ma! uru èèna dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka mema, aku rèngu na, limuri mai ama lamatua pua dhèu nèngu dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa bèi-baki miu pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. ka miu tenge j'ara kahèi ho hia dhèu leo pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci nèti lamatua.

source_text: who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
target_text: aa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga sèra dhu rèti mai atora ad'a dhu lamatua neo hia mi èdhi, te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe.

source_text: when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu pama'ète lii langu sèra nanene rare lii padhai lii stefanus, ka re'a mema, na, nèngu pasala si. ka ra kadhi ngutu aa tèka d'ara.

source_text: but he, being full of the holy spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of god, and jesus standing on the right hand of god,
target_text: te ngaa roh mola-mèci lamatua sab'a ètu d'ara stefanus. na doa kètu ka ladhe asa dedha-liru. ètu nèi, na ladhe nèdhi dadedha ama lamatua, dènge nèdhi kahèi lamatua yesus titu ètu sebhe g'ana na ètu era dhu kab'ua risi.

source_text: and said, behold, i see the heavens opened, and the son of man standing on the right hand of god.
target_text: hèia stefanus padhai lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e ku, ama aa'i-aa'i. ja'a kèdhi liru bhoke eele, aa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a titu ètu era hua iia, re sebhe g'ana ama lamatua.

source_text: then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu pama'ète lii langu sèra hutu ro'a dhilu ra. ka ra jèke ne, sèna ka kai stefanus baku bhoke hèb'a. ka ra mangamok neo game ne.

source_text: and cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was saul.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra nuni-pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u kota. d'ai nèi, ka sakasii sèra bhoke eele kodho li'u ra, ho ra hia mi ana mone ngèru èci nèd'u. ngara na saulus, dhu j'aj'i dhèu dadugu-rariu dhèu. èle èèna ka, ra tabhie stefanus dènge hadhu.

source_text: and they stoned stephen, calling upon god, and saying, lord jesus, receive my spirit.
target_text: ropa ra tabhie, hèia stefanus pa'oo, peka na, lamatua yesus! lod'o ja'a d'ai kèna. sèmi more ku samanga ja'a!

source_text: and he kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, lord, lay not this sin to their charge. and when he had said this, he fell asleep.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na bèbhe-lèpe urutuu, ka na pa'oo hari dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ama! baku hia si d'ui sasala ne'e! hèia na ma'ète a'ae dènge ka.

source_text: and saul was consenting to his death. and at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at jerusalem; and they were all dispersed throughout the regions of judea and samaria, except the apostles.
target_text: aa saulus ètu èèna kahèi, ka nèngu d'èi ra pamadhe stefanus kahèi.

source_text: and devout men carried stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
target_text: lod'o stefanus madhe, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara d'èi dènge lamatua. lasi rare ngi'u aae stefanus ho ra padhane. ka ra tangi ne. nèti lod'o èèna, ka dhèu paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu kota yerusalem, toke d'ai rèngu j'èra bia. èle èèna ka, rèngu rai pahag'a lasi asa propensi yudea dènge propensi samaria. rèngu aa'i-aa'i rai, te ngaa tèke eele dhoka dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus di ètu yerusalem.

source_text: as for saul, he made havoc of the church, entering into every house, and hauling men and women committed them to prison.
target_text: te ngaa saulus tenge j'ara taruu ho pa'èle dhèu unu yesus sèra. na tenge si ètu mia-mia. na maso-kalua èmu dhèu ho na tenge si. sad'i abhu dhèu mone, do dhèu bhèni, na kèpe si, ho na cèlu si asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: therefore they that were dispersed went every where preaching the word.
target_text: masi ka ra paj'èra dhèu unu yesus sèra ho ra rai asa haa asa dhimu, te ngaa rèngu loe boe peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus asa mia-mia.

source_text: then philip went down to the city of samaria, and preached christ to them.
target_text: conto sèmi, ca tèka, pelipus la'e asa d'ara kota èci ètu propensi samaria, ho peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, na, yesus, nuka kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: and the people with one accord gave heed to those things which philip spoke, hearing and seeing the miracles which he performed.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, ka ra pakaboko ho nanene paie ngaa dhu pelipus peka-padhai.

source_text: for unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
target_text: conto sèmi, ètu èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu nidhu tao. nidhu sèra rai eele dhèu se'e dènge pakii-pakèce. dhèu karuku dènge dhèu haga roe cabèka, èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: and there was great joy in that city.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara kota èèna karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: but there was a certain man called simon, who before in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
target_text: ètu kota èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu pake na'i, ngara na simon. nèbhu le na pake na'i ètu talora dhèu samaria sèra. ka na padedha iisi na, peka na, ja'a dhèu èra!

source_text: to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, this man is the great power of god. and to him they had regard, because that for a long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
target_text: ka nèti kota èèna, ana iiki do dhèu kapai, dhèu mone do bhèni, palolo dhoka dhèu ne'e di, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e ele-madha, nga! ngaa-ngaa dhu na tao ne, mai nèti koasa ama lamatua! lula nèngu pake na'i, nèti uru ka mai dhèu ae lèka ne.

source_text: but when they believed philip, preaching the things concerning the kingdom of god, and the name of jesus christ, they were baptized both men and women.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, rèngu nanene pelipus aj'a rèngu j'ara paredha ama lamatua. aa na peka j'ara ho rèngu rèti kolongara yesus, sèna ka rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. ropa ra tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae parcaya, ka j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ra abhu sarani.

source_text: then simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
target_text: te ngaa simon parcaya kahèi, ka manèngi j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka ra sarani ne. hèia na madhutu pelipus asa mia-mia. ropa nèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu pelipus tao, hèia na pangètu kètu na, peka na, ira ii! sèmi ne'e ne, risi eele!

source_text: now when the apostles who were at jerusalem heard that samaria had received the word of god, they sent to them peter and john:
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus dhu ètu yerusalem sèra, tadèngi, na, dhèu ae parcaya le lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu propensi samaria. ka ra manèngi petrus dènge yohanis lasi asa nèi.

source_text: who, when they had come down, prayed for them that they might receive the holy spirit: for as yet he had fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the lord jesus. then they laid their hands on them, and they received the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai nèi, rèngu heka re'a kèna, dhèu ètu nèi abhu mèka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. rèngu dhoka abhu sarani pake kolongara yesus di. hèia petrus dènge yohanis bane ai mi dhèu sèra, ka ra manèngi-mangaj'i sèna ka dhèu samaria sèra sèmi rare roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci kahèi. ka dhèu se'e abhu dènge roh kahèi.

source_text: and when simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the holy spirit was given, he offered them money,
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon ladhe nèdhi rèngu dua ra bane ai mi dhèu se'e, ka dhèu sèra sèmi rare roh lamatua. hèia na j'ole doi asa petrus dènge yohanis, dènge lii manèngi, peka na,

source_text: saying, give me also this power, that on whomsoever i lay hands, he may receive the holy spirit.
target_text: ama-ama! miu hia ku ja'a koasa èèna. sèna ka ladhe ja'a bane ai mi dhèu, na, ra abhu roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci kahèi.

source_text: but peter said to him, thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of god may be purchased with money.
target_text: te ngaa petrus jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhoo èu dènge doi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa hèli koasa roh mola-mèci dènge doi dhari, do? aad'o! dhèu bisa boe hèli roh lamatua!

source_text: thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of god.
target_text: èu dènge boe hak mi roh lamatua, lula d'ara èu mola boe. èu dhoka tenge-tenge j'ara di.

source_text: repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray god, if perhaps the thought of thy heart may be forgiven thee.
target_text: èu hud'i ae eele ku nèti sasala-sasigo èu sèra. hua iia èu sabaj'a ho teko-teko lamatua saku eele ngangee aapa èu.

source_text: for i perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, d'ara èu aapa, aa j'ara karehe ae dhu èki èu!

source_text: then answered simon, and said, pray ye to the lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
target_text: ka simon manèngi dua si, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe sèmi èèna, miu dua mi sabaj'a ku hia ja'a, sèna ka lii dhoo dhu miu peka èèna, baku lèke ja'a.

source_text: and they, when they had testified and preached the word of the lord, returned to jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the samaritans.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia petrus dènge yohanis lole aa'i lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, aa ra lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu d'ara kota èèna. hèia rèngu lèpa hari asa yerusalem. ra kako re rae-rae ètu propensi samaria, ho lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus mi dhèu ètu rae sèra.

source_text: and the angel of the lord spoke to philip, saying, arise, and go towards the south, to the way that goeth down from jerusalem to gaza, which is desert.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga pua pelipus, peka na, lamu ku madhutu j'ara asa balèu. madhutu j'ara dhui, dhu nèti kota yerusalem la'e asa rai gasa.

source_text: and he arose, and went: and behold, a man of ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under candace queen of the ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to jerusalem to worship, was returning; and sitting in his chariot, read isaiah the prophet.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii paredha èèna, ka na pakèd'i dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kako ètu j'ara èèna, ladhe nèdhi dhèu èci. dhèu èèna, pegawi kapai nèti rai etiopia. nèngu ne ka dhu ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau dhèu aae bhèni, ngara na kandake. pegawi èèna heka sabaj'a nare ètu yerusalem, ka na lèpa èmu ca'e kareta. ropa pelipus nèdhi ne, nèngu madhèdi baca ètu dedha kareta. na baca sasuri dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya.

source_text: then the spirit said to philip, go near and join thyself to this chariot.
target_text: èle èèna ka, roh lamatua pua pelipus la'e padètu asa kareta èèna, sèna ka na paraga dènge dhèu èèna.

source_text: and philip ran thither to him, and heard him reading the prophet isaiah, and said, understandest thou what thou readest?
target_text: ropa na dètu, ka na tadèngi, na, dhèu èèna baca sasuri yesaya. ka pelipus karèi ne, peka na, ama! ama ku me'a, do aad'o, ngaa dhu ama baca èèna?

source_text: and he said, how can i, except some man should guide me? and he desired philip that he would come up, and sit with him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ja'a ke'a boe. hud'i abhu ku dhèu dhu peka-padhai dènge ja'a, heka ja'a ke'a kèna. ca'e mai ho madhèdi dènge ja'a.

source_text: the place of the scripture which he read was this, he was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so he opened not his mouth:
target_text: sasuri dhu na baca èèna, sèmi ne'e ka, ra nuni rèti ne, sama sèmi nuni kahib'i-kalèbho, ho neo roro ne. nèngu j'aj'i sama sèmi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dhèu g'ute rèu ne, te ngaa nèngu mau-mau sène, na kabee boe. hèb'a na kutu mèno, aa na kalua boe lii ca lamusi sa.

source_text: in his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
target_text: ka ra lalangu ne, ra j'ue lii langu na lèke boe. lod'o èèna, ra pamadhe ne, masi ka nèngu dènge boe sasala-sasigo. de èdhi peka ngaa hari lula-nèti ana-èpu na?

source_text: and the eunuch answered philip, and said, i pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
target_text: ropa na baca nare, hèia na karèi pelipus, peka na, tasamia, ee? sasuri yesaya ne, lèke mi nèngu, do, lèke mi dhèu leo?

source_text: then philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached to him jesus.
target_text: ka pelipus aj'a ne lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. na lolo nèti lii sasuri yesaya, ho pad'elo j'ara madhutu yesus.

source_text: and as they went on their way, they came to a certain water: and the eunuch said, see, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu d'ara kakako era, rèngu rage loko èci dènge èi. ka dhèu èèna peka dènge pelipus, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ku èi ka nèi. ladhe èu ngee, na, cadhui boe, mai puru lati, ho èu sarani ku ja'a.

source_text: and philip said, if thou believest with all thy heart, thou mayest. and he answered and said, i believe that jesus christ is the son of god.
target_text: hèia pelipus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe ama tare'a-re'a parcaya lamatua yesus, na, cadhui boe. mai dua ti puru ho ja'a sarani èu. ka na dhaa, peka na, ja'a parcaya tare'a-re'a, na, yesus èèna dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai. nèngu èèna, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: and he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they both went down into the water, both philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
target_text: hèia pegawi èèna, paredha ho patitu kareta. ka dua ra puru asa d'ara èi èèna, ka pelipus sarani ne.

source_text: and when they had come up out of the water, the spirit of the lord caught away philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
target_text: ropa ra kalua mai nèti d'ara èi, kabèdhi laa roh lamatua ded'e nèti pelipus asa era leo. ka dhèu èèna nèdhi heka pelipus. hèia pegawi kapai èèna lèpa dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: but philip was found at azotus: and passing through, he preached in all the cities, till he came to cesarea.
target_text: ka pelipus cèu ètu rae èci, ngara na asotus. nèti rae èèna, ka na la'e padhue-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. na dhuli rae-rae ètu rai èèna, toke d'ai kota kaisarea.

source_text: and saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the lord, went to the high priest,
target_text: lod'o èèna, saulus paj'èra taruu dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu yesus. na tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe si. nèti èèna ka, la'e asa kètu kapai risi agama yahudi,

source_text: and desired from him letters to damascus to the synagogues, that if he should find any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound to jerusalem.
target_text: ka manèngi pèri-pèri sasuri koasa, ho nèti la'e asa ama-ama èmu manèngi-mangaj'i agama yahudi ètu kota damsik nèi. na manèngi, ladhe nèngu rage dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus ètu nèi, bhèni-mone, nèngu kèpe ho èki si, sèna ka ère nèti hari si asa yerusalem.

source_text: and as he journeyed, he came near damascus: and suddenly there shined around him a light from heaven:
target_text: ropa sèmi nare sasuri koasa sèra, ka nèngu dènge angalai na lasi asa kota damsik. ropa oe dètu dènge kota èèna, cag'ag'a laa, saraa puru nèti dedha-liru sarimu nare saulus.

source_text: and he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, saul, saul, why persecutest thou me?
target_text: ka na bèbhe rai la'e. hèia na tadèngi lii èci padhai lii dènge ne, peka na, saulus! saulus! nga tao ka èu paj'èra ja'a sèmi ne'e?

source_text: and he said, who art thou, lord? and the lord said, i am jesus whom thou persecutest. it is hard for thee to kick against the goads.
target_text: hèia saulus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhu padhai lii ne, cee ka èu? lii èèna, peka hari, ja'a ne, yesus, dhu èu paj'èra aae ne.

source_text: and he trembling and astonished said, lord, what wilt thou have me to do? and the lord said to him, arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
target_text: kèd'i, ho lamu asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, pe ja'a peka dènge èu, ngaa dhu èu hud'i tao.

source_text: and the men who journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
target_text: aa angalai nèngu sèra tadèngi kahèi lii èèna, te ngaa rèdhi boe cee-cee. dhèu se'e malaa, ka re'a heka padhai lii ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into damascus.
target_text: hèia saulus kèd'i titu. ka na neo bhoke musi madha na, te ngaa nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ka ra sarad'e rèti ne asa d'ara kota damsik.

source_text: and he was three days without sight, and neither ate nor drank.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, na bisa boe nèdhi ngaa-ngaa. aa na'a-ninu boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: and there was a certain disciple at damascus, named ananias; and to him said the lord in a vision, ananias. and he said, behold, i am here, lord.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota èèna, abhu dhèu unu lamatua yesus èci, ngara na ananias. lamatua mai pad'elo iisi dènge ne, sama sèmi tanila sa. na paroa, peka na, ananias! hèia ananias dhaa, peka na, oo, lamatua!

source_text: and the lord said to him, arise, and go into the street which is called straight, and inquire in the house of judas for one called saul of tarsus: for behold, he prayeth,
target_text: lamatua peka, na, nanene ku! èu lamu tenge ku dhèu unu ja'a èci. kako lamu asa j'ara èci, dhu ngara na j'ara mola. lamu asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. ètu èèna, karèi rèngu dhèu èci nèti kota tarsus, ngara na saulus. dhèu èèna sabaj'a era.

source_text: and hath seen in a vision a man named ananias, coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
target_text: ja'a hia ne tanila kahèi, na, èèna na dhèu mone èci neo mai paraga dènge ne, nuka èu, ananias. de lamu ho bane ai èu mi nèngu, sèna ka na bisa nèdhi hari.

source_text: then ananias answered, lord, i have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at jerusalem:
target_text: te ngaa ananias b'ala, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, lamatua! ji'i tadèngi le lii palolo lula-nèti dhèu èèna. nèngu èèna ka dhu paj'èra dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bani heka bhodho baboro!

source_text: and here he hath authority from the chief priests, to bind all that call on thy name.
target_text: limuri ne, ji'i tadèngi hari, peka na, kètu agama yahudi sèra hia ne koasa ho mai kèpa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus.

source_text: but the lord said to him, go, for he is a chosen vessel to me, to bear my name before the gentiles, and kings, and the children of israel.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua padhai lii hari dènge ananias, peka na, masi ka sèmi èèna, èu hud'i lamu ku! te ja'a hag'e kore nèngu le, ho na bhoke j'ara, sèna ka na lole lii lolo be'a ja'a hia dhèu kabarai leo sèra, hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu isra'el kahèi.

source_text: for i will show him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a pad'elo dènge ne, sèna ka nèngu ne'a mema j'aj'èra tasa mera mia ka dhu bèli-camèd'a nèngu pasae, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and ananias went, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him, said, brother saul, the lord even jesus that appeared to thee in the way as thou camest hath sent me, that thou mayest receive thy sight, and be filled with the holy spirit.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii padhai lii lamatua, hèia ananias la'e ka maso asa èmu èèna. ka na bane ai na mi saulus, peka na, angalai saulus! lamatua yesus dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu talora j'ara lod'o èu mai asa ne'e, nèngu èèna ka dhu pua ja'a mai paraga dènge èu ètu ne'e. na pua ja'a kahèi ho sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha èu, sèna ka èu bisa mèdhi hari. aa na d'èi ho èu sèmi more roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: and immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, saulus rasa ngaa èci bèbhe eele nèti musi madha nèngu, sèmi nai i'a. hèia na ladhe nèdhi hari. ka na kèd'i, aa ra sarani dènge ne.

source_text: and when he had received food, he was strengthened. then was saul certain days with the disciples who were at damascus.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na na'a-ninu. ka na abhu hari a'èra. ka saulus pea hari dènge dhèu unu lamatua yesus pèri-pèri lod'o ètu kota damsik.

source_text: and immediately he preached christ in the synagogues, that he is the son of god.
target_text: aa la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! mema yesus tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua.

source_text: but all that heard him were amazed, and said, is not this he that destroyed them who called on this name in jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound to the chief priests?
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa dènge bingu, ropa ra tadèngi saulus padhai lii sèmi èèna. hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, nèngu ka dhu paj'èra dhèu unu yesus ètu yerusalem, sina ma? aa mamai ne, sèna ka na kèpe dhèu se'e ho nèti asa kètu agama yahudi sèra! na, tasamia ka ne?

source_text: but saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the jews who dwelt at damascus, proving that this is very christ.
target_text: te ngaa saulus padhai lii taruu, aku nèngu na, yesus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru, ho pua na mai. saulus padhai lii dènge d'èlu-mèu aa d'ara adhu, toke dhèu yahudi sèra segi boe nèngu. nèti èèna ka, a'èra saulus asa tabha kapai.

source_text: and after many days were fulfilled, the jews took counsel to kill him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu yahudi sèra sanunu ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: but their laying in wait, was known to saul. and they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
target_text: te ngaa saulus ae nare ngangee aapa rèngu èèna, dhu peka na, ra mate ne mèu-mèda ètu hèb'a-hèb'a tebho kota, ho ra neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
target_text: ka ca tèka hari, d'ara mèda, angalai saulus pèri-pèri dhèu mai rare ne, ka ra papuru ne ètu d'ara kadhari cue, re karasa li'u tebho kota. dènge j'ara èèna ka, nèngu rai nèti kota damsik.

source_text: and when saul had come to jerusalem, he essayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
target_text: èle èèna ka, saulus la'e asa yerusalem. d'ai nèi, ka na neo pa'èci dènge dhèu unu lamatua yesus. te ngaa dhèu sèra madha'u dènge nèngu, lula ra pangee, na, nèngu dhoka sangaja di, j'aj'i dhèu parcaya dhu madhutu lamatua yesus. èle èèna na, nèngu kabèli hari ho neo kèpe rèngu.

source_text: but barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at damascus in the name of jesus.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci, ngara na barnabas, nèngu ka dhu nèti saulus ho patadhe mi dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua ètu èèna. na lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi dedha saulus ètu talora j'ara. na peka, na, saulus paraga le dènge lamatua yesus kahèi. aa yesus padhai lii dènge nèngu kahèi. na lolo kahèi babani saulus padhai lii j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus mi dhèu damsik sèra.

source_text: and he was with them coming in and going out at jerusalem.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare barnabas peka sèmi èèna, heka ra sèmi rare saulus kèna. ka ra pea pa'èci ètu kota yerusalem. saulus bani lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus kahèi, sad'i dènge dhèu cee èèna ka. nèngu madha'u boe.

source_text: and he spoke boldly in the name of the lord jesus, and disputed against the grecians: but they went about to slay him.
target_text: na pakarèi dènge pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu padhai lii yunani. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii padhai lii nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra tenge j'ara neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to cesarea, and sent him forth to tarsus.
target_text: ropa dhèu unu lamatua yesus re'a ngangee karehe dhèu sèra, hèia lasi rare saulus rèti asa kota kaisarea. d'ai nèi, ka ra pua ne lèpa asa kota na, tarsus.

source_text: then had the churches rest throughout all judea, and galilee, and samaria, and were edified: and walking in the fear of the lord, and in the comfort of the holy spirit, were multiplied.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu propensi yudea, propensi galilea, dènge propensi samaria, mamuri dènge mera-milu. rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pa'èra d'ara rèngu.

source_text: and it came to pass, as peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints who dwelt at lydda.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o sèra, petrus biasa kako palème asa mia-mia, ho pa'èra d'ara dhèu unu lamatua sèra. ca lod'o ka na la'e ngad'o rèngu ètu rae lida.

source_text: and there he found a certain man named eneas, who had kept his bed eight years, and was sick with the palsy.
target_text: ètu nèi, na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ngara na eneas. dhèu ne, karuku aru tèu kèna, ka na kèd'i nare heka nèti era j'unu na.

source_text: and peter said to him, eneas, jesus christ healeth thee: arise, and make thy bed. and he arose immediately.
target_text: hèia petrus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, eneas! limuri ne, lamatua yesus kristus pa'èle èu. de kèd'i ka! lalau paie era j'unu èu! nanene nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and all that dwelt at lydda and saron saw him, and turned to the lord.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi eneas èle le, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rae lida dènge rae saron parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: now there was at joppa a certain disciple named tabitha, who by interpretation is called dorcas: this woman was full of good works and alms-deeds which she did.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na tabita, pea dètu dènge nebhe dhasi ètu kota yope. madhutu lii yunani ra paroa bhèni ne, ngara na dorkas. sasoa na ‘rusa'. bhèni ne parcaya lamatua yesus. tatao bhèni ne be'a mi dedha dhèu leo, aa na tema laladhe dhèu j'èra.

source_text: and it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom, when they had washed, they laid in an upper chamber.
target_text: lod'o èèna, tabita ne pèd'a aae, ka madhe. ka dhèu padiu ne èi. èle èèna ka, ra papake ne mèdha-papake, ka ra paj'unu ne ètu kama dedha.

source_text: and as lydda was nigh to joppa, and the disciples had heard that peter was there, they sent to him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu se tadèngi, na, petrus ètu rae lida, dhu kaj'èu nèti kota yope, sèmi kako haga na ele boe ca'èta lod'o sa. ka ra pua dhèu dua lasi paroa petrus, peka na, ama! ji'i manèngi ama mai ku lai-lai asa kota yope.

source_text: then peter arose, and went with them. when he had come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which dorcas made, while she was with them.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka petrus kèd'i dènge ka, la'e madhutu rèngu. d'ai nèi, ka na maso taruu asa d'ara kama tabita. ètu d'ara kama na, pènu le dènge bhèni balu dhu mai tangi. bhèni balu sèra pad'elo mi petrus kodho dènge mèdha-papake leo, dhu dorkas j'au hia rèngu, lod'o na mamuri era.

source_text: but peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning to the body, said, tabitha, arise. and she opened her eyes: and when she saw peter, she sat up.
target_text: hèia petrus pua si kalua nèti kama. ka na patitu urutuu ho na manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia na ladhe asa dhèu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii, peka na, tabita! kèd'i ka! cag'ag'a laa, tabita bhoke musi madha na. ropa ladhe nèdhi petrus, ka na kèd'i madhèdi.

source_text: and he gave her his hand, and lifted her up; and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
target_text: hèia petrus kèpe kacui-aai na, ho hia ne titu. ka petrus paroa bhèni balu sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu leo ètu èèna, ho na hia bhèni dhu mamuri hari ne asa rèngu.

source_text: and it was known throughout all joppa: and many believed in the lord.
target_text: ka lii lole ne, dhèu lolo palème d'ara kota yope, toke d'ai dhèu ae parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: and it came to pass, that he tarried many days in joppa with one simon a tanner.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus pea pèri-pèri lod'o ètu èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. dhèu ne'e, tuka pamèu ka'uri badha.

source_text: there was a certain man in cesarea, called cornelius, a centurion of the band called the italian band,
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu komedhaa sordad'u roma dhèu èci, ngara na kornelis. nèngu ne, komedhaa nèti sordad'u cangasu dhèu. rèngu mai nèti kaj'èu, nèti rai italia, ka ra pea ètu kota kaisarea.

source_text: a devout man, and one that feared god with all his house, who gave much alms to the people, and prayed to god always.
target_text: nèngu dènge isi èmu na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ae ka dhèu roma leo sèmi boe èèna. nèngu biasa soru-bara dhèu j'èra, aa na maj'èni sabaj'a mi ama lamatua.

source_text: he saw in a vision evidently, about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of god coming in to him, and saying to him, cornelius.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, na abhu tanila. na ladhe nèdhi iia-iia ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka na paroa ne, peka na, kornelis!

source_text: and when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, what is it, lord? and he said to him, thy prayers and thy alms are come up for a memorial before god.
target_text: ropa kornelis ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga, ka na madha'u titu kèna. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama? ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, na, lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu leo. ka na sanèd'e èu.

source_text: and now send men to joppa, and call for one simon, whose surname is peter:
target_text: de pua dhèu lasi asa kota yope, ho paroa rèti dhèu èci, ngara na simon petrus.

source_text: he lodgeth with one simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea-side: he will tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
target_text: dhèu èèna manubha ètu èmu cue ètu sebhe dhasi, unu simon, tuka pamèu ka'uri badha.

source_text: and when the angel who spoke to cornelius had departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
target_text: ropa ana pajuu nèti sorga ne tèke eele kornelis, ka na paroa ana sab'a na dhèu dua, dènge sordad'u èci dhu d'èi padètu dènge lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and when he had declared all these things to them, he sent them to joppa.
target_text: kornelis lolo aa'i ngaa dhu nèngu nèdhi èèna, ka na pua si lasi asa kota yope.

source_text: on the morrow, as they were going on their journey, and drew nigh to the city, peter went up upon the house-top to pray, about the sixth hour:
target_text: ka asa bèli èèna, pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, dhèu paleha nèti kornelis sèra oe d'ai le yope. lod'o èèna, petrus ca'e la'e neo manèngi-mangaj'i asa kalaga dedha èmu simon.

source_text: and he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
target_text: ropa na manèngi-mangaj'i, na rasa manganga. na mate dhèu lalau nganga'a-nginu. ropa nèngu manèngi-mangaj'i era, na abhu tanila kahèi.

source_text: and saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending to him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
target_text: na nèdhi sèmi liru bhoka. ka hahèla-koi bhèla aae ca bèla puru mai, dhu èki re suu-suu èpa na.

source_text: in which were all manner of four-footed beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping animals, and fowls of the air.
target_text: ètu d'ara hahèla-koi èèna, nèngu ladhe nèdhi rupa-rupa badha, nuka badha ai èpa, badha rod'o-kakara, dènge rupa-rupa manu-bhui kahèi.

source_text: and there came a voice to him, rise, peter; kill, and eat.
target_text: hèia na tadèngi lii èci pua ne, petrus! kèd'i ka! kèj'i badha se, ho mu'a!

source_text: but peter said, not so, lord; for i have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, ama! baku sèmi èèna! te ja'a ku'a kèdhi mèka sisi badha sèmi se'e! ji'i dhèu yahudi luri sisi badha se'e aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: and the voice spoke to him again the second time, what god hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
target_text: te ngaa lii ne b'ala hari, peka na, ladhe ama lamatua peka mèdha ngaa dhu mèu, èu baku peka kaj'alu!

source_text: this was done thrice: and the vessel was received again into heaven.
target_text: hahèla-koi èèna cèu tèlu hari, èle èèna ka ca'e hari asa dedha-liru la'e.

source_text: now while peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men who were sent from cornelius had made inquiry for simon's house, and were standing before the gate,
target_text: hèia petrus pajiko la'e-mai sasoa tanila deo na. kabèdhi laa, ana paleha kornelis sèra d'ai madha èmu simon. ra titu ètu hèb'a èmu.

source_text: and called, and asked whether simon, who was surnamed peter, lodged there.
target_text: ka ra lii, peka na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci dhu manubha ètu èmu ne'e. ngara na, simon petrus. ele boe ama tadhe, do?

source_text: while peter thought on the vision, the spirit said to him, behold, three men seek thee.
target_text: ropa petrus pajiko sasoa tanila na era. ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ne, petrus. dhèu mate èu ka haha si.

source_text: arise therefore, and go down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for i have sent them.
target_text: de puru ho lamu ka dènge si. èu baku mage-mage ia ka. masi ka ad'a yahudi aj'a, na, dhèu yahudi hud'i madenge dènge dhèu leo, te ngaa èu baku madenge dènge rèngu, lula ja'a ka dhu pua rèngu mai rare èu.

source_text: then peter went down to the men who were sent to him from cornelius; and said, behold, i am he whom ye seek: what is the cause for which ye have come?
target_text: ka petrus puru la'e paraga dènge dhèu sèra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e ka dhu miu tenge. de miu parluu ngaa?

source_text: and they said, cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth god, and of good report among all the nation of the jews, was warned from god by a holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words from thee.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, komedhaa sordad'u roma èci pua ji'i mai asa ne'e. nèngu èèna, komedhaa nèti cangasu sordad'u. dhèu ne d'ara mola, aa na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. dhèu yahudi ae dhu re'a le babe'a dhèu ne'e. med'a na, heka ana pajuu ama lamatua puru mai nèti sorga, ho pua lamatua ji'i manèngi èu lamu asa èmu na, ho na neo nanene unu na nèti èu.

source_text: then he called them in, and lodged them. and on the morrow peter went with them, and certain brethren from joppa accompanied him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia petrus manèngi rèngu ho j'unu taha mèda ne ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, ra pakèd'i, lasi palere. dhèu unu lamatua yesus pèri-pèri nèti yope lasi kahèi.

source_text: and on the morrow they entered into cesarea. and cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
target_text: mèda èèna rèngu j'unu ètu j'ara. bèli èèna, heka rèngu d'ai kota kaisarea kèna. ropa rèngu d'ai, kornelis mate mema rèngu. na pakaboko nare le a'ari na dènge mone-aanga angalai na ètu èmu nèngu.

source_text: and as peter was coming in, cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai hèb'a èmu, kornelis mai soru ne, ka madhèdi patitu kètu urutuu ètu haga petrus, ho na pahaha iisi.

source_text: but peter took him up, saying, stand up: i myself also am a man.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pakèd'i ne, peka na, ama! baku sèmi èèna! baku pahaha iisi mi ja'a. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èu kahèi.

source_text: and as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that had come together.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, kornelis kèd'i titu dènge. ka dua ra padhai lii, kako lasi asa d'ara èmu. d'ai d'ara èmu, petrus nèdhi dhèu ae pakaboko mate nèngu.

source_text: and he said to them, ye know that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a jew to keep company, or come to one of another nation; but god hath shown me that i should not call any man common or unclean.
target_text: na ladhe palème dhèu sèra, ka na padhai lii, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i mi! miu me'a mema ad'a ji'i dhèu yahudi. madhutu ad'a ji'i, na, ji'i bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu leo. ngaa hari, maso asa d'ara èmu ra. te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo le dènge ja'a, ladhe mèdha ngaa dhu nèngu peka na mèu, ja'a baku peka na mèdha èèna kaj'alu. de limuri ne, ja'a madenge heka dènge dhèu leo. ja'a hud'i tao dhèu leo sama sèmi a'ari ja'a kahèi.

source_text: therefore i came to you without gainsaying, as soon as i was sent for: i ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lod'o miu lami paroa, ka ja'a mai dènge. ja'a pamata heka, lula lamatua peka nare le dènge ja'a sèmi èèna. miu peka ku laa. miu parluu ngaa nèti ja'a?

source_text: and cornelius said, four days ago i was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour i prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
target_text: hèia kornelis lole aa'i mèu-mèu, aku nèngu na, èpa lod'o dhu la'e èèna, ropa lod'o nihia, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu èmu ja'a. cag'ag'a laa, dhèu mone èci titu ètu madha ja'a. mèdha-papake na heo loa-loa.

source_text: and said, cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thy alms are had in remembrance in the sight of god.
target_text: ka na paroa ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘kornelis! lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: send therefore to joppa, and call hither simon, whose surname is peter; he lodgeth in the house of one simon a tanner, by the sea-side: who, when he cometh, will speak to thee.
target_text: de lod'o ne'e, pua dhèu lasi rare dhèu èci asa kota yope. ngara na, simon petrus. nèngu manubha ètu èmu cue ètu sebhe dhasi, ètu èmu tuka pamèu ka'uri badha. ngara na, simon kahèi. '

source_text: immediately therefore i sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou hast come. now therefore we are all here present before god, to hear all things that are commanded thee from god.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pua dhèu dhiu rare ama. ji'i manèngi makasi ae, lula ama mai dènge, ropa tadèngi lii paroa ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pakaboko ètu ne'e, ho neo nanene ngaa dhu ama lamatua pua ama peka dènge ji'i!

source_text: then peter opened his mouth, and said, in truth i perceive that god is no respecter of persons:
target_text: hèia petrus padhai lii, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a heka ke'a kèna, na, ètu madha ama lamatua, dhèu rai-haha sama èci èèna ka. lamatua ladhe boe rèhu, mia ka dhèu yahudi, aa mia ka dhèu leo.

source_text: but in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
target_text: dhèu mia dhu d'ara mola, dhu maj'èni manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, aa madhutu dad'èi nèngu, rèngu sèra pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: the word which god sent to the children of israel, preaching peace by jesus christ: he is lord of all:
target_text: de miu me'a, ngaa dhu lamatua peka le dènge ji'i dhèu isra'el, peka na, nèngu pua le kristus, nuka yesus. ka yesus madhe ho padame dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua. aa nèngu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: that word, i say, ye know, which was published throughout all judea, and began from galilee, after the baptism which john preached;
target_text: miu tadèngi kahèi, ngaa dhu j'aj'i le ètu palème propensi yudea. lii lole èèna mulai nèti yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, aj'a dhèu ho ra ele-ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo rèngu. aa rèngu hud'i abhu sarani kahèi, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, rèngu pabe'a le dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: that god anointed jesus of nazareth with the holy spirit and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed by the devil; for god was with him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua hia roh na dhu mola-mèci mi yesus, dhèu nasaret. lamatua hia koasa na mi yesus kahèi. ka yesus maso-kalua rae-rae, tao j'ara be'a mi dhèu-dhèu. aa na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu dhèu aae nidhu paj'èra si. na tao sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua sama-sama dènge ne taruu.

source_text: and we are witnesses of all things which he did, both in the land of the jews, and in jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree.
target_text: te ji'i se'e ka dhu ladhe ngèdhi unu mi, ngaa dhu na sab'a ètu kota yerusalem, aa palème kabarai yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: him god raised the third day, and showed him openly;
target_text: nèngu madhe tare'a, te ngaa asa camèd'a, ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. ka na pad'elo iisi na, ho dhèu rèdhi, sèna ka ra re'a nèngu mamuri hari tare'a-re'a le.

source_text: not to all the people, but to witnesses chosen before by god, even to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae cahag'e dhu rèdhi boe ne, dhoka ji'i di. lod'o nèngu mamuri hari le, ji'i biasa nga'a-nginu dènge ne. ama lamatua paj'uj'u ji'i ho la'a lole palème lii lolo be'a yesus mi dhèu ae ètu mia-mia.

source_text: and he commanded us to preach to the people, and to testify that it is he who was ordained by god to be the judge of the living and the dead.
target_text: aa lamatua ka dhu pua ji'i la'a lole peka pasaraa mi dhèu, lula-nèti dhèu dhu na paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai, nuka yesus. aa lamatua ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu j'ue lii langu, ho pama'ète, na, cee ka dhu bisa mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua, aa cee aad'o. yesus èèna ka dhu j'ue lii dhèu dhu madhe le, dènge dhèu dhu mamuri era.

source_text: to him give all the prophets testimony, that through his name whoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra lole le yesus, peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya nèngu, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare si, aa saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu kahèi.

source_text: while peter was yet speaking these words, the holy spirit fell on all them who heard the word.
target_text: lod'o petrus padhai lii nare mèka, cag'ag'a laa, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci maso asa d'ara dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i ra dhu nanene lii padhai lii na.

source_text: and they of the circumcision who believed, were astonished, as many as came with peter, because that on the gentiles also was poured out the gift of the holy spirit.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu yahudi angalai petrus dhu mai palere dènge ne nèti kota yope asa èmu kornelis ètu kota kaisarea. ropa rèngu rèdhi dhèu ae sèra abhu roh ama lamatua, ka ra malaa, lula rèngu heka re'a kèna, na, lamatua hia roh na mi dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: for they heard them speak in languages and magnify god. then answered peter,
target_text: rèngu tadèngi dhèu ètu d'ara èmu kornelis sèra padhai lii, pake lii dhu baka-leo. aa ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. hèia petrus padhai lii, peka na,

source_text: can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, who have received the holy spirit as well as we?
target_text: miu mèdhi unu mi! dhèu se'e se, sèmi rare le roh lamatua èci èèna ka dènge èdhi kahèi. de mai ka, sèna ka èdhi sarani si. dhèu èci sa dhu bisa heka taha rèngu.

source_text: and he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the lord. then they requested him to tarry certain days.
target_text: hèia petrus pua si ho sarani kornelis dènge dhèu ètu sèra sa, ho ra j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka ra manèngi petrus pea dènge rèngu pèri-pèri lod'o hari. èle èèna ka, heka ra hia ne lèpa asa yerusalem.

source_text: and the apostles and brethren that were in judea, heard that the gentiles also had received the word of god.
