target_text: petrus dhae lèpa mèka, te ngaa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus dènge dhèu parcaya yesus dhu leo sèra, dhu pea ètu yerusalem, tadèngi rare le, peka na, dhèu yahudi boe sèmi rare le lii lole be'a lamatua.

source_text: and when peter had come to jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai kota yerusalem, dhèu nèti partei yahudi dhu parcaya yesus mai pasala ne,

source_text: saying, thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
target_text: peka na, weh! èu tao samia kèna? èu me'a ad'a-tatao èdhi, do aad'o? èu ne bani titu kèna, maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu leo! aa èu mu'a-minu dènge rèngu kahèi! baku tao sèmi èèna, te rèngu madhutu mèka ad'a suna èdhi! èdhi bisa boe pa'èci dènge rèngu sèra!

source_text: but peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order to them, saying,
target_text: hèia petrus lole aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le, peka na,

source_text: i was in the city of joppa praying: and in a trance i saw a vision, a certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
target_text: lod'o ja'a ètu kota yope, ja'a laku sabaj'a, ka ja'a abhu tanila. ja'a kèdhi liru bhoka, ka hahèla-koi bhèla aae ca bèla, dhu èki re suu-suu èpa na, puru mai asa ja'a.

source_text: upon which when i had fastened my eyes, i considered, and saw four-footed beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping animals, and fowls of the air.
target_text: ropa ja'a patigi asa d'ara hahèla-koi èèna, ja'a kèdhi rupa-rupa badha, nuka badha ai èpa, badha rod'o-kakara, dènge rupa-rupa manu-bhui kahèi. badha se'e se, dhu èdhi dhèu yahudi luri.

source_text: and i heard a voice saying to me, arise, peter; slay and eat.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci pua, peka na, ‘petrus! kèd'i ka! kèj'i badha se, ho mu'a! '

source_text: but i said, not so, lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a dhaa, peka na, ‘bisa boe, ama! baku sèmi èèna! te ja'a ku'a kèdhi mèka sisi badha sèmi se'e! dhèu yahudi luri sisi badha se'e aa'i-aa'i ra! '

source_text: but the voice answered me again from heaven, what god hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
target_text: te ngaa lii ne b'ala hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ama lamatua peka mèdha ngaa dhu mèu, èu baku peka na kaj'alu! '

source_text: and this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi hahèla-koi èèna cèu padhutu tèlu hari, ka ca'e hari asa dedha-liru la'e.

source_text: and behold, immediately there were three men already come to the house where i was, sent from cesarea to me.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu tèlu d'ai èmu dhu ja'a pea. rèngu nèti kaisarea mai tenge ja'a.

source_text: and the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. moreover, these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
target_text: hèia roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘puru ho lamu ka dènge dhèu sèra. èu baku mage-mage ia ka. èu baku madenge dènge rèngu. ' ka a'ari èdhi dhèu èna palere dènge ja'a kahèi asa kaisarea. ètu èèna, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi maso asa d'ara èmu komedhaa sordad'u roma.

source_text: and he showed us how he had seen an angel in his house, who stood and said to him, send men to joppa, and call for simon, whose surname is peter;
target_text: na lolo, peka na, pèri-pèri lod'o dhu la'e èèna, nèngu nèdhi ana pajuu lamatua puru nèti sorga, titu ètu d'ara èmu na. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘pua dhèu lasi asa kota yope, ho paroa mèti dhèu èci, ngara na simon petrus.

source_text: who shall tell thee words, by which thou and all thy house shall be saved.
target_text: sèna ka dhèu èèna ka dhu pad'elo mi dedha èu dènge isi èmu èu aa'i-aa'i ra, j'ara lamatua dhu hia miu mamuri, dènge saku eele sasala-sasigo miu sèra. '

source_text: and as i began to speak, the holy spirit fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pad'elo j'ara mamuri lamatua mi dedha rèngu. ka rèngu abhu dènge ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, sama sèmi èdhi abhu ca hari na.

source_text: then i remembered the word of the lord, how he said, john indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa ja'a kèdhi rèngu abhu roh lamatua kahèi, ka ja'a sanèd'e lii padhai lii lamatua yesus uru èèna, dhu peka na, ‘yohanis sarani dhèu pake dhoka èi di, te ngaa ladhe miu mate hari pèri-pèri lod'o, èèna na lamatua neo tao dhu kapai risi eele hia miu. nuka, na hia miu roh na dhu mola-mèci. '

source_text: forasmuch then as god gave them the like gift as he did to us, who believed on the lord jesus christ, what was i that i could withstand god?
target_text: te lamatua unu na ka dhu hia roh na mi dedha dhèu leo sèra, sama sèmi na pala-bagi mi èdhi se. de madhutu dad'èi miu, ja'a hud'i palab'a dènge ama lamatua, do tasamia? de ja'a peka ngaa hari?

source_text: when they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified god, saying, then hath god also to the gentiles granted repentance to life.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, petrus siri iisi na sèmi èèna, ka rèngu pasala heka ne. hèia ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! nia kahèi, nga! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia dhèu leo ho ra tèke eele j'ara mamuri rèngu dhu sala, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu. sèna ka rèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: now they who were dispersed upon the persecution that arose about stephen traveled as far as phenice, and cyprus, and antioch, preaching the word to none but to the jews only.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ra pamadhe rare stefanus, ka ra paj'èra dhèu unu yesus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e rai paj'ala asa mia-mia. cahag'e rai asa propensi finisia. cahag'e rai asa pulu siprus, aa cahag'e hari rai d'ai kota antiokia ètu propensi siria. dhèu dhu rai sèra, lole taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus asa mia-mia. te ngaa ra lole dhoka dènge dhèu yahudi rèngu sèra. ra lole boe dènge dhèu leo.

source_text: and some of them were men of cyprus and cyrene, who when they had come to antioch, spoke to the grecians, preaching the lord jesus.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu mai nèti pulu siprus dènge kota kirene. rèngu cahag'e rai taruu lasi asa kota antiokia ètu propensi siria. rèngu se'e ka dhu lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus hia dhèu yahudi boe ètu era èèna.

source_text: and the hand of the lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned to the lord.
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa na, nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae titu kèna parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: then tidings of these things came to the ears of the church which was in jerusalem: and they sent forth barnabas, that he should go as far as antioch. who, when he came, and had seen the grace of god, was glad, and exhorted them all that with purpose of heart they would cleave to the lord. for he was a good man, and full of the holy spirit, and of faith: and many people were added to the lord.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu yerusalem tadèngi, na, dhèu leo ètu kota antiokia parcaya yesus kahèi. ka ra pua barnabas la'e ladhe si ètu nèi. barnabas ne, dhèu d'ara be'a, aa parcaya tare'a-re'a ama lamatua. aa roh lamatua dènge nèngu kahèi. ropa nèngu d'ai nèi, na nèdhi tare'a ama lamatua sab'a ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu leo sèra. ka d'ara nèngu karej'e. ka na pa'èra d'ara rèngu, sèna ka rèngu madhutu taruu j'ara mamuri lamatua dènge tare'a-re'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu lamatua ètu èèna asa tabha ae.

source_text: then barnabas departed to tarsus, to seek saul:
target_text: èle èèna ka, barnabas la'e tenge saulus asa kota tarsus.

source_text: and when he had found him, he brought him to antioch. and it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught many people. and the disciples were first called christians in antioch.
target_text: lod'o paraga dènge ne, ka na pamako saulus ho lasi pea ètu antiokia. ka dua ra pea ètu nèi ca tèu, pa'èci dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra. bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu dua ra aj'a-nori j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus mi dhèu ae. ètu kota antiokia ne'e ka, dhèu mulai pangare dhèu parcaya lamatua yesus, ‘dhèu kristen'.

source_text: and in these days came prophets from jerusalem to antioch.
target_text: lod'o rèngu dua ra pea ètu antiokia era, pèri-pèri dhèu mai nèti yerusalem. ama lamatua tema le pake dhèu se'e ho rèti lii padhai na.

source_text: and there stood up one of them named agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of claudius cesar.
target_text: nèti rèngu se, dhèu èci, ngara na agabus. roh lamatua peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a abhu lod'o manganga-mad'èu lèke palème toke d'ai suu-suu rai-haha. hèia la'e peka hari dènge dhèu-dhèu. lii dhu na padhai na, mema j'aj'i tare'a, lod'o dhèu aae kapai risi ètu roma, ngara na klaudius, nèd'u paredha. ra paroa dhèu aae kapai risi ne, keser.

source_text: then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief to the brethren who dwelt in judea.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii agabus ne, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu antiokia sèra, rare lii èci ho pa'oru doi, sèna ka ra hia mi a'ari dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, dhu abhu j'aj'èra ètu propensi yudea. èci-èci hia madhutu a'abhu ra.

source_text: which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of barnabas and saul.
target_text: ropa ra pa'oru rare, ka ra pua barnabas dènge saulus rèti doi sèra asa dhèu j'èra sèi.

source_text: now about that time, herod the king stretched forth his hands to afflict certain of the church.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae herodes mulai paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua yesus cahag'e.

source_text: and he killed james the brother of john with the sword.
target_text: nèngu paredha dhèu lasi pare pamadhe yakobis pake samala. yakobis ne, a'a yohanis.

source_text: and because he saw it pleased the jews, he proceeded further to take peter also. then were the days of unleavened bread.
target_text: ropa herodes ne'a, na, d'ara dhèu kapai yahudi sèra karej'e nèti mamadhe yakobis, ka asa na hino. lèke lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi dhu ra pangare na, pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi, ka na pua dhèu lasi kèpe petrus.

source_text: and when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after the passover to bring him forth to the people.
target_text: kèpe rare ne, ka ra pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. ka ra pua sordad'u èpa kaboko ho j'aga petrus pagati-gati mèu-mèda. ca kaboko sordad'u èèna, dhèu èpa. ladhe èle lod'o hua iia, heka herodes neo pama'ète lii petrus ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing by the church to god for him.
target_text: lod'o ra pamaso petrus asa d'ara bèdho, dhèu unu lamatua yesus sèra sabaj'a ma'ète boe manèngi ho lamatua ladhe-leru petrus.

source_text: and when herod would have brought him forth, the same night peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains; and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
target_text: bèli èèna, herodes neo pama'ète lii langu petrus ètu madha dhèu ae. te ngaa mèda èèna, ra èki petrus pake rate dua ètu d'ara èmu bèdho. na j'unu ètu talora sordad'u dhèu dua. aa sordad'u leo sèra j'aga ètu hèb'a babèdho.

source_text: and behold, the angel of the lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison; and he smote peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, arise quickly. and his chains fell off from his hands.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, mai titu ètu èèna. ka d'ara kama na saraa bia. hèia ana pajuu èèna parèi petrus, peka na, petrus! kèd'i mèri! kaca'a laa, rate bèsi sèra bhoke eele unu na nèti kacui-aai petrus.

source_text: and the angel said to him, gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals; and so he did. and he saith to him, cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
target_text: ka ana pajuu èèna pua ne, peka na, pake kodho dènge salapa èu! pake nare, ka ana pajuu èèna peka hari, aku nèngu na, pake kodho li'u èu, ho mai madhutu ja'a!

source_text: and he went out, and followed him, and knew not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
target_text: hèia petrus madhutu ana pajuu ne lasi asa li'u. petrus ngee, na, nèngu nii di. te ngaa mema j'aj'i tare'a.

source_text: when they were past the first and the second ward, they came to the iron gate that leadeth to the city; which opened to them of its own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
target_text: ropa rèngu seli eele era j'aga partama dènge ka dua, hèia rèngu d'ai hèb'a babèdho bèsi. babèdho èèna bhoke unu na, ka dua ra kalua madhutu ka j'ara asa d'ara kota. cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua ne ele, ka tèke eele petrus mesa na ètu era èèna.

source_text: and when peter had come to himself, he said, now i know with certainty, that the lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the jews.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ne ele, hèia petrus heka mase'a kèna. ka na ngee, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! ja'a heka ke'a kèna. lamatua pua ana pajuu na mai, ho patalale eele ja'a nèti kacui-aai herodes. lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka kahadhu karehe dhèu yahudi sèra, lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: and when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of mary the mother of john whose surname was mark; where many were assembled, praying.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus la'e asa èmu maria. maria ne, ina yohanis. ngara leo yohanis ne, markus. ètu èmu èèna, dhèu ae pakaboko ho sabaj'a manèngi ama lamatua ladhe-leru petrus ètu d'ara lii langu èèna.

source_text: and as peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named rhoda.
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai madha hèb'a oka èmu èèna, ka na paroa dènge d'eu hèb'a oka. ka ana bhèni sab'a èci, ngara na rode, neo ne'a dhèu cee ka dhu mai.

source_text: and when she knew peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told that peter stood before the gate
target_text: ropa na tadèngi lii petrus, na tadhe dènge. na karej'e bia. ka rai asa d'ara èmu la'e, peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, nanene ku! petrus nuka li'u! te ngaa lula nèngu bingu, ka na bhèlu eele bhoke hèb'a oka hia petrus.

source_text: and they said to her, thou art insane. but she constantly affirmed that it was even so. then they said, it is his angel.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae sèra dhaa, peka na, aad'o, sina ma! baku paleko! te ngaa bhèni ne peka hari, aku nèngu na, tare'a! èèna lii petrus! nuka li'u nèi. ka dhèu se'e lèka boe, aku rèngu na, ele boe, dhèu nèi ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, dhu mai madhenge petrus.

source_text: but peter continued knocking. and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
target_text: rèngu patule-pajuku taruu, te ngaa petrus loe boe paroa, toke lasi bhoke hèb'a oka hia ne. ropa ra bhoke rare, ka rèngu malaa, lula petrus tare'a-re'a di.

source_text: but he beckoning to them with the hand to hold their peace, declared to them how the lord had brought him out of the prison. and he said, go, show these things to james, and to the brethren. and he departed, and went into another place.
target_text: hèia na hia tadha dènge kacui-aai na, sèna ka rèngu mau-mau. ka na lole tasa mera mia ama lamatua kalua eele nèngu nèti d'ara èmu bèdho. hèia na pua si, aku nèngu na, lami lole lii ne'e aa'i-aa'i mi yakobis dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua leo sèra. èle èèna ka, petrus la'e asa era leo.

source_text: now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of peter.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ropa sordad'u j'aga sèra ladhe, na, petrus aad'o heka, ka rèngu ele ngangee dènge madha'u titu kèna, lula rèngu re'a boe ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi dedha rèngu.

source_text: and when herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. and he went down from judea to cesarea, and there abode.
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi lii ne'e, ka na paredha si lasi tenge petrus. te ngaa rèdhi boe ne. ka herodes hia paredha ho parisa sordad'u j'aga sèra. parisa rare, ka herodes pua pamadhe aa'i sordad'u j'aga sèra. èle èèna ka, herodes pakèd'i nèti propensi yudea, ka la'e pea ètu kota kaisarea.

source_text: and herod was highly displeased with them of tyre and sidon. but they came with one accord to him, and having made blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace, because their country was nourished by the king's country.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu-dhèu nèti dua kota, èci ngara na tirus, aa èci ngara na sidon, biasa hèli nganga'a nèti rai dhèu aae herodes. te ngaa nèbhu aae le, dhèu aae musu dènge rèngu. hèia ra padhue ho tenge j'ara padame dènge ne. ka ra pili dhèu canau ho lasi paraga dènge herodes. d'ai kota kaisarea, rèngu pa'angalai dènge dhèu herodes èci, ngara na blastus. nèngu ne, dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. rèngu pare'a dènge blastus ho nèngu bhoke j'ara sèna ka rèngu paraga dènge dhèu aae herodes.

source_text: and upon a set day, herod arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration to them.
target_text: hèia herodes dhaa kahèi ho sèmi rare rèngu. ka ra pare'a lod'o paraga. lod'o èèna, rèngu tao tatao kapai. herodes pake mèdha-papake dhèu aae, ka na madhèdi ètu kadera paredha na. hèia na padhai lii dènge rèngu.

source_text: and the people gave a shout, saying, it is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
target_text: ropa rèngu tadèngi lii na, hèia dhèu se'e koa ne, peka na, nanene ku lii na laa! ne'e lii boe nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa lii nèti dhèu dedha-liru!

source_text: and immediately the angel of the lord smote him, because he gave not god the glory: and he was eaten by worms, and died.
target_text: kaca'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga hia èi-papèd'a èci mi herodes, lula nèngu sèmi lii koa rèngu, aa na seti eele ama lamatua. ka kalati ra'e aa'i ngi'u herodes, ka na madhe aapa.

source_text: but the word of god grew and multiplied.
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu j'aj'i sèra, dhèu palolo lii lolo be'a ama lamatua d'ai asa mia-mia. aa dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus tabha ae kahèi.

source_text: and barnabas and saul returned from jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them john, whose surname was mark.
target_text: ropa barnabas dènge saulus hia rare doi pa'oru nèti dhèu antiokia mi dhèu yerusalem, ka ra lèpa hari asa antiokia. rèngu gale rèti dènge ana ngèru èci, ngara na yohanis. ngara leo na, markus.

source_text: now there were in the church that was at antioch certain prophets and teachers; as barnabas, and simeon that was called niger, and lucius of cyrene, and manaen, who had been brought up with herod the tetrarch, and saul.
target_text: ètu kota antiokia, dhèu ae parcaya le lamatua yesus. lamatua pake pèri-pèri dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na ètu èèna. cahag'e hari, na pake ho aj'a-nori dhèu. rèngu se, nuka: barnabas, simeon, dhu ra biasa pangare ne, ‘mone mèdhi', lukius, nèti kota kirene, menahem, dhu ra piara sama-sama dènge dhèu aae herodes nèti ana iiki ka mai, aa dènge saulus.

source_text: as they ministered to the lord, and fasted, the holy spirit said, separate for me barnabas and saul, for the work to which i have called them.
target_text: ca lod'o, rèngu puasa, ka ra pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. hèia roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ra, sasab'a ja'a ae titu kèna. de hag'e mere barnabas dènge saulus, sèna ka rèngu pakako sasab'a ja'a.

source_text: and when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
target_text: ropa ra puasa dènge sabaj'a èle, hèia ra bane ai mi dedha barnabas dènge saulus, ho ra j'aj'i ana pua-paleha lamatua. èle èèna ka, ra pua rèngu dua ra ho lasi sab'a sasab'a-la'a lamatua.

source_text: so they being sent forth by the holy spirit, departed to seleucia; and from thence they sailed to cyprus. and when they were at salamis, they preached the word of god in the synagogues of the jews. and they had also john for their minister.
target_text: ropa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pua barnabas dènge saulus lasi palème rai, ka ra dhuli uru asa kota èci ètu nebhe dhasi, ngara na seleukia. yohanis dhu ngara leo na, markus la'e sama-sama dènge si. d'ai nèi ka, rèngu ca'e kapa asa pulu siprus, ka ra puru ètu kota èci, ngara na salamis. ètu èèna, rèngu biasa maso asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, ho aj'a-nori lii holo-nori ama lamatua mi dhèu ètu sèra.

source_text: and when they had gone through the isle to paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a jew, whose name was barjesus: who was with the deputy of the country, sergius paulus, a prudent man; who called for barnabas and saul, and desired to hear the word of god. but elymas the sorcerer for so is his name by interpretation withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
target_text: hèia rèngu lasi dhuli rae-rae, toke ra d'ai kota èci ètu suu haa pulu èèna, ngara na pafos. gubernur pea ètu kota èèna. ngara gubernur èèna, sergius paulus. nèngu ne, dhèu kahadhu mèu. ropa na tadèngi barnabas si d'ai d'ara kota, ka na hia dhèu lasi paroa si, te d'ara na neo nanene lii holo-nori lamatua. te ngaa ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu yahudi èci, ngara na bar yesus, ngara leo na ètu d'ara lii yunani, ‘elimas'. nèngu dhèu suagi. na tema le kapod'e-kabèli dhèu, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa na pa'angalai dènge gubernur. ka ropa barnabas si mai, na kakèj'i gubernur, sèna ka baku sèmi nare si. aa na dadugu gubernur, sèna ka gubernur baku parcaya yesus.

source_text: then saul who also is called paul filled with the holy spirit, set his eyes on him,
target_text: te ngaa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci hia koasa mi dedha saulus dhu ra paroa kahèi paulus, ka na ladhe kaloo dhèu suagi ne, hèia na peka,

source_text: and said, o full of all subtilty, and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the lord?
target_text: eeh, elimas! èu ne, ana nidhu! tuka kapod'e-kabèli! toke d'ai pèri lod'o hari èu kapod'e dhèu? èu lab'a j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka, ji'i nge'a, na, èu madhutu dhèu aae nidhu. tao ia ka sèmi èèna! bhabhae ia ka j'ara mola ama lamatua!

source_text: and now behold, the hand of the lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. and immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
target_text: de mu nanene! nèbhu heka, lamatua huku èu. èèna na, èu bèdhu pèri-pèri lod'o! ropa paulus padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, dhèu èèna bèdhu dènge. ka na kako kèpe leli, hia dhèu kadhèi ai, ho pakako ne.

source_text: then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the lord.
target_text: ropa gubernur ladhe nèdhi unu na, aa na tadèngi lii holo-nori yesus nèti barnabas si, ka na malaa-maloha, aa na parcaya yesus.

source_text: now when paul and his company loosed from paphos, they came to perga in pamphylia. and john departing from them, returned to jerusalem.
target_text: nèti kota pafos ètu pulu siprus, paulus si ca'e kapa, pakèd'i asa kota perga ètu propensi pamfilia. ropa ra puru nèti dedha kapa, yohanis markus tèke eele rèngu, ka lèpa asa yerusalem.

source_text: but when they departed from perga, they came to antioch in pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath, and sat down.
target_text: nèti perga, rèngu kako haga lasi asa kota antiokia ètu propensi pisidia. rèngu d'ai era èèna, lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a dhèu yahudi. ka rèngu madhutu sabaj'a ètu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and after the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, men, brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ra baca ètu sasuri musa, dènge sasuri dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu leo kahèi. èle èèna ka, ama-ama èmu sabaj'a èèna, manèngi paulus si, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe miu dènge lii haholo ho pa'èra d'ara ji'i, na, ji'i manèngi sèna ka miu peka laa.

source_text: then paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand, said, men of israel, and ye that fear god, give audience.
target_text: hèia paulus kako asa madha la'e. ka na hia tadha dènge kacui-aai na, sèna ka rèngu mau-mau. èle èèna ka, na padhai lii, peka na, a'ari dhèu isra'el ti! dènge ina-ama dhèu leo dhu maso agama yahudi, lula d'ara miu d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua dhèu isra'el. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu nanene paie lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: the god of this people israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of egypt, and with a high arm he brought them out of it.
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare le bèi-baki èdhi dhèu isra'el nèti uru ka mai. lod'o rèngu pea ètu rai masir, kabarai dhèu, lamatua hia rèngu mamuri hua iia. ana-èpu rèngu tabha ae ètu era èèna. limuri mai, ka lamatua pake koasa kapai na, ho na kalua eele rèngu nèti rai masir.

source_text: and about the time of forty years he suffered their manners in the wilderness.
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu mamuri pidha-pidha ètu d'ara mamoo toke d'ai èpa nguru tèu. masi ka rèngu kètu hadhu, te ngaa lamatua lere si dènge d'ara dhu taleo.

source_text: and when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of canaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua palaho aa'i pidhu suku ètu rai kana'an. ka na pabagi rai rèngu mi bèi-baki èdhi ho j'aj'i rai pusaka ra.

source_text: and after that he gave to them judges, about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until samuel the prophet.
target_text: bèi-baki èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna toke d'ai èpa ngasu lèmi nguru tèu. ka ama lamatua padhèdi dhèu pama'ète lii langu, sèna ka paj'uj'u j'ara hia si, toke d'ai na padhèdi hia si dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èci, ngara na samuel.

source_text: and afterward they desired a king: and god gave to them saul the son of kish, a man of the tribe of benjamin, by the space of forty years.
target_text: lod'o samuel j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, bèi-baki èdhi neo abhu dhèu aae. ka lamatua padhèdi saul, ana kis, nèti suku benyamin. saul j'aj'i dhèu aae d'ai èpa nguru tèu.

source_text: and when he had removed him, he raised up to them david to be their king: to whom also he gave testimony, and said, i have found david the son of jesse, a man after my own heart, who shall fulfill all my will.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua gao eele saul. ka na padhèdi daud, ana isai, ho j'aj'i dhèu aae hiu. lamatua ne'a tare'a d'ara daud, ka na peka na, ‘daud, ana isai ne, lèke d'ara ja'a. limuri mai, tatu nèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ja'a aa'i-aa'i. '

source_text: of this man's offspring hath god, according to his promise, raised up to israel a savior, jesus:
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua moa tèke le, ho na hag'e nare ana-èpu daud èci, sèna ka na patabuli eele dhèu isra'el nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. ja'a peka mi miu, ana-èpu daud dhu lamatua moa tèke èèna, nuka yesus.

source_text: john having first preached, before his coming, the baptism of repentance to all the people of israel.
target_text: paulus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, lod'o lamatua yesus pakako mèka sab'a na, abhu dhèu èci ngara na yohanis, dhu la'e lole dènge dhèu isra'el, sèna ka rèngu ele-ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo rèngu. na peka kahèi, na, rèngu hud'i sarani ku, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, na, rèngu pabe'a le dènge lamatua.

source_text: and as john fulfilled his course, he said, whom think ye that i am? i am not he. but behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet i am not worthy to loose.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o sasab'a yohanis oe èle, na peka mi dhèu ae, aku nèngu na, ‘baku pangee, na, ja'a ne dhèu dhu lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai. ngee paie! miu hud'i mate hari ku dhèu èci, dhu mai limuri. nèngu kapai risi nèti ja'a. ja'a haha d'ai seli. de j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèngu kahèi, ja'a nia boe. '

source_text: men, brethren, children of the stock of abraham, and whoever among you feareth god, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! miu dhu ana-èpu abraham, aa miu dhèu leo, dhu neo padètu dènge lamatua. mi nanene ku ja'a! ama lamatua peka le j'ara ne dènge èdhi, sèna ka èdhi te'a j'ara mamuri na. nèngu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: for they that dwell at jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the words of the prophets which are read every sabbath, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, ama lamatua pake le dhèu rèti lii padhai na, ho suri lula-nèti dhèu dhu lamatua moa neo hia mai. te ama-ama agama èdhi, dènge dhèu leo ètu yerusalem sèra baca pahari-pahari le, ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri tèke sèra. d'ai lod'o a'oro sasab'a, ra maso asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ho ra baca ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua. te ngaa rèngu re'a boe dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u mema èèna, nuka yesus. ka ra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. te ngaa tatao rèngu sèra kahèi, lèke nuka sèmi dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra suri tèke le.

source_text: and though they found no cause of death in him, yet they desired pilate that he should be put to death.
target_text: ra tenge j'ara, neo pamanahu yesus. te ngaa rèngu abhu boe sasala na. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu kakèj'i gubernur pilatus ho pamadhe ne.

source_text: and when they had fulfilled all that was written concerning him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulcher.
target_text: ka gubernur sèmi nare lii rèngu, hèia ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa tatao rèngu sèra kahèi, lèke sèmi dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra suri tèke le. hèia ra papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka nedhe rèti tao asa d'ara ro'a.

source_text: but god raised him from the dead:
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pake koasa na, ka pamamuri hari yesus.

source_text: and he was seen many days by them who came up with him from galilee to jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
target_text: lod'o yesus mamuri hari, na pad'elo iisi na pèri-pèri hari mi dhèu ae. dhèu sèra nuka dhu mai sama-sama dènge ne nèti propensi galilea asa kota yerusalem. rèngu se ka lèpa limuri na, j'aj'i sakasii mi dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and we declare to you the glad tidings, that the promise which was made to the fathers, god hath fulfilled the same to us their children, in that he hath raised up jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, thou art my son, this day have i begotten thee.
target_text: paulus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, de sèmi ne'e! ji'i dua mi dènge barnabas, mai nèti era kaj'èu ho lole dènge miu, sèna ka miu me'a ngaa dhu lamatua moa mi bèi-baki èdhi sèra, limuri ne j'aj'i aa'i le. lamatua pamamuri hari le yesus nèti mamadhe na. ètu sasuri lii sod'a koa-kio nomer dua, lamatua pake dhèu ho suri lula-nèti yesus, dhèu dhu na moa tèke ho na mai. na suri, peka na: ‘èu ne'e, ana ja'a, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha. '

source_text: and as concerning that he raised him from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, i will give you the sure mercies of david.
target_text: nèti uru èèna ka, ama lamatua moa le, peka na, nèngu neo pamamuri hari dhèu dhu na moa tèke ho na mai. aa dhèu èèna, madhe heka. nèti èèna ka, lamatua pake le dhèu nèti lii padhai na ho na suri, peka na, ‘nèti uru ka mai, ja'a èki lii padhadha dènge dhèu aae daud, sèna ka ja'a hia ne berkat. de limuri ne, ja'a neo pa'èki dènge èu, lii padhadha èèna kahèi, lula èu ne, ana-èpu daud. '

source_text: wherefore he saith also in another psalm, thou wilt not suffer thy holy one to see corruption.
target_text: aa lii sod'a koa-kio leo, peka na, ‘lamatua, èu tèke eele boe ngi'u aae dhèu mola-mèci èu, ho ele iie ètu d'ara ro'a na! '

source_text: for david, after he had served his own generation by the will of god, fell asleep, and was laid to his fathers, and saw corruption: but he whom god raised again, saw no corruption.
target_text: dhu lèke sèmi ne'e ka: lii sod'a koa-kio ne'e, peka boe dhoka daud di! èdhi te'a sèmi èèna, lula dhèu aae daud tao le j'ara be'a ae hia kabarai na, toke na madhe. ropa na madhe, ka ra padhane ne. ngi'u aae na ele iie le. de èdhi te'a, na, lii sod'a koa-kio èèna, peka boe dhoka daud di, te ngaa dhèu leo kahèi. ladhe èèna na dhèu dhu na paj'uj'u èèna madhe, pe ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. nèti èèna ka, ngi'u aae na ele iie boe ciki sa.

source_text: be it known to you therefore, men, brethren, that through this man is preached to you the forgiveness of sins; and by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of moses.
target_text: de a'ari, nanene paie! dhèu èèna, nuka yesus! ladhe èdhi parcaya ne, heka na dui sasala-sasigo èdhi sèra, dhu madhutu iia-iia na, èdhi ka dhu dui. dènge j'ara ne'e, ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi. te ngaa èdhi te'a le, masi ka èdhi madhutu atora ad'a musa aa'i-aa'i ra, èèna d'ai mèka ho pamola èdhi ètu madha lamatua.

source_text: beware therefore, lest that come upon you which is spoken in the prophets; behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for i work a work in your days, a work which ye will in no wise believe, though a man declare it to you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee paie. mage dhoka ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua peka uru sèra, lèka miu. ra suri le, peka na, ‘tuka lalangu dhèu, mate unu miu! lula ja'a, ama lamatua, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pamalaa dhèu. te ngaa limuri mai, mate unu miu! èèna na, miu madhe aapa! ja'a tao j'ara èci, te ngaa miu sèmi mere boe. masi ka dhèu pasaraa le, te ngaa miu me'a boe. be'a risi miu ngee paie, sèna ka miu bisa malaa kahèi tatao lamatua! ' de a'ari sèra! pangee paie ngaa dhu ja'a lole ne. baku core eele ngaa dhu miu tadèngi le. miu baku sama sèmi tuka lalangu dhèu. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii padhai ja'a. makasi!

source_text: and when the jews had gone out of the synagogue, the gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
target_text: padhai lii nare, hèia paulus dènge barnabas kèd'i titu neo kalua nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna. ka dhèu ètu sèra manèngi rèngu lèpa migu mai nèi, ho lole pamèu ngaa dhu ra lole deo na.

source_text: now when the congregation was broken up, many of the jews and religious proselytes followed paul and barnabas; who speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of god.
target_text: ropa ra kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, dhèu ae ètu èèna lasi madhutu paulus dènge barnabas. ka dua ra holo si, peka na, èdhi te'a, na, lamatua d'ara be'a d'ai seli mi dedha èdhi. de miu hud'i madhutu taruu ne.

source_text: and the next sabbath came almost the whole city together to hear the word of god.
target_text: d'ara migu mai nèi, lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a dhèu yahudi, dhèu nèti d'ara kota èèna oe mai aa'i ho ra neo nanene lii holo-nori lamatua.

source_text: but when the jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spoke against those things which were uttered by paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ama-ama dhèu yahudi re'a, na, dhèu ae mai nanene lii padhai lii paulus si, ka rèngu tèka d'ara. hèia ropa paulus padhai lii, rèngu pahaka-palab'a dènge padhai lii pamanahu ne.

source_text: then paul and barnabas became bold, and said, it was necessary that the word of god should first be spoken to you: but seeing ye reject it, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the gentiles.
target_text: te ngaa paulus si hari boe, aa ra padhai lii pa'abhe heka, peka na, mema tare'a ama lamatua bhoke uru j'ara hia èdhi dhèu yahudi, aa na pangèd'u èdhi lii lolo be'a. èèna na lèke! te ngaa miu sèmi mere boe. nèti èèna ka, miu nia boe abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. de limuri ne, ji'i neo ngèti lii lolo be'a ne asa dhèu rai-rai leo sèra, lula miu dhèu yahudi tule eele ne.

source_text: for so hath the lord commanded us, saying, i have set thee to be a light of the gentiles, that thou shouldst be for salvation to the ends of the earth.
target_text: te lamatua pua le ji'i, sama sèmi dhu yesaya suri tèke, peka na, ‘ja'a ded'e le miu ho j'aj'i sama sèmi labhu, ho mèti saraa mi dedha dhèu rai-rai leo sèra, dhu dhèu yahudi boe, sena ka miu tao paheo j'ara dhu mai asa ja'a, ho ja'a patalale si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu. de miu hud'i pad'elo j'ara èèna ètu rai-haha ne, nèti suu èci toke d'ai suu leo la'e! '

source_text: and when the gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life, believed.
target_text: ropa dhèu leo dhu dhèu yahudi boe sèra tadèngi lii ne'e, rèngu karej'e titu kèna. hèia ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lii holo-nori lamatua be'a d'ai seli! aa ètu èèna, abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua pili nare le ho ra mamuri taruu dènge ne. ka ra parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra mi lamatua yesus.

source_text: and the word of the lord was published throughout all the region.
target_text: ka dhèu palolo lème lii holo-nori ama lamatua ne asa rai aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but the jews stirred up the devout and honorable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against paul and barnabas, and expelled them from their borders.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota èèna, abhu dhèu kapai, bhèni-mone. cahag'e d'èi padètu lamatua. te ngaa ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèra mai dadugu-rariu dhèu kapai sèra. hèia rèngu babège eele paulus dènge barnabas nèti rai rèngu.

source_text: but they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to iconium.
target_text: lod'o dua ra kalua nèti d'ara kota èèna, ka ra caro eele ahu nèti haga ra, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara kota èèna ro'o boe nanene rèngu dua ra. èle èèna ka, dua ra kabèli kabodho ho tèke eele kota èèna, lasi asa kota ikonium.

source_text: and the disciples were filled with joy and with the holy spirit.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu parcaya lamatua yesus ètu kota antiokia sèra, d'ara ra karej'e, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pa'èra d'ara rèngu.

source_text: and it came to pass in iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the jews, and so spoke, that a great multitude both of the jews, and also of the greeks, believed.
target_text: lod'o paulus dènge barnabas d'ai kota ikonium, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. ètu èèna, dua ra lole aa'i mèu-mèu lii holo-nori ama lamatua. ka dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu rai leo, ae ka dhu parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: but the unbelieving jews stirred up the gentiles, and made their minds evil-affected against the brethren.
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu kèpe pa'èra atora agama rèngu. ka rèngu sèmi rare boe lii padhai lii paulus si. rèngu kakèj'i dhèu leo, sèna ka ra d'èi boe dènge dhèu dhu parcaya yesus sèra.

source_text: a long time therefore they abode speaking boldly in the lord, who gave testimony to the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
target_text: te ngaa paulus si madha'u boe. dua ra peka-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. ra peka, aku rèngu na, lamatua yesus sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i. lamatua hia paulus si koasa kahèi, ho ra tao tadha-tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu ae re'a lamatua ka dhu pua rèngu. lod'o èèna, paulus si pea nèbhu ètu d'ara kota èèna.

source_text: but the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the jews, and part with the apostles.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dua kaboko dhèu. cahag'e madhutu dhèu yahudi dhu kèpe pa'èra atora agama rèngu. aa cahag'e hari madhutu dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua. ka ra patao-palaha.

source_text: and when there was an assault made both of the gentiles, and also of the jews, with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
target_text: hèia dhèu yahudi dhu kèpe pa'èra atora agama rèngu pare'a lii dènge dhèu leo dènge ama-ama rèngu, ho neo paj'èra dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua. aa rèngu neo tabhie paulus si.

source_text: being apprised of it, they fled to lystra and derbe, cities of lycaonia, and to the region in that vicinity.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu peka dènge paulus si, aku rèngu na, dhèu neo tao aapa mi miu. nèti èèna ka, paulus si rai lasi palu'u iisi asa propensi likonia, ètu kota listra, dènge kota derbe, dènge rae-rae dhu padètu ètu kota sèra.

source_text: and there they preached the gospel.
target_text: ètu era-era se'e, rèngu lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus.

source_text: and there sat a certain man at lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who had never walked.
target_text: d'ai kota listra, paulus dènge barnabas paraga dènge mone èci, dhu karuku nèti ina na nara iisi ne. dhèu ne'e, kako nèdhi mèka.

source_text: the same heard paul speak: who steadfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
target_text: nèngu madhèdi nanene lii lole paulus. ka paulus ladhe patae ne, ka pangee, na, parcaya nèngu mi ama lamatua ka dhu bisa pa'èle papèd'a na!

source_text: said with a loud voice, stand upright on thy feet. and he leaped and walked.
target_text: ka paulus lii dènge ne, peka na, kèd'i titu ka! ropa na tadèngi, hèia dhèu ne kèd'i titu dènge, ka kako la'e-mai.

source_text: and when the people saw what paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of lycaonia, the gods have come down to us in the likeness of men.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra rèdhi paulus tao sèmi èèna, ka rèngu malaa-maloha. ka ra padhai lii dènge lii likonia, peka na, mi nanene ku laa! dhèu dua se, dhèu dedha-liru, te ngaa puru mai dènge rupa dhèu rai-haha!

source_text: and they called barnabas, jupiter, and paul, mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
target_text: rèngu peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu ngee, na, barnabas èèna nuka dhèu dedha-liru rèngu, ngara na seus. aa paulus, dhu tuka padhai lii, nuka dhèu dedha-liru rèngu, ngara na hermes.

source_text: then the priest of jupiter, who was before their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
target_text: ètu hèb'a tedhe li'u kota, abhu èmu era sogo-tagu seus. ropa rèdhi paulus si, ka tuka j'aga èmu sogo-tagu seus èci nèti bunga dènge sapi mone aae, ho mai sogo-tagu paulus dènge barnabas. dhèu ae mai kahèi ho neo sogo-tagu dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra.

source_text: which, when the apostles barnabas and paul heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
target_text: ropa paulus si re'a, na, dhèu sèra mai ho neo sogo-tagu rèngu, ka ra kai si. ka dua ra rai lasi asa talora dhèu ae sèra, hèia ra ciu mae kodho ètu ngi'u ra. tatao èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, rèngu dua ra d'èi boe dhèu sogo-tagu rèngu. hèia dua ra kai si, peka na,

source_text: and saying, sirs, why do ye these things? we also are men of like passions with you, and preach to you, that ye should turn from these vanities to the living god, who made heaven and earth, and the sea, and all things that are in them.
target_text: weh! nga tao ka miu tao sèmi ne'e? baku pangee na, ji'i se dhèu dedha-liru. ji'i dhèu rai-haha èci èèna ka dènge miu. ji'i mai ho neo lole dènge miu, lii lole be'a èci. miu hud'i tèke eele ku, dhèu dedha-liru miu dhu lèke boe sèra. aa miu hud'i mai madhutu ku ama lamatua dhu mamuri tare'a-re'a. nèngu ka dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru, rai-haha dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, dhèu ètu rai mia-mia mamuri madhutu dad'èi d'ara rèngu. aa ama lamatua soro tèke si mamuri sèmi èèna.

source_text: nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua bhèlu boe hia si tadha-tadha, sèna ka re'a, na, lamatua èèna be'a. nèngu ka dhu papuru èj'i mai. nèngu ka dhu hia oka-tedhe èdhi hua-hela. nèngu ka dhu hia èdhi nganga'a-nginu. aa nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara èdhi.

source_text: and with these sayings they scarce restrained the people from doing sacrifice to them.
target_text: masi ka paulus dènge barnabas kai si, te ngaa dhèu sèra pakaseti hia mèdha sogo-tagu sèra mi rèngu.

source_text: and there came thither certain jews from antioch, and iconium, who persuaded the people, and having stoned paul, drew him out of the city, supposing him to be dead.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu mai nèti kota antiokia dènge kota ikonium, lasi asa kota listra. rèngu dadugu dhèu ae ho pa'èci dènge rèngu ho lab'a dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra. ka ra tabhie paulus dènge hadhu. ra ngee na madhe le, ka ra ère rèti lasi core eele ne asa li'u kota.

source_text: but as the disciples stood around him, he rose, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with barnabas to derbe.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu parcaya yesus sèra, titu-reo paulus, ka na kèd'i hari. èle èèna ka, na maso hari asa d'ara kota. asa bèli èèna, paulus dènge barnabas lasi hari asa kota leo, ngara na derbe.

source_text: and when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to lystra, and to iconium, and to antioch,
target_text: ètu kota derbe, paulus dènge barnabas lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. ka dhèu ae parcaya yesus. hèia dua ra lèpa hari asa kota listra. nèti listra, rèngu lasi hari asa kota ikonium. nèti ikonium, rèngu taruu asa antiokia ètu propensi pisidia.

source_text: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of god.
target_text: ètu antiokia, ra padhai lii pa'èra d'ara dhèu dhu madhutu yesus sèra. ra pasanèd'e si, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, baku ngee, na, èdhi abhu heka j'aj'èra. masi ka abhu j'aj'èra, te ngaa èdhi hud'i taha ho madhutu taruu lamatua yesus. dua ra aj'a sèmi èèna mi dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu kota èèna.

source_text: and when they had ordained for them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the lord, on whom they believed.
target_text: èle èèna ka, paulus dènge barnabas tenge dhèu ho ra neo paj'uj'u j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra. ka ra manèngi-mangaj'i dènge puasa neo re'a dad'èi lamatua. dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u, rèngu sabaj'a dènge bane ai mi dedha na, ho ded'e ne j'aj'i kètu juma'at.

source_text: and after they had passed throughout pisidia, they came to pamphylia.
target_text: èle èèna ka, paulus dènge barnabas tèke eele propensi pisidia, lasi asa propensi pamfilia.

source_text: and when they had preached the word in perga, they went down into attalia:
target_text: ka rèngu maso asa kota perga. ètu èèna, ra lole lii lolo be'a lamatua. èle èèna ka, lasi asa kota atalia, dhu kaj'èu boe nèti perga.

source_text: and thence sailed to antioch, from whence they had been commended to the grace of god, for the work which they fulfilled.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ka ra ca'e balu lèpa hari asa kota antiokia ètu propensi siria. ca hari ni, dhèu parcaya yesus ètu antiokia ka dhu pangèd'u dua ra asa lamatua sèna ka na ladhe-leru si, aa rèngu ka dhu pua dua ra lasi kahèi. nèti èèna ka, paulus si lasi ho neo lole mi juma'at antiokia, peka na, rèngu tao rare le sasab'a dhu juma'at pua rèngu sab'a.

source_text: and when they had come, and had assembled the church, they rehearsed all that god had done with them, and that he had opened the door of faith to the gentiles.
target_text: d'ai kota antiokia, ka paulus si pakaboko aa'i dhèu parcaya lamatua ètu èèna. ka ra lolo aa'i-aa'i tatao lamatua mi dedha rèngu. ra lole kahèi, peka na, lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia dhèu yahudi boe ho parcaya lamatua yesus kahèi.

source_text: and there they abode a long time with the disciples.
target_text: èle èèna ka, paulus dènge barnabas pea nèbhu dènge dhèu parcaya lamatua yesus sèra ètu èèna.

source_text: and certain men who came down from judea, taught the brethren, and said, except ye be circumcised after the manner of moses, ye cannot be saved.
target_text: lod'o èèna, pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi kristen mai nèti kaj'èu, nèti propensi yudea, asa kota antiokia. d'ai nèi, ra aj'a dhèu unu lamatua yesus sèra, peka na, miu parcaya yesus, èèna be'a le. te ngaa èèna d'ai mèka. ladhe miu tare'a-re'a neo abhu mamuri, miu hud'i suna ku madhutu ad'a ji'i dhèu yahudi, dhu lamatua papuru le mai re baki musa.

source_text: when therefore paul and barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that paul and barnabas, and certain others of them, should go to jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
target_text: te ngaa paulus dènge barnabas lab'a lii padhai lii dhèu sèra. rèngu palab'a aae. hèia paulus si peka, na, miu sala èèna! dhèu yahudi boe dhu parcaya yesus, parluu boe madhutu ad'a suna dhèu yahudi! lula ra palab'a sèmi èèna, ka a'abhu rèngu èci dènge èci sama boe, hèia ra tenge lii èci ho pua paulus dènge barnabas dènge pèri-pèri dhèu nèti antiokia, ho rèti lii ne'e asa dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dènge ama-ama kristen leo sèra ètu yerusalem.

source_text: and being brought on their way by the church, they passed through phenice, and samaria, declaring the conversion of the gentiles: and they caused great joy to all the brethren.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, paulus si kako haga lasi re propensi finisia dènge propensi samaria. ètu d'ara kakako, rèngu dhuli pèri-pèri èmu dhèu kristen. ka ra lole aa'i mèu-mèu, peka na, dhèu yahudi boe sèra parcaya le lamatua yesus! ra tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, ka aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e.

source_text: and when they had come to jerusalem, they were received by the church, and by the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that god had done with them.
target_text: d'ai yerusalem, ka dhèu madhutu yesus aa'i-aa'i ètu èèna, sèmi rare paulus si dènge be'a. dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dènge ama-ama kristen sèra, sèmi rare rèngu kahèi. ka paulus si lole aa'i mèu-mèu tatao lamatua mi dedha rèngu, hèia dhèu ae nèti rai leo parcaya lamatua yesus. aa rèngu lolo kahèi, na, rèngu palab'a aae lula j'ara suna ètu antiokia.

source_text: but there rose certain of the sect of the pharisees, who believed, saying, that it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of moses.
target_text: ètu talora dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai lii paulus, abhu kahèi dhèu yahudi kristen nèti partei parisi. dhèu se kèd'i titu, ka ra hia lii bia, peka na, nanene paie! ladhe cee ka dhu dhèu yahudi boe, dhu neo madhutu yesus, rèngu hud'i madhutu ku ad'a suna dènge atora ad'a leo èdhi, dhu ama lamatua papuru mai re baki musa.

source_text: and the apostles and elders came together to consider of this matter.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i rare lii èci ho dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dènge ama-ama kristen sèra pakaboko sèna ka ra pajiko lii langu rèngu èèna.

source_text: and when there had been much disputing, peter rose and said to them, men, brethren, ye know that a good while ago, god made choice among us, that the gentiles, by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
target_text: ka ra padhue la'e-mai. hèia petrus kèd'i titu, ka padhai lii, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! miu me'a, na, uru èèna lamatua paj'uj'u le ja'a nèti talora miu, sèna ka ja'a laku lole lii lolo be'a yesus mi dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lula lamatua d'èi, sèna ka rèngu parcaya yesus kahèi.

source_text: and god, who knoweth the hearts, bore them witness, giving to them the holy spirit, even as he did to us:
target_text: lamatua ne'a d'ara èdhi èci-èci. aa nèngu ka dhu pala-bagi roh na dhu mola-mèci hia rèngu, sama sèmi na hia èdhi kahèi. dènge j'ara ne'e, sèna ka èdhi te'a, na, lamatua sèmi nare rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
target_text: te lamatua ladhe boe rèhu dhèu. na tao beda boe rèngu dènge èdhi. te lamatua pamèu le d'ara rèngu, lula rèngu parcaya le yesus kahèi, sama sèmi na pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: now therefore why tempt ye god, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear? but we believe, that through the grace of the lord jesus christ, we shall be saved even as they.
target_text: de tasamia? lamatua sèmi nare le rèngu. nga tao ka èdhi neo pabia hari rèngu dènge ad'a suna èdhi? èdhi te'a, na, èdhi dènge bèi-baki èdhi sèra, dui mèke boe atora-atora agama èdhi aa'i-aa'i ra! de hua iia èdhi baku pabia rèngu. ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia èdhi mamuri lula èdhi madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, sina ma! na hia èdhi mamuri, lula lamatua yesus sue èdhi. de baku bhèlu! lamatua sue aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu rai leo sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to barnabas and paul, declaring what miracles and wonders god had wrought by them among the gentiles.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, rèngu èci sa padhai lii tabha heka. èle èèna ka, paulus dènge barnabas lolo hari j'ara sèmi mia lamatua pake rèngu. ra lole tadha-tadha malaa dènge j'ara kapai dhu ama lamatua tao ètu talora dhèu rai leo sèra.

source_text: and after they held their peace, james answered, saying, men, brethren, hearken to me.
target_text: lole rare, ka dhèu èci, ngara na yakobis kèd'i titu, ka padhai lii, peka na, a'ari! mi nanene ku ja'a!

source_text: simeon hath declared how god at the first visited the gentiles to take from among them a people for his name.
target_text: simon petrus heka lolo nare kèna, peka na, ama lamatua ded'e nare dhèu yahudi boe sèra, ho pamaso si j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus.

source_text: and to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
target_text: èèna lèke sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka tèke nèti uru. ra suri, peka na:

source_text: after this i will return, and will build again the tabernacle of david which is fallen down; and i will build again the ruins of it; and i will set it up:
target_text: ‘ladhe d'ai lod'o èèna, ja'a lèpa hari. lula ja'a neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud, ja'a neo pakèd'i hari dènge pa'èra hari, ana-èpu daud dhu mae-manyèla sèra.

source_text: that the residue of men may seek after the lord, and all the gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the lord, who doeth all these things. known to god are all his works from the beginning of the world.
target_text: dènge tao sèmi èèna, dhèu rai-rai leo mai ho neo paraga dènge ja'a kahèi. te ja'a hag'e kore rèngu kahèi, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a. ama lamatua padhai lii sèmi èèna, nèti uru ka mai! '

source_text: wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, who from among the gentiles are turned to god: but that we write to them that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from lewdness, and from things strangled, and from blood.
target_text: ka madhutu ngangee ja'a, yakobis, sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu yahudi boe neo madhutu ama lamatua, èdhi dhèu yahudi baku paj'èra si. èdhi baku pabia rèngu, ho pua si madhutu ad'a suna èdhi. de èdhi hud'i suri tare sasuri èci, ho ti pa'adhu hia rèngu, peka na, rèngu parluu boe madhutu aa'i atora ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. te ngaa èdhi pasanèd'e rèngu, peka na, bhèni-mone baku tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali rèngu. rèngu baku ra'a nganga'a sogo-tagu. rèngu baku ra'a raa badha. aa rèngu baku ra'a sisi badha madhe dhu ra pacèli koko.

source_text: for moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath.
target_text: de ladhe èdhi tao atora sèra, èèna j'ara hiu boe. lula dhèu ae re'a le ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi sèmi èèna ka. te èdhi baca atora musa sèra ètu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu mia-mia, lod'o a'oro sasab'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu rai leo sèra re'a le. d'ai sange èèna ka. makasi!

source_text: then it pleased the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to antioch, with paul and barnabas; namely, judas surnamed barsabas, and silas, chief men among the brethren:
target_text: èle padhue-padhai èèna, ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dènge ama-ama kristen dhu leo sèra, rare lii èci ho ra pua dhèu lasi peka lii dhu ra pama'ète rare èèna asa dhèu sarani ètu mia-mia. ka ra tenge dhèu dhu juma'at sèra pakab'ua si, dhu lèke dènge sasab'a èèna. hèia ra pili dhèu dua. èci ngara na silas, aa èci hari, ngara na yudas, dhu ngara leo na, barsabas. ka ra pua dua ra lasi sama-sama paulus dènge barnabas.

source_text: and they wrote letters by them after this manner; the apostles, and elders, and brethren, send greeting to the brethren who are of the gentiles in antioch, and syria, and cilicia.
target_text: ka rèngu rèti sasuri hia dhèu sarani dhu yahudi boe, ètu kota antiokia ètu propensi siria d'ai propensi kilikia nèi. isi sasuri èèna, sèmi ne'e ka: lii maho'o nèti ji'i, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus, dènge ama-ama dhu leo ètu kota yerusalem. ji'i sue miu sama sèmi a'ari ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i suri sasuri ne hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: forasmuch as we have heard, that certain who went out from us, have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, ye must be circumcised, and keep the law; to whom we gave no such commandment:
target_text: ji'i tao sasuri ne, lula ji'i tadèngi, na, pèri-pèri dhèu nèti yerusalem dhiu paraga dènge miu. ka ra aj'a lèke boe, hèia paj'èra dènge pab'ingu miu. de sad'i miu me'a, ji'i pua boe dhèu sèra.

source_text: it seemed good to us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men to you, with our beloved barnabas and paul:
target_text: ropa ji'i tadèngi dhèu dhiu paj'èra miu, ka ji'i pakaboko ètu ne'e, ho pajiko lii langu ne'e. de ji'i pama'ète ngare le. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pua dhèu dhiu peka dènge miu, ngaa dhu ji'i pama'ète ngare le. ra dhiu sama-sama dènge barnabas dènge paulus, dhèu pasue ji'i.

source_text: men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: dhèu dua se, dui j'aj'èra le oe d'ai madhe. rèngu dui j'aj'èra, lula rèngu madhutu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: we have sent therefore judas and silas, who will also tell you the same things by mouth.
target_text: de ji'i pua yudas dènge silas, sèna ka dua ra lole hia miu isi sasuri ne'e.

source_text: for it seemed good to the holy spirit, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
target_text: roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge ji'i. aa ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ngare lii èci kahèi, sèna ka miu parluu boe madhutu aa'i ad'a yahudi ji'i, sèmi ad'a suna èèna. te ad'a ji'i èèna, pabia miu. te ngaa abhu èci do dua j'ara dhu miu parluu sanèd'e, nuka:

source_text: that ye abstain from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from lewdness: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye will do well. fare ye well.
target_text: miu bhèni-mone baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali miu. baku mi'a nganga'a sogo-tagu. baku mi'a raa badha. aa baku mi'a sisi badha dhu roro boe. ladhe miu pakaj'èu iisi miu nèti j'ara-j'ara sèra, na, miu bisa pa'èci dènge mera-milu dènge a'ari dhèu yahudi kristen sèra. d'ai sange ne'e ka, sasuri ji'i. saloom.

source_text: so when they were dismissed, they came to antioch: and when they had convened the multitude, they delivered the epistle.
target_text: ropa sèmi rare sasuri èèna, ka ra palangu dènge ka. hèia ra lasi asa kota antiokia. d'ai nèi, ka rèngu pakaboko dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i sèra, ka ra hia sasuri èèna la'a.

source_text: which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
target_text: ropa baca rare sasuri èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e, lula isi sasuri èèna pa'èra d'ara rèngu.

source_text: and judas and silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
target_text: lamatua pake yudas dènge silas kahèi j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na. dua ra padhai lii ae dènge dhèu parcaya ètu kota èèna. dua ra lole lii holo-nori dènge pa'èra d'ara dhèu sèra.

source_text: and after they had tarried there a time, they were dismissed in peace from the brethren to the apostles.
target_text: silas dènge yudas pea ètu èèna ako nèbhu ciki. èle èèna ka, heka dhèu sarani ètu antiokia sèra, hia si lèpa hari asa ama-ama dhu pua rèngu sèra mai. ra hia si lasi dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: notwithstanding, it pleased silas to abide there still.
target_text: te ngaa silas neo pea taruu ètu antiokia.

source_text: paul also and barnabas continued in antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the lord, with many others also.
target_text: paulus dènge barnabas pea pèri-pèri lod'o ètu antiokia. rèngu soru-bara dhèu leo dhu aj'a dhèu dhu padhai lii lula-nèti j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus kahèi.

source_text: and some days after, paul said to barnabas, let us go again and visit our brethren, in every city where we have preached the word of the lord, and see how they do.
target_text: rèngu pea ako nèbhu ètu antiokia. ca lod'o, ka paulus peka dènge barnabas, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èdhi lèpa hari asa era-era dhu èdhi dhuli uru èèna, ho lati ladhe sèku mamuri a'ari èdhi sèra. mamuri rèngu tasamia le. te rèngu parcaya lamatua yesus nèbhu mèka. uru èèna, èdhi ka dhu nori si. mai lati ladhe si!

source_text: and barnabas determined to take with them john, whose surname was mark.
target_text: ropa barnabas tadèngi lii manèngi paulus, nèngu d'èi kahèi. barnabas neo nèti dènge yohanis dhu ngara leo na, markus, la'e dènge rèngu.

source_text: but paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
target_text: te ngaa paulus sèmi boe, lula uru èèna ètu propensi pamfilia, markus rai eele rèngu.

source_text: and the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed, separating one from the other: and so barnabas took mark, and sailed to cyprus.
target_text: paulus dènge barnabas palab'a aae, ka ra pacèri. barnabas nèti markus, ka ra ca'e kapa lasi asa pulu siprus.

source_text: and paul chose silas, and departed, being commended by the brethren to the grace of god.
target_text: te ngaa paulus nèti silas. lod'o rèngu neo pakèd'i, dhèu parcaya ètu antiokia sèra manèngi lamatua j'aga rèngu, dènge pad'elo babe'a na mi dedha rèngu. sabaj'a rare, ka dua ra pakèd'i.

source_text: and he went through syria and cilicia, confirming the churches.
target_text: hèia paulus dènge silas lasi palème propensi siria dènge propensi kilikia. ètu mia-mia, rèngu pa'èra d'ara dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: then he came to derbe and lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named timothy, the son of a certain woman who was a jewess, and believed, but his father was a greek.
target_text: èle èèna ka, paulus si lasi asa kota derbe. ka ra kako taruu asa kota listra. d'ai listra, ra paraga dènge ana mone ngèru èci, ngara na timotius. ama na, dhèu yunani, aa ina na, dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya yesus. timotius j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kahèi.

source_text: who was well reported of by the brethren that were at lystra and iconium.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu kota listra dènge kota ikonium re'a, na, timotius ne, dhèu d'ara be'a.

source_text: him would paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him, because of the jews who were in those quarters: for they all knew that his father was a greek.
target_text: paulus neo sèna ka timotius madhutu rèngu. te ngaa dhèu yahudi ètu èèna re'a, na, ama timotius èèna, dhèu yunani, de nèngu suna mèka madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, paulus ator ho suna timotius.

source_text: and as they went through the cities, they delivered to them the decrees to keep that were ordained by the apostles and elders who were at jerusalem.
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu lasi palème rae-rae, ho lole lii pama'ète nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus dènge ama-ama kristen leo sèra ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: and so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu asa pa'èra d'ara dhèu sarani sèra. bèli-bèli èèna, dhèu parcaya hiu asa tabha ae.

source_text: now when they had gone throughout phrygia, and the region of galatia, and were forbidden by the holy spirit to preach the word in asia;
target_text: èle èèna ka, paulus si lasi taruu. ka ra lasi asa propensi galati dènge propensi frigia, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci kai si ho baku lasi lole lii lolo be'a asa propensi asia.

source_text: after they had come to mysia, they essayed to go into bithynia: but the spirit suffered them not.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai rai èci dhu patoo dènge propensi misia, rèngu neo maso asa propensi bitinia. te ngaa roh yesus kai si, sèna ka baku lasi asa nèi.

source_text: and they, passing by mysia, came down to troas.
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu kako re propensi misia, hèia d'ai kota troas.

source_text: and a vision appeared to paul in the night: there stood a man of macedonia, and prayed him, saying, come over into macedonia, and help us.
target_text: mèda èèna, paulus abhu tanila. nèngu nèdhi dhèu èci titu ètu cabèka dhasi ètu propensi makedonia. dhèu ne, taraa manèngi tulu, aku nèngu na, ama! mai asa ne'e, ho soru ku ji'i laa!

source_text: and after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavored to go into macedonia, assuredly gathering, that the lord had called us to preach the gospel to them.
target_text: nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ji'i ngare lii èci ho la'a asa makedonia. madhutu ngangee ji'i, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pua ji'i la'a lole j'ara mamuri na mi dhèu ètu cabèka dhasi nèi. nèti èèna ka, na kai ji'i baku la'a asa era leo.

source_text: therefore loosing from troas, we came with a straight course to samothracia, and the next day to neapolis;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ji'i ca'e balu ètu kota troas, ho la'a asa pulu iiki cue, ngara na samotrake. asa bèli èèna, ji'i la'a taruu, ka d'ai kota èci, ngara na neapolis. ka ji'i puru ètu èèna.

source_text: and from thence to philippi, which is the chief city of that part of macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
target_text: nèti èèna, ji'i kako haga la'a asa kota pilipi, kota kapai cue ètu propensi makedonia. kota ne'e, ètu d'ara paredha roma kahèi. ji'i pea pèri-pèri lod'o di ètu èèna.

source_text: and on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spoke to the women who resorted thither.
target_text: d'ai lod'o a'oro sasab'a dhèu yahudi, ji'i la'a tenge era sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. ji'i pangee, na, era sabaj'a èèna ètu sebhe loko. ka ji'i kako ako kaj'èu ciki nèti d'ara kota, hèia ji'i ngèdhi loko èci. ètu era ne'e, ji'i paraga dènge pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni, ka ji'i madhèdi padhai lii dènge rèngu.

source_text: and a certain woman named lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of thyatira, who worshiped god, heard us: whose heart the lord opened, that she attended to the things which were spoken by paul.
target_text: nèti dhèu bhèni se, abhu dhèu èci, ngara na lidia. nèngu nèti kota kaj'èu èci ètu propensi asia, ngara na kota tiatira. sasab'a lidia, pahia bèla mea sanama mangèru dhu kab'ua titu kèna dènge dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. nèngu maj'èni manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ropa na tadèngi lii padhai paulus, ka na sèmi nare dènge.

source_text: and when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, if ye have judged me to be faithful to the lord, come into my house, and abide there: and she constrained us.
target_text: hèia ji'i sarani lidia dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa sarani èle, ka na gale ji'i, aku nèngu na, ama si! ladhe miu ngee, na, ja'a ne parcaya tare'a-re'a le lamatua yesus, na, miu mai manubha ètu d'ara èmu ji'i. lula na pamako loe boe, hèia ji'i la'a.

source_text: and it came to pass as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination, met us, who brought her masters much gain by sooth-saying:
target_text: ca lod'o, ropa ji'i la'a asa era manèngi-mangaj'i, ka ji'i paraga dènge ana bhèni èci. nèngu ne, ènu dhèu. nidhu bhèlu sab'a ètu d'ara nèngu, ka na ne'a ladhe kalua dhèu. nèngu ne'a malare kahèi. ka dhèu ae hia ne doi, ho ra manèngi nèngu ladhe kalua rèngu. te ngaa lamatua ana bhèni ènu ne ka dhu abhu doi aa'i-aa'i sèra. ka rèngu j'aj'i kaja.

source_text: the same followed paul and us, and cried, saying, these men are the servants of the most high god, who show to us the way of salvation.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa ji'i kako, ana bhèni ne madhutu taruu ji'i. ka na pa'oo-parodha, peka na, dhèu se'e se, ana madhutu ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai. rèngu mai ho neo pad'elo j'ara tasamia ka dhèu bisa abhu mamuri, aa tasamia ka lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: and this she did many days. but paul being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, i command thee in the name of jesus christ to come out of her. and he came out the same hour.
target_text: ana bhèni ne pa'oo taruu sèmi èèna d'ai pèri-pèri lod'o. nèbhu-nèbhu hèia paulus roca nanene lii pa'oo-parodha ana bhèni ne. ca tèka, ka paulus kabèli kabodho, ka na ladhe kaloo ne, hèia na hia paredha, peka na, he! èu nidhu bhèlu! dènge koasa lamatua yesus, ja'a paredha èu kalua nèti ana bhèni ne, ètu d'ara ciki oo'e ne'e kahèi! ropa paulus peka nare sèmi èèna, cag'ag'a laa, nidhu ne kalua dènge ka.

source_text: and when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught paul and silas, and drew them into the market-place to the rulers,
target_text: lod'o lamatua ana bhèni ènu èèna re'a, na, koasa nèngu ele le, hèia ra nasa, lula rèngu abhu heka doi. nèti èèna ka, ra kèpe paulus dènge silas, ka nuni rèti si asa era pama'ète lii langu, ètu d'ara pasa.

source_text: and brought them to the magistrates, saying, these men, being jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
target_text: d'ai èèna, hèia ra pa'oo aae, peka na, dhèu se'e mai pa'ele iie kabarai èdhi. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu rai leo. dhèu yahudi se mai nèti li'u, ho pamae kabarai èdhi!

source_text: and teach customs which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being romans.
target_text: rèngu dadugu isi kabarai èdhi, ho baku pusi-pahae dènge j'ara paredha roma, sèna ka madhutu dhoka j'ara rèngu di.

source_text: and the multitude rose together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae sèra nasa, ka ra game paulus dènge silas. ka dhèu kapai èci ètu èèna, pua dhèu ciu eele mèdha-papake ka hake si.

source_text: and when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.
target_text: ra hake rare, ka pamaso dua ra asa d'ara bèdho. ra pua komedhaa j'aga ho j'aga paie, mage dhoka ra rai.

source_text: who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, ka komedhaa j'aga ne pamaso paulus dènge silas asa d'ara kama èci ètu talora aae èmu bèdho èèna. ka na ngapi haga si dua ra dènge aj'u ngangapi.

source_text: and at midnight paul and silas prayed, and sang praises to god: and the prisoners heard them.
target_text: pe d'ara talora mèda sa, paulus dènge silas sabaj'a dènge sod'a koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. aa ana bèdho leo sèra tadèngi lii sod'a ra.

source_text: and suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, rai opo, ka èmu bèdho ne gaged'o. hèia babèdho èmu ne bhoke eele. aa rate ana bèdho sèra, bhoke eele aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had fled.
target_text: ropa komedhaa j'aga èmu bèdho na cag'ag'a, ka na kèd'i. na ladhe hèb'a èmu bèdho bhoke eele aa'i. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na pangee, na, ana bèdho rai aa'i le. ka na bete samala na, ho neo pamadhe iisi.

source_text: but paul cried with a loud voice, saying, do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
target_text: te ngaa paulus kai ne dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, baku pamadhe iisi èu, te ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ka se'e dhu tesa-tesa era!

source_text: then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before paul and silas;
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii èèna, komedhaa ne madha'u titu kèna dènge ele ngangee. ka na pua dhèu rèti hia ne labhu, ka rai la'e asa d'ara bèdho, isi rèbha-rèbha sène. ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha paulus dènge silas.

source_text: and brought them out, and said, sirs, what must i do to be saved?
target_text: hèia lere nèti rèngu asa li'u, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, ama si! ja'a ne, j'èra bia. ja'a tao tasamia, sèna ka ja'a baku abhu hahuku?

source_text: and they said, believe on the lord jesus christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
target_text: ka paulus si dhaa ne, aku rèngu na, j'ara ne sèmi ne'e: èu parcaya lamatua yesus, sèna ka na patabuli èu. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge isi èmu èu.

source_text: and they spoke to him the word of the lord, and to all that were in his house.
target_text: hèia paulus dènge silas padhai lii dènge komedhaa èmu bèdho, dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i ra. rèngu peka dènge si j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus.

source_text: and he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, without delay.
target_text: d'ara talora mèda risi sa, hèia komedhaa j'aga èèna, lere nèti paulus dènge silas, ho ra pamèu nu'a ra. èle èèna ka, paulus dènge silas sarani komedhaa dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and when he had brought them into his house, he set food before them, and rejoiced, believing in god with all his house.
target_text: hèia komedhaa j'aga ne nèti paulus si asa èmu na, hia si ra'a-rinu. dhèu ne, dènge isi èmu na karej'e bia, lula rèngu parcaya le ama lamatua.

source_text: and when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, let those men go.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, dhèu kapai dhu pama'ète lii, hia lii asa komedhaa j'aga èmu bèdho, sèna ka na patabuli eele paulus dènge silas nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and the keeper of the prison told this saying to paul, the magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii èèna, hèia komedhaa ne peka dènge paulus, aku nèngu na, dhèu kapai se, rare lii èci le, ho kalua eele miu. de miu dua mi lèpa ka dènge mera-milu.

source_text: but paul said to them, they have beaten us openly uncondemned, being romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privately? no verily; but let them come themselves and bring us out.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, ka paulus no'o boe sèmi nare. ka na peka hari dènge dhèu rèti lii sèra, aku nèngu na, aad'o sèmi èèna! ji'i se dhèu kabarai roma. de ji'i manèngi hak ji'i kahèi! dhèu paredha hud'i j'ue lii langu ji'i madhutu atora. dhu lèke, hud'i parisa uuru ku lii langu, heka huku kèna. te ngaa rèngu tao boe sèmi èèna. te rèngu dhae parisa mèka lii ho tenge sasala ji'i, te ngaa rèngu hake kalabhe ji'i ètu madha dhèu ae. aa abhu mèka sasala èci sa, te ngaa rèngu pamaso le ji'i asa d'ara èmu bèdho. ne'e ne sisu atora paredha roma. de rèngu neo kalua eele ji'i iia-iia ka laa, sèna ka dhèu baku re'a sasala ji'i ngaa! ? ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi èèna! pua dhèu kapai sèra mai unu ra ho kalua eele ji'i. sèmi èèna ku, heka ji'i sèmi ngare kèna!

source_text: and the sergeants told these words to the magistrates: and they feared when they heard that they were romans.
target_text: ropa dhèu rèti lii sèra lèpa lasi peka lii èèna asa dhèu kapai kota èèna, heka rèngu re'a kèna, na, paulus dènge silas dhèu kabarai roma kahèi. ka ra madha'u bia.

source_text: and they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
target_text: hèia dhèu kapai sèra mai asa èmu bèdho, ka ra mangaku sasala ra dènge manèngi, sèna ka paulus dènge silas baku nasa. ka ra patabuli dua ra nèti d'ara bèdho. aa ra manèngi ho dua ra pakèd'i dènge ka nèti kota èèna.

source_text: and they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
target_text: kalua nèti èmu bèdho, ka paulus si dhuli èmu lidia. ètu èmu èèna, dua ra paraga dènge dhèu parcaya sèra. ka ra aj'a, aa pa'èra d'ara rèngu kahèi. èle èèna ka, ra pakèd'i nèti kota èèna.

source_text: now when they had passed through amphipolis, and apollonia, they came to thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the jews.
target_text: èle èèna ka, paulus dènge silas kako taruu. rèngu kako re kota èci, ngara na ampipolis, lasi asa kota leo èci, ngara na apolonia. nèti nèi, rèngu kako taruu hari asa kota tesalonika. ètu èèna, abhu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi cue.

source_text: and paul, as his manner was, went in to them, and on three sabbaths reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
target_text: dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai era èci dhu abhu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, aa lèke dènge lod'o a'oro sasab'a dhèu yahudi, paulus la'e sabaj'a dènge dhèu ètu sèra. ètu tesalonika, paulus maso asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i rèngu kahèi. ka na padhue-padhai dènge rèngu madhutu isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. paulus madhutu sabaj'a dènge dhèu sèra d'ai tèlu migu.

source_text: opening and alledging, that it was needful that christ should suffer, and rise again from the dead; and that this jesus, whom i preach to you, is christ.
target_text: nèngu peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ladhe èdhi parisa paie sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, èdhi te'a, na, nèti uru ka mai ra suri tèke le, na, dhèu dhu lamatua moa tèke èèna, limuri mai abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna, toke d'ai na madhe. te ngaa lamatua pake koasa na ho pamamuri hari ne. doe ne'e, èdhi te'a le, na, dhèu dhu lamatua moa tèke èèna, nuka yesus!

source_text: and some of them believed, and consorted with paul and silas: and of the devout greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, abhu dhèu yahudi dhu sèmi rare lii padhai paulus, hèia ra pa'èci dènge ne. ètu talora dhèu dhu sèmi rare lii padhai lii nèngu sèra, abhu dhèu yunani kahèi, dhu d'ara d'èi padètu lamatua. aa abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni kapai ètu kota èèna.

source_text: but the jews who believed not, moved with envy, took to them certain vile fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city in an uproar, and assaulted the house of jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
target_text: te ngaa ama-ama dhèu yahudi ètu kota èèna d'ara pèd'a, ka ra nasa. hèia ra kakèj'i-rariu dhèu bhelu ho ra tao kaco. lod'o dhèu pakaboko ae, ka ra tao maruru ètu d'ara kota èèna. ra tenge paulus dènge silas ho neo nuni rèti asa era dhèu maruru sèra. ka ra lasi maruru asa èmu yason, lula paulus dènge silas pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and when they found them not, they drew jason and certain brethren to the rulers of the city, crying, these that have turned the world upside down, have come hither also; whom jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of cesar, saying, that there is another king, one jesus.
