source_text: for the scripture saith to pharaoh, even for this same purpose have i raised thee up, that i might show my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, lamatua padhai lii dènge dhèu aae masir, peka na, ja'a ded'e kore èu j'aj'i dhèu aae, lula ja'a neo pake èu ho pad'elo koasa ja'a mi dhèu ae-ae. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu pale-lème rai-haha ne, bisa koa-kio kolongara ja'a.

source_text: therefore he hath mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
target_text: de ladhe lamatua neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dhèu èci, na, nèngu tao. aa ladhe na neo tao d'ara ca dhèu adhu sèmi hadhu, na, nèngu tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: thou wilt say then to me, why doth he yet find fault? for who hath resisted his will?
target_text: ladhe sèmi abhu dhèu dhu sisu ja'a, peka na, kèri sèmi èèna, ladhe lamatua neo ad'u j'ara èci, cee ka dhu bisa lab'a ne? aad'o, sina ma? de nga tao ka nèngu neo pèci sasala mi dedha èdhi? èèna adil boe!

source_text: no, but, o man, who art thou that repliest against god? shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, why hast thou made me thus?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu pangee sèmi èèna, ja'a dhaa sèmi ne'e ka: èu pangee na, èu ne cee? ! èu neo padhai lii lab'a lamatua, do? baku sèmi èèna! te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, abhu dhu suri, peka na, ladhe dhèu tao mèdha èci, abhu ètu mia mèdha ne karèi hari dhèu dhu tao ne peka na, ‘nga tao ka èu tao ja'a sèmi ne'e! ? '

source_text: hath not the potter power over the clay of the same lump to make one vessel to honor, and another to dishonor?
target_text: nuka sèmi dhèu tao èru rai. nèti rai mea ca kahore, nèngu dènge hak tao g'ala dhu kale'e cue, sèna ka dhèu koa ne. dhèu ne dènge hak kahèi, pake rai mea ca kahore ne tao era kaboko maruru èci, madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: what if god, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much long-suffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ama lamatua. nèngu dènge hak ho tao madhutu dad'èi na. nèngu neo pad'elo mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, nèngu nasa, aa tule eele bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu tao. nèngu neo ho dhèu re'a kahèi, na, nèngu unu koasa ae-ae. sèna ka dhèu bisa re'a, nèngu taha d'ara dènge dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a. te ngaa mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a, dhoka mate lod'o di, ho ra ele iie aa'i.

source_text: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had before prepared for glory,
target_text: lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara ne, ho paj'uj'u mi dhèu ae, na, nèngu neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dhèu cahag'e. rèngu se'e ka dhu na hag'e nare mema le, sèna ka ded'e si padedha-dedha. aa na neo sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, nèngu mesa na ka dhu dedha risi aa'i.

source_text: even us whom he hath called, not of the jews only, but also of the gentiles.
target_text: te èdhi se dhu na pili nare le, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. èdhi se, cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi, aa cahag'e hari nèti dhèu leo rai kara.

source_text: as he saith also in hosea, i will call them my people, who were not my people; and her beloved, who was not beloved.
target_text: uru èèna, lamatua pake dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na hosea, ho suri dhèu leo rai kara sèra, peka na, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna, unu boe ja'a, te ngaa ja'a neo paroa kore si, na, ‘miu se, dhèu ja'a. ' aa abhu suku dhu uru èèna, ja'a sue boe, te ngaa ja'a neo paroa kore si, na, ‘miu se, suku dhu ja'a sue. '

source_text: and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said to them, ye are not my people; there shall they be called, the children of the living god.
target_text: hosea suri kahèi, na, ètu èèna, ètu era dhu lamatua peka dènge si, na, ‘miu se, j'aj'i boe dhèu ja'a! ' pe lamatua dhu mamuri èèna, neo peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ‘limuri ne, miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ja'a! ' na peka sèmi èèna, lula na kasia mi dhèu yahudi boe sèra.

source_text: isaiah also crieth concerning israel, though the number of the children of israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
target_text: dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èci hari, nuka yesaya, peka nèdhi le lula-nèti suku isra'el, na, masi ka dhèu isra'el ca nau-ca nadha, nuka sèmi salae dhasi, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua patabuli rèngu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra, dhoka dhèu ciki di.

source_text: for he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the lord make upon the earth.
target_text: te èèna d'ai lod'o na, ho ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sama sèmi dhu na peka mema le. te ngaa na pamata heka, te na pamèci nare lai-lai!

source_text: and as isaiah said before, except the lord of sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as sodom, and been made like gomorrah.
target_text: lod'o uru èèna, yesaya peka le lula-nèti dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi oto, lula ama lamatua dhu koasa risi aa'i èèna, soro tèke sèna ka ana-èpu èdhi cahag'e abhu sod'a. te ladhe aad'o sèmi èèna, na, èdhi se aad'o heka le, nuka sèmi dhèu kota sodom dènge kota gomora sèra.

source_text: what shall we say then? that the gentiles who followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is by faith:
target_text: de èdhi neo peka ngaa? èdhi neo peka, na, dhèu dhu yahudi boe sèra mai nèti mia-mia. uru èèna rèngu tenge boe j'ara ho pabe'a rèngu dènge lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, ra pabe'a le dènge ne, lula parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: but israel, who followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu isra'el sèra, neo ae le tenge j'ara sèna ka tao madhutu atora musa, ho pabe'a rèngu dènge lamatua, te ngaa j'aj'i boe.

source_text: why? because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. for they stumbled at that stumbling-stone; as it is written, behold, i lay in sion a stumbling-stone, and rock of offense: and whoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
target_text: nga tao ka rèngu bisa boe pabe'a dènge lamatua? lula rèngu dhodhoka neo tao madhutu atora di, sèna ka na sèmi nare si nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara mola, te ngaa rèngu parcaya boe yesus kristus. hèia rèngu oe sèmi kadhunu sa, lèke hadhu kadhunu cue. ne'e ne ka naneo nèti sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu peka na, ladhe ku sa ne'e! te ja'a pamadhèdi le ca dhèu ètu ledhe sion, nuka kota yerusalem. dhèu ne nuka sèmi hadhu cue, dhu dhèu kadhunu lèke ne. te ngaa cee dhu parcaya ne, nèngu parluu boe makae. hadhu ne, nuka yesus. te ngaa dhèu isra'el tule eele ne. èèna na sama sèmi rèngu kadhunu, ka bèbha lula hadhu deo na.

source_text: brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to god for israel is, that they may be saved.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo dhèu isra'el abhu ngaa? ja'a sabaj'a ho hud'i laa lamatua patalale rèngu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a heka karej'e kèna!

source_text: for i bear them testimony that they have a zeal of god, but not according to knowledge.
target_text: ja'a bisa peka j'ara-j'ara nèti tatao dhèu se'e: rèngu se maj'èni neo madhutu ama lamatua. masi ka ra maj'èni sèmi èèna, te ngaa re'a mèu boe j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: for they, being ignorant of god's righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves to the righteousness of god.
target_text: lula rèngu re'a boe j'ara mamuri dhu mola, dhu bisa pabe'a dhèu dènge lamatua, nèti èèna ka dhèu se bhoke j'ara unu ra, ho neo sèku pabe'a dènge lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: for christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhutu dhoka atora di, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare si, na, èèna d'ai mèka. nèti èèna ka, kristus pamèci nare aa'i mèu-mèu le, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua. ka limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for moses describeth the righteousness which is by the law, that the man who doeth these things shall live by them.
target_text: uru èèna, musa pad'elo le j'ara ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, sèna ka dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, sad'i ra tao madhutu aa'i mèu-mèu atora lamatua. nèngu suri, peka na, dhèu cee dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ne, bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu mamuri mola.

source_text: but the righteousness which is by faith speaketh on this wise, say not in thy heart, who shall ascend into heaven? that is, to bring christ down.
target_text: te ngaa sasuri mola-mèci lamatua pad'elo j'ara leo, peka na, dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua sad'i rèngu parcaya yesus kristus. dhu suri tèke, na, mage karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu bisa ca'e asa sorga? ' èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu neo ca'e la'e peka dènge kristus, na, èdhi dhèu rai-haha d'èi ladhe nèngu puru mai sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: or, who shall descend into the deep? that is, to bring christ again from the dead.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci suri kahèi, peka na, mage karèi, na ‘cee ka dhu neo puru la'e asa d'ara naraka, ètu era dhèu madhe sèra? ' èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu puru la'e ho paca'e kristus nèti era mamadhe na, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: but what saith it? the word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach:
target_text: baku sèmi èèna! te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri, na, lii moa nèti lamatua ètu katanga madha èu! te lii moa èèna abhu le ètu hèb'a dènge d'ara èu. lii moa ne dhu èdhi peka-padhai dènge dhèu, peka na, ladhe èu neo abhu mamuri, na, hud'i parcaya ku kristus!

source_text: that if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the lord jesus, and shalt believe in thy heart that god hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
target_text: ladhe èu mangaku dènge hèb'a mu, peka na, kristus èèna, kètu ja'a, aa parcaya ètu d'ara èu, na, ama lamatua pamamuri hari le yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na, ka ama lamatua patabuli èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èu.

source_text: for with the heart man believeth to righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made to salvation.
target_text: te ladhe èu parcaya kristus dènge d'ara kateme, ama lamatua cap èu, peka na, èu dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. aa ladhe èu mangaku dènge hèb'a mu, peka na, yesus j'aj'i kètu èu, ama lamatua patabuli èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èu kahèi.

source_text: for the scripture saith, whoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, cee dhu parcaya ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a, na'e boe makae, lula lamatua neo tao j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu, ngaa dhu na peka nare le.

source_text: for there is no difference between the jew and the greek: for the same lord over all, is rich to all that call upon him,
target_text: dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe, èci èèna ka. beda boe. abhu dhoka kètu èci di, aa nèngu ka kètu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi bara nèti nèngu.

source_text: for whoever shall call upon the name of the lord shall be saved.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi lamatua soru-bara si, pe nèngu patabuli si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: how then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
target_text: te ngaa tasamia dhèu bisa manèngi bara nèti ca dhèu, ladhe rèngu dhae parcaya mèka ne? aa tasamia rèngu bisa parcaya ne, ladhe rèngu dhae tadèngi mèka j'ara mamuri dhèu ne? tasamia rèngu bisa tadèngi lula-nèti nèngu ne, ladhe abhu boe dhèu dhu lole dènge ra?

source_text: and how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, how beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things?
target_text: aa tasamia rèngu bisa lole dènge dhèu, ladhe abhu boe dhu pua-paleha si? ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ladhe dhèu rèti mai lii lolo be'a, mamai dhèu se'e se be'a titu kèna!

source_text: but they have not all obeyed the gospel. for isaiah saith, lord, who hath believed our report?
target_text: te ngaa miu kahèi me'a, na, abhu dhèu isra'el cahag'e ro'o boe nanene lii lolo be'a lamatua. te yesaya, ca dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai lamatua, suri peka na, lamatua! dhèu se'e ro'o boe lèka lii moa dhu rèngu tadèngi le nèti ji'i!

source_text: so then, faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of god.
target_text: de ladhe neo parcaya ama lamatua, na, hud'i nanene uuru ku lii holo-nori na. aa neo me'a lii moa na, hud'i tadèngi uuru ku lula-nèti kristus.

source_text: but i say, have they not heard? yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.
target_text: ja'a karèi sèku, sèmi ne'e: ele boe miu pangee, na, dhèu isra'el sèra tadèngi rèdhi mèka lula-nèti kristus, do? tatu ra tadèngi le! nuka sèmi dhèu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu palolo lula-nèti lamatua ne pale-palème le rai-haha; lii rèngu d'ai aa'i le palème rai-haha toke d'ai suu-suu rai.

source_text: but i say, did not israel know? first, moses saith, i will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation i will anger you.
target_text: ja'a neo karèi hari ca j'ara, dhèu isra'el sèra dhane rare mèka j'ara ama lamatua, do? musa ka, dhèu uru j'ara dhu suri peka na, lamatua peka mi dhèu isra'el sèmi ne'e: ja'a neo tao j'ara èci hia dhèu nèti suku leo sèra. j'ara ne tao miu tèka d'ara. aa ja'a neo tao j'ara èci, hia dhèu dhu mi pangee na kahadhu ènyu. j'ara ne tao miu kadhi ngutu.

source_text: but isaiah is very bold, and saith, i was found by them that sought me not; i was made manifest to them that asked not for me.
target_text: limuri hari, yesaya suri dhu paled'a risi lula-nèti dhèu yahudi boe, dhu peka na, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna tenge boe ja'a, te ngaa rèngu paraga le dènge ja'a. abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna manèngi boe ho rèdhi ja'a, te ngaa ja'a pad'elo iisi le mi rèngu.

source_text: but to israel he saith, all day long i have stretched forth my hands to a disobedient and gainsaying people.
target_text: te ngaa, lula-nèti dhèu isra'el sèra, lamatua peka le sèmi ne'e: mèda-mèu, ai ja'a dhu pakabhèle tèke, sèna ka tatae mamai dhèu isra'el asa ja'a. te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ja'a, aa ra d'èi palab'a dènge ja'a.

source_text: i say then, hath god cast away his people? by no means. for i also am an israelite, of the seed of abraham, of the tribe of benjamin.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ele boe miu pangee, na, lula dhèu isra'el ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na tule eele le si. sèmi èèna ka, do? aad'o! te j'aj'aj'i ja'a nèti rèngu kahèi! ja'a ne, nèti suku benyamin. ama benyamin, nuka yakob. baki na, isak, ama isak, ka abraham, dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: god hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. know ye not what the scripture saith of elijah? how he maketh intercession to god against israel, saying,
target_text: ama lamatua tule eele nèdhi boe dhèu unu na sèra. rèngu se'e ka dhu na tadhe karèi nèti uru-uru ka. miu sanèd'e era, ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti elia, si? elia ka'uu-kamuki mi lamatua lula-nèti dhèu isra'el sèra, hèia na manèngi, sèna ka lamatua huku si,

source_text: lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thy altars; and i am left alone, and they seek my life.
target_text: peka na, ama! dhèu se pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai, dhu ama pua mai. ra pa'ele iie le mei korban kahèi, ètu era dhu dhèu tema pahaha iisi mi ama. nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ate dhoka ja'a mesa-mesa ku di dhu mamuri. te ngaa rèngu tenge j'ara, ho neo pamadhe ja'a kahèi!

source_text: but what saith the answer of god to him? i have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to baal.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa, peka na: lii èu èèna, sala! te dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi ja'a, abhu pidhu riho dhèu era. rèngu se taha dènge èra, aa sogo-tagu boe ba'al!

source_text: even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace. and if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. but if of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi limuri ne. te dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i boe dhu soro kabodho mi ama lamatua. abhu ciki nèti ji'i era dhu lamatua pili nare, sèna ka hia mamuri, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i, lula boe nèti tatao ji'i dhu be'a! te ladhe nèngu hud'i pili nare ku ji'i lula tatao ji'i dhu be'a, sasoa na, nèngu bisa boe pama'ète sèna ka neo pad'elo, do pad'elo boe, d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i. ladhe sèmi èèna, peka iia ka, na, ‘nèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na'.

source_text: what then? israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
target_text: de lala'e na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi rèngu, sèna ka rèngu bisa pabe'a kahèi dènge lamatua. te ngaa abhu boe, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu, dènge ro'o boe nanene lamatua. te ngaa cahag'e nèti dhèu se abhu. dhèu se'e ka dhu lamatua hag'e nare si.

source_text: according as it is written, god hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear; to this day.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri lula-nèti dhèu kètu hadhu sèra, peka na, lamatua hia si, musi madha dhu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi, ro'a dhilu dhu bisa boe tadèngi, aa kahadhu dhu bisa boe pangee. de rèngu re'a mèu iia boe, toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: and david saith, let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumbling-block, and a recompense to them:
target_text: dhèu aae daud suri le kahèi lula-nèti dhèu yahudi se, ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, hud'i laa ho ra tao pesta ètu mei unu ra. te tatao rèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i sasii ho sii hari rèngu, ka ra ngee na aa'i-aa'i se be'a le. aa nèti mèdha-panyau unu ra, ka dhu pasaleku rèngu.

source_text: let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back always.
target_text: hud'i laa sèna ka musi madha ra maroga, ho rèdhi boe ngaa-ngaa! hud'i laa rèngu dui bia taruu, sèna ka kabodho ra asa kabhuku!

source_text: i say then, have they stumbled that they should fall? by no means: but rather through their fall salvation is come to the gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: nga tao ka dhèu yahudi sèra kadhunu? ra bèbha le, do? aad'o! te ngaa, lula rèngu ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua, aa ro'o boe parcaya kristus, ne'e ne ka dhu bhoke j'ara hia dhèu yahudi boe, sèna ka ra bisa abhu mamuri, lula lamatua patabuli si nèti sasala ra. nèti tatao lamatua sèmi èèna, nèngu neo ho dhèu yahudi sèra tèka d'ara, hèia ra lèpa hari ho madhutu ne.

source_text: now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the gentiles; how much more their fullness?
target_text: de dhu mola na kèna, peka na, dhèu yahudi se sisu ngaa dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo nèti palème rai-haha ne bisa rasa kakee-mamènyi d'ara hua iia lamatua. de dhèu yahudi rugi kapai. te ngaa èèna tao dhèu yahudi boe sèra oto titu kèna. de nèbhu-nèbhu, ladhe dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra pabe'a hari dènge lamatua, èèna be'a risi hari!

source_text: for i speak to you gentiles, inasmuch as i am the apostle of the gentiles, i magnify my office:
target_text: ja'a neo peka j'ara èci dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe, sèmi ne'e: lamatua pua ja'a sèna ka, laku peka-padhai dènge miu, lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra ngi'u, sèna ka pakako sasab'a dhu be'a aae ne.

source_text: if by any means i may incite to emulation them who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
target_text: te ladhe ja'a pakako sasab'a ne dènge be'a, ja'a sanao sèna ka dhèu yahudi unu ku tèka d'ara. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, ja'a bisa bara rèngu cahag'e sèna ka abhu mamuri.

source_text: for if the rejection of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
target_text: ropa lamatua tule eele dhèu unu na, lod'o èèna kahèi lamatua bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu j'ara ho maso j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa èle èèna, ladhe sèmi rèngu padame hari dènge lamatua, èèna be'a risi. te èèna sama sèmi rèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe ra!

source_text: for if the first fruit is holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root is holy, so are the branches.
target_text: nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao roti. ladhe nare tarigu ciki saraka mi lamatua, èèna na roti se j'aj'i mola-mèci unu lamatua. aa ladhe dhèu hia amo aj'u èci, ho j'aj'i bua sulung mi lamatua, èèna na aj'u ca kapua ne j'aj'i mola-mèci unu lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive-tree, art ingrafted among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive-tree;
target_text: ja'a neo pakasame dhèu yahudi dènge aj'u saitun ca kapua dhu ra piara ètu d'ara oka. ama lamatua dhu tutu eele le dadana cahag'e nèti aj'u ne. te ngaa miu dhu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi saitun j'ami. hèia, nèti dadana miu cahag'e, lamatua pare nare ka la'e patapa mi aj'u dhu ètu d'ara oka deo na. dènge j'ara ne, dadana nèti aj'u dhu ètu li'u oka, sakid'o nare mamuri nèti aj'u ètu d'ara oka deo na. ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge miu dhu yahudi boe, dhu sèmi mere d'ara hua iia lamatua kahèi, dhu na neo hia mi dhèu unu na, dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: boast not against the branches. but if thou boastest, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! de mage mi padedha iisi, ho pangee na, miu dhu nèti li'u, be'a risi nèti dadana dhu lamatua tutu eele sèra! ladhe èu neo padedha iisi, mage èu bhèlu, te, èu ne dhoka ca dadana di! èu boe ka dhu pa'èra kapua aj'u ne. te amo ka dhu pa'èra aj'u ne!

source_text: thou wilt say then, the branches were broken off, that i might be ingrafted.
target_text: ele boe èu neo peka, na, lamatua pare eele dadana èci nèti aj'u dhu muri ètu d'ara oka na, sèna ka na pakaj'èpe ja'a mi era deo na, ho gati dadana deo na.

source_text: well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. be not high-minded, but fear:
target_text: mema lèke. te ngaa baku bhèlu, na, lamatua tutu eele dadana sèra, lula rèngu parcaya boe ne. aa èu gati si, lula èu parcaya nèngu. de baku padedha iisi! be'a risi loe aa baku lela dedha!

source_text: for if god spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi sèra nuka sèmi dadana dhu muri mema, dhu cèu uru tèka. te ngaa lamatua tèke eele boe si toke panèbhu ètu èèna. de ladhe èu parcaya boe taruu mi lamatua, mage èu maena ho na soro tèke èu taruu ètu èèna!

source_text: behold therefore the goodness and severity of god: on them who fell, severity; but towards thee, goodness, if thou shalt continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee pabe'a-be'a ku. ama lamatua mema d'ara hua iia. te ngaa ne'a hia huku dhu bia kahèi. pe nèngu huku dhèu dhu manahu le, dhu pabe'a heka dènge ne. te ngaa mi miu dhèu yahudi boe, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, sad'i miu pa'èki taruu dènge ne, aa miu sèmi mere babe'a na. te ngaa ladhe miu sèmi mere boe j'ara sèmi èèna, lamatua pare eele kahèi miu nèti aj'u na.

source_text: and they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be ingrafted: for god is able to ingraft them again.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu yahudi sèra. ladhe ra ele-ho'a ka, ho mulai parcaya kristus, pe lamatua tape hari rèngu mi aj'u uru èèna. te nèngu dènge koasa ho bisa tao j'ara sèmi èèna!

source_text: for if thou wast cut out of the olive-tree which is wild by nature, and wast ingrafted contrary to nature into a good olive-tree; how much more shall these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive-tree?
target_text: te miu dhu dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dadana nèti aj'u saitun hui, dhu muri tab'a ètu li'u oka. te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare miu, ka pakaj'èpe laa mi aj'u saitun dhu hua iia, dhu na sèle ètu d'ara oka na, sèna ka hud'i laa aj'u hui èèna leko-leo, aa aj'u ètu d'ara oka leko-leo. te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe, bisa j'aj'i sèmi sèra, ngaa hari dhèu yahudi. rèngu bisa risi eele hari, ladhe lamatua pakaj'èpe hari si mi laa aj'u rèngu unu ra.

source_text: for i would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits that blindness in part hath happened to israel, until the fullness of the gentiles shall be come in.
target_text: a'ari ètu roma! miu hud'i me'a ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi rahasia. te ladhe miu me'a, miu mage pakapai iisi, dhu peka na, miu d'èlu-mèu risi. te j'ara na sèmi ne'e: limuri ne d'ara dhèu yahudi, adhu sèmi hadhu, aa ro'o boe parcaya kristus. te ngaa rèngu bisa boe sèmi èèna taruu. te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pili nare si, parcaya le kristus, bèli-camèd'a dhèu yahudi sèra parcaya ne kahèi.

source_text: and so all israel shall be saved: as it is written, there shall come out of sion the deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from jacob:
target_text: de ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, pe lamatua patalale dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. j'ara ne'e j'aj'i, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu peka na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai, dhu patabuli èdhi nèti mamadhe-mamopo. nèngu mai nèti ledhe sion, nuka kota yerusalem. èèna na, nèngu ka dhu tao ho ana-èpu yakob ele-ho'a. te rèngu mamuri pusi-pahae boe ja'a, aa ra soro kabodho mi j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: for this is my covenant to them, when i shall take away their sins.
target_text: ja'a neo saku eele sasala-sasigo ra. te ja'a pa'èki le lii padhadha dènge rèngu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: as concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as concerning the election, they are beloved for the father's sakes.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo be'a lamatua, ra tao iisi ra nuka sèmi musu dhu palab'a dènge ne. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, rèngu hia j'ara mi miu dhu yahudi boe! masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua sue si era, lula na sue bèi-baki ra, aa na hag'e nare si j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: for the gifts and calling of god are without repentance.
target_text: te ladhe ama lamatua hia le mèdha èci, na nare heka. aa ladhe na paroa nare le dhèu, peka na, mai madhutu ja'a! mai asa d'ara ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a! na babège eele heka si.

source_text: for as ye in times past have not believed god, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief;
target_text: uru èèna, miu dhèu yahudi boe, mo'o boe nanene lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi mere rasa kasia nèti lamatua, lula dhèu yahudi ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
target_text: de rèngu se'e ka dhu limuri ne ro'o boe tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi miu era. aa bèli-camèd'a nèngu neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dedha rèngu kahèi.

source_text: for god hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua tao ai-hèb'a mi dedha dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu yahudi boe. te aa'i-aa'i ra tao boe madhutu dad'èi na, nuka sèmi rèngu ètu d'ara babèdho, aa re'a boe j'ara kalua. lamatua soro tèke si sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: o the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of god! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
target_text: ama lamatua d'èlu-mèu titu kèna! aa na pake mamèu na, sèna ka tao j'ara hua iia. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu tadhe mèu ne. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ne'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua pama'ète lii langu. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a mèu, nga tao ka lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara èci.

source_text: for who hath known the mind of the lord? or who hath been his counselor?
target_text: abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ne'a mèu ngangee ama èdhi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa holo ne.

source_text: or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed to him again?
target_text: abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa hia iia lamatua mèdha èci. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa laka-seti lamatua sèna ka na b'ala hari!

source_text: for from him, and by him, and to him are all things: to whom be glory for ever. amen.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i kapua ra nèti ama lamatua! aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula nèngu ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao, èdhi sab'a hia ne. èdhi koa-kio ne, taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia! lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: i beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of god, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to god, which is your reasonable service.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka saraka mamuri miu kateme mi lamatua, sama sèmi korban dhu mamuri. j'ara sèmi ne'e ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. pa'èra ngi'u miu ho madhutu dad'èi na, aa mamuri mola, te j'ara sèmi èèna ka dhu pad'elo sasue miu aa pakab'ua ne. mema lèke, ladhe miu pahaha iisi mi nèngu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good and acceptable, and perfect will of god.
target_text: baku soro tèke ho dhèu rai-haha ne pua miu tao sèmi ne'e, do sèmi èèna, do mamuri sèmi ngaa sa, madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. baku sad'i madhutu iia d'ara di, j'ara ngangee ra, j'ara mamuri ra, do ad'a tatao ra. te ngaa dhu be'a risi eele, ladhe miu soro tèke lamatua ub'a ngangee miu j'aj'i hiu, sèna ka miu laladhe aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu j'ara hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa me'a dad'èi lamatua mi dedha miu. te dad'èi lamatua èèna, be'a, pamèci, dènge pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: for through the grace given to me, i say, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as god hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
target_text: lula lamatua pajuu le ja'a, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e ka: lee ngi'u miu dènge j'ara dhu lèke! baku padedha ngi'u risi nèti dhu lèke. baku pake j'ara dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. dhèu èci-èci hud'i tenge j'ara ho ne'a mèu a'èra dènge karunya dhu lamatua hia le mi nèngu, lula na parcaya kristus.

source_text: for as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
target_text: tare pakasame dènge ngi'u dhèu. ètu ngi'u ne, abhu bagian-bagian, dhu dènge sasab'a-la'a baka-leo.

source_text: so we, being many, are one body in christ, and every one members one of another.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. èdhi se dhèu ae-ae, te ngaa pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci. aa dhèu èci-èci ka dènge sasab'a-la'a na, nuka sèmi bagian nèti ngi'u ne. èci parluu èci. tare conto nèti kacui-aai dhu poro pama'ète nèti ngi'u ne, gaguna na aad'o heka, si?

source_text: having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: lamatua pangèd'u èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti koasa, sèna ka pakako rupa-rupa sasab'a-la'a na, lula na d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. nuka sèmi, ladhe lamatua hia èu koasa sèna ka èu peka lii moa na, èu hud'i peka aa'i lii moa deo na. te ngaa baku peka risi nèti lii moa èèna.

source_text: or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching:
target_text: ladhe lamatua hia èu a'èra dènge karunya, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, èu hud'i lalau-lalo'o pake koasa deo na. ladhe na pala hia èu a'èra dènge karunya ho aj'a-nori dhèu lula-nèti nèngu, na, èu hud'i aj'a-nori ku pake koasa deo na.

source_text: or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that showeth mercy, with cheerfulness.
target_text: ladhe na pala hia èu a'èra dènge karunya, ho pa'èra d'ara dhèu, èu hud'i pa'èra si pake koasa deo na. ladhe na hia èu koasa ho soru-bara dhèu leo dènge mèdha-panyau dhu èu unu, hia la mèdha-panyau sèra mi dhèu sèna ka èu soru-bara si. ladhe na hia èu a'èra dènge karunya ho pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a lamatua dènge be'a, na, èu hud'i maj'èni ho pimpin si pake koasa deo na. ladhe na pala hia èu rasa kasia ho soru-bara dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa, èu hud'i bara si dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: let love be without dissimulation. abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
target_text: ladhe miu pad'elo sasue mi dhèu, na, tao dènge d'ara mola; baku peka leo tao leo. core eele bhelu-katub'a, aa kèpe pa'èra-èra j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honor preferring one another;
target_text: miu dhèu sarani hud'i mamuri pasue ku èci dènge èci. pa'èra iisi ho pad'elo pakab'ua miu èci dènge èci.

source_text: not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the lord;
target_text: ladhe miu sab'a, sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, baku dènge paloa-pad'ui. hud'i laa sèna ka d'ara miu karae, lod'o miu ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a. aa miu hud'i sab'a hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing earnest in prayer;
target_text: d'ara miu hud'i karej'e mèda-mèu, te miu me'a le, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo tao tasamia hia miu. pa'èra d'ara ladhe abhu sasusa. baku roca sabaj'a mèda-mèu.

source_text: distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
target_text: pake mèdha-panyau miu, ho bara dhèu sarani dhu parluu miu bara si. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai nèti rae leo, hia ra'a-rinu, aa sèmi mere si sèna ka manubha ètu d'ara èmu mi. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo le sasue miu mi dedha rèngu.

source_text: bless them who persecute you; bless, and curse not.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu tino paj'èra miu, manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale. tare'a! baku dhoo si!

source_text: rejoice with them that rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu d'ara karej'e, na, karej'e sama-sama dènge ra. aa ladhe abhu dhu tangi roma iisi, lula d'ara pèd'a, na, tangi sama-sama dènge ra.

source_text: be of the same mind one towards another. mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. be not wise in your own conceits.
target_text: mamuri pasue dènge d'ara èci. baku padedha iisi. be'a risi miu pa'angalai dènge dhèu haha. baku padedha iisi ho pangee, na, dhoka èu di dhu me'a.

source_text: recompense to no man evil for evil. provide things honest in the sight of all men.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao bhelu mi dedha èu, na, èu baku b'ala dènge bhabhelu kahèi. te ngaa èu hud'i tenge j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa sèmi rare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: if it is possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
target_text: ladhe bisa, na, tenge j'ara ho mamuri padame dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place to wrath: for it is written, vengeance is mine; i will repay, saith the lord.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ladhe dhèu tao sala mi miu, na, baku b'ala ne. soro tèke, sèna ka lamatua ka dhu ator. te lamatua nasa ladhe dhèu tao bhelu-katub'a sama sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ka dhu dènge hak ho b'ala sasala dhèu. te ja'a ka dhu huku bhabhelu dhèu.

source_text: therefore if thy enemy hungereth, feed him; if he thirsteth, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
target_text: dhu be'a risi ka, tao madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ladhe musu èu manganga, na, hia ne na'a. ladhe musu èu koko-kamango, na, hia ne ninu. te ladhe tao ka sèmi èèna, nèngu makae unu na, aa na pakab'ua hari èu.

source_text: be not overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
target_text: baku soro tèke bhabhelu ator èu. be'a risi ladhe j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a ka dhu uli èu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èu bisa segi madha j'ara dhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: let every soul be subject to the higher powers. for there is no power but from god: the powers that are, are ordained by god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i nanene ku atora nèti dhèu paredha. te rèngu dènge hak aa koasa ho paredha dhèu. te ngaa koasa èèna, mai nèti ama lamatua. lula lamatua ka dhu ded'e si, nèti èèna ka rèngu abhu koasa ho rèd'u paredha.

source_text: whoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of god: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu lab'a dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha, èci èèna ka rèngu lab'a dhu lamatua ded'e nare le. ladhe ra ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu huku nèti lamatua.

source_text: for rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. wilt thou then not be afraid of the power; do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise from the same:
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu lèke, baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. te ngaa ladhe miu ad'u j'ara bhelu, be'a risi miu madha'u dènge ra! de j'aga ngi'u ho tao dhu lèke, sèna ka miu baku madha'u dènge ra. aa ladhe miu tao ka j'ara sèmi èèna, pe ra koa-kad'iri miu.

source_text: for he is the minister of god to thee for good. but if thou doest that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of god, an avenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
target_text: te dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha, rèngu sèra ka dhu lamatua hag'e nare si, ho ladhe-leru miu. te ngaa ladhe miu loe boe nèti tao sala, be'a risi miu madha'u! te rèngu dènge hak dhu iia d'ara boe ho huku miu. rèngu, nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha lamatua, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a. te lamatua sèmi nare boe bhabhelu dhu dhèu tao; na nasa dènge ra.

source_text: wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i nanene ku, mi dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. te miu dhu me'a mèu le, èèna ka dhu lèke mola-mola. aa miu me'a kahèi, na, lamatua nasa, ladhe èdhi tao boe dhu lèke.

source_text: for, for this cause ye pay tribute also: for they are god's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu hud'i b'ae bea dhu madhutu atora, lula dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha sèra, pakako sasab'a lamatua.

source_text: render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honor to whom honor.
target_text: de miu hud'i b'ae aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke madhutu atora. b'ae hia dhèu roro bea sèra, bea aa'i-aa'i dhu miu hud'i b'ae ku. pakab'ua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mema nia sèmi lii pakab'ua. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a taruu, ded'e padedha kolongara si, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
target_text: b'ae pama'ète kèlu èu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka baku mamuri ètu d'ara kèlu-g'ètu. te èdhi pakèlu dhoka ètu ca madha j'ara di, nuka pasue. ladhe miu sue dhèu, miu tao le madhutu atora-atora nèti lamatua.

source_text: for this, thou shalt not commit adultery, thou shalt not kill, thou shalt not steal, thou shalt not bear false witness, thou shalt not covet; and if there is any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
target_text: te atora sèra peka na, baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali mu; baku pamadhe dhèu; baku mana'u; baku d'èi leli neo unu mèdha-panyau dhèu, aa dhu leo hari. ladhe neo madhutu aa'i atora se'e, hud'i tao madhutu ku atora èci ne'e, dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu.

source_text: love worketh no ill to one's neighbor: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu leo, èdhi tao boe bhelu mi nèngu, si? de ladhe èdhi loe boe pad'elo sasue èdhi, èdhi bisa tao madhutu aa'i atora lamatua.

source_text: and this, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
target_text: ama lamatua neo patabuli èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha. aa limuri ne, lod'o sèna ka dhèu abhu mamuri nèti lamatua dètu ae le, ladhe èdhi pasoro dènge lod'o dhu èdhi heka parcaya yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i mamuri pasue, lula èdhi te'a le madha j'ara ne'e. nuka sèmi uru èèna, èdhi dhu bhèj'i era. te ngaa limuri ne d'ai le lod'o na, ho èdhi kèd'i ka nèti bhabhèj'i èdhi!

source_text: the night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.
target_text: nèbhu boe, te mèda oe èle kèna, aa lod'o rea kèna. de be'a risi èdhi ae eele ka nèti bhabhelu-katub'a èdhi. j'ara ne, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhabhelu, te rèngu pangee, na, abhu boe dhu ladhe rèdhi tatao rèngu sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i j'aj'i ku sama sèmi sordad'u dhu bori mema mèdha-papake pamusu, ho pa'èra ngi'u sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
target_text: èdhi hud'i mamuri mola ku, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa rèdhi, na, èdhi dhu tao j'ara be'a. be'a boe ladhe èdhi mamuri dhoka ètu d'ara tao pesta, dènge tinu mahu di. be'a boe ladhe èdhi tao j'ara makae. be'a boe ladhe bau lii langu g'ana-kariu. aa be'a boe ladhe èdhi tèka d'ara, lula èdhi d'èi boe dhèu risi èdhi.

source_text: but put ye on the lord jesus christ, and make not provision for the lusts of flesh.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi ka, miu ub'a d'ara miu, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai. aa ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue j'ara dhu lèke boe, na, taha d'ara mu! mage soro tèke ho madhutu dad'èi mu dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa parcaya na èra mèka, aa j'ara ae ka dhu ne'a mèka. pakabhèle ai èu ho sèmi more ne dènge d'ara kateme. baku sisu ngaa dhu na peka-padhai. hud'i laa nèngu pa'angalai dènge miu.

source_text: for one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu pangee na, dhèu sarani bisa ra'a ngaa sa, nuka sèmi sisi, do ngaa èèna ka. te ngaa abhu dhèu sarani leo, dhu parcaya ra èra mèka, dhu ra'a dhoka sayur di. te ra luri sisi.

source_text: let not him that eateth, despise him that eateth not; and let not him who eateth not, judge him that eateth: for god hath received him.
target_text: te ngaa nanene, ee! dhèu sarani dhu bisa ra'a ngaa èèna ka, baku pahahe dhèu dhu neo boe ra'a sisi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu sarani dhu neo boe ra'a sisi, baku peka dènge dhèu dhu bisa ra'a sisi, na, weh! mu'a sisi, sala! lula ama lamatua sèmi nare le dua ra ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na!

source_text: who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth: and he shall be held up: for god is able to make him stand.
target_text: ladhe èu me'a dhoka karitik a'ari mu dhèu parcaya sèra, te èu ngee na, èu ne cee? èu dènge hak ngaa, ho pèci sasala mi dhèu leo? dhèu ne ènu èu boe, si! aa èu ne, lamatua boe nèngu, si. te dhodhoka lamatua nèngu di dhu unu hak, sèna ka peka paled'a, tatao na èèna lèke, do sala. te ngaa baku bhèlu, bèli-camèd'a lamatua na sèmi nare dhèu ne'e dènge be'a, lula lamatua na bisa pa'èra ne, sèna ka na bisa titu èra.

source_text: one man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu pama'ète rare, peka na, lod'o èci be'a risi nèti lod'o leo. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu peka na, lod'o aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, lod'o èci sa risi boe nèti lod'o leo. dhèu èci-èci ka pama'ète unu na j'ara ne'e.

source_text: he that regardeth the day, regardeth it to the lord: and he that regardeth not the day, to the lord he doth not regard it. he that eateth, eateth to the lord, for he giveth god thanks; and he that eateth not, to the lord he eateth not, and giveth god thanks.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pangee, na, abhu lod'o dhu be'a risi nèti lod'o leo, nèngu tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. dhèu dhu na'a sisi dènge nganga'a dhu leo, bisa na'a ho pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu na'a boe sisi. nèngu neo pakab'ua kahèi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèngu manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
target_text: lod'o èdhi mamuri, èdhi mamuri boe dhoka hia ngi'u èdhi mesa ti. aa ladhe èdhi madhe, madhe boe dhoka pala ngi'u mesa ti.

source_text: for whether we live, we live to the lord; and whether we die, we die to the lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the lord's.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi mamuri era, èdhi pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi madhe, èdhi pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de masi ka èdhi mamuri, do madhe, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na era.

source_text: for to this end christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be lord both of the dead and the living.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, kristus madhe, hèia mamuri hari. na tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa j'aj'i kètu bagi mi dhèu dhu madhe le, dènge dhèu dhu mamuri era kahèi.

source_text: but why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at naught thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment-seat of christ.
target_text: de, nga tao ka èu ded'e iisi mu, tao sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu, ho karitik leli lii padhai a'ari mu dhèu sarani? nga tao ka èu pahahe ne? te bèli-camèd'a èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti hud'i lati asa madha ama lamatua, ho na parisa mamuri èdhi èci-èci.

source_text: for it is written, as i live, saith the lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to god.
target_text: abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ama èdhi mesa na dhu peka, na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pe patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi ja'a, dènge pakab'ua ja'a. bèli-camèd'a, nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu èci-èci, ra mangaku, na, ja'a j'aj'i kètu rèngu, lula ja'a ne, ama lamatua. '

source_text: so then every one of us shall give account of himself to god.
target_text: de èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, bèli-camèd'a hud'i dhaa ètu madha lamatua, ho peka na, èdhi tao tasamia, aa nga tao ka èdhi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling-block, or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
target_text: uru èèna, miu ètu roma pèci sasala taruu mi a'ari miu dhèu sarani sèra. tao ia ka sèmi èèna! be'a risi èdhi pama'ète sèmi ne'e: èdhi baku tao sèna ka a'ari èdhi kadhunu. èdhi baku tenge j'ara ho sii pamanahu si, sèna ka ra tao sasala.

source_text: i know, and am persuaded by the lord jesus, that there is nothing unclean by itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ja'a ke'a mèu, sèmi ne'e: abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu bisa pakaj'alu dhèu, toke na bisa boe sabaj'a mi lamatua. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu èci dhu pangee, na, mèdha èci tao ne kaj'alu, toke nèngu ngee na, bisa heka dènge hak sèna ka sabaj'a, na, hud'i laa mèdha ne j'aj'i mèdha luri hia nèngu.

source_text: but if thy brother is grieved with thy food, now walkest thou not charitably. destroy not him with thy food, for whom christ died.
target_text: conto sèmi èu mu'a sisi, aa papèd'a d'ara a'ari mu, na, èu pad'elo boe sasue èu mi nèngu, si? ladhe sèmi èèna, baku mu'a! baku pa'ele iie a'ari mu, lula èu neo mu'a nganga'a èci! te kristus madhe pala mi dhèu ne'e kahèi.

source_text: let not then your good be evil spoken of:
target_text: be'a boe ladhe èu ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu a'abhu èu, be'a, te ngaa dhèu leo padhai kakoli kolongara èu, lula ra pangee na, tatao èu deo na, karehe.

source_text: for the kingdom of god is not food and drink, but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the holy spirit.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! te ama lamatua ka, dhèu aae èdhi. te ngaa èdhi j'aj'i boe dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, lula èdhi ta'a-tinu madhutu dhoka atora di. aad'o! ladhe èdhi neo j'aj'i dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, èdhi hud'i tao dhu lèke, d'ara mola-mèci, mamuri mola dènge mera-milu, aa d'ara dhu karej'e-karae. aa'i-aa'i se bisa j'aj'i, ladhe èdhi pa'èki taruu dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for he that in these things serveth christ, is acceptable to god, and approved by men.
target_text: dhèu dhu lalau-lalo'o hia kristus sèmi èèna, pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua. aa dhèu leo lee kahèi mamuri dhèu ne'e, hèia padedha kolongara dhèu ne'e, peka na, nèngu ne, be'a!

source_text: let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things with which one may edify another.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i pa'èra ètu d'ara mamuri padame, aa maj'èni pa'èra èci dènge èci.

source_text: for the sake of food, destroy not the work of god. all things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offense.
target_text: baku pa'ele iie sasab'a lamatua ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu leo, lula dhoka nèti j'ara ta'a-tinu di. lamatua dhu peka le, èdhi bisa ta'a ngaa èèna ka, te aa'i-aa'i dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa ladhe èu patao-palaha dènge a'ari mu lula j'ara nganga'a-nganginu di, èu sala le. baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: it is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing by which thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
target_text: hua iia taha iisi mu. mu'a ia ka sisi, do minu ia ka èi anggor, do baku mu'a-minu ngaa dhu leo, dhu tao a'ari mu kadhunu.

source_text: hast thou faith? have it to thyself before god. happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe èu more lii èci dènge lamatua, hèia èu pama'ète, na, èu neo parcaya ne lula-nèti nganga'a-nganginu, na, èu oto aa dènge heka lii langu. pangee ia ka ngaa-ngaa dhu peka na, èu tao sala, do aad'o. te èu dhu pama'ète more le sèmi èèna.

source_text: and he that doubteth is damned if he eateth, because he eateth not from faith: for whatever is not from faith is sin.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe d'ara èu kajari, ka mu'a mèdha èci dhu èu ngee na pakaj'alu èu, lamatua pasala èu, lula èu madhutu boe ngaa dhu èu parcaya lod'o dhu èu mu'a. te ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue ngaa sa èci, te ngaa èu parcaya, peka na, èèna lèke boe ètu madha lamatua, na, èèna èu sala le.

source_text: we then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
target_text: èdhi dhu parcaya èra, hud'i dènge d'ara maho'o ho bara dhèu dhu parcaya èra mèka, sèna ka rèngu taha ètu d'ara sasusa. be'a boe, ladhe èdhi dhoka pakarej'e ngi'u èdhi mesa ti.

source_text: let every one of us please his neighbor for his good to edification.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a hud'i sèmi ne'e ku: èdhi èci-èci ka tenge j'ara, sèna ka tao dhu be'a hia a'ari èdhi dhèu sarani, ho parcaya ra asa tabha èra. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa karej'e dènge èdhi.

source_text: for even christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, the reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
target_text: te yesus kristus mesa na, pakako boe sasab'a na ho pakarej'e d'ara nèngu unu na, te ngaa na neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua kahèi. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua lula-nèti ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi dedha yesus, dhu peka na, lii pa-aape rèngu hia mi èu, noto mi dedha ja'a kahèi.

source_text: for whatever things were written formerly, were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna dhèu suri ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, sèna ka nori èdhi. nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka asa pa'èra èdhi, taha pa'èra-èra, aa lii holo-nori na pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, èdhi bisa taha ètu d'ara tatae neo tèdhi lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: now the god of patience and consolation grant you to be like-minded one towards another according to christ jesus:
target_text: lamatua ka dhu hia dhèu a'èra, sèna ka ra bisa taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi lamatua pad'elo j'ara, ho miu mamuri d'ara èci madhutu dad'èi yesus kristus.

source_text: that ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify god, even the father of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: te ladhe miu mamuri d'ara èci, miu bisa sama-sama koa-kio ama lamatua. nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: wherefore receive ye one another, as christ also received us to the glory of god.
target_text: de miu isi-aanga mi hud'i sèmi mere èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sèmi nare le miu. te ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, pe dhèu ae j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: now i say that jesus christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of god, to confirm the promises made to the fathers:
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha, sèna ka hia dhèu yahudi re'a mèu, peka na, ama lamatua padhai lii lèke mola-mola. aa kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha kahèi, ho pamèci aa'i mèu ngaa-ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha neo tao, hia mi bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: and that the gentiles might glorify god for his mercy; as it is written, for this cause i will confess to thee among the gentiles, and sing to thy name.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i koa-kio ama lamatua. te rèngu re'a, na, nèngu dhu rasa kasia mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. sèra nuka sèmi dhu daud suri uru èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, mi suku dhu leo sèra. ja'a neo sod'a lii koa-kio kolongara èu ètu katanga madha udhu rasa dhu leo sèra.

source_text: and again he saith, rejoice, ye gentiles, with his people.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri kahèi, na, we! miu dhèu leo rai kara dhu nèti rai leo. tao d'ara miu karej'e kea rae-rae, palere-lere dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and again, praise the lord, all ye gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, daud suri, peka na, miu dhu nèti suku leo sèra. lami peka palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti dadedha lamatua, sèna ka rèngu koa-kio kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: and again isaiah saith, there shall be a root of jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the gentiles; in him shall the gentiles trust.
target_text: ètu era leo hari, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, yesaya suri, peka na, nèti dhèu aae daud, ana isai, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai ana-èpu na ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha mi suku leo sèra. rèngu dhu re'a le, naneo mamai nèngu èèna. hèia rèngu mate tatae ne, te rèngu re'a mèu, na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: now the god of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the holy spirit.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi sanao-maena. ladhe miu parcaya ne, nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara miu aa pamau d'ara miu. hud'i laa sèna ka koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, tao miu asa me'a mèu lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao.

source_text: and i myself also am persuaded concerning you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, d'ara miu pènu dènge madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu be'a, j'ara ae-ae dhu miu me'a mèu le, aa me'a holo èci dènge èci.

source_text: nevertheless, brethren, i have written the more boldly to you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me from god.
target_text: ja'a suri paled'a-led'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, ho pasanèd'e miu catèka hari nèti rupa-rupa madha j'ara. ja'a suri sèmi ne'e, lula lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a,

source_text: that i should be the minister of jesus christ to the gentiles, ministering the gospel of god, that the offering up of the gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèngu asa dhèu yahudi boe sèra. ja'a pakako sasab'a ja'a èèna, nuka sèmi ama agama èci dhu neo pa'èra dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i mi persembahan èci dhu pamaho'o d'ara lamatua. te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu tao si j'aj'i mola-mèci, sèna ka ama lamatua sèmi nare si.

source_text: i have therefore cause for glorying through jesus christ, in those things which pertain to god.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa boti kètu ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: for i will not dare to speak of any of those things which christ hath not wrought by me, to make the gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
target_text: ja'a bani boe padhai lii j'ara leo. ja'a dhoka lole tatao dhu kristus ad'u-ue, aa dènge j'ara sèmi ngaa na pake ja'a. limuri ne, abhu dhèu yahudi boe dhu madhutu kristus, lula lamatua pake ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara pake lii padhai dènge tatao ja'a.

source_text: through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the spirit of god; so that from jerusalem, and around to illyricum, i have fully preached the gospel of christ.
target_text: kristus pangèd'u le mi ja'a koasa nèti roh lamatua, sèna ka bisa tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. na pangèd'u koasa èèna mi ja'a, sèna ka neo pad'elo, peka na, kristus ne cee. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a peka-padhai le aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti lii lolo be'a kristus dènge dhèu ètu mia-mia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a lole nèti kota yerusalem, pale-lème toke d'ai rai ilirikum dètu dènge italia.

source_text: and so have i strived to preach the gospel, not where christ was named, lest i should build upon another man's foundation:
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a dhu pangee, na, ja'a d'èi titu kèna lole lula-nèti kristus mi dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lii lolo be'a na! te ja'a d'èi boe aj'a-nori ètu era dhu dhèu leo aj'a le.

source_text: but as it is written, they shall see to whom he was not spoken of: and they that have not heard shall understand.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, suku dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lula lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi ne. dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka ngaa-ngaa, rèngu sèra ka dhu pe re'a mèu lula nèngu.

source_text: for which cause also i have been much hindered from coming to you.
target_text: lula sasab'a ja'a ae sèmi èèna, ka lake kore mèka dhiu pa'asu-pareo dènge miu.

source_text: but now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come to you;
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, sasab'a ja'a ètu ne'e èla aa'i le. aa ja'a nelu nèbhu ae le pèri-pèri tèu kèna, dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: whenever i take my journey into spain, i will come to you: for i trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first i shall be somewhat filled with your company.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a laku asa spanyol, ja'a neo dhuli miu. aa ladhe ja'a dhuli taha ètu era miu, miu bisa ogo ja'a kahèi laku asa spanyol.

source_text: but now i go to jerusalem to minister to the saints.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo laku uru asa yerusalem, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu parcaya lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: for it hath pleased them of macedonia and achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor of the saints who are at jerusalem.
target_text: te a'ari èdhi ètu propensi makedonia dènge propensi akaya, hia le doi kolete, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa dhu parcaya lamatua ètu yerusalem.

source_text: it hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. for if the gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister to them in carnal things.
target_text: rèngu neo tao sèmi ne'e, lula ra pangee, na, rèngu oe sèmi pakèlu sa, mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem. te dhèu-dhèu nèti suku leo ètu mia-mia, rèngu abhu le j'ara hua iia kahèi dhu uru èèna roh lamatua hia le mi dhèu yahudi sèra. de lèke mola-mola ladhe dhèu sarani dhu dhèu yahudi boe, pake mèdha-panyau ra ho soru-bara a'ari ra dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: when therefore i have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, i will go by you into spain.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pabagi kore ka doi se'e mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem, ja'a neo dhuli pangad'o dènge miu, ropa laku asa spanyol.

source_text: and i am sure that when i come to you, i shall come in the fullness of the blessing of the gospel of christ.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu, kèti dènge mèngi-nale ae-ae nèti kristus.

source_text: now i beseech you, brethren, for the lord jesus christ's sake, and for the love of the spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to god for me;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lula yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, aa lula roh lamatua ka tao miu pasue èci dènge èci, nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi ho miu sabaj'a patare'a-re'a, sèna ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: that i may be delivered from them in judea who do not believe; and that my service which i have for jerusalem, may be acceptable to the saints;
target_text: manèngi sèna ka lamatua bhiri-sarobho ja'a ètu propensi yudea, ho dhèu dhu ro'o boe parcaya lamatua baku tao bhelu mi dedha ja'a. aa manèngi ho ladhe ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani ètu yerusalem, rèngu sèmi rare ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: that i may come to you with joy by the will of god, and may with you be refreshed.
target_text: èle èèna, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, ja'a bisa dhiu asa miu dènge d'ara karej'e, lula ja'a neo ae kore ciki dènge miu.

source_text: now the god of peace be with you all. amen.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu. te nèngu ka dhu bisa tao ho dhèu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. lèke tare'a!

source_text: i commend to you phebe our sister, who is a servant of the church which is at cenchrea:
target_text: dènge sasuri ne'e, ja'a neo patadha miu dènge ana hèni èdhi febe, aa manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne. nèngu ka dhu ra ded'e ho ladhe-leru juma'at ètu kota kengkrea.

source_text: that ye receive her in the lord, as it becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succorer of many, and of myself also.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a. tao dhu pantas mi nèngu, nuka sèmi hia dhèu sarani sèra, lula nèngu ne pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ladhe na parluu ngaa, soru-bara ne. te nèngu biasa soru-bara le ja'a dènge dhèu ae-ae, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: greet priscilla and aquila my helpers in christ jesus:
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, priskila dènge dhèu èmu na, akila. ji'i ka dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ae-ae nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: who have for my life laid down their own necks: to whom not only i give thanks, but also all the churches of the gentiles.
target_text: dua ra oe madhe sad'i neo pamamuri ja'a. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di dhu manèngi makasi mi dua ra. te dhèu yahudi boe dhu j'aj'i le dhèu sarani, nèti juma'at aa'i-aa'i buli mia-mia, manèngi makasi kahèi, lula tatao ra dhu be'a.

source_text: likewise greet the church that is in their house. salute my well-beloved epenetus, who is the first-fruits of achaia to christ.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara èmu priskila dènge akila. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi angalai ja'a, epenetus. nèngu ka, dhèu uru tèka parcaya kristus ètu propensi asia.

source_text: greet mary, who bestowed much labor on us.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, maria. nèngu dhu sab'a ne'a boe j'èra ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: salute andronicus and junia my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in christ before me.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi andronikus dènge ana hèni èdhi, yunia. dua ra dhèu yahudi, sama sèmi ja'a kahèi. dua ra parcaya uuru kristus nèti ja'a. uru èèna, rèngu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho. dua ra j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, aa dhèu ae tadhe si.

source_text: greet amplias my beloved in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ampliatus. ja'a sue ne, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: salute urbane, our helper in christ, and stachys my beloved.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi urbanus. nèngu kahèi pakako sasab'a kristus sama-sama dènge èdhi. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi stakis, dhu ja'a sue.

source_text: salute apelles approved in christ. salute them who are of aristobulus' household.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi apeles. masi ka nèngu lèke dadugu-rariu, te ngaa na segi ka nare li'u, lula lèka èra kristus. hia lii maho'o mi a'ari aa'i-aa'i nèti aristobulus.

source_text: salute herodion my kinsman. greet them that are of the household of narcissus, who are in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi a'a herodion. nèngu dhèu yahudi kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi isi èmu narkisus dhu parcaya kristus.

source_text: salute tryphena and tryphosa, who labor in the lord. salute the beloved persis, who labored much in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi ana hèni èdhi, trifena dènge trifosa. rèngu pakako kahèi sasab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. hia lii maho'o mi angalai ja'a, ana hèni èdhi, persis. te nèngu kahèi sab'a bia hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: salute rufus chosen in the lord, and his mother and mine.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi rufus. kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu hag'e nare ne. hia lii maho'o mi ina na kahèi. te nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ina d'èlu ja'a.

source_text: salute asyncritus, phlegon, hermas, patrobas, hermes, and the brethren who are with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi asinkritus, flegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas dènge a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge rèngu.

source_text: salute philologus, and julia, nereus, and his sister, and olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi filologus, ana hèni èdhi, yulia, olimpas, nereus dènge ana hèni na, dènge dhèu-dhèu sarani aa'i dhu sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: salute one another with a holy kiss. the churches of christ salute you.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, mi pa'uu èci dènge èci, dhu pantas mi dhèu parcaya. juma'at kristus aa'i-aa'i ètu se'e, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi.

source_text: now i beseech you, brethren, mark them who cause divisions and offenses, contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mage-mage! j'aga paie-iie, te abhu dhèu dhu tao miu mae-manyèla, aa dhu neo sii pabèbhe miu. ngaa dhu rèngu peka dènge miu sèra, palab'a dènge ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a-nori le miu. de baku pa'angalai dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: for they that are such serve not our lord jesus christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
target_text: dhèu sèra sab'a boe hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. rèngu sèra dhoka sab'a ho pa'oto ngi'u rèngu unu ra. dhèu sèra dhoka hèb'a mènyi mi dhèu dhu dhae re'a mèka mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe. rèngu hèb'a mènyi ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu.

source_text: for your obedience is come abroad to all men. i am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet i would have you wise to that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le, na, miu loe boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna lula miu. dad'èi ja'a ka, ladhe miu d'èlu-mèu ètu j'ara-j'ara be'a, aa baku pakihu kee dènge j'ara-j'ara karehe.

source_text: and the god of peace will soon bruise satan under your feet. the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you. amen.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu bisa hia èdhi mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. nèngu ka dhu èèna na palaho koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, aa pad'elo, peka na, miu ka dhu segi. se'e se nèbhu heka j'aj'i. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: timothy my work-fellow, and lucius, and jason, and sosipater my kinsmen, salute you.
target_text: ari èdhi, timotius, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ja'a, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi. lukius, yason, dènge sosipater, hia lii maho'o kahèi. rèngu se dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a.

source_text: i tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the lord.
target_text: ja'a ne, tertius, ka dhu suri sasuri ne'e madhutu ngaa dhu paulus pua ja'a suri. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, te ja'a ne dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and quartus a brother.
target_text: ja'a, paulus, manubha ètu èmu gayus. dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i tema pakaboko ètu èmu na ho manèngi-mangaj'i. nèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi. erastus, dhu j'aj'i bendahara kota, dènge a'ari èdhi kuartus, hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you all. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi, sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi! lèke tare'a!

source_text: now to him that is able to establish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of jesus christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which hath been kept secret since the world began,
target_text: koa-kio mi ama lamatua! te nèngu ka dhu unu koasa, sèna ka tao miu j'aj'i èra. lii lolo be'a na peka sèmi èèna ka, aa ja'a aj'a-nori dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi, ropa ja'a peka dènge rèngu lula-nèti yesus kristus. lamatua ka dhu bhoke paled'a hia mi èdhi j'ara aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti kristus, dhu uru-uru sèra dhèu dhae re'a mèka, lula dhu pahuni era.

source_text: but now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting god, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
target_text: te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu uru sèra dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci, limuri ne mèu aadha-aadha le. ama lamatua dhu madhe nèdhi boe, nèngu ka ator sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, re'a mèu madha j'ara dhu pahuni uru sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu sèra bisa parcaya ne, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: to god the only wise, be glory through jesus christ for ever. amen.
target_text: dhodhoka nèngu mesa-mesa na di, ama lamatua. dhodhoka nèngu mesa-mesa na, dhu ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara. ja'a d'èi j'oka padedha-dedha ne, lula tatao yesus kristus! lèke tare'a! sasuri ja'a d'ai sange ne'e ka, saloom, paulus

source_text: paul, called to be an apostle of jesus christ through the will of god, and sosthenes our brother,
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua hag'e nare le ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. sostenes hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: to the church of god which is at corinth, to them that are sanctified in christ jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of jesus christ our lord, both theirs and ours.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu dhèu parcaya ama lamatua ètu kota korintus. na hag'e nare le miu ho j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci nèngu, lula miu parcaya le yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema le karèi nèti uru ka ho na mai. ama lamatua tao miu mola-mèci kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. te rèngu manèngi le sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus soru-bara si. nèngu ne j'aj'i kètu mi dedha èdhi aa rèngu kahèi.

source_text: grace be to you, and peace from god our father, and from the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i thank my god always on your behalf, for the grace of god which is given you by jesus christ;
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a ngee kèdhi miu, ja'a padhai lii dènge lamatua ja'a, peka na, makasi ae-ae lula parcaya dhèu korintus sèra! te lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu, lula miu lèka taruu yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua na mai.

source_text: that in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
target_text: hèia na hia miu a'èra, ka miu bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a aa'i-aa'i, lula miu pa'èki dènge ne. èèna ka dhu tao d'ara miu kaja-su'i dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka miu me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu hua iia risi, lula-nèti j'ara mamuri nèngu. miu me'a kahèi j'ara mia dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu lole mi dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: even as the testimony of christ was confirmed in you:
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i ne'e ka dhu padelo, na, j'ara-j'ara dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu lula-nèti kristus èèna, dhu amo le ètu d'ara miu. nèti èèna ka, miu me'a tare'a-re'a, na, j'ara sèra lèke.

source_text: so that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our lord jesus christ:
target_text: de miu abhu le j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu roh lamatua pala-bagi hia dhèu unu na. kura boe ciki sa. hèia miu tatae lod'o dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua bhoke ho pad'elo kètu èdhi, yesus kristus mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: who will also confirm you to the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: kristus èèna ka dhu neo pa'èra miu sèna ka miu taha taruu, toke na mai hari asa rai-haha ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu manahu boe, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pèci sasala mi dedha miu.

source_text: god is faithful, by whom ye were called to the fellowship of his son jesus christ our lord.
target_text: èdhi bisa parcaya lii holo-nori ama lamatua, lula ngaa dhu nèngu peka, èèna ka dhu j'aj'i. tatu nèngu neo tao j'ara se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa tadhe ana na, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus èèna.

source_text: now i beseech you, brethren, by the name of our lord jesus christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind, and in the same judgment.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ètu d'ara aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a padhai lii pake kolongara kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de ja'a manèngi tare'a-re'a, sèna ka miu loe ka nèti padhèto ètu d'ara lii padhai. te ngaa miu hud'i tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci, aa baku mae-manyèla. miu hud'i pake ngangee madhera, ho me'a, na, miu neo d'ai too-lane dhu èci èèna ka di.

source_text: for it hath been declared to me concerning you, my brethren, by them who are of the house of chloe, that there are contentions among you.
target_text: te abhu dhèu nèti isi èmu ana hèni èdhi kloe dhu mai peka dènge ja'a, na, ètu talora miu abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: now this i say, that every one of you saith, i am of paul; and i of apollos; and i of cephas; and i of christ.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a re paulus! aa cahag'e peka na, ja'a re apolos! aa abhu kahèi dhu paka'uu, na, ja'a re petrus! aa dhu leo hari peka na, ja'a ne, nanene dhoka kristus di!

source_text: is christ divided? was paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of paul?
target_text: miu pangee tasamia, ee? dhèu unu kristus bisa boe mae-manyèla. do, miu pangee, na, ja'a ka dhu madhe pala miu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha? aad'o! do, lod'o ra sarani miu, rèngu pake ngara ja'a, ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, do? bisa boe, si?

source_text: i thank god that i baptized none of you, but crispus and gaius;
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, te lod'o ja'a ètu èèna dènge miu, ja'a sarani boe dhèu ae. dhu ja'a sarani ètu nèi dhoka krispus dènge gayus di.

source_text: lest any should say that i had baptized in my own name.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa peka na, ra sarani ja'a pake ngara paulus, ka ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu paulus.

source_text: and i baptized also the household of stephanas; besides, i know not whether i baptized any other.
target_text: ee, ja'a heka sanèd'e kèna. ja'a sarani isi èmu stefanus cahag'e kahèi. te ngaa ja'a sanèd'e heka, abhu dhèu era dhu ja'a sarani, do aad'o.

source_text: for christ hath not sent me to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of christ should be made of no effect.
target_text: te kristus pua boe ja'a ho laku sarani dhèu. kapua sasab'a ja'a, nuka peka-padhai dènge j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a lole mi dhèu, nèngu d'èi boe ja'a peka mamèu ja'a, do, pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii sèmi èèna, èèna pakura koasa nèti lii lolo mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: for the preaching of the cross is to them that perish, foolishness; but to us who are saved, it is the power of god.
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi peka-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, goa titu kèna. te ngaa dhèu sèmi sèra, bèli-camèd'a cèri eele nèti ama lamatua. aa te ngaa, bagi mi èdhi, mamadhe kristus ne, sèna ka pad'elo koasa lamatua ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: for it is written, i will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
target_text: j'ara ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na, ama lamatua peka na, ‘madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu re'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pa'ele iie aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua. rupa-rupa mamèu rèngu, bèli-camèd'a ja'a core eele aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu guna boe. '

source_text: where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not god made foolish the wisdom of this world?
target_text: uru èèna, mema lamatua padhai lii sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, tasamia hari? dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra, sèmi ngaa sa? mese agama sèra, j'aj'i sèmi ngaa? aa tuka tao lii langu sèra, tasa mera mia? miu nanene sèku! lamatua tao si nuka sèmi dhèu goa! nèngu bete eele aa'i le mamèu dhu amo ètu d'ara kahadhu dhèu rai-haha ne, aa tao mamèu sèra nuka sèmi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: for when in the wisdom of god the world by wisdom knew not god, it pleased god by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe. for the jews require a sign, and the greeks seek wisdom:
