target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne asa a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi galati. a'ari dhu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu ne'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ja'a pasanèd'e miu, na, ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a. nèti boe dhèu rai-haha ne. yesus kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai le. kristus madhe, te ngaa lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia ra pua-paleha ja'a, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge dhèu-dhèu.

source_text: grace be to you and peace from god the father, and from our lord jesus christ,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, aa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi ho rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, sèna ka miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of god and our father:
target_text: kristus madhe, sèna ka saku eele aa'i sasala èdhi aa pakaj'èu èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rai-haha ne. aa'i-aa'i dhu kristus ad'u-ue sèra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: to whom be glory for ever and ever. amen.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i koa-kio ne taruu! dhu lèke kèna!

source_text: i marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of christ, to another gospel:
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a heka tao miu sa mia! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na neo ho miu me'a d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa tasamia ka miu malai titu kèna lami madhutu lii lolo leo

source_text: which is not another; but there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of christ.
target_text: dhu lèke boe? uuru èèna, ja'a aj'a le dhu mola-mola lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra mai pakapod'e lii lolo be'a èèna, toke miu malaa-maloha.

source_text: but though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach any other gospel to you than that which we have preached to you, let him be accursed.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a lamatua huku dhèu dhu aj'a lii lolo be'a dhu sama boe dènge dhu ji'i aj'a-nori uru èèna. masi ka dhèu nèti ji'i do, ana pajuu nèti sorga do, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: as we said before, so i say now again, if any man preacheth any other gospel to you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
target_text: ji'i dhu peka le karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo hari pasanèd'e sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu aj'a leo nèti lii lolo be'a dhu miu abhu le uru èèna, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: for do i now persuade men, or god? or do i seek to please men? for if i yet pleased men, i should not be the servant of christ.
target_text: ja'a bani peka sèmi èèna, lula ja'a neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, neo boe pakarej'e dhèu rai-haha ne. miu ngee, na, ja'a tenge kolongara nèti dhèu rai-haha, do? aad'o! te ladhe ja'a tao sèmi èèna, ja'a pantas boe j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèti kristus.

source_text: but i certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached by me is not according to man.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka paled'a dènge miu, na, lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a aj'a-nori miu, nèti boe tatao dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for i neither received it from man, neither was i taught it, but by the revelation of jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a abhu boe nèti dhèu rai-haha, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu aj'a-nori ja'a. te yesus kristus mesa na ka dhu bhoke sasoa na mi ja'a.

source_text: for ye have heard of my manner of life in time past in the jews' religion, that beyond measure i persecuted the church of god, and wasted it;
target_text: tatu miu tadèngi le lii lolo nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a, lod'o ja'a madhutu agama yahudi era, si? lod'o èèna, ja'a paj'èra titu kèna dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua, aa neo pa'ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: and profited in the jews' religion above many my equals in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
target_text: aa lod'o èèna kahèi, d'ara ja'a neo titu kèna aj'a j'ara-j'ara agama yahudi, risi nèti dhèu yahudi dhu leo dhu ca dadena dènge ja'a. aa ja'a ne maj'èni risi pakako ad'a bèi-baki èdhi dènge atora agama aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but when it pleased god, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace, to reveal his son in me, that i might preach him among the heathen; immediately i conferred not with flesh and blood:
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le ho patadhe ana na mi ja'a. ina ku dhae nara iisi mèka ja'a, te nèngu dhu hag'e mema le ja'a, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèngu kahèi pua ja'a ho laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lod'o na pua ja'a èèna, laku boe manèngi a'abhu nèti dhèu leo.

source_text: neither did i go to jerusalem to them who were apostles before me: but i went into arabia, and returned again to damascus.
target_text: aa laku boe paraga dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka kristen dhu j'aj'i mema le dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus ètu kota yerusalem. te ngaa laku dènge ka asa rai arab. èle ka, ja'a lèpa hari asa kota damsik.

source_text: then after three years i went to jerusalem to see peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
target_text: hèia lalu eele tèlu tèu ku, heka laku paraga dènge petrus ètu yerusalem, ho pakarèi j'ara-j'ara nèti nèngu. ka ja'a manubha taha canguru lèmi lod'o ètu nèi.

source_text: but i saw no other of the apostles, save james the lord's brother.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a paraga kahèi dènge yakobis, ari d'èlu lamatua yesus. te ngaa ja'a paraga boe dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra. dhoka dua ra di.

source_text: now the things which i write to you, behold, before god, i lie not.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a suri ne, mema tare'a sèmi èèna! ja'a kapod'e boe! lamatua ne'a aa'i!

source_text: afterwards i came into the regions of syria and cilicia;
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ja'a laku asa propensi siria dènge propensi kilikia.

source_text: and was unknown by face to the churches of judea which were in christ:
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu-dhèu unu kristus ètu propensi yudea, dhae tadhe mèka ja'a.

source_text: but they had heard only, that he who persecuted us in times past, now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
target_text: dhèu se'e dhoka tadèngi lii palolo, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu uru èèna paj'èra èdhi, limuri ne nuka aj'a lii lolo be'a kristus. nèngu ka dhu uru èèna, neo pa'ele iie aa'i èdhi.

source_text: and they glorified god in me.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio ama lamatua, lula ja'a parcaya le yesus kristus.

source_text: then fourteen years after i went again to jerusalem with barnabas, and took titus with me also.
target_text: d'ai èle canguru èpa tèu, hèia ja'a lèpa asa kota yerusalem sama-sama dènge barnabas. aa ji'i ngèti dènge titus, ca dhèu parcaya dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and i went by revelation, and communicated to them that gospel which i preach among the gentiles, but privately to them who were of reputation, lest by any means i should run, or had run in vain.
target_text: ja'a laku asa nèi, lula lii paredha ama lamatua. d'ai nèi, ka ja'a lole mi dhèu heka-dhèu heka kristen, lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le mi dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lod'o èèna, ja'a peka unu ku mi rèngu se, ho ra parisa pabe'a-be'a ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a le sèra, lèke do aad'o. te ladhe ra pama'ète, peka na, a'aj'a ja'a èèna sala, na, dhèu bisa ngee, na, ja'a sab'a iia d'ara di!

source_text: but neither titus, who was with me, being a greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
target_text: ropa dhèu se'e tadèngi rare lii ja'a sèmi èèna, hèia ra sèmi rare dènge be'a. aa ra d'èi sèmi rare titus dènge be'a kahèi. masi ka titus dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa ra laka-seti boe sèna ka na suna.

source_text: and that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privately to spy out our liberty which we have in christ jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu a'ari dhèu pèri dhu d'èi boe a'aj'a ja'a, lula rèngu se aj'a dhu leo. rèngu se, dhèu kristen kapod'e-kabèli. ka rèngu mau-mau mai laka-seti dhèu unu kristus sèra dhu dhèu yahudi boe, ho madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi. te ngaa, lula yesus kristus patalale eele le èdhi, nèti èèna ka atora sèra èki heka èdhi, sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: to whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
target_text: masi ka ra laka-seti sèmi èèna, te ngaa ciki sa ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi ngare. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa parcaya taruu lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a nori le. te dhu mola-mola na kèna!

source_text: but of these, who seemed to be somewhat, whatever they were, it maketh no matter to me: god accepteth no man's person: for they who seemed to be somewhat, in conference added nothing to me:
target_text: dhèu heka-dhèu heka se sèmi rare lii a'aj'a ja'a ne, aa ra patabha heka ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ama lamatua hag'e boe dhèu. de masi ka rèngu dhèu kapai do ana iiki, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: but on the contrary, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed to me, as the gospel of the circumcision was to peter;
target_text: te dhu lèke, nuka: rèngu re'a, na, ama lamatua pili nare le ja'a, ho kèti lii lolo be'a mi dhèu-dhèu yahudi boe. nuka sèmi dhu na paredha mi petrus kahèi, sèna ka nèti lii lolo be'a asa dhèu yahudi.

source_text: for he that wrought effectually in peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me towards the gentiles:
target_text: te ama lamatua pangèd'u koasa mi petrus ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha mi dhèu yahudi. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia ja'a koasa sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha mi dhèu-dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and when james, cephas, and john, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given to me, they gave to me and barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go to the heathen, and they to the circumcision.
target_text: lod'o èèna, madhutu ngangee dhèu sèra, yakobis, petrus, dènge yohanis, dhu j'aj'i le ama-ama gareja. ropa rèngu tèlu ra re'a, na, ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, hèia ra kèd'i paj'ola ai dènge ja'a, aa dènge barnabas, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ara èci le. rèngu ro'o kahèi, ji'i ngèti lii lolo be'a asa dhèu yahudi boe, aa rèngu rèti asa dhèu yahudi.

source_text: only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which i also was forward to do.
target_text: dhoka ca j'ara di, dhu ra pasanèd'e ji'i, nuka ji'i baku bhèlu soru-bara dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra. mema j'ara ne'e ka dhu ja'a neo tao.

source_text: but when peter had come to antioch, i withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
target_text: ka ca tèka, petrus mai asa kota antiokia. hèia ja'a kai ne patoo madha dènge madha, lula nèngu tao sala.

source_text: for before that certain came from james, he used to eat with the gentiles: but when they had come, he withdrew, and separated himself, fearing them who were of the circumcision.
target_text: lod'o na heka mai, nèngu karèj'e madhèdi na'a dènge dhèu-dhèu unu kristus dhu dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa ropa angalai yakobis dhèu yahudi sèra mai, hèia petrus mulai pakaj'èu nèti a'ari dhèu yahudi boe, ka na na'a pa'èci heka dènge rèngu. te lula na madha'u dènge a'aj'a nèti dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, dhèu unu kristus hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra atora agama yahudi aa'i-aa'i, aa hud'i pakaj'èu ku dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and the other jews dissembled likewise with him; so that barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
target_text: ropa rèdhi tatao petrus ne, ka dhèu yahudi dhu leo sèra tao madhutu kahèi. toke barnabas kahèi madhutu tatao ra dhu peka leo, tao leo.

source_text: but when i saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, i said to peter before them all, if thou, being a jew, livest after the manner of gentiles, and not as do the jews, why compellest thou the gentiles to live as do the jews?
target_text: te ngaa ropa ja'a patigi kèdhi, rèngu madhutu be'a heka dad'èi lii lolo be'a, hèia ja'a kai dènge ka petrus ètu katanga madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, eee, petrus! èu ne, mema dhèu yahudi. te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara, ho dhèu dhu parcaya yesus kristus pa'èki heka madhutu atora agama yahudi sèra. aa èu dhu sèmi more le j'ara ne'e, nga tasamia ka, èu laka-seti dhèu yahudi boe, sèna ka tao iisi ra sama sèmi dhèu yahudi?

source_text: we who are jews by nature, and not sinners of the gentiles,
target_text: ja'a kai petrus sèmi èèna, lula ji'i dua mi dhèu yahudi. suku ji'i dua mi se dhèu yahudi, sama boe dènge suku leo sèra, lula suku ji'i dhu nèbhu le tadhe ama lamatua.

source_text: knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of jesus christ, even we have believed in jesus christ, that we may be justified by the faith of christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ji'i nge'a kahèi, na, lamatua sèmi nare boe ca dhèu sa j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, lula nèngu tao madhutu atora agama dènge be'a. te ngaa lamatua sèmi nare dhèu, ladhe nèngu parcaya yesus kristus, lula boe nèti nèngu madhutu atora agama. sèmi èèna ku, heka lamatua peka na, dhèu ne dènge heka sasala-sasigo.

source_text: but if, while we seek to be justified by christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore christ the minister of sin? by no means.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i aj'a, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, lula na parcaya yesus kristus. te ngaa abhu dhèu yahudi dhu pasala ji'i. ra peka na, ji'i parcaya yesus kristus, te ngaa kèpe heka atora agama yahudi. miu neo pèci sasala sèmi èèna mi ji'i kahèi, do?

source_text: for if i build again the things which i destroyed, i make myself a transgressor.
target_text: te ladhe ja'a kèpe kore hari atora agama dhu ja'a patabuli eele le, èèna heka peka na ja'a sala kèna!

source_text: for i through the law am dead to the law, that i may live to god. i am crucified with christ: nevertheless, i live; yet not i, but christ liveth in me: and the life which i now live in the flesh, i live by the faith of the son of god, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
target_text: mema uru èèna, ja'a tenge j'ara ho madhutu dènge be'a atora agama yahudi, sèna ka ja'a pabe'a dènge lamatua. te ngaa bisa boe kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tèke eele le atora agama sèra, ho mamuri pa'èki dènge kristus. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, heka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu mola. peka sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a madhe lèke paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha sama-sama dènge kristus. de limuri ne, ja'a boe ka dhu mamuri, te ngaa kristus ka dhu mamuri ètu d'ara ngi'u ja'a. ja'a abhu mamuri dhu hiu ne, lula parcaya ana nèti lamatua. te nèngu sue ja'a titu kèna, toke na madhe gati ja'a.

source_text: i do not frustrate the grace of god: for if righteousness is attainable by the law, then christ hath died in vain.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a, lula d'ara hua iia na, lula boe nèti ja'a madhutu atora agama sèra. te ladhe dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua lula madhutu atora agama, èèna sasoa na, mamadhe kristus iia-iia d'ara di. sèra sa ka dhu ja'a peka dènge petrus si ètu antiokia.

source_text: o foolish galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes jesus christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
target_text: heh! dhèu galati sèra! uru èèna, ja'a unu ku lole dènge miu patoo madha dènge madha, lula-nèti mamadhe yesus kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa limuri ne dhèu monya miu mamadha iia-iia! miu se, goa titu kèna!

source_text: this only would i learn from you, received ye the spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
target_text: ja'a neo dhoka karèi ca j'ara di. miu sèmi mere le roh lamatua èèna, lula miu madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, si! roh na mai asa miu, lula miu lèka lii lolo be'a dhu miu nanene èèna.

source_text: are ye so foolish? having begun in the spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
target_text: de, nga tao ka miu goa sèmi èèna, ee? uru èèna, miu mamuri le madhutu dad'èi roh mola-mèci. te ngaa limuri ne, miu kabèli hari, mamuri madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it is yet in vain.
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu dhu miu parcaya kristus èèna, miu abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna. mage dhoka j'ara sèra ele iia d'ara di! te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, parcaya mi kristus ele boe iia d'ara.

source_text: he therefore that ministereth to you the spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he this by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hia roh na, aa pad'elo rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu madha miu, miu ngee, na, lamatua tao sèmi èèna, lula miu madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, si! na tao sèmi èèna, lula miu lèka lii lolo be'a dhu miu nanene èèna.

source_text: even as abraham believed god, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
target_text: sanèd'e mèdhi era sina ma, bèi-baki dhèu yahudi, nuka abraham. te sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri, peka na, lula na parcaya ama lamatua, ka lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola.

source_text: know ye therefore, that they who are of faith, the same are the children of abraham.
target_text: de miu hud'i me'a pabe'a-be'a ku j'ara ne'e! dhèu dhu parcaya sama sèmi abraham, rèngu j'aj'i mi dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and the scripture foreseeing that god would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel to abraham, saying, in thee shall all nations be blessed.
target_text: lamatua dhu peka tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, peka na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu nèti suku leo j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, ladhe ra parcaya ne. te uru èèna, na peka mema le mi abraham lii lolo be'a, na, bèli-camèd'a suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale lula èu ne.

source_text: so then they who are of faith are blessed with faithful abraham.
target_text: lula lii moa ama lamatua èèna, ka na papuru kahèi berkat mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, nuka sèmi dhu na hia mi abraham.

source_text: for as many as are of the works of the law, are under the curse: for it is written, accursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu atora agama, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, nèngu hud'i pasae nare ku babia nèti atora sèra aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi nèngu lèke le dhoo. te dhu suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, dhèu dhu madhutu boe taruu atora agama d'ai lutu, nèngu lèke le dhoo èèna!

source_text: but that no man is justified by the law in the sight of god, is evident: for, the just shall live by faith.
target_text: te ngaa te'a, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare boe ca dhèu sa, lula na madhutu atora agama. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a, heka sèmi kore ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, ho na abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: and the law is not of faith: but, the man that doeth them shall live by them.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu neo mamuri madhutu dad'èi atora agama, nèngu hud'i tao madhutu ku aa'i-aa'i toke lutu! te lamatua dhu peka mema le ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, dhèu dhu neo mamuri madhutu atora, èèna na nèngu bhute dhoka dènge atora sèra di.

source_text: christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, accursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
target_text: te ngaa kristus b'ae pama'ète le, ho patabuli èdhi nèti atora agama dhu èki èdhi. uru èèna, èdhi mamuri oe madhe, dènge pasae babia atora agama, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu lèke dhoo. te ngaa limuri ne lamatua yesus ded'e eele le babia èèna nèti èdhi. te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, ladhe dhèu madhe lèke kadhoe ètu agarii, sasoa na, nèngu madhe aapa.

source_text: that the blessing of abraham might come on the gentiles through jesus christ; that we might receive the promise of the spirit through faith.
target_text: ropa yesus kristus madhe, sèna ka pala-bagi mamuri mi èdhi, berkat èèna ka dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u mi abraham, aa hia kahèi mi suku leo. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus, bisa abhu roh ama lamatua dhu na jaji le.

source_text: brethren, i speak after the manner of men; though it is but a man's covenant, yet if it is confirmed, no man disannulleth or addeth to it.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! doe ne'e ja'a neo kore pakasame nèti mamuri èdhi bèli-mai bèli-mai. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu suri sasuri lii padhadha nèti pusaka, ka dhu ènyi le ngara na ètu sasuri ne, sasoa na, sasuri ne lèke tare'a. dhèu leo bisa boe ère eele ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, aa bisa boe suri tabha hari ngaa-ngaa asa d'ara sasuri èèna.

source_text: now to abraham and his seed were the promises made. he saith not, and to seeds, as of many; but as of one, and to thy seed, which is christ.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o ama lamatua patari lii padhadha dènge abraham, aa dènge ana-èpu na. ama lamatua peka boe, na, ja'a patari lii padhadha ne dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, lula na padhadha boe dènge dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa na padhadha dhoka dènge ana-èpu abraham ca dhèu di, nuka kristus.

source_text: and this i say, that the covenant that was confirmed before by god in christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of no effect.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ama lamatua paj'ari uru lii padhadha dènge abraham. hèia èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu ku, heka na papuru atora agama hia dhèu yahudi kèna, re baki ra musa. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, lamatua ère heka lii padhadha dhu na tao uru èèna.

source_text: for if the inheritance is by the law, it is no more by promise: but god gave it to abraham by promise.
target_text: te lamatua hia boe mèngi-nale mi abraham, lula na tao madhutu atora ne. te ngaa lamatua hia berkat lula na moa tèke le, karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia hadia mi abraham. èèna nuka sèmi ana ca dhèu abhu pusaka nèti ama na. ana ne abhu pusaka na, lula ama na dhu padhadha uru le, lula boe nèti ana ne tao madhutu atora.

source_text: what purpose then serveth the law? it was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ama lamatua sèmi nare abraham j'aj'i mi dhèu mola lula lalèka na, nga tao ka lamatua tabha hari atora agama re musa? lamatua tabha atora agama sèra, sèna ka aj'a dhèu rai-haha lula-nèti sasala-sasigo ra. dad'èi na sèna ka dhèu rai-haha mamuri madhutu dad'èi atora sèra, toke ana-èpu abraham ca dhèu mai. hèia ladhe dhèu ne mai ka, nuka kristus èèna, na, atora ne parluu heka. lod'o lamatua papuru atora agama yahudi, nèngu j'ole mema boe mi dhèu yahudi sèra. te ngaa na hia re ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai pangèd'u mi adhe-aai musa, heka musa hia asa dhèu yahudi kèna. dènge j'ara ne'e, musa j'aj'i nuka sèmi kalete sa nèti lamatua dènge dhèu-dhèu unu na.

source_text: now a mediator is not a mediator of one; but god is one.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ama lamatua tao lii pajaji dènge abraham, na pake boe kalete. te lamatua peka unu na dènge abraham! dènge sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, lii pajaji lamatua ne kab'ua risi eele nèti atora sèra.

source_text: is the law then against the promises of god? by no means: for if there had been a law given which could give life, verily righteousness would have been by the law.
target_text: lod'o lamatua hia atora agama asa musa èèna, pasala dènge lii-lii pajaji na, do? aad'o! te ladhe abhu atora dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa tao madhutu ne, ho lamatua sèmi nare ne sèna ka na bisa mamuri, tatu atora dhèu yahudi bisa tao sèmi èèna kahèi. madhutu iia-iia na, abhu boe atora èci sa dhu dhèu bisa tao madhutu ne, sèna ka cuhi d'ara lamatua ho lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola.

source_text: but the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of jesus christ might be given to them that believe.
target_text: te ètu sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, suri peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èki madhe dènge rupa-rupa sasala ra. nèti èèna ka, dhodhoka dhèu dhu parcaya yesus kristus di, bisa abhu ngaa dhu ama lamatua moa tèke èèna.

source_text: but before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up to the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
target_text: lod'o kristus dhae mai mèka, ji'i dhèu yahudi pa'èki madhe dènge atora sèra, toke bisa boe kalau. te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua bhoke j'ara ho ji'i kalua nèti atora sèra, ladhe ji'i parcaya kristus.

source_text: wherefore the law was our school-master to bring us to christ, that we might be justified by faith. but after faith is come, we are no longer under a school-master.
target_text: de atora agama sèra, sama sèmi dhèu madhenge dhu aj'a paie-iie èdhi toke kristus mai. te ngaa ropa na mai ku, heka èdhi bisa parcaya ne, sèna ka èdhi mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi parluu heka dhèu madhenge èèna.

source_text: for ye are all children of god by faith in christ jesus.
target_text: limuri ne, miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, lula miu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for as many of you as have been baptized into christ, have put on christ.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu sarani èle le, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu pa'èki madhe dènge ne.

source_text: there is neither jew nor greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in christ jesus.
target_text: dhèu dhu lèka kristus, aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, beda boe. de masi ka miu dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, ènu do ènu boe, dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni, aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, ca ropa èèna ka.

source_text: and if ye are christ's, then are ye abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
target_text: kristus ne, ana-èpu abraham dhu ama lamatua padhadha karèi nèti uru ka. lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, nèti èèna ka miu j'aj'i le tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu bisa kahèi abhu berkat dhu ama lamatua moa tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: now i say, that the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he is lord of all;
target_text: ja'a pakasame dhu leo hari. ca dhèu ana dhu dènge hak ho abhu pusaka nèti ama na, ladhe ama na madhe. te ngaa ladhe ana ne ana iiki ae era, nèngu bisa mèka abhu pusaka èèna, masi ka èèna na aa'i-aa'i se unu nèngu. lula nèngu d'ai mèka umur, nèngu ne nuka sèmi ènu dhu dènge boe hak, sèna ka nare mèdha-panyau lamatua na.

source_text: but is under tutors and governors until the time appointed by the father.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, hud'i dènge ku dhèu dhu pa'uri ana ne dènge pusaka na. ana ne hud'i madhutu ku dad'èi nèti dhèu madhenge nèngu, toke d'ai lod'o dhu ama na pama'ète nare èèna, heka na sèmi nare pusaka na kèna.

source_text: even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge èdhi. lod'o yesus kristus dhae mai mèka, èdhi nuka sèmi ana iiki èèna. te èdhi dhu pa'èki madhe dènge dad'èi rai-haha, nuka sèmi ènu ca dhèu.

source_text: but when the fullness of the time was come, god sent forth his son, born of a woman, born under the law, to redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o na, ama lamatua pua mai ana d'èlu na dhu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha èèna, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha bisa kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu ama lamatua ded'e nare j'aj'i ana-ana na. ana d'èlu na èèna mamuri madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, sèna ka nèngu bisa patabuli dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna pa'èki dènge atora se.

source_text: and because ye are sons, god hath sent forth the spirit of his son into your hearts, crying, abba, father.
target_text: lula miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na hia le roh ana na mai asa d'ara miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu dènge hak paroa ama lamatua, na, ama pasue.

source_text: wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of god through christ.
target_text: de limuri ne miu j'aj'i heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho abhu pusaka. te ngaa miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua dhu dènge hak, sèna ka abhu pusaka aa'i-aa'i dhu na pajaji tèke le.

source_text: however then, when ye knew not god, ye did service to them which by nature are no gods.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o miu tadhe mèka ama lamatua, miu tao iisi mi j'aj'i ènu, ho sogo-tagu ngaa-ngaa dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but now, after ye have known god, or rather are known by god, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, to which ye desire again to be in bondage?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu tadhe le ama lamatua. be'a risi, ja'a peka, na, ama lamatua ka dhu tadhe miu. de tasamia ka miu neo lèpa hari asa sogo-tagu ngaa dhu guna boe, aa dhu dènge boe koasa ngaa-ngaa sèra? miu neo tao iisi mi pa'èki dènge j'ara-j'ara sèra, sèna ka j'aj'i hari ènu ra, do?

source_text: ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi, na, miu kèpe atora ho pakab'ua risi lod'o-lod'o hua iia madhutu lod'o, hèru, èj'i lai, hèru hadhu, dènge tèu, ho neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: i am afraid of you, lest i have bestowed upon you labor in vain.
target_text: ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee ja'a! mage dhoka j'aj'èra ja'a aj'a-nori miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ele iie d'ara di.

source_text: brethren, i beseech you, be as i am; for i am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mamuri pa'èki ia ka dènge madha j'ara sèra, sèmi ja'a ne. te mamuri ja'a ne pa'èki heka le dènge atora agama, èci èèna ka dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe. uru èèna, lod'o èdhi bera-bera era, miu pasusa boe ja'a.

source_text: ye know that in infirmity of the flesh i preached the gospel to you at the first.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ca hari ni, lod'o ja'a mai hiu-hiu èèna, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ngi'u aae ja'a ne roe-bhilu.

source_text: and my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of god, even as christ jesus.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu tule eele boe ja'a, lula miu sèmi mere ja'a nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. risi-risi hari, miu sèmi mere ja'a ne, nuka sèmi yesus kristus mesa na.

source_text: what then was the blessedness ye spoke of; for i bear you testimony, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
target_text: lod'o èèna, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti karej'e titu kèna. te ngaa, nga tao ka limuri ne, sèmi heka èèna? uru èèna, miu sue ja'a titu kèna, ka miu toke neo ed'o eele ana madha miu ho hia ja'a.

source_text: am i therefore become your enemy because i tell you the truth?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu ngee, na, ja'a j'aj'i le musu miu, lula ja'a padhai dhu mola dènge miu, do?

source_text: they zealously affect you, but not well; for, they would exclude you, that ye may affect them.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ro'o boe ja'a pa'angalai dènge miu, ka ra dadugu miu ho madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi. dad'èi d'ara ra, sèna ka miu bhute madhutu dad'èi rèngu di.

source_text: but it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when i am present with you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu maj'èni tao j'ara dhu be'a, èèna be'a kahèi! masi ka ja'a sama-sama dènge miu, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i miu tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: my little children, of whom i travail in birth again, until christ be formed in you,
target_text: ana-ana pasue! ne'e ne, ja'a sab'a bia risi hari hia miu, nuka sèmi bhèni dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi. te ja'a ae kora boe ciki sa nèti sasab'a, toke d'ara miu èci èèna ka dènge d'ara kristus.

source_text: i desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for i stand in doubt of you.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a ke'a heka neo tao miu tasamia hari! ja'a d'èi titu kèna, dhiu padhai lii patoo madha dènge miu, sèna ka ja'a baku padhai lii taka sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
target_text: ladhe miu neo mamuri madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, be'a risi miu me'a uuru ku dad'èi nèti atora sèra.

source_text: for it is written, that abraham had two sons; the one by a bond-maid, the other by a free-woman.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua abhu lii lolo dhu lole, peka na, ana mone abraham, dhèu dua. nèngu abhu ana ca dhèu nèti bhèni dhu ènu na, aa ca dhèu hari nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, dhu ènu boe.

source_text: but he who was of the bond-woman, was born according to the flesh; but he of the free-woman was by promise.
target_text: ènu ne nara iisi ana na, lula madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa dhèu èmu abraham nara iisi ana na, lula madhutu lii moa dhu ama lamatua peka mema le.

source_text: which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is agar.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, nuka sèmi tadha dhu pad'elo dua lii pajaji dhu ama lamatua padhadha dènge dhèu rai-haha. lii pajaji èci, lamatua pangèd'u mi musa ètu ledhe sinai, lod'o nèngu papuru atora agama dhèu yahudi. dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge atora agama sèra, rèngu j'aj'i ènu sama sèmi hagar kahèi.

source_text: for this agar is mount sinai in arabia, and answereth to jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
target_text: era ètu ledhe sinai ètu rae arab èèna, nuka sèmi hagar ne kahèi. dhèu yerusalem aa'i-aa'i lod'o limuri ne, dhu pa'èki era dènge atora agama yahudi, rèngu sèra ènu kahèi nuka sèmi hagar.

source_text: but jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
target_text: te ngaa lii pajaji dhu leo hari, paj'uj'u asa kota yerusalem dhu leo èci ètu sorga. ana-ana unu ama lamatua dhu pea ètu èèna, ènu boe. te rèngu dhèu bebas dhu pa'èki boe dènge atora agama èèna. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se èci èèna ka dènge ina ji'i sara, dhèu èmu abraham.

source_text: for it is written, rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she who hath a husband.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci, dhu suri tèke, peka na, wee! bhèni dhu nara iisi nèdhi boe! pakarej'e d'ara mu! wee! bhèni dhu rasa nèdhi boe kabake pèd'a nara iisi! sod'a pakarej'e d'ara mu! bhèni dhu d'ara roe-bhilu, lula dhèu èmu na pusi-pahae heka ne, pe na abhu ana ae risi nèti bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu-kamali.

source_text: now we, brethren, as isaac was, are the children of promise.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! uru èèna ama lamatua dhu padhadha le hia ana mi abraham. te ngaa nèbhu ku, heka lamatua tao madhutu lii pajaji na kèna, hèia sara nara iisi isak hia abraham. èdhi sama sèmi isak kahèi, lula ama lamatua pajaji hia abraham ana-èpu dhu leo kahèi.

source_text: but as then he that was born according to the flesh persecuted him that was born according to the spirit, even so it is now.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana ènu dhu j'aj'i madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha èèna, ropa na kapai, na paj'èra isak, dhu j'aj'i madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua. èèna sama kahèi dènge ngaa dhu j'aj'i limuri ne.

source_text: nevertheless, what saith the scripture? cast out the bond-woman and her son: for the son of the bond-woman shall not be heir with the son of the free-woman.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri kahèi, peka na, babège eele ènu dènge ana na. te ana nèti ènu ne dènge boe hak ho abhu pusaka. dhodhoka ana nèti dhèu èmu kab'i na dhu dènge hak.

source_text: so then, brethren, we are not children of the bond-woman, but of the free.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari aa'i-aa'i! èdhi sama boe dènge ana nèti ènu, lula èdhi pa'èki heka dènge atora agama dhèu yahudi. te èdhi nuka sèmi ana nèti dhèu èmu kab'i abraham, lula èdhi parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: stand fast therefore in the liberty with which christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
target_text: uru èèna dhèu yahudi j'èra bia pasae atora agama ra. te ngaa limuri ne, kristus ded'e eele le babia èèna nèti dhèu dhu parcaya ne. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi pasae heka babia. de miu baku lèke kapod'e-kabèli, ho pasae hari atora sèra, tao nuka sèmi ènu sa!

source_text: behold, i paul say to you, that if ye be circumcised, christ will profit you nothing.
target_text: de nanene, ee! ja'a ne, paulus, ka dhu peka lii ne'e. ladhe miu suna ho madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, na, mamadhe kristus dhu hia miu bebas èèna, gaguna na aad'o!

source_text: for i testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
target_text: ladhe dhèu suna ho madhutu atora agama sèmi èèna, nèngu hud'i pasae hari ku atora sèra aa'i-aa'i ra. miu sanèd'e era, do aad'o? te uru èèna, ja'a dhu peka mema le.

source_text: christ is become of no effect to you, whoever of you are justified by the law; ye have fallen from grace.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo pake atora, sèna ka ama lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, nèngu tao iisi na pakaj'èu nèti kristus. te dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu core eele d'ara hua iia ama lamatua.

source_text: for we through the spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
target_text: te ngaa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu bhoke j'ara hia èdhi, ho èdhi parcaya yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka èdhi sanao, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pama'ète, na, èdhi dhèu mola.

source_text: for in jesus christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
target_text: masi ka dhèu suna, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa dhu hua iia risi, nuka dhèu dhu parcaya kristus aa sue dhèu leo.

source_text: ye did run well, who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri le madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu cee ka dhu kapod'e-kabèli miu, ka miu madhutu heka j'ara èèna?

source_text: this persuasion cometh not from him that calleth you.
target_text: te a'aj'a-nanori kapod'e-kabèli dhu miu nanene èèna, mai boe nèti ama lamatua. madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu ka dhu paroa nare miu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
target_text: ngaa dhu ra aj'a, hiu-hiu èèna dhoka ca hèb'a-dua hèb'a di. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, lii a'aj'a ne tao ngangee miu ele iie. nuka sèmi ragi ciki dhu dhèu pakihu dènge tarigu ho neo tao roti. nèbhu-nèbhu hèia ragi ne'e ka paca'e tarigu dhu pakihu èèna.

source_text: i have confidence in you through the lord, that ye will be no otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whoever he may be.
target_text: lula èdhi j'aj'i le èci dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka ja'a ke'a mèu, nèngu èèna hia miu parcaya hari mi ngaa dhu ja'a nori le sèra. aa ama lamatua mesa na, pe huku dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie lalèka miu.

source_text: and i, brethren, if i yet preach circumcision, why do i yet suffer persecution? then hath the offense of the cross ceased.
target_text: sèmi ne'e a'ari! ladhe ja'a aj'a, peka na, dhèu hud'i suna ku, tatu ja'a abhu boe j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. aa dhèu yahudi tule eele boe a'aj'a ja'a lula-nèti mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: i would they were even cut off who trouble you.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli miu sèra lula j'ara suna, na soro tèke si sèna ka rèngu unu ra pake tud'i ho ari eele mèdha nèti isi ra!

source_text: for, brethren, ye have been called to liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lamatua patabuli le miu, ho miu mamuri pa'èki heka dènge dad'èi atora agama. te ngaa mage pangee, na, miu bisa tao leli ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi miu di! te dhu lèke, nuka miu hud'i mamuri pasue ku, aa paladha-leru èci dènge èci, sèmi ènu lalau-lalo'o lamatua na.

source_text: for all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this, thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ladhe miu tao madhutu dhoka atora sasue ne di, na, miu tao aa'i le madhutu dad'èi atora agama dhèu yahudi.

source_text: but if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one by another.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu èci patao-palaha dènge èci, do, èci pakèji dènge èci, pe mèdhi unu mi! nèbhu boe, te miu palaho ngi'u miu unu mi.

source_text: this i say then, walk in the spirit, and ye will not fulfill the lust of the flesh.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe miu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, miu madhutu heka dad'èi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for the flesh lusteth against the spirit, and the spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other; so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
target_text: te dad'èi dhèu rai-haha madhutu boe dad'èi roh. aa dad'èi roh madhutu boe dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. dua ra bisa boe pa'èci, te ngaa palab'a taruu! nèti èèna ka, miu bisa heka tao hari madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi!

source_text: but if ye are led by the spirit, ye are not under the law.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua ator miu, na, miu pa'èki heka dènge atora sèra.

source_text: now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these, adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
target_text: dhèu dhu loe boe madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha, nuka sèmi: dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali na, dhèu dhu ngangee kaj'alu, dhu re'a boe d'ara makae,

source_text: idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
target_text: dhu sogo-tagu nidhu ho suagi dhèu, dhu pamusu, dhu d'èi pasibha d'ara lii, dhu tèka d'ara, dhu nasa leli, dhu ngee dhoka ngi'u na, dhu d'èi kakèj'i dhèu, dhu d'èi tao maruru,

source_text: envyings, murders, drunkenness, revelings, and such like: of which i tell you before, as i have also told you in time past, that they who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhu d'èi boe dhèu leo risi ne, dhu d'èi mahu paa-paa, dhu d'èi madhutu pesta toke re'a heka makae, aa d'èi tao sasala dhu leo hari. uru èèna, dhu ja'a pasanèd'e le, na, dhèu dhu tema tao j'ara-j'ara sèmi sèra, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: but the fruit of the spirit is love, joy, peace, long-suffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, èèna na roh tao ne ho j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'èi pasue, d'ara dhu karej'e-karae, dhu d'èi padame, taha nare d'ara, d'ara be'a dènge dhèu leo, dhu d'èi soru-bara dhèu, dhu d'èi kèpe pa'èra-èra lii pajaji,

source_text: meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
target_text: dhu lii mako dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa j'aga paie-iie mamuri na. abhu boe atora èci sa dhu magee j'ara se'e se.

source_text: and they that are christ's have crucified the flesh, with the affections and lusts.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus, nèngu dhu pakaj'èu le nèti dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. te d'ara dhu d'èi tao bhelu èèna, dhu na paku pamadhe le ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha palere-lere dènge yesus.

source_text: if we live in the spirit, let us also walk in the spirit.
target_text: de ladhe roh lamatua hia le mamuri hiu mi èdhi, na, èdhi hud'i madhutu taruu ku dad'èi nèngu.

source_text: let us not be desirous of vain-glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, baku padedha iisi, baku d'èi èci kakèj'i èci, aa baku patèka d'ara èci dènge èci.

source_text: brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye who are spiritual, restore such one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ladhe abhu dhèu parcaya ca dhèu dhu tao sala, na, miu dhu me'a tare'a-re'a dad'èi roh lamatua, lami padhai lii mako-mako dènge ne dènge d'ara mola. hèia mèti hari ne, sèna ka madhutu j'ara dhu lèke nèti lamatua. te ngaa j'aga ngi'u mi, sèna ka baku manahu asa sasala na èèna.

source_text: bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of christ.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paraga dènge sasusa, na, miu dhu leo lami soru-bara ne. te dènge sèmi èèna, miu tao le madhutu atora nèti kristus.

source_text: for if a man thinketh himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu padedha iisi, peka na, nèngu risi nèti dhèu leo, aa te ngaa aad'o sèmi èèna, na, nèngu tipu ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: but let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
target_text: de ca dhèu-dhèu ka hud'i parisa ku ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue. ladhe ngaa dhu nèngu tao ne be'a le, pe ne'a unu na. mage pasèku dènge tatao dhèu leo.

source_text: for every man shall bear his own burden.
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi èèna, lula ca dhèu-dhèu ka dhu tago nare unu na, ngaa dhu nèngu tao.

source_text: let him that is taught in the word communicate to him that teacheth in all good things.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sèmi nare le lii holo-nori lamatua, nèngu hud'i pabagi ku rui-j'aj'èra na, ho soru-bara dhèu dhu aj'a-nori nèngu.

source_text: be not deceived; god is not mocked: for whatever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ama lamatua ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. de baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi, aa baku neo tipu lamatua. lula, ngaa dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka-tedhe, pe nèngu abhu hari hua-hela na.

source_text: for he that soweth to his flesh shall from the flesh reap corruption: but he that soweth to the spirit, shall from the spirit reap life everlasting.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara bhelu-katub'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na dui nare hari mamuri dhu ele iie. te ngaa ladhe dhèu tao j'ara be'a madhutu dad'èi roh mola-mèci, pe nèngu abhu hari mamuri dhu lèke toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a. te ropa d'ai lod'o na, èdhi abhu hari j'ara dhu be'a, sad'i èdhi taha taruu.

source_text: as we have therefore opportunity, let us do good to all men, especially to them who are of the household of faith.
target_text: de ropa èdhi abhu lod'o dhu taleo, na, èdhi tao mema ka j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, risi-risi mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: ye see how large a letter i have written to you with my own hand.
target_text: sasuri ne'e, ja'a ka suri unu ku, pake huruf dhu kapai aae hua.

source_text: as many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of christ.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra lèka kahèi mi yesus kristus dhu madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa rèngu laka-seti miu ho suna, lula ra madha'u dènge dhèu yahudi leo, rèngu mage dhèu se paj'èra si, ladhe rèngu aj'a, peka na, ama lamatua sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu madhutu boe atora suna. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se d'èi solo-mako dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: for neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
target_text: masi ka rèngu dhu suna le, te ngaa rèngu unu ra madhutu aa'i boe atora agama sèra. rèngu d'èi ho miu madhutu suna, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, partei ra ded'e padedha-dedha rèngu.

source_text: but may it never be that i should glory, save in the cross of our lord jesus christ, by whom the world is crucified to me, and i to the world.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ne d'èi dhoka ded'e padedha-dedha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. nèngu madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu ad'u-ue madhutu dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pusi-pahae heka dènge dad'èi rai-haha. aa dad'èi rai-haha ne èki heka ja'a.

source_text: for in christ jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
target_text: suna, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa dhu karisi, nuka èdhi abhu mamuri hiu nèti lamatua.

source_text: and as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the israel of god.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu a'aj'a ja'a ne, ho rèngu mamuri padame, aa pad'elo rasa kasia èci dènge èci. te rèngu j'aj'i le suku dhu hiu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: from henceforth let no man trouble me: for i bear in my body the marks of the lord jesus.
target_text: ja'a peka mola-mola kèna, na, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu sèku ia ka ja'a dènge lii langu suna ne. te ètu ngi'u ja'a ne dènge tadha nu'a era, lula ja'a sab'a hia yesus kristus.

source_text: brethren, the grace of our lord jesus christ be with your spirit. amen.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na asa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of jesus christ by the will of god, to the saints who are at ephesus, and to the faithful in christ jesus:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a suri sasuri ne, hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi, dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus ètu kota epesus, aa dhu taha ètu d'ara mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi na. nèngu mesa na ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: grace be to you, and peace from god our father, and from the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua ne, ama èdhi. aa yesus kristus, kètu èdhi. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: blessed be the god and father of our lord jesus christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in christ:
target_text: koa-kio mi ama lamatua! nèngu ka ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ama lamatua pala-bagi le mi èdhi mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i nèti sorga, lula èdhi j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: according as he hath chosen us in him, before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
target_text: te lod'o rai-haha dhae j'aj'i mèka, ama lamatua sue aa hag'e nare le èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus. na d'èi sèna ka èdhi mamuri mola-mèci. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pasala èdhi.

source_text: having predestinated us to the adoption of children to himself by jesus christ, according to the good pleasure of his will,
target_text: nèngu ka dhu pama'ète mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho ded'e èdhi j'aj'i ana na, lula yesus kristus. ne'e ne ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: to the praise of the glory of his grace, in which he hath made us accepted in the beloved:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi koa-kio ne. te nèngu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, ho èdhi bisa mamuri pa'èci dènge ana pasue na.

source_text: in whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
target_text: masi ka èdhi uru èèna mamuri mola-mèci boe madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, te ngaa na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa hia ana na mai, sèna ka pasuti raa na toke madhe. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana na sui nare èdhi nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: in which he hath abounded towards us in all wisdom and prudence;
target_text: lula na dutu-bhori sasue na mi èdhi, nèngu pasaraa d'ara èdhi kahèi, ka bisa te'a mèu dad'èi d'ara na.

source_text: having made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua dhae peka aa'i mèka dad'èi d'ara na mi dhèu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, madhutu dad'èi na, na hia le èdhi te'a, peka na, karèi nèti uru ka, na pama'ète nare le ho neo pake yesus kristus sèna ka padame dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: that in the dispensation of the fullness of times he might collect in one all things in christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
target_text: aa, pe d'ai lod'o na, yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu ho uri aa'i ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga.

source_text: in whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will: that we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in christ.
target_text: lula èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kristus, nèti èèna ka èdhi abhu pusaka kahèi nèti ama lamatua. te karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, na hag'e nare ji'i dhèu yahudi, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. dad'èi nèngu ka, neo pake ji'i ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu-dhèu leo, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya kristus. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, madhutu ngaa dhu na pama'ète nare le. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa ded'e padedha-dedha risi hari, kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom ye also trusted, after ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy spirit of promise,
target_text: lula ji'i bhoke le j'ara, nèti èèna ka miu nèti suku leo bisa mai j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, sad'i miu parcaya lii lolo be'a na dhu mola. te lii lolo be'a èèna ka dhu pamamuri miu. ladhe miu parcaya sèmi èèna, miu sèmi mere kahèi roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu na moa mema le. te roh lamatua mola-mèci ne, nuka sèmi cap ho patadha, peka na, miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, to the praise of his glory.
target_text: roh mola-mèci ne'e j'aj'i mi jaminan kahèi, dhu peka na, pe ama lamatua hia aa'i mèu-mèu dhu na moa mema sèra, toke na sui nare èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi koa-kio dadedha na.

source_text: wherefore i also, having heard of your faith in the lord jesus, and love to all the saints,
target_text: ja'a tadèngi ae le, j'ara-j'ara lalèka miu mi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèti sasue miu mi dhèu parcaya sèra. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
target_text: ja'a loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: that the god of our lord jesus christ, the father of glory, may give to you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a, peka na, ama pasue! ama ku, ama lamatua nèti kètu ja'a, yesus kristus. aa ama ku ka dhu kapai risi aa'i. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama hia roh ama mi dhèu epesus, ho re'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, aa bisa tadhe ama mèu risi hari.

source_text: the eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua bhoke ngangee dènge pasaraa d'ara ra, sèna ka bisa re'a aa'i ngaa dhu ama padhadha neo hia si. ja'a neo kahèi sèna ka rèngu re'a pusaka dhu ama moa neo hia si bèli-camèd'a. te pusaka èèna kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
target_text: ja'a manèngi kahèi, ho ama bhoke j'ara hia si, sèna ka bisa re'a mèu koasa ama dhu dedha risi èèna. te ama pake koasa èèna, ho soru-bara dhèu parcaya dhu unu ama sèra.

source_text: which he wrought in christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
target_text: te koasa ama lamatua èèna, risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti koasa ne'e ka na pamamuri kristus nèti mamadhe na. hèia ama lamatua ded'e kristus asa sorga, ka hia ne madhèdi ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele, ètu baboa g'ana na.

source_text: far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
target_text: nèngu dedha risi nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga. te nèngu dedha risi nèti koasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhu rèd'u paredha aa'i-aa'i ra. na kèpe koasa na dhu risi nèti aa'i-aa'i sèra, mesa boe doe ne'e ne di. te na nèd'u koasa ne taruu toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
target_text: ama lamatua unu na ka dhu tao sèna ka aa'i-aa'i se pahaha iisi mi kristus. aa nèngu kahèi ded'e kristus j'aj'i kètu, sèna ka uri aa'i-aa'i dhu pa'èki dènge dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: which is his body, the fullness of him that filleth all in all.
target_text: de ladhe na j'aj'i kètu, èdhi dhèu parcaya j'aj'i nuka sèmi ngi'u na. bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu sab'a pa'èle aa'i mèu sasab'a dhu na pakako lod'o na ètu rai-haha ne era. te nèngu ka dènge koasa ho paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. lii sabaj'a ja'a sèmi ne'e ka hia miu.

source_text: and you hath he revived, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
target_text: uru èèna, miu sisu paredha ama lamatua, aa ad'u-ue rupa-rupa sasala. nèti èèna ka lamatua peka na, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le.

source_text: in which in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
target_text: uru èèna, mamuri miu madhutu dad'èi rai-haha ne, dènge dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. toke d'ai sange ne'e, nidhu loe boe dadugu-rariu dhèu rai-haha, sèna ka palab'a dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: among whom also we all had our manner of life in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna kahèi, ka ngaa dhu èdhi rasa do, pangee do, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. te èdhi dhèu bhelu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka ama lamatua nasa titu kèna dènge èdhi,

source_text: but god, who is rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead in sins, hath made us alive together with christ, by grace ye are saved;
target_text: aa pangee na, èdhi nuka sèmi dhèu madhe kahèi dhu cèri eele nèti nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara na la'e boe lula na sue èdhi titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pua yesus kristus mai sèna ka pala-bagi mamuri hiu hia èdhi. de lamatua ka dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi lula d'ara hua iia na.

source_text: and hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places, in christ jesus:
target_text: yesus kristus madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia lamatua ded'e ne ho nèd'u paredha ètu sorga. lamatua tao sèmi èèna kahèi mi dedha èdhi, na pala-bagi mamuri hiu mi èdhi, hèia na ded'e èdhi, ka tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge kristus ètu sorga.

source_text: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness towards us, through christ jesus.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mulai nèti doe ne'e, d'ai mia-mia la'e, ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara sasue na ae-ae, dènge d'ara hua iia na dhu risi aa'i èèna, lula èdhi parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for by grace are ye saved, through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of god: not by works, lest any man should boast.
target_text: ropa miu parcaya kristus, ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, lula d'ara hua iia na. na hia mamuri sèmi èèna, baku pangee, na, nèngu b'ala ngaa dhu miu tao. lula mamuri èèna j'aj'i hadia dhu na hia iia d'ara mi miu. nèti èèna ka, miu baku padedha iisi nèti ngaa dhu miu tao.

source_text: for we are his workmanship, created in christ jesus to good works, which god hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
target_text: èdhi mamuri, lula ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i èdhi. hèia yesus kristus hia èdhi mamuri hiu, sèna ka èdhi tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu lamatua pama'ète nare le karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: wherefore remember, that ye being in time past gentiles in the flesh, who are called uncircumcision by that which is called the circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu me'a le, na, dhèu yahudi kèpe pa'èra-èra atora suna rèngu, aa ra pusi-pahae boe miu dhèu yahudi boe, lula mo'o boe madhutu atora èèna! madhutu iia-iia na, atora suna ne dhoka nèti ngi'u aae di, nèti boe d'ara dhèu.

source_text: that at that time ye were without christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without god in the world:
target_text: lod'o miu dhae parcaya mèka yesus kristus, miu dènge mèka hak ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. te uru èèna, miu dhae maso mèka asa d'ara lii pajaji ama lamatua dhu na pa'èki tèke mi abraham, aa dènge ana-èpu na. lod'o èèna, miu mamuri ètu rai-haha, te ngaa bisa boe maena mi ama lamatua, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu leo rai kara era,

source_text: but now, in christ jesus, ye, who formerly were far off, are made nigh by the blood of christ.
target_text: dhu cèri nèti lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, yesus kristus bhoke nare le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa pa'èki dènge ama lamatua. te kristus madhe sèna ka cuhi d'ara lamatua, ho miu bisa padame dènge ne, aa bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: for he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i dhèu yahudi ngo'o boe mamuri dame dènge miu dhèu leo rai kara. nuka sèmi kadidhi dhu hag'e eele èdhi. te ngaa lula mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka na paguri eele le kadidhi èèna, sèna ka èdhi dhu uru èèna pamusu, bisa padame hari ho j'aj'i mi ca suku.

source_text: having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances: to make in himself of two one new man, so making peace;
target_text: te uru èèna, dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho pake atora agama rèngu sèna ka pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ropa yesus kristus madhe, na pa'ele iie le j'ara dhui, aa bhoke j'ara hiu, sèna ka dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu leo kara, dua-dua ra bisa mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èki j'aj'i mi ca suku dhu hiu, dhu mamuri mera-milu.

source_text: and that he might reconcile both to god in one body by the cross, having by it slain the enmity:
target_text: de kristus madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèna ka tao dua suku sèra j'aj'i mi èci, aa nèti hari si asa ama lamatua. te kristus palaho eele aa'i le ngaa dhu uru èèna tao rèngu ho pamusu.

source_text: and came and preached peace to you who were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
target_text: nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, nèti lii lolo be'a hia dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu leo kara sèra, dhu lole na, uru èèna miu mamuri pamusu, te ngaa limuri ne abhu le j'ara sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: for through him we both have an access by one spirit to the father.
target_text: de ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe, aa'i-aa'i ti abhu j'ara ho lati asa ama lamatua èdhi, lula yesus bhoke le j'ara hia èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. aa roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pad'elo j'ara mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti kahèi.

source_text: now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellow-citizens with the saints, and of the household of god;
target_text: lula pa'ue-ai yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka miu dhèu yahudi boe j'aj'i heka dhèu leo rai kara dhu dènge boe hak ngaa-ngaa. te limuri ne, miu unu le hak ho j'aj'i ana kabarai sorga, lula ama lamatua ded'e le miu j'aj'i ana-èpu na.

source_text: and are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, jesus christ himself being the chief corner -stone;
target_text: ne'e ne, nuka sèmi ama lamatua neo patitu èmu cue. na patitu hadhu dhu padhèdi uru, nuka yesus kristus. hèia na tao fanderen, nuka dhèu rèti lii padhai na dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na. ka na padhèdi hadhu se pagod'o-god'o ètu dedha sèra aa'i-aa'i. hadhu se, nuka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu na.

source_text: in whom all the building fitly framed together, groweth to a holy temple in the lord:
target_text: èmu ne titu èra bia, lula hadhu se dhu pagod'o si dènge be'a ètu dedha hadhu dhu padhèdi uru sèra. aa èmu èèna nèbhu-nèbhu asa kapai, ka dhèu lasi asa d'ara èmu èèna, sèna ka manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom ye also are built together, for a habitation of god through the spirit.
target_text: de limuri ne, ama lamatua tao sèna ka miu dhèu yahudi boe kahèi j'aj'i nuka sèmi hadhu, sama-sama dènge ji'i dhèu yahudi. ama lamatua padhèdi pagod'o-god'o èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, ho j'aj'i era pea roh na.

source_text: for this cause, i paul, the prisoner of jesus christ for you gentiles,
target_text: lula ama lamatua hag'e boe dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe, nèti èèna ka na pua ja'a, paulus, ho lole lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe ètu d'ara kota epesus. ja'a pakako le sasab'a ja'a, toke ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho.

source_text: if ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of god which is given me on your account.
target_text: tatu miu me'a kahèi, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha ja'a mai, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu.

source_text: that by revelation he made known to me the mystery, as i wrote before in few words;
target_text: uru èèna, mema ama lamatua dhae peka mèka dènge dhèu rai-haha ne, lula-nèti ngaa dhu na pama'ète hia mi dhèu dhu yahudi boe. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu peka le dènge ja'a, j'ara ne aa'i-aa'i ra. aa ne'e ne, ja'a dhu suri pabab'a-bab'a le ètu sasuri ne hia miu.

source_text: by which when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of christ,
target_text: ladhe miu baca mere, tatu miu bisa me'a kahèi dad'èi ama lamatua mi yesus kristus, dhu na bhoke hia ja'a.

source_text: which in other ages was not made known to the sons of men, as it is now revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the spirit;
target_text: te uru èèna, dhèu rai-haha re'a mèka dad'èi na. te ngaa limuri ne, na pake le roh na, sèna ka peka dad'èi na mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na.

source_text: that the gentiles should be joint-heirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in christ by the gospel:
target_text: te karèi nèti uru ka, ama lamatua pama'ète le sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu yahudi boe parcaya lii lolo be'a yesus kristus, rèngu bisa j'aj'i kahèi ana-ana ama lamatua, sama sèmi dhèu yahudi sèra. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pa'a'ari le, aa èdhi sama-sama bisa abhu mèngi-nale nèti ama èdhi, ama lamatua.

source_text: of which i was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of god given to me by the effectual working of his power.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, ka hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. aa na pangèd'u koasa na mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: to me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that i should preach among the gentiles the unsearchable riches of christ;
target_text: nèti dhèu unu lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ja'a ne haha d'ai seli. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare ja'a, ho pakako sasab'a na dhu kapai risi eele èèna. dad'èi na sèna ka ja'a lole dènge dhèu yahudi boe, lula-nèti d'ara hua iia yesus kristus dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in god, who created all things by jesus christ:
target_text: te karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, dad'èi na neo hia kristus mai èèna, dhu pahuni era. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu neo, sèna ka ja'a lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ho ra re'a mèu dad'èi na èèna.

source_text: to the intent that now to the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of god,
target_text: te dad'èi na èèna, d'èlu-mèu risi eele. hèia nèngu neo pake dhèu unu na, ho pad'elo mamèu na mi koasa-koasa dhu leo, aa mi aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in christ jesus our lord:
target_text: lod'o dhu na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le neo bhoke j'ara ho patabuli eele dhèu rai-haha nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèti èèna ka, na pake kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sèna ka tao madhutu sèmi èèna.

source_text: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu parcaya yesus kristus, parluu heka madha'u padhai lii dènge ama lamatua. te nèngu dhu pakabhèle mema ai na, sèna ka sèmi nare èdhi lod'o mia èèna ka.

source_text: wherefore i desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a j'èra lula lalau-lalo'o miu dhèu yahudi boe. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara miu mage èra boe kahèi. ja'a pasae kore j'aj'èra ne, lula neo pa'èra miu ho sèmi mere babe'a na.

source_text: for this cause i bow my knees to the father of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a ngee kèdhi d'ara hua iia ama lamatua dhu risi eele èèna, hèia ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho manèngi makasi.

source_text: of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
target_text: te a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga unu dhoka ama èci di, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: that he would grant you according to the riches of his glory to be strengthened with might by his spirit in the inner man;
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale ae-ae mi dedha miu, madhutu dad'èi d'ara na dhu hua iia risi èèna. aa ja'a manèngi kahèi ho na hia roh na, dènge koasa na, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu.

source_text: that christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho yesus kristus pea ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya ne taruu. aa ja'a sabaj'a kahèi sèna ka miu mamuri pa'èki dènge sasue na, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u asa èra, lula amo na maso marèma asa d'ara rai.

source_text: may be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and highth. and to know the love of christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye may be filled with all the fullness of god.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a kahèi ho miu dènge dhèu unu lamatua aa'i-aa'i bisa me'a mèu sasue kristus dhu dhèu rai-haha ne d'èu rare boe. te sasue ne, kapai titu kèna, taleo titu kèna, marèma titu kèna, aa ae titu kèna! ja'a sabaj'a kahèi sèna ka miu rasa sasue na, toke sasue ne maso papènu d'ara dènge mamuri miu.

source_text: now to him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us.
target_text: koasa ama lamatua kapai titu kèna, risi aa'i nèti dhu èdhi manèngi dènge dhu èdhi bisa ngee. aa na pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho sab'a ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: to him be glory in the church by christ jesus throughout all ages, world without end. amen.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kristus, ti ded'e ne padedha-dedha! koa-kio ne taruu, mulai nèti doe ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. ne'e ka dhu lèke!

source_text: i therefore, the prisoner of the lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation by which ye are called,
target_text: ja'a pakako le sasab'a lamatua ja'a, toke ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho. de limuri ne ja'a pamako miu, sèna ka mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, lula na paroa nare le miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: with all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, forbearing one another in love;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i mamuri dènge pahaha iisi, aa pamaho'o èci dènge èci. miu hud'i taha mere d'ara, aa tadhe mèu èci dènge èci, ho mamuri pasue dhu tare'a. ladhe nèti miu, abhu dhu tenge lii langu dènge angalai na, baku tèka d'ara dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: endeavoring to keep the unity of the spirit in the bond of peace.
target_text: tenge j'ara ho muri dame èci dènge èci, lula roh ama lamatua dhu èki le miu j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: there is one body, and one spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
target_text: te dhèu unu yesus kristus dhu j'aj'i le èci, nuka sèmi ngi'u kristus unu na. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare le roh lamatua dhu dhoka èci èèna di. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sanao-maena dhoka mi ama lamatua di, lula nèngu ka dhu paroa nare si ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: one lord, one faith, one baptism,
target_text: lamatua èdhi, dhoka èci di; parcaya èdhi, dhoka ca j'ara di, sèna ka bisa padame dènge ne. aa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti abhu sarani, sèna ka pa'èki dènge ne.

source_text: one god and father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
target_text: ama lamatua, dhoka èci di, aa ama èdhi, dhoka nèngu di. dhoka nèngu di dhu paredha èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. dhoka nèngu di dhu bera-bera dènge èdhi. aa nèngu mesa na di dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: but to every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of christ.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kristus pala-bagi le koasa na mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi èci-èci ka pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: wherefore he saith, when he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.
target_text: nèti èèna ka sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu ca'e la'e asa era dedha, sèna ka na pamusu ètu èèna toke segi. hèia ère nèti dhèu ae-ae dhu lèke taha, aa papala hadia mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
target_text: sanèd'e lii-lii dhu peka na, nèngu ca'e la'e. ladhe na ca'e la'e, sasoa na, uru èèna na puru nèdhi le asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: he that descended is the same also that ascended far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.
target_text: de dhèu dhu puru mai èèna, nuka kristus. te nèngu ca'e hari asa sorga, sèna ka bisa uri aa'i dhu ètu dedha-liru dènge ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
target_text: kristus dhu pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu unu na, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a-la'a dhu na pala-bagi hia rèngu. abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si koasa ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na; cahag'e j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na; cahag'e j'aj'i sèmi ca dhèu ama sa, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu unu kristus; cahag'e j'aj'i dhèu d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a dhèu unu na; aa cahag'e hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu tema rèti lii lolo be'a asa era-era dhu hiu.

source_text: for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of christ:
target_text: ca dhèu-dhèu ka sèmi rare sasab'a ra, sèna ka pa'èra dhèu-dhèu parcaya ho aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pakako sasab'a lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu parcaya yesus kristus asa tabha èra,

source_text: till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the son of god, to a perfect man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of christ: that we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, by which they lie in wait to deceive:
target_text: toke èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti parcaya d'ara èci. aa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadhe tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua. èdhi sèmi heka ana iiki, lula èdhi madhutu mola-mola le j'ara nèngu, aa j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na. ladhe èdhi mamuri ka sèmi èèna, èdhi sèmi heka koha dhu dènge boe uli, ka madhutu dhoka rii di. te ladhe dhèu kapod'e-kabèli mai aj'a pagoa èdhi, ra tao rare boe.

source_text: but speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, who is the head, even christ:
target_text: te ngaa èdhi dènge lii mako lole dhoka ngaa dhu lèke hia mi a'ari èdhi sèra, lula èdhi sue rèngu. aa ladhe èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna ètu d'ara ngaa èèna ka, èdhi j'aj'i ca ropa dènge kristus. te nèngu ne kètu èdhi dhu uri èdhi.

source_text: from whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body to the edifying of itself in love.
target_text: aa èdhi j'aj'i nuka sèmi ngi'u na. sama sèmi ngi'u dhèu èci, dhu dènge musi madha, hèb'a, kacui-aai, aa haga, ladhe sab'a sama-sama madhutu sasab'a ra èci-èci, na, ngi'u na asa tabha èra. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu unu yesus kristus sèra. ladhe èdhi pasue aa soru-bara èci dènge èci, tatu èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti asa tabha èra kahèi.

source_text: this i say therefore, and testify in the lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka, lula kètu ja'a, yesus kristus ka dhu nori ja'a. miu mamuri ia ka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. lula ngaa dhu ra tao sèra madhutu dhoka gagoa ra.

source_text: having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of god through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
target_text: rèngu raga leli, nuka sèmi dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga. ra mamuri pacèri nèti ama lamatua, lula ra kètu hadhu, aa pusi-pahae boe ne.

source_text: who being past feeling have given themselves over to lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
target_text: rèngu re'a heka makae. nèti èèna ka, ra madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara ho ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge mamuri kaj'alu. te ngaa re'a boe roca kahèi.

source_text: but ye have not so learned christ;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aj'a-nori boe miu j'ara mamuri kristus sèmi èèna!

source_text: if indeed ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in jesus:
target_text: te, ngaa dhu miu me'a le lula-nèti yesus kristus, a'aj'a èèna ka dhu mola. tatu miu tadèngi le!

source_text: that ye put off concerning the former manner of life the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts:
target_text: de tèke eele j'ara mamuri miu dhu dhui èèna! te ladhe miu mamuri kaj'alu madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha, na, miu dhu lèke le tipu. miu dènge heka hak mamuri sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: and be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa ama lamatua tao d'ara dènge ngangee miu j'aj'i hiu,

source_text: and that ye put on the new man, which after god is created in righteousness and true holiness.
target_text: ho miu j'aj'i dhèu hiu, madhutu ropa na. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pad'elo ku d'ara hiu miu, dhu mola-mèci dènge mera-milu.

source_text: wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbor: for we are members one of another.
target_text: de limuri ne, loe eele ka nèti kapod'e-kabèli! padhai lii èci dènge èci dhu mola, te èdhi dhu pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ngi'u èci dhu dènge musi madha, hèb'a, kacui-aai, aa dènge haga.

source_text: be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
target_text: ladhe nasa, baku ad'u sasala kahèi. hua iia miu pabe'a hari! baku tèke nanasa toke lod'o cèna!

source_text: neither give place to the devil.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe dadugu-rariu miu. baku golo ne!

source_text: let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi mana'u, ae eele ka! be'a risi dhèu sèmi sèra sab'a pake kacui-aai unu ra, sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra na soru-bara dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra.

source_text: let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace to the hearers.
target_text: ladhe padhai lii, na, baku hia lii karehe, masi ka ca hèb'a doko-doko di! hua iia risi padhai lii dhu be'a di. aa holo dhèu sèna ka ra soru-bara dènge be'a, aa pa'èra d'ara si.

source_text: and grieve not the holy spirit of god, whereby ye are sealed to the day of redemption.
