target_text: baku papèd'a d'ara roh ama lamatua, te nèngu pea ètu d'ara miu. aa na cap nare miu, peka na, miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. roh na j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, toke d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ama lamatua sui nare miu, sèna ka mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamor, and evil-speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
target_text: de baku tèka d'ara dènge dhèu leo! bqku kadhi ngutu dènge dhèu! baku panasa! baku patao-palaha! baku padhai kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu! aa baku ad'u-ue j'ara bhabhelu dhu leo-leo hèi!

source_text: and be ye kind one to another, tender-hearted, forgiving one another, even as god for christ's sake hath forgiven you.
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi mi pasue, aa tao j'ara dhu be'a èci dènge èci. miu hud'i pabhèlu eele ku sasala dhèu, aa hia si abho, sama sèmi ama lamatua saku eele sasala miu, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus.

source_text: be ye therefore followers of god, as dear children;
target_text: miu ana pasue ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madhutu ku dad'èi na.

source_text: and walk in love, as christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to god for a sweet-smelling savor.
target_text: aa miu hud'i mamuri pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sue miu. te na soro le ngi'u na, ho madhe gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu j'aj'i nuka sèmi badha sogo-tagu dhu ra tunu ka hèu mèngi, sèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: but lewdness and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
target_text: miu dhèu mola-mèci unu ama lamatua kahèi. de baku mamuri dènge d'ara kaj'alu! baku ngee madha j'ara kaj'alu kahèi! de baku tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali èu! baku manga'a dèu ngara!

source_text: neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
target_text: baku padhai lii kaj'alu! aa baku padhai lii leli! te dhèu unu ama lamatua, ladhe padhai lii sèmi sèra, lèke boe. hua iia risi miu padhai lii be'a aa manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: for this ye know, that no lewd, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of christ and of god.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! te ama lamatua nare boe dhèu dhu mamuri kaj'alu, aa dhèu dhu tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali nèngu! rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, aa ama lamatua j'aj'i boe dhèu aae rèngu. ama lamatua sèmi nare boe kahèi dhèu dhu manga'a dèu ngara, lula rèngu seti eele ne, ka ra pakab'ua risi j'ara dhu leo sèra.

source_text: let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of god upon the children of disobedience.
target_text: mage dhèu pagoa miu dènge padhai lii hèb'a hua, peka na, mamuri kaj'alu ciki di, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, we! te tatu ama lamatua nasa mi dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu boe dad'èi na.

source_text: be ye not therefore partakers with them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, baku pa'èki ngi'u dènge dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for ye were sometime darkness, but now are ye light in the lord: walk as children of light;
target_text: uru èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, lula miu tadhe mèka ama lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, na hia le saraa, sèna ka tao miu j'aj'i ana-ana na. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i mamuri ètu d'ara saraa na.

source_text: for the fruit of the spirit is in all goodness, and righteousness, and truth;
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri taruu ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu ne tao j'ara dhu be'a, mamuri mola, aa leko-monya boe.

source_text: proving what is acceptable to the lord.
target_text: tenge taruu j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ne dhèu aae èdhi.

source_text: and have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
target_text: baku pa'èki ngi'u dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. te tatao ra, gaguna aad'o. de mi pasanèd'e si, aa bhoke paled'a sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: for it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done by them in secret.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue pahuni-pacub'i, kaj'alu titu kèna, toke èdhi makae, ladhe neo padhai lii j'ara-j'ara sèra.

source_text: but all things that are reproved, are made manifest by the light: for whatever doth make manifest is light.
target_text: ja'a pakasame sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu d'elo mèdha èci ètu d'ara maroga, tatu dhèu bisa rèdhi mèu.

source_text: wherefore he saith, awake, thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and christ will give thee light.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi peka paled'a j'ara bhelu dhu dhèu ad'u-ue, nèngu bisa ne'a, na, j'ara dhu na ad'u-ue ne, karehe. abhu lii sod'a èci, peka na, wee! miu dhu bhèj'i, kèd'i ka! miu dhu madhe, mamuri hari ka! te kristus neo hia saraa mi miu.

source_text: see then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu èci-èci parisa paie mamuri mi, sèna ka baku sèmi dhèu goa. be'a risi pake ngangee dhu be'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
target_text: limuri ne dhèu loe boe tao j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu. de ladhe abhu lod'o tao j'ara dhu be'a, na baku pamata!

source_text: wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the lord is.
target_text: pangee paie-iie, ho me'a mèu dad'èi lamatua èdhi, sèna ka baku mi goa.

source_text: and be not drunk with wine, in which is excess; but be filled with the spirit;
target_text: baku mahu, te, ngaa dhu miu minu èèna ka dhu uli miu, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu karehe. te ngaa bhoke d'ara miu, sèna ka roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu uli miu.

source_text: speaking to yourselves in psalms, and hymns, and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the lord,
target_text: de padhai lii èci dènge èci pake lii holo-nori ama lamatua, mèti lii koa-kio mi nèngu, aa mèti lii sod'a dhu miu abhu nèti roh mola-mèci na. aa ladhe sod'a, baku dhoka ètu hèb'a di, te ngaa koa-kio ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: giving thanks always for all things to god and the father, in the name of our lord jesus christ;
target_text: te yesus kristus j'aj'i le kètu èdhi, aa ama lamatua dhu tao le j'ara-j'ara ae titu kèna hia èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi baku loe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of god.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi, hud'i mamuri èci nanene èci. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pakab'ua yesus kristus.

source_text: wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as to the lord.
target_text: bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i mamuri nanene dhèu èmu mi, sama sèmi miu nanene yesus kristus, kètu miu.

source_text: for the husband is the head of the wife, even as christ is the head of the church: and he is the savior of the body.
target_text: te dhèu èmu miu èèna, nuka sèmi kètu nèti miu bhèni se. aa yesus kristus kahèi j'aj'i kètu nèti dhèu unu na. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho dhèu abhu mamuri.

source_text: therefore as the church is subject to christ, so let wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu unu kristus hud'i mamuri nanene paie-iie nèngu. de sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu, hud'i nanene pabe'a-be'a ku dhèu èmu na, ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: husbands, love your wives, even as christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu, sèmi èèna kahèi! miu hud'i sue dhèu èmu miu, èci èèna ka dènge kristus sue dhèu unu na, toke na soro ngi'u na, sèna ka madhe gati rèngu.

source_text: that he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna ka, ho rèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua, lula rèngu madhutu le lii holo-nori na, aa sarani le.

source_text: that he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
target_text: dhèu unu yesus kristus èci èèna ka dènge bhèni dhu neo kab'i dhu pagaa iisi na, te dhèu mone dhu neo kab'i èèna neo mai nare ne. sama sèmi èèna kahèi, kristus neo mai nare dhèu unu na sèra. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge be'a aa mola-mèci, toke abhu boe sasala ciki sa.

source_text: so ought men to love their wives, as their own bodies. he that loveth his wife, loveth himself.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu mi, nuka sèmi miu sue ngi'u miu mesa mi. te ladhe dhèu mone sue dhèu èmu na, sasoa na, nèngu sue ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: for no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the lord the church:
target_text: abhu boe dhèu dhu sue boe ngi'u na. te ngaa na lalau-lalo'o ngi'u na pabe'a-be'a, sèmi yesus ladhe-leru dhèu unu na paie-iie,

source_text: for we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
target_text: lula èdhi nuka sèmi ngi'u nèngu.

source_text: for this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri, peka na, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, te dua ra j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: this is a great mystery: but i speak concerning christ and the church.
target_text: te mamuri pasue dhèu èmu-kamali ne, lamatua bhoke le ètu d'ara lii holo-nori na nèti uru ka mai. j'ara ne'e ne, ka dhu kapai. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi te'a kahèi, na, lii holo-nori ne pad'elo sasue kristus mi dhèu unu na sèra.

source_text: nevertheless, let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself: and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
target_text: de dhèu mone hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu na, nuka sèmi sue ngi'u nèngu unu na. aa dhèu bhèni hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu èmu na.

source_text: children, obey your parents in the lord: for this is right.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ana-ana! miu hud'i mamuri nanene ku ina-ama mi, te èèna ka dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi d'ara lamatua èdhi.

source_text: honor thy father and mother which is the first commandment with promise
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri tèke le, peka na, èu hud'i pakab'ua ku ina dènge ama mu. ne'e ne lii paredha ama lamatua dhu uru tèka, dhu dènge lii pajaji.

source_text: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
target_text: te lod'o lamatua hia paredha èèna, nèngu moa kahèi, peka na, ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi èèna, pe èu abhu mèngi-nale ae-ae, aa mamuri èu madhii-manèro.

source_text: and, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the lord.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ina-ama sèra! miu baku ènyi aa lii taka leli ana-ana miu, te aad'o na, ra nasa ka ra parui. be'a risi miu lalau-lalo'o si paie-iie, aa nori si nèti ana iiki mai ho madhutu j'ara lamatua. ladhe ra tao sala, nori si dènge be'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to christ;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a! miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge lamatua dhu paredha miu ètu rai-haha ne, aa nanene ne. baku sab'a dènge d'ara cabèka, te ngaa madhutu dad'èi lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nuka sèmi miu madhutu dad'èi kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but as the servants of christ, doing the will of god from the heart;
target_text: te miu dhèu sab'a unu kristus. de ètu rai-haha ne miu baku sad'i sab'a di, lula lamatua dhu ladhe miu. te ngaa sab'a dènge d'ara maj'èni hia lamatua mi, masi ka nèngu aad'o ètu madha. te èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: with good will doing service, as to the lord, and not to men:
target_text: de sab'a sasab'a miu dènge d'ara kateme hia lamatua miu ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi miu sab'a hia ama lamatua, kètu èdhi.

source_text: knowing that whatever good thing any man doeth, the same will he receive from the lord, whether he be bond or free.
target_text: lula èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua b'ala hia dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a. masi ka rèngu dhèu sab'a do, lamatua do, ènu do, ènu boe do, nèngu b'ala aa'i mèu-mèu si.

source_text: and, ye masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua sèra! baku miu j'ege pamadha'u leli dhèu dhu sab'a hia miu sèra. te rèngu dènge lamatua ètu sorga kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge miu. ama lamatua ladhe boe rèhu dhèu, te ngaa na nanene dhèu cee èèna ka. masi ka lamatua do, dhèu sab'a do, na nanene si aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: finally, my brethren, be strong in the lord, and in the power of his might.
target_text: nanene pabe'a-be'a lii padhai ja'a dhu limuri tèka ne. miu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku parcaya miu mi ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka kètu miu, aa koasa na dhu dedha risi eele aa'i si. èèna na dhu bisa pa'èra miu!

source_text: put on the whole armor of god, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
target_text: sordad'u dènge rèka ho lab'a musu ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua neo pake miu sèmi sordad'u. te nèngu neo miu lab'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu aae nidhu ad'u-ue. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra ku, sèna ka pake aa'i rèka nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
target_text: te èdhi ètu d'ara pamusu! èdhi lab'a boe musu dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa èdhi lab'a koasa bhabhelu dhu èdhi tèdhi boe, lab'a dhu rèd'u paredha, lab'a koasa maroga, aa lab'a j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: wherefore take to you the whole armor of god, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
target_text: de miu hud'i pa'èra pake rèka aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua sèna ka bèli-camèd'a, ropa d'ai lod'o-lod'o bhabhelu-katub'a, miu bisa lab'a taruu. te ladhe miu taha, miu bisa segi.

source_text: stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breast-plate of righteousness;
target_text: de miu hud'i titu pa'èra-èra! parcaya dhoka lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke, te èèna nuka sèmi miu dhu bori dhari hake sordad'u. mamuri mola, te èèna sama sèmi miu silu kodho bèsi pa'abhe kakara.

source_text: and your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
target_text: pa'èra ho lami peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dhu pad'elo j'ara, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri padame dènge ama lamatua, te èci èèna ka dènge miu pake salapa sordad'u.

source_text: above all, taking the shield of faith, with which ye will be able to extinguish all the fiery darts of the wicked.
target_text: parcaya taruu mi lamatua, te parcaya èèna sama sèmi mèdha èci dhu sordad'u pake ho sili iisi nèti rèka musu. dènge parcaya sèmi èèna, miu bisa pamadhe ai ètu isi kataki nidhu bhelu, dhu ra siri mi miu.

source_text: and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the spirit, which is the word of god:
target_text: kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu dhu peka na, miu unu le mamuri nèti ama lamatua, te èèna sèmi sordad'u pake solo bèsi. kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti roh na dhu mola-mèci, te èèna sama sèmi sordad'u dhu kèpe samala.

source_text: praying always with all prayer and supplication in the spirit, and watching for this purpose with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
target_text: ladhe miu neo titu èra, na, miu baku loe sabaj'a pake koasa nèti roh mola-mèci ama lamatua. j'aga taruu aa baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia dhèu unu lamatua buli mia-mia.

source_text: and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that i may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
target_text: aa baku bhèlu kahèi sabaj'a hia ja'a. manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia kahèi lii holo-nori na, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka mola-mola naneo na mi dhèu leo.

source_text: for which i am an embassador in bonds: that therein i may speak boldly, as i ought to speak.
target_text: masi ka ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, te ngaa lamatua yesus pua-paleha ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ai g'ana nèngu. de sabaj'a hia ja'a, ho ja'a baku madha'u padhai dhu lèke, te èèna ka dhu j'aj'i sasab'a-la'a ja'a!

source_text: but that ye also may know my affairs, and how i do, tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the lord, will make known to you all things:
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu me'a mèu mamuri ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pua tikikus dhiu asa miu. nèngu ne, a'ari pasue ja'a, aa na maj'èni pakako sasab'a kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: whom i have sent to you for the same purpose, that ye may know our affairs, and that he may comfort your hearts.
target_text: hud'i laa na lole j'ara-j'ara mamuri èdhi ètu ne'e. aa ja'a neo, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu kahèi.

source_text: peace be to the brethren, and love with faith from god the father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ho tao miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci, aa pasue èci dènge èci, lula miu parcaya mi rèngu.

source_text: grace be with all them that love our lord jesus christ in sincerity. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi, sèna ka kètu èdhi, kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne taruu. sasuri ja'a, d'ai sange ne'e ka. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul and timothy, the servants of jesus christ, to all the saints in christ jesus who are at philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
target_text: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, paulus. aa angalai ja'a, timotius pa'adhu hia miu lii maho'o kahèi. ji'i dua mi se, ana sab'a nèti yesus kristus. ji'i pa'adhu sasuri ne, hia mi dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu kota pilipi. ji'i neo kahèi, ho dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra, re'a mèu isi sasuri ne'e.

source_text: grace be to you, and peace, from god our father and from the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, ama èdhi. aa yesus kristus èèna, kètu èdhi. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho bisa mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i thank my god upon every remembrance of you,
target_text: masi ka nèbhu le ja'a paraga heka dènge miu, te ngaa ja'a bhèlu boe miu! lod'o-lod'o ja'a sanèd'e miu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula miu parcaya ne taruu.

source_text: always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
target_text: lod'o ja'a sabaj'a hia miu, d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae,

source_text: for your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
target_text: lula karèi nèti hiu-hiu miu sèmi mere lii lolo be'a lamatua, miu pakako taruu sasab'a na, sama-sama dènge ja'a.

source_text: being confident of this very thing, that he who hath begun a good work in you, will perform it until the day of jesus christ:
target_text: èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ama lamatua mulai sab'a ètu d'ara miu kèna. aa ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, lamatua pakako taruu sasab'a na dhu be'a èèna, toke pamèci aa'i mèu-mèu, toke d'ai lod'o yesus kristus mai hari.

source_text: even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because i have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a ladhe ja'a sue miu, lula d'ara ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge miu karèi nèti uru ka. ca hari nèi, miu sab'a le bera-bera dènge ja'a, lod'o ja'a lole dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua, aa ropa ja'a dhaa mi dhèu dhu lab'a lii lolo be'a èèna. masi ka ja'a maso bui, te ngaa miu hari boe nèti baboa ja'a.

source_text: for god is my witness, how greatly i long after you all in the bowels of jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu ne'a, na, d'ara ja'a neo taruu paraga dènge miu. te sasue ja'a mi dedha miu, èci èèna ka dènge sasue yesus kristus.

source_text: and this i pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment; that ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offense till the day of christ;
target_text: de ja'a sabaj'a hia miu sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a manèngi ho miu asa tabha pasue èci dènge èci. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka ama lamatua hia miu me'a mèu, mia dhu be'a, sèna ka miu mamuri mola-mèci. pe d'ai lod'o kristus pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na peka na, miu sala boe ngaa-ngaa,

source_text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by jesus christ, to the glory and praise of god.
target_text: lula nèngu mesa na ka dhu tao d'ara miu mola-mèci, ho bisa mamuri mola. dènge mamuri mola sèmi èèna ka, dhèu leo ded'e padedha-dedha aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: but i would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened to me have fallen out rather to the furtherance of the gospel;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu me'a, na, abhu dhèu dhu pasusa ja'a, toke pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho. te ngaa te'a boe, na, lii lolo be'a lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia,

source_text: so that my bonds in christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
target_text: toke sordad'u dhu madhenga èmu dhèu aae, dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, ja'a maso bui lula madhutu yesus kristus.

source_text: and many of the brethren in the lord, becoming confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
target_text: ka dhèu unu ama lamatua ètu se'e se rèdhi, na, lamatua ka dhu tao j'ara èèna lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne. nèti èèna ka, rèngu asa tabha bani, toke re'a heka madha'u. hèia ra padhai paled'a-led'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu mia-mia.

source_text: some indeed preach christ even from envy and strife; and some also from good will. the one preach christ from contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds: but the other from love, knowing that i am set for the defense of the gospel.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu dua rupa dhèu dhu maj'èni aj'a j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti kristus. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola, aa abhu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara koe-kapengo. dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola, rèngu be'a dènge ja'a. dhèu se re'a mèu, na, ja'a dui sasusa ne, lula pakako sasab'a ja'a, dhu hari boe kabodho ciki sa. te ngaa dhu sab'a dènge d'ara koe-kapengo, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèti rèngu aa tenge kolongara di. rèngu pamae-pamanyèla dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sad'i abhu dhèu dhu madhutu ra. te ra tenge j'ara ho bisa padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu risi ja'a. rèngu pangee, na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu madhutu rèngu, èèna na asa tabha paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara bui.

source_text: what then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretense or in truth, christ is preached; and i therein do rejoice, yes, and will rejoice.
target_text: te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! ja'a pusi-pahae boe, ladhe dhèu aj'a dènge d'ara mola, do aad'o. sad'i dhu rèngu aj'a, dhoka lula-nèti yesus kristus di! èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a karej'e tare'a-re'a,

source_text: for i know that this will turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the spirit of jesus christ,
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a, na, miu sabaj'a hia ja'a, aa roh yesus kristus dhu soru-bara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ke'a, na, lèpa lod'o limuri, aa'i-aa'i se èle dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing i shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also, christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.
target_text: masi ka ja'a muri do, madhe do, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i ama lamatua pake ja'a, sèna ka ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara yesus kristus, aa aj'a mola-mola lula-nèti nèngu, toke abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu pamakae ja'a. se'e se ka dhu ja'a sanao karèi nèti uru, toke doe ne'e ne.

source_text: for to me to live is christ, and to die is gain. but if i live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labor: yet what i shall choose i know not. for i am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with christ; which is far better:
target_text: te ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ja'a mamuri, na, hud'i laa pa'èki dènge kristus, aa pakako taruu sasab'a-la'a na. èèna ka dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe ja'a madhe, ja'a oto risi hari, lula ja'a tèke eele rai-haha ne, aa mamuri hari ho pea pa'èci dènge kristus ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a kajari, aa ke'a boe mia ka dhu be'a risi eele!

source_text: nevertheless, to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ka laa! lula miu parluu ja'a era ètu ne'e, be'a risi ja'a pea pa'èci dènge miu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and having this confidence, i know that i shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, mamuri ja'a madhera era, sèna ka paraga hari dènge miu. te lamatua neo ho ja'a pa'èra d'ara miu, hèia miu asa lèka ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: that your rejoicing for me may be more abundant in jesus christ by my coming to you again.
target_text: de bèli-camèd'a miu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara yesus kristus, lula na bhoke le j'ara sèna ka ja'a lèpa pa'asu-pareo hari dènge miu.

source_text: only let your manner of life be as it becometh the gospel of christ: that whether i come and see you, or else be absent, i may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel; and in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that from god.
target_text: masi ka tasa mera mia, mamuri miu hud'i lèke ku, te miu dhèu unu lamatua. de miu hud'i mamuri dhu mèci ku, aa tao madhutu lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu peka le dènge miu. aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, do tadèngi dhoka lii nèti dhèu di, peka na, miu mamuri mola, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e. te ja'a bisa ke'a, na, miu dhu mamuri d'ara èci, lula pa'èki dènge roh èci di. aa bisa ke'a, na, miu pa'èra ho pakako sama-sama lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, sèna ka dhèu leo parcaya kahèi. aa miu me'a boe madha'u kahèi, masi ka abhu dhèu dhu lab'a miu. ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tadha hia musu, na, ama lamatua neo lalèta eele si. te ngaa ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, ho bèli-camèd'a miu mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: for to you it is given in the behalf of christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
target_text: te, lula ama lamatua d'ara hua iia risi, nèti èèna ka na bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya kristus, aa j'aj'i dhèu unu na. mesa boe parcaya di, te ngaa lamatua soro tèke miu abhu sasusa kahèi, lula miu madhutu nèngu.

source_text: having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
target_text: te dhu ja'a tadèngi, abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu lab'a miu, lula miu pakako lii lolo be'a kristus. sanèd'e, te ca hari ni rèngu lab'a le ja'a kahèi, toke d'ai doe ne'e ne.

source_text: if there is therefore any consolation in christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i, unu yesus kristus! na pangèd'u le miu j'ara be'a ae-ae. de miu bisa pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci. miu bisa holo dhu mai nèti sasue miu. miu bisa mamuri pabe'a èci dènge èci, lula roh lamatua dhu sab'a ètu talora aae miu. aa miu bisa pad'elo rasa kasia miu dènge d'ara be'a èci dènge èci.

source_text: fulfill ye my joy, that ye be like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
target_text: ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e kea rae-rae. risi-risi hari, ladhe miu pasue dènge d'ara èci, mamuri ètu ca j'ara, aa mere lii èci ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a.

source_text: let nothing be done through strife or vain glory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
target_text: baku tao ngaa-ngaa dhu tenge dhoka pa'oto ngi'u èu risi nèti dhèu leo. aa baku pangee, na, èu risi nèti dhèu leo. te pamone do pabhèni èu èèna, dènge boe kolo-kapua. te ngaa èdhi hud'i pahaha iisi ku, sèna ka te'a, na, dhèu leo risi nèti èdhi.

source_text: look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
target_text: aa baku dhoka uri mamuri miu mesa-mesa mi. te ngaa èdhi hud'i ladhe kahèi, ngaa dhu dhèu leo parluu.

source_text: let this mind be in you, which was also in christ jesus:
target_text: te d'ara èdhi hud'i sama ku sèmi d'ara yesus kristus.

source_text: who, being in the form of god, thought it not robbery to be equal with god:
target_text: masi ka nèngu ca ropa dènge ama lamatua, aa nèngu kètu èdhi kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua, te ngaa na tèke eele hak na, aa pake boe dadedha dènge kapai na.

source_text: but made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
target_text: hèia na puru mai asa rai-haha ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rai-haha. na tèke eele hak na aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao iisi na j'aj'i nuka sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: and being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient to death, even the death of the cross.
target_text: mesa boe j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli di, te ngaa na tao ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu dhu laku-laku boe kahèi, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. masi ka ra pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, na sèmi nare kahèi, aa madhe, nuka sèmi dhèu bhelu.

source_text: wherefore god also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
target_text: lula nèngu pahaha iisi sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha. aa pangèd'u ne ngara dhu kapai aae. te abhu boe ngara èci sa dhu kapai aae risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: that at the name of jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things on earth, and things under the earth;
target_text: ama lamatua ded'e padedha-dedha ngara na èèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ne. nuka: dhèu ètu dedha-liru, dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu mamuri dènge dhèu madhe. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and that every tongue should confess that jesus christ is lord, to the glory of god the father.
target_text: aa bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i peka na, yesus kristus èèna, tare'a-re'a lamatua! dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pea ètu kota pilipi era, miu nanene lii padhai ja'a, ka miu madhutu j'ara mola ama lamatua. limuri ne, èdhi pahag'a, te ngaa ja'a manèngi ho miu titu èra ètu d'ara mamuri mola. sanèd'e, te ladhe miu nanene boe nèngu, bèli-camèd'a pe mèdhi unu mi! lula nèngu ka dhu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo mi. hèia miu mamuri dhu mèci, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: for it is god who worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu sab'a ètu d'ara miu. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu neo nanene ne. aa nèngu ka dhu hia koasa kahèi, ho miu d'èi sab'a pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: do all things without murmurings and disputings:
target_text: de ladhe sad'i miu tao ngaa èèna ka, na, baku ka'uu-kamuki, aa baku pasibha d'ara lii.

source_text: that ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of god, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
target_text: tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. miu mamuri ètu d'ara talora aae dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te ngaa baku madhutu si! te mamuri miu hud'i mola-mèci ku, lula miu ana-ana lamatua. hèia mamuri miu hud'i heo ku, ho pad'elo j'ara hia rèngu, nuka sèmi hua-hètu dhu pasaraa ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: holding forth the word of life; that i may rejoice in the day of christ, that i have not run in vain, neither labored in vain.
target_text: hèia miu mamuri mola dènge pakako lii holo-nori lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a miu tao d'ara ja'a kea rae-rae, lod'o yesus kristus lèpa hari mai. aa rui-j'aj'èra ja'a core eele boe iia d'ara, te ngaa dènge kab'ua.

source_text: and if i am even offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, i joy, and rejoice with you all. for the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe sèmi ja'a dutu pa'èle aa'i mèu-mèu mamuri ja'a, ho j'aj'i nuka sèmi korban èi anggor, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya asa èra, aa pakako sasab'a lamatua, ja'a sèmi kore mamadhe dènge karej'e. èèna nuka sèmi ama agama tiko èi anggor ètu mei korban, ho pahaha iisi mi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi bisa sama-sama karej'e, lula korban ne, iia d'ara boe.

source_text: but i trust in the lord jesus to send timothy shortly to you, that i also may be of good comfort, when i know your state.
target_text: ja'a sanao, nèbhu heka, lamatua yesus bhoke j'ara, ho ja'a pua timotius dhiu, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu. èle èèna, na lèpa hari mai sa ne'e, ho na lolo dènge ja'a kakako miu, aa pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: for i have no man like-minded, who will naturally care for your state.
target_text: ja'a pua boe dhèu leo, dhoka timotius di, lula nèngu ne d'ara èci dènge ja'a. aa na sue tare'a-re'a miu.

source_text: for all seek their own, not the things of jesus christ.
target_text: nèngu ne, sama boe dènge a'ari dhu leo sèra. te rèngu sèra pangee dhoka ngi'u rèngu unu ra, te ngaa uri boe ngaa-ngaa dhu pamèci hia yesus kristus.

source_text: but ye know the proof of him, that as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
target_text: te ngaa miu me'a le, na, timotius sab'a d'ai madhe, pakako sasab'a ama lamatua. na sab'a dènge ja'a nuka sèmi ana dhu sab'a hia ama na. ji'i dua mi la'a peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus ètu mia-mia.

source_text: him therefore i hope to send presently, so soon as i shall see how it will go with me.
target_text: ladhe rèngu pama'ète rare ku lii langu ja'a, ja'a heka pua timotius dhiu asa miu kèna.

source_text: but i trust in the lord that i also myself shall come shortly.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua pa'èra d'ara ja'a, na, nèbhu heka ja'a bisa dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: yet i supposed it necessary to send to you epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labor, and fellow-soldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra era, miu pua a'ari èdhi epaproditus mai ladhe-leru ja'a. na pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a, nuka sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu maj'èni madhutu paredha komedhaa na. te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a neo pua na lèpa hari asa miu.

source_text: for he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because ye had heard that he was sick.
target_text: te d'ara na neo ae le nèdhi miu. aa na ngee miu, lula ne'a, na, miu tadèngi le nèngu dhu pèd'a.

source_text: for indeed he was sick nigh to death: but god had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest i should have sorrow upon sorrow.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a. ca hari ni, na pèd'a aae oe madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua sue ne, aa lamatua sue ja'a kahèi, ka na puri-pa'èle epaproditus, sèna ka ja'a baku asa susa.

source_text: i sent him therefore the more speedily, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that i may be the less sorrowful.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo pua hari na lèpa, ho bisa paraga hari dènge miu dènge d'ara karej'e-karae. ladhe sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a heka mau kèna.

source_text: receive him therefore in the lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation: because for the work of christ he was nigh to death, not regarding his life, to supply the want of your service towards me.
target_text: de miu hud'i sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, te nèngu ne dhèu unu lamatua. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ca ropa dènge ne. te nèngu pakako sasab'a kristus, toke oe madhe. aa nèngu hari boe kabodho ciki sa, lula na neo soru-bara ja'a, gati miu. de sèmi mere hari ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: finally, my brethren, rejoice in the lord. to write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! d'ara miu hud'i karej'e ku, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. masi ka ja'a suri pahari-pahari, te ngaa ja'a roca boe pasanèd'e miu sèna ka baku lèke tipu!

source_text: beware of dogs, beware of evil-workers, beware of the concision.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu laka-seti dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i suna ku, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, miu se dhèu unu lamatua. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua paredha boe sèmi èèna! rèngu sala le èèna! te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ra bata-magèla dhèu nuka sèmi busa pakadhi sa.

source_text: for we are the circumcision, who worship god in the spirit, and rejoice in christ jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
target_text: te rèngu peka, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu lula rèngu suna. te ngaa èèna sala! èdhi te'a le, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu lula ra parcaya yesus. ka dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a unu lamatua, nuka èdhi dhu parcaya yesus! èdhi dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu, madhutu roh na dhu mola-mèci. èdhi ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha yesus kristus, lula na bhoke nare le j'ara, ho èdhi bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. te èdhi bisa boe abhu mamuri, lula madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: though i might also have confidence in the flesh. if any other man thinketh that he hath reason to trust in the flesh, i more:
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a pangee dhu èci èèna ka dènge rèngu kahèi, peka na, dhèu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, sad'i ra suna. madhutu iia-iia na, sèra sa sasab'a dhèu rai-haha di! ladhe neo padhue sasab'a dhèu rai-haha, na, ja'a bisa padhai lii padedha iisi risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i, lula uru èèna sasab'a ja'a lèke mola-mola dènge atora agama dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of israel, of the tribe of benjamin, a hebrew of the hebrews; with respect to the law, a pharisee; concerning zeal, persecuting the church; with respect to the righteousness which is by the law, blameless.
target_text: madhutu atora agama, ina-ama ja'a suna ja'a, ropa ja'a d'ai aru lod'o. ja'a ne dhèu yahudi tare'a-re'a, lula j'aj'aj'i ja'a nèti suku benyamin, ana-èpu nèti baki isra'el. ja'a maj'èni titu kèna, madhutu mola-mola atora aa'i-aa'i nèti partei agama parisi, toke abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pasala ja'a. risi-risi hari, ja'a d'èi titu kèna, paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu kristus, lula madhutu a'abhu ja'a, na, dhèu se rai eele le atora agama èdhi.

source_text: but what things were gain to me, those i counted loss for christ. yes doubtless, and i count all things to be loss for the excellence of the knowledge of christ jesus my lord: for whom i have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them to be dung, that i may win christ,
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, ka ngangee ja'a kabèli, ropa ja'a madhutu kristus. de limuri ne, ja'a padedha heka iisi dènge j'ara mamuri dhu uru sèra, lula dènge heka sasoa ngaa-ngaa hia mi mamuri ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a, na, dhu dedha risi nuka: ja'a tadhe kristus, kètu ja'a èèna. j'ara leo aa'i-aa'i ra, nuka sèmi mamumu di.

source_text: and be found in him, not having my own righteousness, which is from the law, but that which is through the faith of christ, the righteousness which is from god by faith:
target_text: ja'a neo mamuri pa'èki dènge yesus kristus. te masi ka ja'a madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi, tatu mèka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a. aa masi ka ja'a pangee, na, ngi'u ja'a mola, tatu boe lamatua sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. te ngaa ja'a hud'i parcaya ku kristus, heka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a kèna, peka na, lula kristus saku eele le sasala èu, nèti èèna ka èu j'aj'i mola-mèci.

source_text: that i may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable to his death;
target_text: ka dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: ja'a neo tadhe pamèu-mèu kristus. ja'a neo ke'a mèu kahèi koasa ama lamatua dhu na pake ho pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. ladhe sèmi abhu dhèu dhu neo paj'èra ja'a, lula ja'a madhutu kristus, na, hud'i nèngu sène. te dhèu paj'èra kristus kahèi. aa ladhe abhu dhèu neo pamadhe ja'a, lula ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, na, ja'a sèmi kore kahèi. te kristus madhe hia ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: if by any means i may attain to the resurrection of the dead.
target_text: aa ladhe ja'a madhe, pe nèngu pamamuri hari ja'a kahèi.

source_text: not as though i had already attained, either were already perfect: but i pursue, if that i may apprehend that for which also i am apprehended by christ jesus. brethren, i count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing i do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forward to those things which are before,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo titu kèna madhutu j'ara mamuri kristus dènge dad'èi na aa'i-aa'i. te ngaa ladhe peka dhu mola-mola, ja'a tao lèke mèka sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra ngi'u, lula yesus kristus hag'e nare le ja'a ho madhutu ne. ja'a nuka sèmi dhèu dhu rai pa'èra-èra, sèna ka bisa d'ai lane. de ja'a rai mola-mola asa madha, dhu kabib'a boe kabodho, ho ngee j'ara uru sèra. ja'a pabhèlu eele aa'i si.

source_text: i press towards the mark for the prize of the high calling of god in christ jesus.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a rai pamèdhu-mèdhu toke d'ai lane, sèna ka abhu piala. hadia ja'a èèna nuka: bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a ètu sorga, lula ja'a parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: let us therefore, as many as are perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye are otherwise minded, god will reveal even this to you.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi ho miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu mamuri sega dènge amo dhu èra ètu d'ara kristus, bisa d'ara èci dènge j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu ngee leo, na, hud'i laa ama lamatua paj'uj'u j'ara dhu hua iia hia nèngu.

source_text: nevertheless, to what we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, èdhi hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku, aa tao palèke j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua aj'a le èdhi.

source_text: brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them who walk so as ye have us for an example.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i laladhe ku j'ara mamuri ja'a sèna ka tao madhutu. miu cahag'e ètu sèra, j'ara mamuri èci èèna ka dènge ja'a. te ngaa miu dhu leo bisa laladhe nèti rèngu, sèna ka tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for many walk, of whom i have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of christ:
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu ae dhu lab'a kristus aa dhu sèmi boe dènge be'a mamadhe na ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. j'ara mamuri unu ra ka dhu peka na, rèngu lab'a kristus. ja'a peka kèdhi le miu lula-nèti dhèu dhu ca ropa dènge rèngu, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a pasanèd'e hari miu dènge pahaa èi madha.

source_text: whose end is destruction, whose god is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a lamatua tule eele si, hèia pèci si asa d'ara ai naraka, lula d'ara rèngu dhu pa'èki boe dènge ne. rèngu mamuri dhoka ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a di, aa tenge j'ara sèna ka pakasee d'ara iisi unu ra, toke ra padedha iisi dènge bhabhelu rèngu sèra. dhèu sèra dhu re'a heka makae. ngangee rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua.

source_text: for our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the savior, the lord jesus christ:
target_text: miu baku madhutu si, te ngaa madhutu la ji'i. lula èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, dhu dènge hak j'aj'i ana-ana kabarai sorga. limuri ne èdhi tatae kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te bèli-camèd'a na lèpa hari mai nèti sorga, ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti nanasa ama lamatua.

source_text: who will change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like to his glorious body, according to the working by which he is able even to subdue all things to himself.
target_text: èèna na, kristus ub'a ngi'u èdhi dhu roe dhu bisa madhe ne, j'aj'i mi ngi'u hiu dhu madhe boe nuka sèmi ngi'u na dhu èra aae èèna. na ub'a ngi'u aae èdhi ne, pake koasa na dhu kapai seli eele èèna. aa na pake kahèi koasa èèna, sèna ka tao aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu mia-mia, ho madhutu paredha na.

source_text: therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the lord, my dearly beloved.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! nèti se'e se, ka ja'a manèngi ho miu mamuri mola taruu, aa baku koe-kapengo. ja'a neo taruu kèdhi miu. te miu se ka dhu j'aj'i parcaya nèti rui-j'aj'èra ja'a. miu pamaho'o dènge pakarej'e d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a bisa boti kètu, lula miu.

source_text: i beseech euodias, and beseech syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the lord.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka bhèni dhèu dua sèra, nuka yodia dènge sinteke, ho loe eele ka nèti patao-palaha. rèngu hud'i padame ku, ho pabe'a èci dènge èci. lula lamatua rèngu èci di, nèti èèna ka pa'èki rèngu èci dènge èci.

source_text: and i entreat thee also, true yoke-fellow, help those women who labored with me in the gospel, with clement also, and with other my fellow-laborers, whose names are in the book of life.
target_text: angalai, ee! ja'a manèngi ho èu uri ku ana hèni èdhi bhèni dhèu dua sèra, toke ra pabe'a hari. te uru èèna, rèngu sab'a rèdhi le, ho soru-bara ja'a ètu peka-padhue dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua. rèngu sab'a rèdhi sèmi èèna kahèi sama-sama dènge klemens, dènge angalai dhu leo. ngara rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra suri le ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua dhu suri ngara-ngara dhèu dhu bèli-camèd'a mamuri sama-sama dènge ne ètu sorga.

source_text: rejoice in the lord always: and again i say, rejoice.
target_text: lula miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu hud'i karej'e ku mèda-mèu. ja'a peka hari catèka: pakarej'e taruu d'ara miu!

source_text: let your moderation be known to all men. the lord is at hand.
target_text: d'ara miu hud'i maho'o kahèi dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. aa baku bhèlu, peka na, lamatua yesus nèbhu heka mai hari.

source_text: be anxious for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to god.
target_text: ladhe miu paraga dènge j'aj'èra, na, baku d'ara miu roe dènge ngaa èci sa. te ngaa sabaj'a ho manèngi ama lamatua soru-bara miu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu manèngi se, baku bhèlu manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and the peace of god, which passeth all understanding, will keep your hearts and minds through christ jesus.
target_text: ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, pe lamatua pamau d'ara miu. mema dhèu rai-haha ne, re'a mèu mèka d'ara dhu mau, dhu èdhi abhu nèti lamatua. te ngaa, lula miu parcaya yesus kristus, lamatua dhu pamau d'ara miu, neo j'aga miu sèna ka d'ara dènge ngangee miu baku kajari.

source_text: finally, brethren, whatever things are true, whatever things are honest, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think on these things.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! j'ara na sèmi ne'e ka: baku ngee dhu rupa-rupa. te ngaa j'aga ngangee miu, sèna ka ngee j'ara-j'ara dhu pamèci dènge d'ara lamatua, aa ngee j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu pakarej'e d'ara dhèu leo. miu hud'i ngee dhu mola dènge dhu mola-mèci. ngee j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, dènge dhu hua iia. tenge j'ara ho ra pakab'ua dhèu leo kahèi. tenge j'ara ho pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu hua iia. aa baku loe pangee nèti j'ara dhu be'a se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the god of peace will be with you.
target_text: ja'a aj'a-nori le miu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua. mamuri miu kahèi hud'i madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a, aa tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a padhue-padhai aa dhu tao kèdhi le. ladhe miu madhutu sèmi èèna, na, ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, aa bisa mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: but i rejoiced in the lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi dènge koa-kio ama lamatua, lula miu bhèlu boe ja'a. ja'a ke'a, na, uru èèna miu dhu sanèd'e taruu ja'a, te ngaa abhu mèka lod'o ho bara ja'a.

source_text: not that i speak in respect of want: for i have learned, in whatever state i am, with that to be content.
target_text: ja'a pangee boe manèngi miu ngaa-ngaa. te ja'a kura kèdhi mèka ngaa-ngaa èci sa, lula ja'a dhu tema le mamuri dènge ngaa dhu ja'a unu.

source_text: i know both how to be abased, and i know how to abound: every where and in all things i am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
target_text: ja'a mamuri kèdhi le dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ja'a mamuri kèdhi le kahèi dènge katei-kabheca. ja'a paraga le dènge kabake manganga, dènge kabake bècu. ètu d'ara ngaa èèna ka, ja'a dhu ke'a kore le rasia na ho bisa taha mamuri.

source_text: i can do all things through christ who strengtheneth me.
target_text: te ja'a bisa tago kore aa'i j'ara sèra, lula kristus ka dhu pa'èra ja'a!

source_text: notwithstanding ye have done well, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
target_text: masi ka tasa mera mia èèna, ja'a manèngi makasi, lula miu pad'elo le d'ara be'a miu, aa soru-bara ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra.

source_text: now, ye philippians, know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when i departed from macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
target_text: uru èèna, ropa ja'a kèd'i eele nèti propensi makedonia, ho laku pakako lii lolo be'a lamatua asa era leo, dhodhoka miu di nèti kota pilipi dhu ogo-oru ja'a. juma'at leo sèra, aad'o. te ngaa miu dhu me'a le lii lolo èèna.

source_text: for even in thessalonica ye sent once and again to my necessity.
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a ètu kota tesalonika èèna, miu pa'adhu doi catèka-dua hari, ho soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: not because i desire a gift: but i desire fruit that may abound to your account.
target_text: limuri ne, baku pangee, na, ja'a neo manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. te ja'a neo sèna ka lamatua pala-bagi miu mèngi-nale, lula miu d'ara be'a dènge ja'a.

source_text: but i have all, and abound: i am full, having received from epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odor of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, well-pleasing to god.
target_text: ja'a sèmi kore le nèti epaproditus, aa'i-aa'i dhu miu pa'adhu mai bara ja'a. se'e se j'aj'i mi berkat hia ja'a, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a kura boe ngaa-ngaa. se'e se j'aj'i nuka sèmi korban tunu dhu hèu mèngi, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua. aa lamatua sèmi nare korban èèna, lula pakarej'e d'ara nèngu.

source_text: but my god will supply all your need according to his riches in glory by christ jesus.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu ja'a pahaha iisi èèna, kaja seli eele. aa ne'a mèu ngaa dhu miu parluu. de na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pala hia miu mèngi-nale dhu risi eele, lula miu dhu pa'èki tèke le dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: now to god and our father be glory for ever and ever. amen.
target_text: de hud'i laa èdhi ded'e padedha-dedha taruu kolongara ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. ne'e ne ka dhu lèke mola-mola!

source_text: salute every saint in christ jesus. the brethren who are with me greet you.
target_text: ja'a pa'adhu lii maho'o ja'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu yesus kristus ètu kota pilipi. angalai ja'a ètu se'e se, hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: all the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of cesar's household.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu kota roma ne, hia lii maho'o kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge a'ari sèra dhu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae kapai ne. ra pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu kahèi.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you all. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. sasuri ja'a tèja mi ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of jesus christ by the will of god, and timothy our brother,
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu hag'e nare ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ètu ne'e, abhu kahèi a'ari èdhi timotius dhu pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu.

source_text: to the saints and faithful brethren in christ who are at colosse: grace be to you, and peace, from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, dhèu unu ama lamatua ètu kota kolose, dhu tao madhutu taruu j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama èdhi, ama lamatua, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: we give thanks to god and the father of our lord jesus christ, praying always for you,
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu ji'i sabaj'a hia miu, ji'i manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua dhu j'aj'i ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: since we heard of your faith in christ jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
target_text: te ji'i tadèngi ae le, nèti parcaya miu mi yesus kristus, aa nèti sasue dènge d'ara hua iia miu mi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: for the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, of which ye have heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
target_text: miu tao sèmi èèna, lula miu me'a mèu madha j'ara dhu be'a dhu tao tèke le hia miu ètu sorga. j'ara-j'ara sèra, miu tadèngi mèdhi le nèti lii holo-nori dhu lèke, nuka lii lolo be'a lamatua,

source_text: which is come to you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of god in truth:
target_text: dhu dhèu peka le dènge miu karèi nèti uru ka. lii lolo be'a ne, pale-lème le buli mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, aa abhu hua-hela dhu be'a, lula lii ne ub'a mamuri dhèu j'aj'i be'a. mamuri miu j'aj'i be'a sèmi èèna kahèi, karèi nèti hiu-hiu èèna miu tadèngi lii lolo be'a, dènge me'a mèu d'ara hua iia ama lamatua.

source_text: as ye also learned from epaphras our dear fellow-servant, who is for you a faithful minister of christ;
target_text: miu se abhu le a'aj'a ne'e nèti epapras, angalai d'ara sasab'a ji'i dhu ji'i sue. te nèngu maj'èni pakako taruu sasab'a yesus ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: who also declared to us your love in the spirit.
target_text: na lolo hia ji'i ètu ne'e lula-nèti sasue miu dhu roh lamatua pala-bagi hia miu.

source_text: for this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, karèi nèti lod'o hiu-hiu ji'i tadèngi j'ara mamuri miu, ji'i loe boe sabaj'a hia miu. ji'i manèngi ama lamatua, ho miu bisa me'a mèu dad'èi na, aa bisa me'a madha j'ara ae-ae, madhutu ngaa dhu roh na aj'a miu.

source_text: that ye may walk worthy of the lord to all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of god;
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa mamuri dhu lèke, dènge mèti kolongara hua iia ama lamatua. aa miu bisa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra kahèi. ladhe miu pad'elo d'ara be'a mi dhèu, pe lamatua hia miu hua-hela dhu be'a. dènge sèmi èèna, miu asa tadhe mèu lamatua.

source_text: strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, to all patience and long-suffering with joyfulness; giving thanks to the father, who hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light: who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his beloved son:
target_text: ji'i manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka nèngu hia miu koasa na dhu dedha risi èèna, ho miu bisa tago j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra dènge taha d'ara. ji'i manèngi ho d'ara miu dènge karej'e-karae, sèna ka miu manèngi makasi taruu mi ama lamatua. te na bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka miu sèmi mere pusaka pala miu ètu sorga. pusaka èèna ka dhu na pala-bagi mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu parcaya yesus kristus. te na patabuli eele le èdhi nèti koasa maroga, hèia na pamaso èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus sèna ka pea ètu d'ara saraa. ama lamatua ka dhu ded'e yesus kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae èdhi. yesus ne, ana pasue ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
target_text: te ama lamatua hia ana na, sèna ka sui nare èdhi, dènge saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: who is the image of the invisible god, the first-born of every creature:
target_text: kristus ne, ca ropa dènge ama lamatua, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa boe ladhe rèdhi. nèngu dhu mema le, uru nèti aa'i-aa'i, aa nèngu j'aj'i kètu nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i.

source_text: for by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are upon earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
target_text: te ama lamatua pake ne, ho paj'aj'i aa'i isi nèti dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. na paj'aj'i j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ladhe rèdhi, dènge dhu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi. nuka, rèngu dhu rèd'u paredha, rèngu dhu rèd'u koasa, dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu kapai-dhèu kapai sèra. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua neo tao sèra, na tao hia mi yesus kristus, aa yesus dhu sab'a sèra aa'i-aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
target_text: lod'o aa'i-aa'i se dhae j'aj'i mèka, te nèngu ka dhu mema-mema le. aa'i-aa'i se pa'èki dènge ne. aa nèngu ka dhu uri si.

source_text: and he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the first-born from the dead; that in all things he may have the pre-eminence.
target_text: nèngu ka dhu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i. aa dhèu parcaya sèra, nuka sèmi ngi'u na. te nèngu ka dhu pakako aa'i-aa'i si. nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe, hèia mamuri hari, nèngu ka dhu kapai risi, ho sèna ka nèngu ka dhu dedha risi aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: for it pleased the father that in him should all fullness dwell;
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara ama lamatua, abhu kahèi ètu d'ara kristus, aa èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: and, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things to himself; by him, i say, whether they are things on earth, or things in heaven.
target_text: ama lamatua pake yesus kristus, ho padame dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i le. na hia ana na, ho j'aj'i korban dhu pasuti raa na, aa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru, aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, bisa padame hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and you, that were formerly alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled,
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri ètu li'u, pakaj'èu nèti ama lamatua. miu pamusu dènge ne, ka mamuri pacèri nèti nèngu, lula d'ara miu karehe dènge tatao dhu bhelu èèna ka, miu lab'a taruu ne.

source_text: in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblamable and unreprovable in his sight:
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa limuri ne nèngu ka dhu bhoke le j'ara, ho èdhi bisa padame hari dènge ne. te nèngu ka dhu pua ana na, ho j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. aa nèngu ka dhu hia ana na èèna j'aj'i mi korban, aa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka èdhi bisa padame hari dènge ne. yesus kristus tao j'ara ne'e, ho bisa lere nèti èdhi lati titu ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci dènge d'ara mola, dhu dènge heka sasala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: if ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and are not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which hath been preached to every creature which is under heaven; of which i paul am made a minister;
target_text: sad'i miu taha taruu dènge lalèka miu. kèpe pa'èra-èra, sèna ka baku kalau! baku pakaj'èu nèti lii lolo be'a èèna, dhu miu sèmi mere ropa miu nanene hiu-hiu lii èèna. te lii lolo be'a èèna j'aj'i mi era sarai miu. dhèu lasi palolo lème le lii lolo be'a èèna ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. aa lamatua ka pua ja'a, paulus, sèna ka laku lole lii lolo be'a ne kahèi.

source_text: who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
target_text: lod'o kristus mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, na dui j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli. aa limuri ne, ja'a pasae rupa-rupa j'aj'èra kahèi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara ja'a karej'e taruu. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu hud'i abhu ku j'aj'èra, na, hud'i laa ja'a dui j'aj'èra èèna sama-sama dènge ra, nuka sèmi kristus pasae nare j'aj'èra nèti dhèu-dhèu unu na. te dhèu unu na, j'aj'i sama sèmi ngi'u nèngu.

source_text: of which i am made a minister, according to the dispensation of god which is given to me for you, to fulfill the word of god;
target_text: ama lamatua hia ja'a sasab'a na kahèi, ho ladhe-leru dhèu-dhèu unu na. nèti èèna ka, ja'a aj'a lii holo-nori na, toke lutu-sela hia miu.

source_text: even the mystery which hath been hid from ages, and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints: to whom god would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the gentiles; which is christ in you, the hope of glory:
target_text: dhèu tadèngi lii holo-nori lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa dhae re'a mèu mèka naneo nèti lii holo-nori se'e dènge be'a, te naneo na dhu pahuni era. te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua bhoke le naneo ne hia dhèu unu na. aa naneo na èèna, lii dhu kapai titu kèna pala mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. lii babe'a dhu kapai risi èèna, nuka: kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu! èèna na ka dhu tao miu parcaya taruu, peka na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu tao j'ara dhu hua iia risi hia miu ètu sorga. ne'e ne ka dhu èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne mate tae-tae karèi nèti uru-uru j'ara ka.

source_text: whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in christ jesus.
target_text: de ji'i peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti kristus. ji'i aj'a-nori dènge pasanèd'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, pake ngangee lii padhai dhu ama lamatua hia mi ji'i. ji'i tao j'ara se'e, ho pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu kristus, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a rèngu bisa titu ètu madha na, dhu dènge boe makae, lula ra mamuri mola taruu.

source_text: for which i also labor, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a titu pa'èra, aa sab'a j'èra titu kèna hia miu. ja'a bisa taha sab'a bia sèmi èèna, lula koasa kristus ka pa'èra ja'a. aa koasa na èèna, kapai titu kèna!

source_text: for i would that ye knew what great conflict i have for you, and for them at laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
target_text: miu dhu pea ètu kota kolose, aa miu ètu kota laodikia, dènge rèngu dhu paraga rèdhi mèka dènge ja'a. nanene paie-iie! ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a mèu sasab'a ja'a dhu bia ne hia miu, aa hia mi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: that their hearts may be comforted, being knit together in love, and to all riches of the full assurance of understanding to the acknowledgment of the mystery of god, and of the father, and of christ;
target_text: dad'èi ja'a ka, neo pa'èra d'ara rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka rèngu bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, lula ra mamuri pasue. hèia ra j'aj'i re'a mèu, lula rèngu re'a tare'a, na, uru èèna naneo lamatua pahuni era. dhu pahuni èèna, nuka kristus!

source_text: in whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki j'aj'i d'ara èci dènge kristus, heka na hia miu d'èlu-mèu dhu miu parluu, aa aj'a miu pake mamèu se, sèna ka tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. mamèu se'e se, nuka sèmi mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua.

source_text: and this i say, lest any man should deceive you with enticing words.
target_text: ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka mage dhoka dhèu mai kapod'e-kabèli miu dènge hèb'a mènyi.

source_text: for though i am absent in the flesh, yet i am with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in christ.
target_text: ja'a mema kaj'èu nèti miu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a bhèlu boe miu, lula d'ara ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge miu. aa ja'a karej'e, lula ke'a, na, miu mamuri dhu lèke, aa miu dhu kèpe pa'èra parcaya miu mi kristus era.

source_text: as ye have therefore received christ jesus the lord, so walk ye in him:
target_text: lula uru èèna miu sèmi mere le yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, nèti èèna ka limuri ne, miu hud'i nanene ne taruu. aa nèngu èèna j'aj'i kètu miu era.

source_text: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding in it with thanksgiving.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki taruu dènge ne sèmi èèna, miu nuka sèmi ana aaj'u dhu asa tabha èra, lula amo la'e asa marèma aae. aa miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu èra, lula dhu patitu ètu fanderen dhu èra. miu pa'èra taruu ètu d'ara lalèka miu, sama sèmi a'aj'a dhu miu abhu mèdhi le. hud'i laa, sèna ka d'ara miu pasoa-pasoka ètu d'ara manèngi makasi, lula j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ama lamatua tao tèke le hia miu.

source_text: beware lest any man make a prey of you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after christ.
target_text: j'aga paie-iie, sèna ka baku madhutu dhèu leo dhu pake d'èlu-mèu dhèu rai-haha, ho ère rèti miu nèti j'ara mola. aa mage madhutu a'aj'a dhèu rai-haha dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te a'aj'a rèngu sèra dhoka mai nèti d'èlu-mèu dhèu rai-haha di, aa nèti atora-atora rai-haha ne. te ngaa a'aj'a sèra mai boe nèti kristus.

source_text: for in him dwelleth all the fullness of the godhead bodily.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara ama lamatua, abhu kahèi ètu d'ara kristus. aa kristus kahèi j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, èci èèna ka dènge èdhi.

source_text: and ye are complete in him, who is the head of all principality and power:
target_text: lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, aa j'aj'i dhèu unu na, nèti èèna ka, na tao pamèci miu. te nèngu dedha risi eele nèti koasa aa'i-aa'i dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha, masi ka dhu be'a do dhu bhelu.

source_text: in whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of christ:
target_text: lod'o suna dhèu yahudi, ra j'ue eele ka'uri dhu karisi nèti era makae ra, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, na, rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. lod'o miu maso j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, miu suna kahèi. sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: suna ne, lula boe nèti dhèu j'ue eele ka'uri nèti ngi'u aae ne, te ngaa kristus j'ue eele j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a nèti d'ara èdhi. nuka j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu dhu èdhi d'èi ad'u-ue, lula èdhi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: buried with him in baptism, in which also ye are raised with him through the faith of the operation of god, who hath raised him from the dead.
target_text: lod'o ra sarani miu pake èi, èèna nuka sèmi padhane miu, sama-sama dènge kristus. hèia miu abhu mamuri dhu hiu, sèmi nèngu unu mamuri hiu kahèi. miu abhu sèmi èèna, lula miu parcaya, peka na, ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. lamatua pake kahèi koasa ne'e ho sab'a ètu d'ara miu.

source_text: and you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he made alive together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
target_text: uru èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le, lula miu dhu tao sasala rupa-rupa, aa miu dhae j'aj'i mèka dhèu unu ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa na saku eele aa'i-aa'i sasala-sasigo miu, aa bagi hia miu mamuri hiu, sama sèmi na pamamuri hari yesus kristus.

source_text: blotting out the hand-writing of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
target_text: dhu mola-mola ka, èdhi hud'i abhu ku huku, lula èdhi sisu le atora-atora ama lamatua. te ngaa na saku eele le hahuku se'e ropa ra paku yesus kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: and having despoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
target_text: ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha ne, na segi aa'i le koasa maroga, aa aa'i-aa'i dhu paredha dènge bhabhelu. ka na pamakae si ètu madha dhèu ae-ae. aa'i-aa'i se, nuka sèmi sordad'u dhu segi musu, dhu lèpa kako palème rae dènge lii sod'a, sèna ka pad'elo sasegi ra aa pamakae musu ra.

source_text: let no man therefore judge you in food, or in drink, or in respect of a holy-day, or or the new-moon, or of the sabbaths:
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu neo pamanahu miu, nèti j'ara-j'ara ta'a-tinu, mage mi pusi-pahae si. aa ladhe dhèu neo tao lii dènge miu, nèti j'ara-j'ara lod'o be'a, do tao pesta hèru hiu, do atora lod'o ae sasab'a, na, baku pusi-pahae si.

source_text: which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of christ.
target_text: j'ara sèmi sèra sa, guna boe! te sèra sa nuka sèmi mamaho di, dhu èèna na ele. te ngaa kristus ne ka dhu asli. nèngu ne ele boe aa taa-taa.

source_text: let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshiping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo pamanahu miu, lula miu mo'o boe madhutu atora dhu rèngu tao unu ra, baku nanene si. te ladhe miu nanene si, miu bisa heka abhu j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu ama lamatua neo hia miu. de mage-mage! te mema abhu dhèu dhu d'èi tenge j'ara ho pamanahu miu. dad'èi ra, ladhe miu pahaha iisi miu, aa sogo-tagu ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga, lula ra pangee, na, abhu tanila dhu peka sèmi èèna. rèngu tao iisi ra be'a risi nèti dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i ra. madhutu iia-iia na, sèmi boe èèna. te ngangee ra sama sèmi dhèu rai-haha biasa di.

source_text: and not holding the head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of god.
target_text: kristus èèna kètu, te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe pa'èki dènge ne. aa dhèu unu kristus, nuka sèmi ngi'u na dhu na ator si. na tao dhèu unu na asa tabha èra, pake koasa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu j'aj'i nuka sèmi kalua dènge rui dhu pa'èki pa'èra-èra, sèna ka èci bara èci, toke ngi'u dhu kateme bisa sab'a dènge be'a.

source_text: wherefore, if ye are dead with christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
target_text: miu madhe le sama-sama dènge kristus. hèia miu pa'èki heka dènge koasa-koasa maroga ètu rai-haha ne. de nga tao ka miu loe boe madhutu rupa-rupa atora rai-haha? rèngu peka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: touch not; taste not; handle not;
target_text: mage kèpe ne'e; baku mi'e èèna, mage goi ne'e.

source_text: which all are to perish with the using; according to the commandments and doctrines of men?
target_text: te ngaa atora sèra, dhoka pa'ue-ai nèti dhèu rai-haha, ho ra aj'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. madhutu iia-iia na, atora sèra dhodhoka uri j'ara-j'ara dhu èèna na ele iia d'ara di!

source_text: which things have indeed a show of wisdom in will-worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honor to the satisfying of the flesh.
target_text: ladhe sèmi dhèu bisa tao madhutu atora sèra, ra pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu pakab'ua si, aa peka na, rèngu se d'èlu-mèu titu kèna; dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu kèpe pa'èra atora agama; dhèu dhu d'ara mako; dhèu dhu paj'èra ngi'u unu ra, dènge dhèu dhu maj'èni sogo-tagu. madhutu iia-iia na, aad'o! atora sèra bisa boe pamèu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhabhelu!

source_text: if ye then be raised with christ, seek those things which are above, where christ sitteth on the right hand of god.
target_text: ama lamatua hia le miu mamuri hiu, nuka sèmi nèngu pamamuri hari miu sama-sama dènge kristus. limuri ne, kristus madhèdi le ètu era dhu kab'ua risi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
target_text: pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua d'èi. baku pusi-pahae dènge j'ara dhu dhodhoka pakarej'e d'ara dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: for ye are dead, and your life is hid with christ in god.
target_text: te miu madhe kahèi, ropa kristus madhe. hèia mamuri hiu miu èèna kalau boe, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, dhu bera-bera dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: when christ, who is our life, shall appear, then will ye also appear with him in glory.
target_text: kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu, aa na pabe'a mamuri miu. bèli-camèd'a, ropa na lèpa hari mai, miu cèu palere-lere dènge ne kahèi ètu d'ara dadedha dènge kapai na!

source_text: mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; lewdness, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pèci eele ku dad'èi d'ara dhu neo tao bhabhelu-katub'a. nuka sèmi: d'ara d'èi tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali èu; d'ara d'èi tao j'ara-j'ara kaj'alu; d'ara d'èi dhu neo tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara di; d'ara d'èi tao bhabhelu rupa-rupa, aa manga'a dhu d'èi dhoka aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu èu di madhutu iia-iia na, sèra sa nuka sèmi èu sogo-tagu, lula èu ded'e padedha-dedha j'ara leo dhu seti eele lamatua.

source_text: for which things the wrath of god cometh on the children of disobedience:
target_text: j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao ama lamatua nasa titu kèna, toke na neo huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: in which ye also walked formerly, when ye lived with them.
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri sèmi èèna ka, lula d'ara miu pa'èki dènge j'ara bhelu sèra.

source_text: but now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i pèci eele ku dad'èi d'ara dhu neo ad'u-ue bhabhelu aa'i-aa'i. nuka sèmi: d'èi nasa; d'ara pana-mag'oro; tèka d'ara dènge dhèu; padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu; dènge padhai lii kaj'alu.

source_text: lie not one to another, seeing ye have put off the old man with his deeds; and have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
target_text: aa miu èci dènge èci baku kapod'e-kabèli. lula miu core eele le dad'èi d'ara dhu neo tao bhelu, aa tèke eele j'ara mamuri dhui sèra. aa limuri ne, miu gati dènge d'ara dhu hiu. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu core eele le mèdha-papake dhui dhu kaj'alu, sèna ka silu mèdha hiu dhu mèu. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i miu. aa limuri ne, na tao miu asa tadhe pabe'a-be'a nèngu, aa tao miu j'aj'i ca ropa dènge ne.

source_text: where there is neither greek nor jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, barbarian, scythian, bond nor free: but christ is all, and in all.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamuri hiu ne, èdhi hag'e boe, na, rèngu sèra dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe; dhèu dhu madhutu suna, do dhèu dhu suna boe; dhèu leo rai kara, do dhèu dhu ad'a aad'o; dhèu ènu, do ènu boe. se'e se kolo-karisi na, aad'o! te ngaa dhu lèke ka, ladhe rèngu pa'èki dènge kristus, aa nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara ra.

source_text: put on therefore, as the elect of god, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, long-suffering;
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na sue miu. dad'èi na sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci na dhu leko-leo nèti dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu d'ara hua iia, d'ara be'a, pahaha iisi, lii mako, dènge taha mere d'ara.

source_text: forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man hath a quarrel against any: even as christ forgave you, so also do ye.
target_text: miu hud'i taha mere d'ara, aa èci tadhe mèu èci. ladhe nèti miu, abhu dhu tenge lii langu dènge angalai na, na, baku tèka d'ara dènge ne. te ngaa miu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na, aa abho ne, nuka sèmi lamatua dhu pabhèlu eele le sasala miu.

source_text: and above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee. te sasue èèna risi aa'i nèti ngaa-ngaa. de miu hud'i pake sasue ne ètu d'ara miu, nuka sèmi mèdha-papake ètu ua. te sasue èèna, nuka sèmi loa hèngu dhu èdhi manènu, sèna ka j'aj'i sig'i dhu saraga titu kèna. ne'e ne ka dhu pa'èki èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: and let the peace of god rule in your hearts, to which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
target_text: èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua, lula kristus. de miu hud'i soro tèke kahèi dadame kristus ne, uri d'ara miu. te lamatua d'èi ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi mamuri mera-milu èci dènge èci, lula miu pa'èki j'aj'i ngi'u èci. aa d'ara miu hud'i me'a manèngi makasi, lula lamatua unu na ka hag'e nare miu.

source_text: let the word of christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms, and hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the lord.
target_text: hud'i laa lii holo-nori kristus uri d'ara miu dènge mamuri miu kahèi. lii holo-nori se'e, nuka sèmi mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua, dhu na pangèd'u mi miu. lii se'e pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa me'a madha j'ara ae-ae, madhutu ngangee lamatua. ka miu bisa pake lii se'e, sèna ka aj'a-nori, aa pasanèd'e miu èci dènge èci. ladhe nori dhèu-dhèu miu, mage dènge sakaa, te ngaa pake lii dènge d'ara dhu taleo moro-moro dhu pènu dènge rasa makasi. pake lii sod'a koa-kio, lii sod'a dhu miu abhu nèti roh mola-mèci lamatua, aa lii sod'a dhu miu mesa mi suri ho koa-kio ama lamatua.

source_text: and whatever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the lord jesus, giving thanks to god and the father by him.
target_text: miu j'aj'i le ai g'ana nèti yesus kristus. de sanèd'e, te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu padhue-padhai sèra, mèti kolongara lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tao sèra mèti kolongara lamatua kahèi. de baku bhèlu tao aa'i-aa'i dènge kolongara kètu miu, yesus kristus. aa manèngi makasi taruu mi ama na, ama lamatua.

source_text: wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as it is fit in the lord.
target_text: bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i mamuri nanene ku dhèu èmu miu, lula èèna ka dhu lèke mi dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu yesus kristus.

source_text: husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
target_text: mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu miu, aa baku sakaa dènge ne, ka papèd'a d'ara na.

source_text: children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well-pleasing to the lord.
target_text: ana-ana aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i nanene ina-ama miu, ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, te èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
target_text: ina-ama aa'i-aa'i! miu baku ènyi aa lii taka leli mi ana-ana miu, te aad'o na, ra nasa ka ra parui. mage-mage d'ara ra ta'u'a dènge miu.

source_text: servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing god:
target_text: dhèu sab'a sèra! ètu rai-haha ne miu hud'i tao ku madhutu dad'èi lamatua miu ètu d'ara sasab'a aa'i-aa'i ra. mage dhoka mere d'ara di, lod'o dhu lamatua miu ètu madha miu. te ngaa tenge la j'ara, ho pakarej'e taruu d'ara ra. sab'a dènge be'a, lula miu dhu me'a, na, ama lamatua dhu ladhe patae miu.
