source_text: and the angels who kept not their first state, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness to the judgment of the great day.
target_text: conto leo, nuka ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga. ama lamatua pangèd'u si koasa, te ngaa dènge lane kahèi. te ngaa rèngu cahag'e roca boe, hèia ra tao risi nèti hak rèngu. hèia lamatua èki si, pake rate dhu bisa boe ma'ète, aa taha si ètu era maroga sèna ka mate d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua neo pama'ète sasala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: even as sodom and gomorrah, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to impurity, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
target_text: aa mage bhèlu kota sodom dènge kota gomora, dènge rae-rae leo dhu padètu ètu sèra. dhèu-dhèu ra d'èi dhoka ad'u-ue rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu rèngu boe. rèngu d'èi titu kèna pa'èci dhu lèke-lèke boe kahèi. te ngaa lamatua pakèpu aa'i si pake ai. lii lolo ne pasanèd'e èdhi, peka na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua pake ai naraka dhu madhe boe èèna, sèna ka huku aa'i-aa'i dhu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu dhu maso asa talora aae miu sèra, mamuri ad'u-ue sasala taruu. aa te ngaa, lii nii ra, ka rèngu pake j'aj'i mi alasan ho pakaj'alu iisi ra, ho lab'a leli dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa, aa pahahe koasa-koasa dhu hua iia ètu sorga.

source_text: yet michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, the lord rebuke thee.
target_text: te ngaa mikael tao boe sèmi rèngu. nèngu èèna, madho nèti ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga. lod'o musa heka madhe èèna, mikael dhu pab'ala dènge dhèu aae nidhu lula-nèti ngi'u aae musa. te ngaa mikael pasala boe ne, do pahahe boe ne kahèi. dhoka na peka na, pe lamatua ka ator èu, heka èu sèmi more pala mu kèna!

source_text: but these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu maso asa talora aae miu, sama boe sèmi èèna. dhèu se pahahe aa pusi-pahae boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu rèngu re'a boe. rèngu dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di, nuka sèmi badha sa. nèti èèna ka, rèngu pa'ele iie ngi'u unu ra.

source_text: woe to them! for they have gone in the way of cain, and run greedily after the error of balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of core.
target_text: mata unu ra! pe sèmi rare pala ra. te tatao rèngu nuka sèmi kaen, dhu hake pamadhe ari d'èlu na. ra tao nuka sèmi balaam, dhu sab'a ngaa èèna ka, sad'i abhu doi. rèngu tao kahèi sama sèmi kora, dhu unu mamadhe-mamopo lula palab'a dènge lamatua. lula bhabhelu-katub'a ra, èèna na rèngu pakaj'èu nèti lamatua kahèi.

source_text: these are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about by winds; withered autumnal trees, without fruit, twice dead, plucked out by the roots;
target_text: ladhe rèngu pakaboko dènge miu ho sanèd'e sasue lamatua, lod'o miu mi'a sama-sama, na, rèngu re'a boe makae, aa manga'a dèu ngara. de miu baku pamud'e. te rèngu nuka sèmi hadhu aae ètu d'ara dhasi dhu bisa pamae kapa. rèngu cakaraa liru mèdhi ètu dedha rai mango dhu papuru boe èj'i ca pasuti sa. rèngu dhoka lii padhai di dhu kapai, te ngaa tao rare boe ngaa èci sa dhu be'a. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana aaj'u dhu guna boe ngaa-ngaa. ladhe d'ai hèru hua, hua boe cue sa hèi; te'a boe, na, dhu bete eele le toke d'ai amo-èsu kateme.

source_text: raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
target_text: sasab'a ra dhoka pamakae èdhi di. te rèngu nuka sèmi naha dhasi dhu tèke eele horo dhu pènu dènge kaj'alu dhutu-dhutu ètu sebhe dhasi. rèngu sama sèmi hua-hètu kahèi dhu la'e-mai ètu dedha-liru dhu abhu huku, ka lamatua tèke si ètu era èci dhu maroga aatu-aatu, hèia ele aa'i si.

source_text: and enoch also, the seventh from adam, prophesied of these, saying, behold, the lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
target_text: henok, ana-èpu ka pidhu, ige mulai nèti adam. nèngu peka mema le, lula-nèti dhèu sèmi se'e se. te na peka na, miu ladhe sèku. lamatua èdhi mai dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga dhu mola-mèci. rèngu sèra, ae titu kèna toke ige tare boe.

source_text: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have impiously committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
target_text: nèngu mai ho pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. èèna na nèngu pad'elo sasala nèti ca dhèu-ca dhèu, dènge bhoke paled'a-led'a tatao-tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe. na pabèbhe hahuku mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sèra, lula padhai lii rèngu dhu lèke boe mi lamatua.

source_text: these are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
target_text: dhèu se'e se re'a dhoka loe boe ka'ugu di. rèngu muri dhoka pasasei di. ra pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, aa madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara rèngu di. rèngu dhoka padhai lii padedha iisi ra. ra d'èi pahie rèhu dènge mangojo d'ara dhèu, sèna ka hud'i laa rèngu abhu pala madhutu dad'èi ra.

source_text: but, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before by the apostles of our lord jesus christ; that they told you there would be mockers in the last time, who would walk after their own ungodly lusts.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu lii padhadha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu dhèu pajuu-paleha na peka-padhai mema mi miu, na, ladhe oe èle rai-haha, dhèu dhu tema pa-aape dhèu, èèna na, cèu mai. rèngu d'èi pahahe dad'èi lamatua, ho madhutu dad'èi rèngu unu ra dhu koe-kapengo.

source_text: these are they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the spirit.
target_text: limuri ne, abhu le dhèu sèra. rèngu ka dhu kakèj'i dhèu ètu mia-mia, sèna ka pamae-pamanyèla miu. mamuri ra dhoka madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci abhu boe ètu d'ara rèngu.

source_text: but ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying by the holy spirit,
target_text: te ngaa a'ari pasue! miu hud'i padhèdi ku mamuri miu mi dedha fanderen nèti lalèka miu dhu mola-mèci. aa ladhe miu sabaj'a, madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci peka dènge miu.

source_text: keep yourselves in the love of god, looking for the mercy of our lord jesus christ to eternal life.
target_text: sanèd'e, ama lamatua sue miu titu kèna. de j'aga ngi'u miu, aa sanèd'e sasue na. aa miu hud'i tatae taruu, sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo rasa kasia mi miu, aa hia miu mamuri dènge ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: and of some have compassion, making a difference:
target_text: miu hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia mi dhèu dhu d'ara kajari.

source_text: and others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
target_text: miu hud'i bantu dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parluu abhu mamuri, sama sèmi miu ère dhèu nèti d'ara ai karoo. abhu dhèu leo hari dhu miu hud'i pad'elo ku d'ara be'a miu dènge rèngu. te ngaa, mage-mage! masi ka miu rasa kasia mi rèngu, te ngaa miu kahèi hud'i madenge ku dènge kaj'alu ra, nuka sèmi dhèu madenge dènge kodho dhu kaj'alu.

source_text: now to him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
target_text: mai ti koa-kio padedha-dedha ama lamatua! te nèngu ka dhu bisa madhenga miu, sèna ka baku manahu. aa nèngu ka dhu bisa lere miu, sèna ka miu titu ètu madha lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu pamèu miu, toke hahera abhu boe ciki sa hèi. miu mai dènge d'ara karae, te dadedha na kapai titu kèna!

source_text: to god the only wise, our savior, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. amen.
target_text: dhodhoka ama lamatua mesa-mesa na, dhu j'aj'i lamatua dhu lèke, dhodhoka nèngu di dhu bisa pamamuri èdhi! hèia na pake kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ho pala-bagi èdhi mamuri. de lii koa-kad'iri hia aa'i mi nèngu. dadedha dènge kapai aa'i-aa'i unu nèngu. koasa na kapai titu kèna. aa hak paredha nèngu, karèi nèti uru ka, deo ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. tare'a-re'a! nèngu èèna kèna! nèti ja'a, yudas

source_text: the revelation of jesus christ, which god gave to him, to show to his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel to his servant john: who bore testimony of the word of god, and of the testimony of jesus christ, and of all things that he saw.
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yohanis, ana pua-paleha nèti yesus kristus. ja'a suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a. ja'a ke'a j'ara se'e se, sèmi ne'e ka: ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka tèke mi yesus kristus. hèia ama lamatua pua yesus ho lole mi dhèu unu na sèra. èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana pajuu na ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai bhoke pad'elo j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a, sèna ka ja'a suri mema. te nèbhu heka j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, tatu j'aj'i. de nanene paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu yesus peka ne.

source_text: blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu baca sasuri ne'e toke dhèu bisa nanene, na, rèngu oto titu kèna. aa dhèu dhu nanene isi na, aa tao madhutu sèmi dhu na moa, rèngu oto kahèi. te lod'o mamai na dètu ae le.

source_text: john to the seven churches which are in asia: grace be to you, and peace, from him who is, and who was, and who is to come; and from the seven spirits who are before his throne;
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, hia mi pidhu juma'at ètu propensi asia. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. te ama lamatua abhu mema le, karèi nèti uru ka. nèngu dhu deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a, toke d'ai mia-mia. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka roh na dhu mola-mèci pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. ja'a ladhe kèdhi roh mola-mèci ne, nuka sèmi abhu pidhu roh sa dhu patangara dènge kadera paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and from jesus christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first-begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. to him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
target_text: ja'a manèngi kahèi ho yesus kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, sèna ka miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. nèngu ne loe boe padhai lii paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu ama lamatua peka dènge ne. uru èèna na madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne, ka na j'aj'i dhèu uru tèka, dhu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe. pe nèngu ka dhu paredha dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. lula yesus sue èdhi, nèti èèna ka na pasuti raa na hia mi èdhi. nèti mamadhe na, na bhoke j'ara sèna ka patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: and hath made us kings and priests to god and his father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. amen.
target_text: ka na ded'e nare èdhi, j'aj'i ana kabarai na, sèna ka èdhi sab'a hia ama na, ama lamatua. yesus kristus ne, kapai titu kèna, lula koasa na èle boe. lèke sèmi èèna!

source_text: behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also who pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. even so, amen.
target_text: de bhoke musi madha ho ladhe paie-iie! yesus dènge ama na, limuri ne ètu sorga nèi. te ngaa nèbhu heka na puru mai d'ara ra'i-liru. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, èèna na ladhe rèdhi ne, sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu uru na kèj'i ne. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne manyasa, aa tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula tadhe ne. se'e se, mema tare'a-re'a j'aj'i. lèke tare'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: i am alpha and omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the lord, who is, and who was, and who is to come, the almighty.
target_text: ama lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, alpa toke d'ai omega. ja'a ne, a toke d'ai z. aa'i-aa'i ra kapua nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru tèka toke d'ai èle. ja'a ne dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka mai. ja'a dhu deo ne'e. aa ja'a dhu bèli-camèd'a, toke d'ai mia-mia. ka ja'a mesa-mesa ku dhu dènge koasa kapai risi eele!

source_text: i john, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of jesus christ, was in the isle that is called patmos, for the word of god, and for the testimony of jesus christ.
target_text: lula èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti parcaya, na, yesus ne dhèu aae èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi pa'a'ari. abhu dhèu leo dhu nasa kahèi lula èdhi madhutu yesus, ka rèngu paj'èra èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. te ngaa yesus pa'èra d'ara èdhi, ka bisa taha taruu. lula ja'a aj'a-nori le dhèu lula-nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua aa lole j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus, ka abhu dhèu dhu tèka d'ara. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne ra kèpe rare ja'a, ka hue eele asa pulu patmos ne'e.

source_text: i was in the spirit on the lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
target_text: ka d'ara ca lod'o, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a abhu roh ama lamatua. kaca'a laa, ja'a tadèngi lii rodhe nèti kabodho. lii èèna nuka sèmi lii tiu tèbhe sa.

source_text: saying, i am alpha and omega, the first and the last: and, what thou seest, write in a book, and send it to the seven churches which are in asia; to ephesus, and to smyrna, and to pergamos, and to thyatira, and to sardis, and to philadelphia, and to laodicea.
target_text: lii ne, pua ja'a, peka na, yohanis! ja'a neo bhoke j'ara èci, ho pad'elo dènge èu. aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi se, èu hud'i suri more ku. èle èèna, èu hud'i pa'adhu hia pidhu juma'at, nuka ètu kota epesus, kota smirna, kota pergamus, kota tiatira, kota sardis, kota piladelfia, dènge kota laodikia.

source_text: and i turned to see the voice that spoke with me. and having turned, i saw seven golden candlesticks;
target_text: ropa tadèngi kore lii ne'e, ja'a kabib'a asa kabodho, neo ke'a cee ka dhu lii deo na. te ngaa ja'a kèdhi labhu èi mènyi pidhu bua dhu pamadhèdi ètu dedha tatèka labhu, dhu tao nèti hualaa.

source_text: and in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like the son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci dhu titu ètu talora aae labhu se'e. rèhu na nuka sèmi dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. na pake kodho èci dhu robho d'ai rai, aa dhu cape dènge saledha hualaa ca bèla ètu kakara na.

source_text: his head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
target_text: rèu kètu na pudhi lao-lao nuka sèmi rèu kahib'i-kalèbho pudhi. musi madha na heo lo'a-lo'a sèmi ai.

source_text: and his feet like fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
target_text: haga na mea gèu-gèu sèmi tabaga dhu tunu ètu d'ara ai karoo. lii na kadèru sèmi lii bèbhe naha dhasi kapai.

source_text: and he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp two-edged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
target_text: ètu ai g'ana, na kèpe dènge hua-hètu pidhu bua. nèti hèb'a na, bhodho samala èci dhu dua rèka dhu madèka. rèhu na cèb'a-cèb'a nuka sèmi madha lod'o dhu re mèu rai.

source_text: and when i saw him, i fell at his feet as dead. and he laid his right hand upon me, saying to me, fear not; i am the first and the last:
target_text: ropa ja'a ladhe kèdhi dhèu ne'e, hèia ja'a bèbhe dènge ka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe ètu haga na. te ngaa na gai ja'a dènge ai g'ana na, hèia na lii peka na, ana, ee! baku madha'u! te aa'i-aa'i se kapua ra nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru toke d'ai èle.

source_text: i am he that liveth, and was dead; and behold, i am alive for evermore, amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
target_text: uru èèna, mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, èu ladhe ku laa! ja'a mamuri hari le, aa èèna na mamuri taa-taa. aa ja'a ka dhu kèd'u gagoe dhu bisa bhoke era pea dhèu madhe, sèna ka pamamuri hari si.

source_text: write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
target_text: èu hud'i suri more aa'i ku dhu ladhe mèdhi se, aa suri kahèi ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: the mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
target_text: ja'a peka uuru ku sasoa na: labhu hualaa pidhu bua se, nuka pidhu juma'at. aa pidhu hua-hètu dhu èu mèdhi ètu ai g'ana ja'a ne, nuka ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga dhu rèti lii ama lamatua hia mi pidhu juma'at sèra.

source_text: to the angel of the church of ephesus write; these things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna paredha ja'a, aku nèngu na, yohanis, èu suri more ku sasuri èci. isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota epesus: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u pidhu hua-hètu ètu ai g'ana ja'a. ja'a dhu kako palème kahèi laladhe pidhu labhu hualaa se cue-cue. nanene paie lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know thy works, and thy labor, and thy patience, and that thou canst not bear them who are evil; and thou hast tried them who say they are apostles, and are not; and hast found them liars:
target_text: ja'a ladhe kèdhi le, j'ara mamuri miu ètu kota epesus, peka na, miu sab'a bia hia lamatua. ladhe abhu dhèu bhelu ètu talora aae miu, miu soro tèke boe ne. ladhe dhèu mai dadugu, peka na, nèngu dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, miu parisa paie-iie mamuri na, sèna ka me'a na, nèngu ne dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. hèia miu tule eele, aa nanene boe ne.

source_text: and hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast labored, and hast not fainted.
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra miu lula miu parcaya ja'a, te ngaa miu taha taruu aa hari boe ciki sa.

source_text: nevertheless, i have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ladhe, na, miu manahu ètu ca madha j'ara. lula uru èèna, lod'o miu hiu-hiu parcaya ja'a, miu mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi heka èèna.

source_text: remember therefore from whence thou hast fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else i will come to thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of its place, except thou repent.
target_text: de miu hud'i sanèd'e hari ku j'ara uru èèna! te limuri ne, miu pakaj'èu ae nèti j'ara uru èèna. de miu ae eele ka nèti sasala miu se'e, sèna ka mi pasue hari sèmi uru èèna. te aad'o na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a mai kore hari labhu hualaa èèna nèti miu.

source_text: but this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the nicolaitans, which i also hate.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara ja'a ako karej'e, lula miu tule eele lii aj'a-nori nèti nikolai, dhu ana madhutu na sèra tao madhutu. ja'a tule eele kahèi tatao kapod'e-kabèli ra sèra.

source_text: he that hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith to the churches; to him that overcometh will i give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of god.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. dhèu cee dhu taha pa'èra madhutu ja'a toke na madhe, pe ja'a soro tèke na'a hua aj'u ètu d'ara talora oka ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu na'a hua aj'u èèna, nèngu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in smyrna, write; these things saith the first and the last, who was dead, and is alive;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna, tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota smirna: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru ka toke d'ai èle. uru èèna mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a mamuri hari le. de miu nanene lii padhai ja'a ne.

source_text: i know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, but thou art rich and i know the blasphemy of them who say they are jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of satan.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le j'aj'èra mamuri miu ètu kota smirna. masi ka ètu madha dhèu rai-haha, miu unu aad'o, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua miu kaja. abhu dhèu dhu mangaku, na, rèngu sèra dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa padhai lii pakarehe kolongara miu. te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, rèngu se unu boe lamatua. rèngu madhutu dhoka dhèu aae nidhu di.

source_text: fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer. behold, the devil will cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days. be thou faithful to death, and i will give thee a crown of life.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie. miu baku madha'u, ladhe abhu j'aj'èra era. sad'i miu me'a, na, dhèu aae nidhu neo tenge dhèu ho kèpe miu cahag'e, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara bèdho d'ai canguru lod'o. dad'èi na, sèna ka miu rai tèke eele ja'a. masi ka nidhu neo pamadhe miu èèna ka, te ngaa miu baku bhèlu ja'a kahèi. te dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pala-bagi ne mamuri, sèna ka na mamuri taa-taa dènge ja'a.

source_text: he that hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith to the churches; he that overcometh, shall not be hurt by the second death.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. dhèu cee dhu madhutu ja'a toke madhe, èèna na nèngu abhu boe j'aj'èra ètu d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo robhe-robhe kura boe ciki sa èèna. dènge sèmi ne'e, nèngu abhu boe mamadhe ka dua hari. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in pergamos write; these things saith he who hath the sharp sword with two edges;
target_text: hèia dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota pergamus: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u samala rèka dua dhu madèka. nanene lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where satan dwelleth.
target_text: ja'a ke'a mèu le kota pergamus miu èèna. te, dhu nèd'u paredha ètu èèna, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu kèpe pa'èra kolongara ja'a, aa parcaya taruu ja'a. uru èèna abhu dhèu ja'a èci ètu èèna, ngara na antipas. nèngu aj'a lèke mola-mola j'ara mamuri ja'a, te ngaa ra pamadhe ne. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu pasili boe ja'a.

source_text: but i have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of balaam, who taught balak to cast a stumbling-block before the children of israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit lewdness.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ladhe, na, miu manahu ètu ca j'ara dua j'ara. abhu nèti miu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu d'èi madhutu lii aj'a-nori nèti balaam. uru èèna balaam aj'a balak ho kakèj'i dhèu isra'el, toke ra sisu dad'èi lamatua. balak kakèj'i dhèu isra'el sèra, ho pae'a dènge ra'a-rinu mèdha sogo-tagu, aa ra tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra.

source_text: so hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the nicolaitans, which thing i hate.
target_text: abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu nèti miu dhu madhutu lii aj'a-nori nèti nikolai.

source_text: repent; or else i will come to thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
target_text: de miu hud'i loe ku nèti sasala-sasigo miu sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, nèbhu heka ja'a dhiu pad'ui miu dènge lii sakaa dhu nuka sèmi pare dènge samala.

source_text: he that hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith to the churches; to him that overcometh will i give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth, he excepted, that receiveth it.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka dènge juma'at na. dhèu cee ka dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, pe ja'a hia ne na'a roti manna nèti sorga dhu tèke paie iie ne. pe ja'a pangèd'u ne hèi, hadhu pudhi cue dhu suri tèke ngara hiu na. dhodhoka nèngu mesa na di dhu ne'a ngara na; dhèu leo re'a boe. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in thyatira write; these things saith the son of god, who hath his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
target_text: ka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna, tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota tiatira: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus, nuka ana ama lamatua. musi madha ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a sèmi ai, aa haga ja'a mea gèu-gèu sèmi tabaga ètu d'ara ai. nanene ku lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first:
target_text: ja'a kèdhi le mamuri miu. miu sue ja'a tare'a, aa parcaya èra ja'a kahèi. miu madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu. masi ka dhèu paj'èra miu, te ngaa miu taha taruu. ja'a ke'a kahèi, limuri ne miu sab'a bia risi hari hia ja'a.

source_text: notwithstanding, i have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit lewdness, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
target_text: te ngaa miu manahu ètu ca j'ara: miu sèmi mere dènge be'a, bhèni dhu ngara na isabel, dhu padedha iisi peka na, nèngu èèna dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua. ka miu hud'i na sène, aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe mi dhèu ja'a. lula lii a'aj'a na dhu kapod'e-kabèli èèna ka, dhèu ja'a tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, aa ra'a nganga'a sogo-tagu.

source_text: and i gave her time to repent of her lewdness, and she repented not.
target_text: ja'a dhu kai le bhèni èèna pèri-pèri hari le, sèna ka ele-ho'a nèti sasala na, te ngaa na d'èi boe.

source_text: behold, i will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
target_text: de ladhe paie-iie. te ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho hia ne lèke papèd'a èci, toke na bisa boe puru nèti era j'unu na. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu j'unu pa'èci dènge ne. ladhe rèngu tèke eele boe bhèni aapa ne, nèbhu boe ja'a huku si kahèi.

source_text: and i will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that i am he who searcheth the reins and hearts: and i will give to every one of you according to your works.
target_text: èèna na ja'a pamadhe aa'i ana-ana nèti bhèni aapa ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèra re'a, na, ja'a ne ke'a aa'i d'ara dhèu. pe ja'a b'ala miu madhutu tatao dhu miu ad'u-ue.

source_text: but to you i say, and to the rest in thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and who have not known the depths of satan, as they speak; i will put upon you no other burden:
target_text: te ngaa miu cahag'e ètu tiatira sèra, dhu madhutu boe lii a'aj'a bhèni aapa ne. miu tule eele le a'aj'a dhu pahuni èèna, dhu ra peka na, ‘ilmu maroga nèti dhèu aae nidhu'. nèti èèna ka, ja'a parluu heka kai miu,

source_text: but that which ye have already hold fast till i come.
target_text: sad'i miu kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu mi dedha ja'a, toke ja'a lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and he that overcometh, and keepeth my works to the end, to him will i give power over the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as i received of my father. and i will give him the morning-star.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, pe ja'a hia ne koasa. koasa èèna kapai, nuka sèmi koasa dhu ja'a abhu nèti ama ku, ho paredha dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dènge tatea bèsi. ladhe abhu dhu lab'a ne, pe na ab'o palaho si, nuka sèmi dhèu pamae èru rai. èèna na, ja'a hia miu hua-hètu dhimu kahèi.

source_text: he that hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in sardis write; these things saith he that hath the seven spirits of god, and the seven stars; i know thy works, that thou hast a name, that thou livest, and art dead.
target_text: hèia dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne lii hari dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota sardis: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. roh ama lamatua ètu ja'a. aa roh ne, pidhu rupa. ja'a dhu kèpe kahèi pidhu hua-hètu ètu d'ara ai ja'a. nanene lii padhai ja'a. ja'a ke'a le tatao miu ètu sardis. dhèu peka, na, miu se mamuri madhutu dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa miu nuka sèmi samanga aad'o ètu kètu.

source_text: be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for i have not found thy works perfect before god.
target_text: de kèd'i ka! pa'èra parcaya miu dhu oe èle na. te ja'a dhu parisa le ngaa dhu miu sab'a, abhu boe dhu mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. if therefore thou shalt not watch, i will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour i will come upon thee.
target_text: de baku bhèlu lii aj'a-nori dhu mola, dhu miu nanene aa abhu nèti uru èèna. madhutu paie-iie dad'èi ama lamatua, aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu sèra. ladhe miu kèd'i malai boe, ho mi tao madhutu j'ara sèra, cag'ag'a laa ja'a dhiu nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu miu me'a mere boe.

source_text: thou hast a few names even in sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e era nèti miu ètu sardis dhu mamuri mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pakaj'alu boe mèdha-papake ra. lula miu mamuri mola, ka miu nia kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, pake mèdha-papake pudhi.

source_text: he that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and i will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but i will confess his name before my father, and before his angels.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pake mèdha-papake pudhi kahèi. bèli-camèd'a ja'a roso eele boe ngara na nèti d'ara sasuri dhu suri ngara dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. èèna na ja'a mangaku ne ètu madha ama ku, dènge ètu madha ana pajuu ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu ja'a.

source_text: he that hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka dènge juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in philadelphia write; these things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of david, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth:
target_text: ka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne lii hari, peka na, yohanis, èu hud'i suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu lii na sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota piladelfia: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a dhu mola-mèci dènge dhu lèke tare'a. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u gagoe dhèu aae daud. ladhe ja'a bhoke kore babèdho, abhu boe ca dhèu sa bisa bèdho hari. ladhe ja'a bèdho kore, abhu boe ca dhèu sa bisa bhoke.

source_text: i know thy works: behold, i have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
target_text: ja'a ke'a aa'i ngaa dhu miu tao. ja'a ke'a kahèi, pangaru miu kapai boe. masi ka sèmi èèna, miu pasili boe ja'a, aa madhutu taruu lii a'aj'a ja'a. sanèd'e paie, te ja'a dhu conge le babèdho hia miu, de dhèu èci sa bisa boe bèdho hari.

source_text: behold, i will make them of the synagogue of satan, who say they are jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, i will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that i have loved thee.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te abhu dhèu leko-monya dhu peka na, rèngu sèra dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa rèngu sèra, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu madhutu dhèu aae nidhu. pe me'a unu mi! ja'a tao si, sèna ka ra dhiu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha miu, aa ra mangaku na, ja'a tare'a-re'a sue miu.

source_text: because thou hast kept the word of my patience, i also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
target_text: lula miu madhutu le paredha ja'a, ka miu taha madhutu ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a bhabhae miu nèti j'aj'èra dhu lamatua neo hia mai, ho sèku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: behold, i come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a dhiu. de miu kèpe pa'èra-èra lii aj'a-nori ja'a, dhu miu abhu le karèi nèti uru ka. te mage dhoka abhu dhu parame rare rui-j'aj'èra dhu lamatua neo b'ala hia miu.

source_text: him that overcometh, will i make a pillar in the temple of my god, and he shall go out no more: and i will write upon him the name of my god, and the name of the city of my god, which is new jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my god: and i will write upon him my new name.
target_text: dhèu cee ka dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pea taruu dènge lamatua, sama sèmi agarii aae dhu titu mèno ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua. pe ja'a suri ngara lamatua ja'a, dènge ngara kota lamatua ètu ngi'u dhèu ne. kota èèna ra pangare, na, ‘yerusalem hiu', dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua papuru mai nèti sorga. aa èèna na, ja'a suri kahèi ngara hiu ja'a mi ngi'u dhèu ne.

source_text: he that hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh ama lamatua peka mi juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church of the laodiceans write; these things saith the amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of god;
target_text: èle ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tuhu hari lii, peka na, yohanis, èu hud'i suri more ku sasuri dhu limuri tèka, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota laodikia: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus, dhu dhèu paroa na, ‘tare'a sèmi èèna'. ja'a ne loe boe padhai lii dènge mola lii holo-nori ama lamatua. dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua ad'u-ue sèra, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a.

source_text: i know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: i would thou wert cold or hot.
target_text: ja'a ladhe kèdhi le tatao miu ètu laodikia. te ngaa miu sèmi ngaa mèro? ! pana aad'o, aa pacuhi aad'o kahèi. ladhe pana, na, hud'i tare'a-re'a pana! aa ladhe pacuhi, na, hud'i tare'a-re'a pacuhi!

source_text: so then, because thou art luke-warm, and neither cold nor hot, i will vomit thee out of my mouth:
target_text: te ngaa, lula d'ara miu kajari, bèli-camèd'a ja'a sabhuu eele miu nèti d'ara hèb'a ja'a, sama sèmi dhèu sabhuu ilu.

source_text: because thou sayest, i am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
target_text: miu padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ‘ji'i se, kaja-su'i. ji'i mamuri be'a, kura boe ngaa-ngaa! ' te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, d'ara miu dhu bèdhu le, ka me'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka, miu j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dhu dènge boe mèdha ètu ua mi.

source_text: i counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness may not appear; and anoint thy eyes with eye-salve, that thou mayest see.
target_text: de hua iia mai ho hèli mere poe-pai nèti ja'a, sèna ka miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. aa hèli mere mèdha-papake pudhi, ho pahutu era makae mi. aa hèli mere kahèi èi na'i musi madha, sèna ka roso mi musi madha miu, ho mèdhi mèu hari.

source_text: as many as i love, i rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pasue ja'a tao sala, ja'a kai aa huku si, sèna ka ra j'aj'i be'a. de miu hud'i pamola d'ara mi, ho madhutu ja'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: behold, i stand at the door, and knock: if any man shall hear my voice, and open the door, i will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
target_text: nanene paie-iie. te ja'a nuka titu ètu hèb'a èmu ne, aa ja'a paroa taruu ho neo maso asa d'ara èmu. ladhe dhèu cee dhu tadèngi lii ja'a, ho na conge èmu, ja'a dhiu asa d'ara, sèna ka madhèdi ta'a-tinu pa'èci.

source_text: to him that overcometh will i grant to sit with me on my throne, even as i also overcame, and am set down with my father on his throne.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pangèd'u ne hak, ho nèd'u paredha bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a taha le madhutu ama ku kahèi, nèti èèna ka limuri ne ja'a kèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: he that hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith to the churches.

source_text: after this i looked, and behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which i heard, was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, come up hither, and i will show thee things which must be hereafter.
target_text: ropa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, peka nare lii moa na mi pidhu juma'at sèra, hèia lamatua bhoke pad'elo dènge ja'a, ngaa-ngaa dhu leo hari. ètu d'ara ciki oo'e èèna kahèi, ja'a kèdhi babèdho èci dhu bhoke le tangare la'e asa sorga. ka ja'a tadèngi hari lii dhu mèdhu nèti dhèu deo na, nuka sèmi lii tiu tèbhe, peka na, mai ku! ca'e asa ne'e, sèna ka ja'a pad'elo dènge èu ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: and immediately i was in the spirit: and behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, roh lamatua ded'e nèti ja'a asa sorga. cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi kadera paredha èci, aa abhu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha.

source_text: and he that sat was in appearance like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow around the throne in sight like an emerald.
target_text: dhu madhèdi ètu kadera èèna heo mangèru dènge mea, èci èèna ka dènge hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua, dhu ra peka na, yaspis dènge sardius. abhu kahèi saroo èci dhu reo nare kadera paredha na. saroo ne heo na mangèru sama sèmi hadhu kale'e samrud.

source_text: and around the throne were four and twenty seats; and upon the seats i saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
target_text: ètu èèna kahèi, abhu dua nguru èpa kadera paredha iiki, dhu reo rare kadera paredha dhu ètu talora aae èèna. ètu dedha kadera paredha iiki se'e, madhèdi katua dua nguru èpa dhèu. aa'i-aa'i ra pake mèdha-papake pudhi, dènge solo paredha dhu tao nèti hualaa.

source_text: and out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices. and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven spirits of god.
target_text: nèti kadera paredha ètu talora aae èèna, abhu bela dhu kacèb'a, dènge d'oro dhu lii mèdhu patuu ma'èta boe. abhu kahèi ob'o pidhu bua dhu heo ètu madha kadera paredha èèna. rèngu se, nuka sèmi roh ama lamatua dhu pidhu rupa.

source_text: and before the throne there was a sea of glass like crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and around the throne, were four living beings full of eyes before and behind.
target_text: ètu madha kadera paredha ne, ja'a kèdhi èi, oe sèmi dhasi dhu mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru. hèia ja'a kèdhi badha èpa ngi'u dhu dhae kèdhi mèka ciki sa rai-reo kadera èèna. ngi'u ra nèti madha toke kabodho, pènu dènge musi madha. badha se'e ka dhu lalau-lalo'o lamatua.

source_text: and the first living being was like a lion, and the second living being like a calf, and the third living being had a face as a man, and the fourth living being was like a flying eagle.
target_text: badha ka èci, rèhu na sèmi singa. ka dua, rèhu na sèmi sapi mone. ka tèlu, rèhu na sèmi dhèu. aa ka èpa, rèhu na nuka sèmi manea luji dhu lela.

source_text: and the four living beings had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, holy, holy, holy, lord god almighty, who was, and is, and is to come.
target_text: badha èpa ngi'u se, ci'u-ci'u ka dhu dènge èla ra, èna. re li'u dènge re d'ara èla se, pènu dènge musi madha kahèi. mèu-mèda, badha se loe boe sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua! lamatua èèna, dhu mola-mèci risi eele! koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. lamatua èèna karèi nèti uru ka mai. lamatua dhu deo ne'e ne. aa lamatua dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: and when those living beings give glory, and honor, and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
target_text: dènge ra sod'a sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio dènge pakab'ua ama lamatua, aa ra manèngi makasi mi nèngu kahèi, lula nèngu ka dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha èèna, aa nèngu ka dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. ropa rèngu sod'a,

source_text: the four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
target_text: hèia dua nguru èpa katua sèra pabèbha iisi ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna. katua se bhoke eele solo paredha ra, ka ra tèke mi madha kadera paredha èèna, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu dhu mamuri taa-taa dènge boe too-lane. èle ka, ra koa-kio ne, peka na,

source_text: thou art worthy, o lord, to receive glory, and honor, and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
target_text: ooo, ama lamatua! ji'i koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua. lamatua ne, kètu ji'i. lamatua ne, ama lamatua ji'i! lamatua ka dhu nia sèmi more koa-kio ji'i. lamatua ka dhu pantas sèmi lii pakab'ua ji'i. lula lamatua ka dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa lamatua ka dhu dedha risi eele. lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. lamatua ka dhu hia mamuri aa'i-aa'i. aa'i-aa'i dhu tesa, j'aj'i, lula lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue. aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, dènge a'ae, lula lamatua ka dhu hia.

source_text: and i saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe hari nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha èèna. na kèpe dènge sasuri ca lulu ètu ai g'ana na. ètu lalulu sasuri ne, dhu suri le re li'u dènge d'ara. ra segel le ètu pidhu era.

source_text: and i saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, who is worthy to open the book, and to loose its seals?
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga ca dhèu dhu kapai aae. dènge lii aae, na karèi, dhèu cee ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel aa baca sasuri ne?

source_text: and no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look upon it.
target_text: na karèi sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa ra abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu dènge hak, ho bisa bhoke dènge baca isi sasuri ne. masi ka ètu sorga, do ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe èci sa hèi dhu dènge hak. ètu era dhèu madhe, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: and i wept much, because no man was found worthy to open, and to read the book, neither to look upon it.
target_text: ropa kèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ja'a tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke sasuri aa baca isi na.

source_text: and one of the elders saith to me, weep not: behold, the lion of the tribe of judah, the root of david, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose its seven seals.
target_text: èle ka, ca dhèu nèti dua nguru èpa katua se'e, lii dènge ja'a, peka na, baku tangi, we. te ana-èpu dhèu aae daud ca dhèu dhu kapai risi eele, dhu ra haji ngara na, ‘singa nèti udhu-rasa yahuda'. nèngu ka dhu ab'o palaho le aa'i-aa'i dhu bhelu-katub'a. de nèngu ka dhu dènge hak, sèna ka bisa bhoke segel aa baca isi sasuri ne.

source_text: and i beheld, and lo, in the midst of the throne, and of the four living beings, and in the midst of the elders stood a lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of god sent forth into all the earth.
target_text: ropa tadèngi kore lii ne'e, ja'a kèdhi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu titu ètu talora aae badha èpa ngi'u sèra, dènge dua nguru èpa katua dhu madhèdi reo rare kadera paredha èèna. ana kahib'i-kalèbho ne, oe sèmi dhu ra pamadhe le. nèngu ne dènge tadhu pidhu, aa musi madha na pidhu kahèi. musi madha pidhu sèra, nuka sèmi roh na dhu dènge pidhu rupa, dhu na papuru mai palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho ne, kako la'e asa madha nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna, sèna ka sèmi nare lalulu sasuri nèti ai g'ana na.

source_text: and when he had taken the book, the four living beings, and four and twenty elders fell down before the lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odors, which are the prayers of saints.
target_text: ropa ana kalèbho ne sèmi nare sasuri, cag'ag'a laa badha èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua sèra, pabèbha iisi ra, ka ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. rèngu se èci-èci ka kèpe mèdha lii sod'a oe sèmi sasadhu sa, dènge mago hualaa dhu isi dènge raa aj'u hèu mèngi, sèna ka ra pasèbu ho pahèu mèngi. raa aj'u hèu mèngi se'e ka, nuka lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: and they sung a new song, saying, thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals of it: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to god by thy blood out of every kindred, and language, and people, and nation;
target_text: ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i sod'a lii sod'a hiu èci, peka na: ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu nia sèmi nare sasuri ne. ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel sèra. te nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe le. hèia ama lamatua pake raa na, ho sui nare dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka dhèu cahag'e bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu rai-haha nèti lii aa'i-aa'i dènge rai aa'i-aa'i, bisa j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua.

source_text: and hast made us to our god kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
target_text: ana kalèbho ne'e ka, oru nare si aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ca rae-ca nadha. ana kalèbho ne'e ka, hag'e nare si, j'aj'i dhèu sab'a lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu se'e ka dhu rèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha. pe rèngu sab'a hia lamatua ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and i beheld, and i heard the voice of many angels around the throne, and the living beings, and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
target_text: èle ka, ja'a boti kètu, hèia tadèngi lii mèdhu aae èci. hèia ja'a ladhe badha aae èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua se, tabha hari dènge ana pajuu nèti sorga ae titu kèna. ana pajuu se d'ai juta-kehi.

source_text: saying with a loud voice, worthy is the lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honor, and glory, and blessing.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho dhu ra pamadhe le, lula nèngu ka dhu nia sèmi nare lii koa-kio ji'i! koasa na, kapai risi eele. kakaja na, lale-kabèle. ngangee lii padhai na, lèke mola-mola. a'èra na, èci sa risi boe. ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na. ji'i pakab'ua ne. ji'i koa-kio ne.

source_text: and every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, i heard saying, blessing, and honor, and glory, and power, be to him that sitteth upon the throne, and to the lamb for ever and ever.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a tadèngi hari lii sod'a dhu leo èci. lii sod'a ne, mai nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu: sorga, dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhasi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a. nèti era dhèu madhe kahèi, ra madhutu sod'a. aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha. ji'i nedhe padedha-dedha kahèi ana kalèbho ne. ji'i pakab'ua rèngu. ji'i pahaha iisi mi rèngu. lula rèngu ka dhu rèd'u paredha taa-taa! aa koasa ra dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: and the four living beings said, amen. and the four and twenty elders fell down and worshiped him that liveth for ever and ever.
target_text: hèia èpa badha aae se, loe boe dènge lii dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a! lèke kèna! ka dua nguru èpa katua se'e pabèbha hari iisi ra, hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, ho ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, dènge ana kalèbho èèna.

source_text: and i saw when the lamb opened one of the seals, and i heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four living beings saying, come and see.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka èci nèti lalulu sasuri èèna. hèia ja'a tadèngi, na, èci nèti èpa badha aae sèra parodha dènge lii mèdhu, nuka sèmi lii d'oro. na paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and i saw, and behold, a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given to him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara pudhi ci'u. dhèu èci dhu manya'e pake dènge solo kapala musu, lula nèngu ka dhu segi taruu ètu d'ara pamusu. limuri ne na kèpe le kataki-hahusu, la'e ho segi hari musu na ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and when he had opened the second seal, i heard the second living being say, come and see.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka dua. ka ja'a tadèngi badha aae ka dua paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat upon him to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given to him a great sword.
target_text: ka jara ci'u dhu mea gèu-gèu kalua mai. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne sèmi nare samala aae èci. ra hia ne koasa ho la'e pamaruru ètu rai-haha, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha èci pamadhe èci.

source_text: and when he had opened the third seal, i heard the third living being say, come and see. and i beheld, and lo, a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
target_text: ka ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka tèlu. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii paredha nèti badha aae ka tèlu, peka na, lamu dènge ka! kaca'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara mèdhi ci'u. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne nèd'u dènge kabatai cue, sèna ka tai nganga'a dhu oe kura kèna.

source_text: and i heard a voice in the midst of the four living beings say, a measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari, nuka sèmi lii èci mai nèti talora aae badha èpa ngi'u se, peka na, bèli-camèd'a, abhu manganga-mad'èu dhu kapai titu kèna ètu rai-haha. gaji dhèu ca lod'o nia dhoka hèli laludhu tèlu moo di; te ngaa neo laludhu be'a, abhu dhoka ca moo di. masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pa'ele iie aj'u saitun dènge aj'u anggor ètu d'ara oka ra.

source_text: and when he had opened the fourth seal, i heard the voice of the fourth living being say, come and see.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èpa. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii nèti badha aae ka èpa hia paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and i looked, and behold, a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was death, and hell followed with him. and power was given to them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
target_text: kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi jara ci'u dhu rèu na sanama karara. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne, ngara na ‘mamadhe'. aa abhu dhu madhutu ne re limuri, ngara na ‘era pea samanga dhèu madhe'. rèngu dua ra abhu koasa ho lasi pamadhe dhèu ètu rai-haha pake samala, tèu manganga-madèu, papèd'a-tarègu, dènge pasoku badha hui dhu bhelu. ladhe ige aa'i dhèu dhu madhe, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kaboko nèti èpa kaboko nèti dhèu dhu pea ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and when he had opened the fifth seal, i saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of god, and for the testimony which they held:
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka lèmi. ka ja'a kèdhi samanga dhèu dhu ra pamadhe uru sèra ètu ro'a mei korban. ra pamadhe rèngu lula parcaya ama lamatua, aa aj'a-nori dhèu taruu lula-nèti lii holo-nori na.

source_text: and they cried with a loud voice, saying, how long, o lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
target_text: ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, oo lamatua, ama dhu kapai risi! ama dhu mola-mèci! ji'i parcaya ngaa dhu lamatua peka-padhai. te ngaa ji'i hud'i tatae d'ai pèri lod'o hari, heka lamatua pama'ète lii langu, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu pamadhe ji'i ètu rai-haha nèi?

source_text: and white robes were given to every one of them; and it was said to them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellow-servants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
target_text: ropa rèngu karèi rare sèmi èèna, hèia rèngu èci-èci ka abhu kodho pudhi robho d'ai rai. abhu dhu peka dènge ra, tatae hari ku ciki oo'e, toke miu tesa aa'i. te abhu anga miu era dhu ra pamadhe sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: and i beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood:
target_text: ka ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èna. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi rai-haha ne opo kapai titu kèna. hèia madha lod'o maroga kiu-kiu, nuka sèmi bèla mèdhi, aa hèru mea sama sèmi raa.

source_text: and the stars of heaven fell to the earth, even as a fig-tree casteth its untimely figs, when it is shaken by a mighty wind.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu nèti dedha-liru bèbhe mai asa rai-haha, nuka sèmi hua aj'u hoa dhu kabhui, lula lèke ngèlu aae.

source_text: and the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and isle were moved out of their places.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe, na, liru mae bagi mi dua, ka lulu nuka sèmi dhèpi, toke ele. aa ledhe-ledhe dènge pulu aa'i-aa'i ra gaged'o, toke ele nèti era ra.

source_text: and the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bond-man, and every free-man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
target_text: ropa j'ara se j'aj'i, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, mulai nèti dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, komedhaa sordad'u, dhèu kaja-su'i, toke d'ai ènu sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi lu'u ètu ro'a-ro'a loe, dènge sasanga-sasanga hadhu ètu ledhe.

source_text: and said to the mountains and rocks, fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the lamb:
target_text: dhèu sèra pua ledhe-ledhe aa hadhu aae sèra, peka na, saguru mere ka ji'i laa! pahuni ji'i sèna ka nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha aae èèna, baku nèdhi ji'i. aa ana kalèbho èèna huku ia ka ji'i.

source_text: for the great day of his wrath is come; and who will be able to stand?
target_text: ira ii! ji'i laho mae-mae le, te lod'o d'ai mamadhe-mamopo kèna! ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho èèna, neo dutu nanasa rèngu mi dedha ji'i. te ngaa èci sa bisa boe sili rare, hèia tatu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: and after these things i saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhèu èpa puru mai nèti sorga, titu ètu èpa madha ngèlu ètu rai-haha ne, ho taha ngèlu. ka ngèlu bisa boe tiu asa d'ara dhasi, rai-dedha, dènge aj'u-aj'u.

source_text: and i saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living god: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa, ho ra pa'ele iie rai-dedha dènge d'ara dhasi. ka ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai nèti dhimu. na mai nèti dènge cap ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa. hèia na rodhe mi ana pajuu dhèu èpa sèra, peka na,

source_text: saying, hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our god in their foreheads.
target_text: mate ku! baku pa'ele iie ku rai-dedha, do d'ara dhasi, do aj'u sèra. mate toke ji'i tao ngare ku cap mi katangarèi dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and i heard the number of them who were sealed: and there were sealed a hundred and forty four thousand of all the tribes of the children of israel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, ana pajuu ne tao le tadha mi dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu, dhu mai nèti suku isra'el. nuka:

source_text: of the tribe of judah were sealed twelve thousand. of the tribe of reuben were sealed twelve thousand. of the tribe of gad were sealed twelve thousand.
target_text: nèti suku yahuda, 12. canguru dua riho dhèu; suku ruben, 12. 000 dhèu; suku gad, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of asher were sealed twelve thousand. of the tribe of naphtalim were sealed twelve thousand. of the tribe of manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
target_text: suku aser, 12. 000 dhèu; suku naftali, 12. 000 dhèu; suku manase, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of simeon were sealed twelve thousand. of the tribe of levi were sealed twelve thousand. of the tribe of isachar were sealed twelve thousand.
target_text: suku simeon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku lewi, 12. 000 dhèu; suku isaskar, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. of the tribe of joseph were sealed twelve thousand. of the tribe of benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
target_text: suku sebulon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku yusuf, 12. 000 dhèu; aa nèti suku benyamin, 12. 000 dhèu.

source_text: after this i beheld, and lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and languages, stood before the throne, and before the lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi dhèu ae titu kèna, dhu ige kore boe. rèngu mai nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, nèti kabarai aa'i-aa'i, aa nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. rèngu pakaboko tangara asa kadera paredha, aa asa ana kalèbho kahèi. dhèu sèra pake kodho pudhi, aa ra kèpe dènge rèu palam.

source_text: and cried with a loud voice, saying, salvation to our god who sitteth upon the throne, and to the lamb.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio, aku rèngu na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua ji'i, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha na. ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho ne kahèi! rèngu se'e ka dhu pala mamuri hia ji'i. rèngu se'e ka dhu bhoke j'ara mamuri hia ji'i.

source_text: and all the angels stood around the throne, and about the elders and the four living beings, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshiped god,
target_text: ropa padhai lii rare sèmi èèna, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga dhu rai-reo rare kadera paredha ne, patitu kètu urutuu ra, toke rèhu d'ai rai, tangare asa kadera paredha aae ne. katua-katua dènge èpa badha aae sèra, tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua,

source_text: saying, amen: blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honor, and power, and might, be to our god for ever and ever. amen.
target_text: aa ra peka na, tare'a! èèna tare'a-re'a! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua kahèi! ngangee dènge lii padhai lamatua, dhu lèke mola-mola. koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. a'èra lamatua seli eele. ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ji'i loe boe pakab'ua lamatua. lèke! tare'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: and one of the elders answered, saying to me, who are these that are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
target_text: ropa rèngu koa-kio rare sèmi èèna, hèia nèti dua nguru èpa katua se, èci karèi ja'a, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae-ae dhu pake kodho pudhi se, èu tadha si, do? rèngu se mai nèti mia?

source_text: and i said to him, sir, thou knowest. and he said to me, these are they who came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the lamb.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ama. ja'a tadhe boe rèngu se, cee. ama ka dhu tadhe risi. ka na peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, rèngu se, dhèu dhu bhodho nèti d'ara j'aj'èra aae. rèngu se, dhèu dhu pake le raa ana kalèbho ne, sèna ka rase mèdha-papake ra, aa tao papudhi kodho ra.

source_text: therefore they are before the throne of god, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne will dwell among them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu titu ètu madha kadera paredha ama lamatua. mèu-mèda rèngu lalau-lalo'o lamatua ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i na. lamatua dènge si taa-taa. lamatua madhenge si taa-taa.

source_text: they shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
target_text: pe rèngu re'a heka manganga. pe rèngu koko-kamango heka. pe madha lod'o pakèpu heka si. pe ka'uri rèngu carici heka lèke lod'o pana.

source_text: for the lamb who is in the midst of the throne will feed them, and will lead them to living fountains of waters: and god will wipe away all tears from their eyes.
target_text: ana kalèbho dhu padètu dènge kadera paredha èèna, pe nèngu ka j'aj'i dhèu bata-magee kètu rèngu. èèna na nèngu ka eo nèti si, lasi rinu asa madha èi dhu nèti mamuri hia dhèu. pe lamatua saku eele sasusa ra, sèna ka ra tangi ia ka.

source_text: and when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka pidhu. kabèdhi laa, aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga kalau-karèto boe. abhu boe lii èci sa, pe d'ai catenga jam sa.

source_text: and i saw the seven angels who stood before god; and to them were given seven trumpets.
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, titu taruu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu pa'èra lalau ne. rèngu èci-èci ka sèmi rare tèbhe ra.

source_text: and another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given to him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu, titu ètu madha mei era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. nèngu dhu nèd'u dènge mago hualaa cue, era isi raa aj'u hèu mèngi. hèia ra hia ne raa aj'u hèu mèngi ae-ae, sèna ka na pab'ali dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua. ka na nèti mago hualaa, ho tao sèmi korban dhu hèu mèngi, sèna ka la'e tèke asa dedha mei hualaa ètu madha kadera paredha aae.

source_text: and the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended before god out of the angel's hand.
target_text: ka na tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ne. hèia hèu mèngi na ca'e asa madha ama lamatua, palere-lere dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: and the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it upon the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ne nare ai nèti dedha mei ne, la'e tao asa d'ara mago hualaa èèna. hèia na pèci mago ne asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bela kacèb'a lolo aae nèti g'ana-kariu ètu rai-haha. ka lii tea ma'ète boe, aa rai opo kapai titu kèna.

source_text: and the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga sèra, pa'èra ho tiu tèbhe ra.

source_text: the first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka èci tiu tèbhe na, hèia èj'i es aa ai pab'ali dènge raa, sabhori mai asa rai-haha. j'u'u aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia kèpu-ladhu ai. ca era nèti tèlu era ètu rai-haha ne, kèpu-ladhu ai. aa ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko ana aaj'u ètu rai-haha ne, dhu kèpu-ladhu ai kahèi.

source_text: and the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka dua tiu tèbhe na, ka mèdha èci sama sèmi ledhe aae cue dhu heo robhe-robhe, pèci la'e asa d'ara dhasi, toke ca era nèti tèlu era ètu d'ara dhasi j'aj'i raa.

source_text: and the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
target_text: hèia ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko badha ètu d'ara dhasi, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko kapa aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, laho eele aa'i si.

source_text: and the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters; and the name of the star is called wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died by the waters, because they were made bitter.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka tèlu tiu tèbhe na, hèia nèti dedha-liru hua-hètu aae cue bèbhe mai, nuka sèmi ob'o kapai aae èci dhu heo. hua-hètu ne, ngara na ‘pèd'u'. ropa na bèbhe mai, èi loko dènge madha èi, j'aj'i pèd'u. hèia nèti dhèu dhu rinu, ae ka dhu madhe. ladhe sèmi loko dènge èi madha ètu rai-haha ne hag'e mi tèlu, na, ca hag'e j'aj'i pèd'u.

source_text: and the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so that the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èpa tiu tèbhe na. kaca'a laa, madha lod'o, hèru dènge hua-hètu lèke hake, hèia maroga. ladhe re mèu, maroga èpa jam, lula madha lod'o heo iia heka. aa ladhe re mèda, maroga kiu-kiu èpa jam kahèi, lula hèru dènge hua-hètu heo iia heka kahèi.

source_text: and i beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth, by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
target_text: èle ka, ja'a doa kètu, ka ladhe kèdhi manea luji ci'u dhu lela dedha titu kèna. na parodha, peka na, kasian! kasian! bèli-camèd'a j'aj'èra kapai lèke dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha. te ana pajuu dhèu tèlu era, dhu tiu mèka tèbhe ra.

source_text: and the fifth angel sounded, and i saw a star fall from heaven to the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ka lèmi tiu tèbhe na. hèia ja'a kèdhi hua-hètu cue bèbhe asa rai-haha. ra pangèd'u hua-hètu ne gagoe èci, ho na bhoke babèdho ro'a j'aj'èra dhu marèma na dènge boe too.

source_text: and he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
target_text: lod'o na bhoke nare babèdho ro'a ne, kaca'a laa sèb'u dhu mèdhi guru-guru kalua mai, nuka sèmi sèb'u ai na'e j'ami. sèb'u ne kalua mai dhu kahore-kahore, ca'e la'e asa dedha, ka dedha-liru dènge madha lod'o maroga.

source_text: and there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and to them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
target_text: hèia kabara ae titu kèna, lela nèti d'ara sèb'u ai ne, ka bèbhe asa rai-haha. ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u le koasa mi rèngu, sama sèmi karakarai.

source_text: and it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men who have not the seal of god in their foreheads.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka dènge si, ho baku pa'ele iie j'u'u, aj'u-aj'u, dènge ana aaj'u ètu rai-haha. te ngaa ra hud'i paj'èra ku dhèu dhu dènge boe tadha lamatua ètu katangarèi ra.

source_text: and to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
target_text: lamatua soro tèke kabara se paj'èra dhèu sèra toke d'ai lèmi hèru, te ngaa bisa boe pamadhe si. dhodhoka tao papèd'a di, sama sèmi karakarai tèpu.

source_text: and in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
target_text: ètu d'ara lèmi hèru èèna, rarii aa j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi madhe. masi ka sèmi èèna, ra madhe boe.

source_text: and the shapes of the locusts were like to horses prepared for battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
target_text: ja'a ladhe rupa kabara se sama sèmi jara pamusu. rèngu pake solo kapala musu dhu tao nèti hualaa. rèhu ra sama sèmi rèhu dhèu.

source_text: and they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
target_text: rèu kètu ra madhera èci èèna ka dènge rèu kètu dhèu bhèni. ngutu ra mariu sèmi ngutu singa.

source_text: and they had breast-plates, as it were breast-plates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
target_text: rèngu se oe sèmi pake kodho bèsi ètu sangasa ra. lii kahaku èla ra mèdhu sama sèmi jara sordad'u ae titu kèna dhu ère kareta pamusu ra.

source_text: and they had tails like scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
target_text: rèu lai ra èra titu kèna, aa dhu dènge raco nuka sèmi raco karakarai. rèngu se abhu koasa, ho paj'èra dhèu pake raco ra, toke d'ai lèmi hèru.

source_text: and they had a king over them, who is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the hebrew language is abaddon, but in the greek language he hath his name apollyon.
target_text: dhèu aae kabara se, nuka kètu nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra babège si nèti d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane. ngara na ètu d'ara lii ibrani, abadon, aa madhutu lii yunani, apolion. sasoa na, dhu d'èi pa'ele iie.

source_text: one woe is past; and behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, seli le j'aj'èra ka èci. te ngaa baku pamud'e! te dua j'aj'èra dhu leo era, dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i hari.

source_text: and the sixth angel sounded, and i heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before god,
target_text: ka ana pajuu ka èna tiu tèbhe na. hèia ja'a kèdhi mei hualaa, era dhu pake tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi, dhu patangara dènge lamatua. ka lii èci kalua nèti èpa tadhu ètu kabicu mei èèna,

source_text: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, loose the four angels who are bound in the great river euphrates.
target_text: ho peka dènge ana pajuu dhu heka tiu nare tèbhe na, abhu ana pajuu dhèu èpa, dhu nèbhu nare sange ne'e lèke èki ètu d'ara loko aae èci, dhu ngara na efrat. lamu patabuli eele si!

source_text: and the four angels were loosed, who were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, to slay the third part of men.
target_text: hèia la'e patabuli si, sèna ka ana pajuu èpa se lasi pamadhe dhèu, dhu lèke dènge tèu na, hèru na, lod'o na, dènge jam na, dhu lamatua pama'ète nare le. ladhe èdhi bagi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne mi tèlu kaboko, na, dhu madhe, ca kaboko.

source_text: and the number of the army of the horsemen was two hundred thousand thousand: and i heard the number of them.
target_text: rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, sordad'u ana pajuu dhu ca'e jara pamusu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dua ngasu juta dhèu.

source_text: and thus i saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breast-plates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions: and out of their mouths issued fire, and smoke, and brimstone.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi sordad'u dènge jara ra. sordad'u se dhu pake kodho bèsi pa'abhe sangasa ra. kodho se nuka, dhu mea gèu-gèu, mangèru kale'e, dènge karara oe sèmi èi nasu. rupa kètu jara se, sama sèmi kètu singa. nèti hèb'a jara se, kalua ai, sèb'u, aa èi nasu,

source_text: by these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
target_text: ho hia j'aj'èra tèlu rupa asa rai-haha, toke dhèu ètu rai-haha ne madhe aa'i ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko.

source_text: for their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like to serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia jara se lasi paj'èra dhèu pake hèb'a dènge rèu lai ra. ètu rèu lai ra, abhu kètu sèmi kètu mege.

source_text: and the rest of the men who were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha, dhu ra pamadhe boe nèti j'aj'èra se'e. masi ka sèmi èèna, rèngu neo boe tèke eele bhabhelu-katub'a ra. rèngu sogo-tagu taruu nidhu aa mèdha-panyau dhu ra tao nèti hualaa, doi pudhi, tabaga, hadhu, dènge aj'u. masi ka mèdha se bisa boe rèdhi ngaa-ngaa, bisa boe tadèngi ngaa-ngaa, aa bisa boe kako, te ngaa ra loe boe sogo-tagu si.

source_text: neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their lewdness, nor of their thefts.
target_text: dhèu se'e ro'o boe loe kahèi nèti sasala dhu leo, nuka sèmi pamadhe dhèu, pake na'i nidhu, tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, aa mana'u pagogo-pagero.

source_text: and i saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhu kapai èci puru mai nèti sorga. ra'i-liru sarimu nare ngi'u na. kètu na dhu poi dènge saroo. rèhu na heo sama sèmi madha lod'o, aa haga na heo èci èèna ka dènge heo ai.

source_text: and he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
target_text: nèngu ne kèpe dènge lalulu sasuri iiki, dhu bhoke tèke. na titu, haga g'ana na ètu d'ara dhasi, haga kariu na ètu dedha-rai.

source_text: and cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
target_text: hèia na pa'oo-parodha, sèmi lii taraa singa. ropa na pa'oo-parodha nare, hèia d'oro lii pagod'o-god'o pidhu hari.

source_text: and when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, i was about to write: and i heard a voice from heaven saying to me, seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
target_text: ropa d'oro lii, ka ja'a neo suri lii padhai ra. te ngaa ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti sorga, peka na, èu baku lolo dènge dhèu lii padhai lula-nèti pidhu d'oro se'e! mage mu suri ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: and the angel which i saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu titu haga calaa ètu dedha-rai, aa haga calaa ètu d'ara dhasi èèna, j'oka ai g'ana na asa dedha-liru,

source_text: and swore by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that are in it, and the earth, and the things that are in it, and the sea, and the things which are in it, that there should be time no longer:
target_text: hèia na subha, peka na, lii dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a! ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu taa-taa! nèngu ka dhu paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, aa isi ra aa'i-aa'i. nanene paie-iie! lod'o dhu èdhi tatae èèna, mamai na oe dètu le.

source_text: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of god should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
target_text: te ladhe ana pajuu lamatua ka pidhu èèna neo tiu tèbhe na, pe lamatua tao madhutu ngaa dhu uru èèna dhèu dhae re'a mèka. te ngaa, ngaa dhu na neo tao ne, na peka le dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na dhu lalau-lalo'o ne. de nanene paie-iie, te lii padhai ja'a ne lèke tare'a.

source_text: and the voice which i heard from heaven spoke to me again, and said, go, and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
target_text: ka lii dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti dedha-liru èèna, peka hari dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, yohanis, lamu ka asa ana pajuu nèti sorga nèi, dhu titu haga na calaa ètu rai-dedha, aa calaa ètu d'ara dhasi. more nèti kacui-aai na, lalulu sasuri iiki dhu bhoke tèke èèna.

source_text: and i went to the angel, and said to him, give me the little book. and he said to me, take it, and eat it, and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
target_text: hèia ja'a laku dènge ka asa ana pajuu ne, manèngi kore sasuri iiki èèna. ka na lii dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, more ho mu'a ka! èèna na d'ara hèb'a èu, rasa kee nuka sèmi dhua nasu oni, te ngaa ètu d'ara kabake èu, rasa pèd'u.

source_text: and i took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as i had eaten it my belly was bitter.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka ja'a sèmi kore sasuri iiki èèna nèti kacui-aai na. hèia ja'a ku'e dènge ka. ètu d'ara hèb'a ja'a ne kee sèmi dhua nasu oni. te ngaa ropa ja'a dhèle, ja'a rasa na ètu d'ara kabake ja'a pèd'u.

source_text: and he said to me, thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and languages, and kings.
